name: Nicole Vasquez
text: Great atmosphere helped by a big fireplace in the middle of the dining room, with a roaring fire. The Moscow Mules are so good here, especially the strawberry  🍓😍 one! Great daily specials and super discounts on your b'day.   Wonderful dining experience. I recommend highly!

name: John Quinby
text:
The Rib and Chop House was another fantastic meal. Our waiter, Dillon, was excellent and very attentive. The food was top-notch and the drinks were mixed well and were not too boozy or not boozy enough.

Our appetizers were excellent, and my steak was absolutely delicious. Overall I give this place a very well-deserved 6 out of 5.

name: Matt Perrone
text: Rib & Chop house is a chain that has a few locations in Montana and other places. It is best known for its meat dishes, but also has a good sized menu. This location in Billings has a super friendly staff, quick prep time and good prices for the portions you get. The steaks are delicious, especially the rib eye (would highly recommend). Be careful as the meats are a little over salted but easy to balance back out with other seasonings.

name: Vicki Anderson
text: Oh my! Ask for Shirley! She is a premiere server AND sings opera upon request...and she's very good! Even our teenagers mouths dropped open! Oh, and the menu has interesting meals along with any regular food your might desire. The cocktails are wonderful, with some fun ones to make your evening...yes, beers and wines galore! Gonna stop there whenever we're in Billings!

name: Nicole Wilson
text: Went for my Dad's birthday, and had a wonderful experience! Dillon was our server, and he really made us feel at home. Great service!!! The atmosphere is upbeat but relaxed, and the food was TO DIE FOR. Overall, a great experience and we will definitely be back!

name: Sayers Strole
text: Great service! Great atmosphere, friendly staff, excellent service, quality good, and great prices.  Had a small wait but the food and staff were on their game. Have been finding restaurants to be taking way to long since this pandemic BS. The wait staff was very friendly and the steaks were cooked perfectly. We will definitely be back!!

name: John Havener
text: The 10 oz baseball cut top sirloin at the Rib and Chop House I ate tonight, was the high point of the month!  A piece of meat with such tenderness, taste and texture I have not experienced in many years.  One of the secrets for the success of the meal was the extremely hot plate on which the steak was served.  Every bite was enhanced by the continuous heat below the tender cut of meat, the perfect seasonings and the eagerness of the staff to ensure that our visit was worth repeating.  It was!

name: Kara Fairbank
text: Always delicious. They forgot half my salad on a to go order and my husband's side salad. I had to drive back across town to get it and they offered nothing else to compensate it.

name: Tyler Torgrimson
text: Great food and service; even though it was packed to the gills and very loud, the servers were on point and as usual, food was excellent!

name: FENGYAN ZHANG
text: We were the second last group and server and host were both super nice, didn’t show any impatience. Foods were delicious. Nice birthday dinner.

name: Joe Callahan
text: Good food, great atmosphere, and pricing is fair for the high caliber of restaurant this is. We eat here almost every time we make the trip to Montana. Servers seemed very well trained during our most recent visit as well.

name: Cyndi Smith
text: We came to celebrate 31 years of marriage. Met with my folks and stayed almost 3 hours. Amazing fare. The steaks were cooked to perfection. Dakota our server kept up with us without us ever having to ask for anything especially drinks. Highly recommend the rib eye. Mom got the steak sandwich. She loved it and it was only $16. Very impressive indeed.

name: Nuteswaimh Kmbnvcisam
text: Great atmosphere, friendly staff, excellent service, quality good, and great prices. We decided to try MT Rib and Chop House and it was excellent. They even brought out apples and yogurt for the baby and I really think that is what kept him entertained and allowed us (and the other sitting near us) to have an enjoyable evening.

name: Zion Ford
text: We ate here while in Billings and the food did not disappoint. My steak was cooked to perfection and was so tender. The baked potato was massive and well worth the upcharge. Our waitress was great and even helped me with finding some sights while in Billings. Everything was great.

name: Billye Dahl
text: Great service! Had a small wait but the food and staff were on their game. We decided to try MT Rib and Chop House and it was excellent. They even brought out apples and yogurt for the baby and I really think that is what kept him entertained and allowed us (and the other sitting near us) to have an enjoyable evening.

name: Tim A
text: Had the executive lunch.  Filet minion.   Why can't I cook a steak this good! Cooked perfect.

name: Patricia Mally-Haigh
text: The food was great and the wait staff was excellent. My only complaint was that we were with a party of 20 and they gave us a different menu than the standard one. Our "menu" consisted of 7 main dishes and 1 dessert. There was no substituting allowed and no add-ons were allowed. I don't know why our party was not allowed the regular menus. It was kind of bogus. I believe if I was to ever have another group going somewhere for dinner I would not recommend this place.

name: Jennifer Keller
text: Remember back when you could go to the Rib & Chop House and order the barbecued shrimp and you would get a dish heaped with a big pile of garlic mashed potatoes with a deep pool in the center filled with that delicious oil and presented all around the edge were huge succulent shrimp cooked to perfection and the dish felt like an entree and not an appetizer with a skimpy serving of potatoes and a pile of dinky, dry, chewy over cooked shrimp covering it? Those were the days...

name: Darlene Derksen
text: Valentine's dinner was very good. All the people that work there were awesome. Will definitely go back!

name: Terence Reavish
text: Except for one of our orders being completely wrong, we enjoyed our lunch at Rib and Chop. The salads were very fresh, the chicken fried steak massive, and hamburgers delicious. One steak was ordered and it was the least good of the meals being somewhat tough. Still, the servers were great and the food decent.

name: Jacquiline Marry
text: We decided to go to Montana's Rib which was near their Motel, glad we did. Very crowded about 30 minute wait. After we were seated Service was quick. I had Chicken Fried Chicken, which was best I have had, I did have the same at Montana's Rib, Livingston MT., Which was as good. Highly recommend.

name: Hector Henson
text: We eat there all the time, its always been great, the food, the people.  Don't know what was going on. They must of hire rejects this time, service was  slow drinks were horrible. Other wise 4 to 5 stars as always!

name: Jodi Schreiner
text: Fast friendly service. Great food and drinks!

name: Diamantina Quidachay
text: Almost every time my steak comes out perfect and I have a particular way of how I lime my steak. Servers are always jenjoyable even when they slammed.

name: Patty Martin
text: Food was super. Waitress was not quite with us.  Couldn't remember what she was doing. All is good.

name: G S.M
text: Had to come update from my 3 star review because this has become one of my favorite spots in the last couple of years. Staff has been more welcoming and overall on point!! 👏🏻👏🏻 this place has impressed me with cleanliness as well. It may be in my top 3 favs for when I am in Billings!🙌🏻

name: Justin Mclaughlin
text: Great food but the wait staff almost always leave something to be desired. Most of them seem crabby and dont really care if your order is right or not. Recent menu changes added more southern style food!

name: Kayla Redden
text: Busy st Patty's night but good food good service

name: Sabrina Baukol
text: Attended a wedding reception in their private room a few weeks ago. The bride had requested the private room in advance but the night of the event was told it wasn't available and was being used as "storage". In the end it was sorted out and the food was good but the communication definitely could have been better.

name: Bobby Hodosi
text: Great Thanksgiving dinner here. You can pre-order plates and pick them up the day before. The portions were good and the food even better. You can't have a bad meal here. Everytime I've been here it was good.

name: Bill Grunstead
text: Super good food great service

name: Reed Meschke
text: Always friendly and always good food. Get the fried green tomatoes.

name: Zachary Colgrove
text: Extremely good waitress, excellent food. Highly recommended.

name: Holly Riley
text: Jamaican glazed salmon was great!! Fried green tomatoes are always the best. Wonderful server and hostess. Pink moscato was amazing also!! Definitely recommend!!

name: Max Holland
text: Good food great wait staff one of my favorite places to go for breakfast

name: Tammie Holman
text: But our waiter Trent went above and beyond and was a pleasure to deal with even though he was slammed busy

name: Dave Malloy
text: Best steak and rib place in Billings! Popular place, so make reservations.

name: Joe Maslowski
text: Love this place. The wife and I always come out of here satisfied with our belly's full.

name: Stephanie Pyatt
text: Have always had great food and excellent service. You should definitely go for Sunday brunch!

name: Derek Meyers
text: Their food is amazing! Wait staff is very knowledgeable of the menu. Angel P was a great waitress!! Definitely can't wait to go back!!

name: Light For Darkness Ministries & Publishing
text: Very nice professional staff, clean atmosphere,  and the fire was wonderful.

name: Cassidy Jo Schneider
text: Always good. Never let's us down!

name: Dianna Zamora
text: We had a delicious meal with excellent service for our anniversary-cedar plank salmon with garlic mashed potatoes

name: Dan Lee
text: Great energy from every staff member. I had a seared pork chop smothered in blue cheese and balsamic, super delicious.

name: Sean Pearson
text: The baseball steak is amazing always  a good service is spot on

name: cody walter
text:
With everything going on now, we have takeout a couple of nights a week.  We used to order Uber but they were always messing up the orders.  They either missed an item or two or they delivered us someone else’s order.

Rib and Chop has always been the shining star for takeout.  I’m not sure if it’s the management, staff or both. The food is always amazing and it’s always ready when they say it will be ready.  Lots of places say that it will be ready in fifteen minutes and you show up twenty minutes later and then you wait another fifteen minutes.

Order from Rib and Chop if you are looking for a safe takeout option with amazing food!

name: Daniel Swanson
text: Consistently great steaks and pork chops

name: josiah rodda
text: Great steak house in billings mt. Meat is served the way you want it ( which is rare, unless you can't handle real eating meat). Service was quick and freindly even though it was busy. Bill for two people with drinks and dessert was 70 including tip.

name: opsdehcbvm zcadwygjil
text: This place was open and has a variety of non-beef options  as well as a kids menu which was helpful for our party. (Kids meals are served on a take home car tray which they enjoy) I ordered the 6 oz filet medium temp with garlic mashed potatoes which comes with a house salad. The filet was more like medium well. very nice

name: Colby Hernandez
text: Great steaks, reasonable pricing but I personally don't enjoy butter on my steak.

name: Laura G
text: Such great service! Our server got us to try things we normally wouldn't. She was very experienced and fun to work with! We have never had a bad meal here. Fair warning tho, they are very busy on weekends. I recommend making reservations if you do not want to wait. We were lucky and got a table very quickly in the bar. Still a great experience!

name: Jinx
text: Amazing food and Great customer service!!! Their burgers, are so good! Any tourists that visit town need to stop by this restaurant!

name: Rachel Wahlstrom
text: I was visiting in town and went here based on the recommendation of hotel staff.  Our waitress was very kind and my son loved the fact he could draw on the paper table cloth.  I ordered a chicken sandwich and while it did taste good I realized it was raw throughout a portion of it.  The server took it back immediately and the manager did come out.  They apologized profusely and offered to get me anything else but my appetite was gone, for obvious reasons.  They also comped my chicken sandwich (which was the right thing to do).  The rest of the family enjoyed their meals and my sons popcorn shrimp meal came with an astounding amount of shrimp!  Other members in my family got the ribs and clam chowder.  They both were said to be delicious.  As good as they said their food was I won't be back.  Raw chicken is a hard thing to overcome.

name: Trina White
text: First time for Sunday brunch.  Brunch hours until 2pm. Bloody Mary's,  mimosas or screwdriver,  on special deal.  We had the Belgium waffles

name: Mark Critelli
text: Stormy the server was great, but the ribs were no where near the quality I expected.

name: Kegan Krueger
text: Always love a good meal from one of Montana's crowning gem establishments! Best lunch in Billings for a casual business lunch that I have found!

name: Christina Waters
text: Wonderful service and delicious food. Great  place to bring the family or have a date night at.

name: Charles Nepstad
text: Great food will go back

name: Keonte Lucas
text: Loving, caring place food taste fantastic the only problem we had was that my significant others salmon was not cooked thoroughly and she couldn't finish the dish.

name: Tye Brakke
text: First time eating here and everyone in our party enjoyed the food. Reasonable prices and our server was awesome.

name: Charlie Barrick
text: Wonderful staff. Great food. I was stuffed for hours.

name: Tim Mangan
text: Best place I've been to so far on my vacation. Their food is amazing and the service is on point and super professional!! A must if you want great food and friendly service!

name: Douglas Crumpler
text: A little pricey, but food and service excellent!

name: ML G
text: Had dinner here for out wedding anniversary last weekend (Oct 2018) and we were not disappointed.  We had an absolutely wonderful server named Shaylyn (spelling?*) We both ordered the Baseball Sirloin steak medium well, she recommended we order it medium and cut it in half and lay it flat on the piping hot plate they are served in. It worked perfectly and was cooked to perfection.  She was wonderful and perfectly timed at refilling our mixed drinks.  We had the Creme Brulee for dessert and I could have foundered myself on just that alone. It was incredible. Can't wait to go back.

name: Christy Everhard
text: Dakota was amazing!!! Food was awesome and the service was unbelievable

name: Dawn Avent
text: Worth every bite. Can't wait to return!

name: Scott D
text: Recommend dine in!! Had not so good experience with pick up, but Eric took care of us and we appreciate that!!

name: Jody Love
text: Love there ribs

name: Joni Cogar
text: Not only is the food delicious, but our server went above and beyond to make our experience great.

name: Anthony Kasper
text:
Love this place! I always order their calamari as an appetizer.  There steaks are sizzling when they come to your table and I have never felt rushed to eat and get out.
A go to when I and wife want a great steak and date night.

name: Danielle Hicks
text: The food and drinks where excellent but our waitresses was not very great. We have ate at other rib & chop restaurants and always had exceptional service so we were surprised to have a waitresses that wasn't very attentive.

name: Mike Byrnes
text: Great steak and their grilled tuna salad was perfectly do e

name: Steve Hudak
text: Great place for a good dinner and drink.

name: Chris Cross XMF
text: Rib and chop house is the company I work for go to to place to take clients out for dinner or lunch . it's never a hit or miss it's always a hit. The lunch special 15 bucks for a steak and a side ..... I say yes.

name: Morgan Prevost
text: Wonderful service and amazing food

name: Bob Sagit
text: This is the best steak I have had in the last year. I did not take a photo of the steak, but I did see a cool picture of a little kid in a cowboy outfit, so I drew him. Not my best work, unlike my steak which was someones best work. I highly recommend this place to get a steak.

name: Kory Chosa
text: Always excellent food and awesome service!

name: Jenn Keck
text: Great food! Great service!

name: Alison Voight
text: Food was great. Waiter Brandon was amazing. So worth the money

name: Jerbear Holman
text: Amazing waiter Trent

name: Mark Schmidt
text: Finally a great steak. Medium to small lunch special.  Perfect flavor.  Great service.  Just traveling through.  Worth a stop.

name: Johnny Hisaw
text: Great atmosphere, excellent service, and the steak was fantastic

name: Samantha Bretthauer
text: Great atmosphere and food

name: Roy Johns
text: The food was awesome in our waitress was  excellent see you soon again!!

name: Bobbi L
text: Food was great. Servers were friendly, establishment was great

name: AsapTraveler7220
text: Been to this chophouse a plethora of times and yes it is always busy but it's sometimes it worth the wait....well not this time. I must say that the waiter was absolutely fabulous, was quick to grab orders and served us quickly. The table and settings were set up perfect for a big group and the atmosphere was buzzing with a variety of people. This sadly has been the second time I have gotten food poison from this establishment. One was with Salmon and the other was their special the King crab legs. Also, the special was quite expensive for only 3 legs of crab... Anyway my other family members got the same effect and we plan to try one more time or it's 3 strikes your out!

name: gina steele-jorgensen
text: Service was excellent, food was pretty good, only complaint,  people we sat next to.  Extremely annoying.

name: Jerry Mumm
text: Never had a bad meal here. It's our favorite steakhouse

name: Gregory Gregory
text: I was there for lunch during the week with a table of four. The restaurant was busy, but not overwhelming the staff. We were seated right away, and we were made quite welcome. We received excellent service throughout the dinning experience. The menu pricing and selection was great. Several of us picked the "executive lunch" selection. The day we were there it happen to be a fillet mignon with a side. We each chose a different degree of doneness, and they came out together cooked to perfection !! One of us did chose something else and it too was very good. The atmosphere was positive, we had no problem carrying on our conversation. It's set up like a steak house, paper on the table ,  and I knew quality cuts of meat were about to be served. Our dinning experience was great , I strongly recommend this eatery to anyone. So if you're good and Montana hungry for some quality cuts at reasonable prices this is your stop.

name: Annissa Scott
text: $$$ good food and a good atmosphere. Excellent fancy steak house with ahi tuna entree.

name: Greg Church
text: A favorite of mine, especially when friends are in town. Some of the best cuts of meat to be had are here! Definitely a must.

name: Vicki Johnson
text:
I don't think you can ever go wrong choosing the Rib and Chop House. The food is always wonderful and the atmosphere as well.
This would even be a great place to have an employee dinner as it is quiet enough that you can hear each other talk with plenty of room.

name: Tana Lee
text: Always a great place to enjoy a salad or a steak!

name: Christine Nomee
text: The best place for anything!

name: Stephanie Moss
text: Fabulously fun. What a surprise when we were told our check had been paid by the people who had sat next to us at the bar since someone else paid their tab they passed it forward; to us! Wow! We too then passed it forward to another couple dining at a booth nearby. What fun. We live in Spain and are here for my mom as she just had surgery. We have a camper in Torre del Mar Spain next to the Mediterranean Sea and we have on it a bumper sticker from Montana's Rib and Chop House. Good karma always. Thanks oh, by the way delicious gumbo and lobster pot pie. Amazing service wrapped up a perfect night.

name: Joshua Ferguson
text: Great food and nice quiet atmosphere. Perfect for date night.

name: Lee Walker
text: Best steak I've had in a long time; perfectly cooked, great cut & amazing flavor. The staff is friendly and attentive. Nice restaurant but still casual and welcoming

name: Selby Vasquez
text: My wife and I went there for my birthday.  The staff is very accommodating and I received a free dessert and picture that the staff took. It made our day. The lamb chops are divine! The best I have ever had. My wife and I highly recommend this restaurant!

name: Johnny Earley
text: I ordered a burger, a beer and some wings.  Ya know what it was really good. The flavors were nuanced and fresh with tiny subtleties making each dish fresh.  The reason it gets five stars is the amazing service we got.  From being seated to cashing the check the staff was prompt kind and engaging while paying attention to what we were talking about at the table.  Very solid services.

name: Paul Kyle
text:
I had tagged this on google maps before visiting the area, I needed to try the food and it didn’t let me down!
The cheeseburgers taste great and are huge, definitely a great burger!
However the big surprise was the baked beans. I’ve got to say they are the best baked beans I’ve ever had bar none!

name: Adam
text: They were busy and set us up quick with a table. Service was awesome. Food is great and very reasonable. Couple hiccups but the manager smooth things over.

name: Amy Cambron
text: Limited menu still but the food and service were amazing!

name: Monika Johnson
text: Rhonda is the greatest server, never needed to asked for anything. Will ask for her every time we come there. Simple a great employee.

name: Tavi LaRoque
text: Great food! Delicious burgers and yummy mac and cheese. Plenty of screens to watch the game.

name: Betina Auberry
text: Amazingly good!! like always.  We had the best waitress ever! Awesome food and beautiful people. Thank you Rib and Chop house for the Birthday memories 😘

name: J. S.
text: Food was  awesome

name: Les Rispens
text: Had lunch with co-workers. Great burger. Great beer list. Have to come back when I can have a beer.

name: Lucy Melugin
text: We had a great meal! Michael was the BEST waiter!!  It got a little noisy with the larger groups that were in the room where we were.

name: Cody Rambo
text: Good meats served hot and quick. Clean place with a nice staff.

name: Seth Martinez
text: Nice place for date night, or to take the whole family. Good food and drinks, good staff

name: elisabeth Myers
text: First time there and the food and service was wonderful. Very tasty and reasonably priced.

name: Bette Wright
text: Only place in Billings (that I'm aware of) that has lamb chops on their menu. Really good food and friendly service!

name: Kyle Fischer
text: always great food and really good service

name: Nick Robinson
text: This place stepped up big time as we were looking for a backup place for my birthday as the first place couldn't/wouldn't take care of us and Rib and Chops manager said he would figure it out and boy did he. I work across the way and I am definitely impressed with how they took so great care of us.

name: Julie Nordstrom
text: Super food!  Pleasant staff!

name: Clint Peterson
text: Always good

name: Don Johnson
text: The service is always friendly. The food isn't bad either. 😉

name: Heidi Potter
text: Dinner was delicious - the fried green tomato app is a must get! Steak was cooked to order  and deliciously tender and juicy. Atmosphere was upscale but casual. Price was fair for the food quality but it's definitely a higher priced place.

name: jacobablack3
text: We have had our company Christmas party here the last two years. They are always extremely accommodating. The staff are polite, well trained and give excellent service. The food is AMAZING. Thank you all for always making our company Christmas dinner a wonderful experience!

name: Kris Wishinsky
text: Hands down best Prime Rib! Huckleberry cheesecake is heavenly!! Love this place!

name: Fred Beyer
text: Great tasting food, good customer service and a nice dining atmosphere.

name: Archie Spencer
text: Great atmosphere!

name: Erin Helms
text: Always a delicious meal and great service

name: Charlie
text: I have been here twice in one month and Rhonda and Chris B are top shelf servers of this establishment. RnCH is lucky to have them on their team.

name: Justin Schenck
text: Food was decent, price was not. Limited selection of steaks.

name: My Experience
text: Went here for a fundraiser for a guy who was paralyzed in a skiing accident to help him pay for his bills. I never knew this place was even around, until this event. I have to say, it is a nice place, and the food was really good. I get the feeling it is run by people of faith, and have items on the menu showing this boldness. I always support places when people promote Christian faith of any denomination. On the contrary, if I see a liberal or democrat twist, or lack of faith, then that usually, I repeat usually,  is the last time I spend my money there. Not this place. It is now on my radar and I will be back.

name: Beth Pugh
text: Ron our server was above excellent. Dad turned 91 and he treated him like a king. Eggs Benedict with crabmeat and fried green tomatoes was yummy. Whole family was very pleased.

name: Jodi Chavez
text: I ordered the filet mignon and squash casserole. The steak was cooked perfectly, the squash casserole was very delightful and customer service was outstanding. We had reservations and recommend this as this restaurant is always busy.

name: Mike Hallett
text: Fantastic Montana Steak House. Great food and great service.

name: Shannon Arthur
text: Great variety and consistently good meals and service.  Best ribeye I've ever eaten.

name: Jake Bernier
text: Good steaks. During football season on Monday nights 20 bucks for all you can eat wings and beer!! Use uber but enjoy!!

name: Marvin Eubanks
text: Love the food

name: Lee Johnson
text:
Service was glacial. Salads had huge raw onion rings. It was like an onion salad. Garlic mashed potatoes looked like beige stucco. Grilled asparagus were raw. Steaks were the right temp, but two of us had the wrong cut.  Dinner hot plates were filthy. One of us had dirty water and beer glasses.  Beers took so long, we ended up sending them back.
This place has gone way way downhill.

name: Brian
text: The service was horrible but the food was good. The waiter dropped a fork covered with BBQ sauce on my Mom's coat and then was very slow to return with something to try and prevent the coat from staining. While we waited, I got the manager. He said he was sorry and would pay for dry cleaning only. After 10 minutes of bickering he finally offered to comp the meal due to the trouble and poor service. Had this been his first idea this review may have been higher. Since his arm had to be twisted in order for him to make an honest attempt at ending the conflict amicably they receive the lowest score available due to horrible service and horrible management.

name: Caleb Swarthout
text: Pretty good time.

name: Selene Ramirez
text: Bbq shrimp could've been better. Overall was great!!

name: David Reda
text: Good food, full bar. Professional atmosphere

name: Jeremy Woolley
text: Best steak in town!

name: Maggie Fagan
text: Wonderful fast service!

name: David Phelps
text: Great food

name: Linda Smith
text: Wonderful experience 😊 the food was delicious 👌 the service was super great 👍

name: Jeff Loncki
text: Good burgers. They don't serve fireball though.

name: Thomas James
text: Love the steak.  I over do it on my dessert.  Service is always awesome.

name: magean hirschkorn
text: Rib and and Chop is phenomenal. Ron is delightful and the best server we have had definitely worth of the experience. Traditional wait staff is nothing but amazing and we will continue going there and recommending it to everyone.

name: Michelle Judd
text: I have eaten here before and it was amazing. The ribeye just melted in my mouth. So for my birthday, this was my pic. I was so disappointed. The asparagus tasteless, ribeye was chewy, and I mentioned my bday but no cake.😔

name: Sir H
text: Tattoos should be visible on Servers not covered

name: Rodney Gottula
text: Have had good meals here before (previous rating was four stars), but today's service was absolutely inattentive. Empty waters, empty coffees, uncleared dishes, excessive wait time. Sitting right in the middle of the restaurant, not very busy--maybe half capacity--and still ignored. Only decent food keeps this from being a one-star rating.

name: Nate Dunning
text: Bare with me on this. We had one of these in my hometown that was an absolute dumpster-fire, a den of iniquity where good food and cleanliness went to die. That being said, I took my chances and tried the one there in Billings, MT because it was so close to my work location. To say it was ten million times better would be an understatement. Hostess was very inviting, bar staff was busy as calamity, yet still quick and efficient. Even the staff busing tables were clean cut and working hard. I will return and would recommend.

name: Amber DeTienne
text: We were there for a work Christmas party. The service was A++ and the food was fabulous

name: Jeremiah Rooney
text:
Very nice place family friendly. Menu prices are decent. I had their ribs - they were a bit dry for me but they had excellent flavor. Their meat is very nicely smoked.

Lighting was a bit dark.

name: Joan Griffith
text: Had the fish and chips- large portions and very light batter. Very good. Salad was fresh and crisp. Excellent service

name: Jon Verbeck
text: Great food and an awesome atmosphere. Emma was fantastic!

name: Keith Lavachek
text: Excellent service.  Rib eyes and salmon were perfect. Fried greens were tops, better than the Whistle Stop Cafe in Georgia when we were there 3 weeks ago.  A suggestion,  clear the table between courses so the table isn't cluttered. Especially with desserts.

name: Tanner Sousley
text: Great food, friendly staff and surprisingly fast service!

name: Bryan Rask
text: Incredible staff and stellar food. Never disappoints.

name: Grant Wells
text: I arrived just before 4 on a Saturday. Lots of college football on the many screens in the bar. Cocktails were well crafted and potent. The soup of the day... Chicken tortilla, was the absolute best I've tasted anywhere!, I enjoyed the ribs, which are different than I've had before. Marinated 24 hours, then slow baked in their special oven for another 24, then finished on the grill. They seemed a tad dry but the flavor was intense and oh so tender. All of this and great service from the table staff made for a delightful dinner. Thank you!

name: Christina Newell
text: Everything about this place, we love from customer service to their delicious quality food!

name: Clayton Anderson
text: Everything about my meal was perfect!  I only wish that there was more.  First time I have ever ordered a baseball cut sirloin (size and shape of a baseball).  I ordered it medium, and it was perfectly medium all the way through.  It was tender, and did not require any additional sauce for flavor.  Easily one of the top 3 steaks I've ever had.

name: Peggy Sue Jones
text:
8.6.2019

There's a first time for everything and today I was in for a special surprise! The group I was with were familiar with our destination, while I felt like I was on a treasure hunt. Especially considering my sweetie was as confused as I was as to where we were suppose to be. A telephone later, one left turn and we found the rest of our party impatiently waiting at the front of... TADA!!!  Golden Corral.

Expecting to go into a 'be served' style restaurant, I was delightfully surprised to find it was buffet style, much like Home Town Buffet in California. Did I tell you I was a Wyoming newbie? LOL...

While all the rest of the party walked past all the different sections of food, I'm afraid I was lagging behind, because the first station was, of course, DESSERTS! And you know what THEY say. "Life is short, eat dessert first." *sigh

Catching up with the crew, we settled at a table and then it was chow time. Whoa Nelly!! Where did one start? Hmmm... How about a nice cool salad, Done. Then off to the Brazier station for some 'So HOT fried chicken', it was still steaming when we got back to the table. Talk about finger lickin' good. I'm think a certain chicken chain might be in trouble.

Finally, the dessert station. By now I was really full, but... well, you know. How about a little dollop of Banana Creme pudding, Chocolate Mousse, a couple tiny chocolate chip cookies and, I'm now in a food coma.

Is this place worth ALL the hype I've seen on TV and heard via word of mouth? Can I just say YESSSSSSSSSSSSS PLEASE. Will I be back. Just as soon as I recover from the gastronomical delights from today.

**5 Thumbs up.... Highly Recommend.

name: Melinda Clark
text: Couldn't stomach anything but salad. Rolls were cold even when first brought out, and stiff. Tried a few other tastes, but food is not good at all. Kids LOVED that they had cotton candy! Great for the kids. They tried pretty much everything. Soft sever was down, but scoop ice cream was a good alternative. 1 star for me, probably a five star for kids. Depends on taste I suppose.

text:

The customer service was outstanding tho, every person that I spoke with was very nice and very helpful. Our waitress's name was Jordan and she was just wonderful.

name: Dennis Johnson
text:
The positive- Good, tasty food. Food that should be hot, is hot. Servers are friendly and helpful. The negative- Maybe they are/were under staffed on the food lines and kitchen because when we went in at 3:40p there were 17 empty serving containers from salads, main course to dessert. As well the serving areas were not kept cleaned up. Not very inviting. Not the usual standard for the Golden Coral chain and not at all like ours in Casa Grande, AZ.   Several customers complained among themselves. After 4:00 things filled up and looked a little more normal. We wont be back.
3 day tourists from Arizona.

name: Michael R. Wilder
text: My family and I have been long time customers of Golden Corral, especially since we've had kids. I mean what better place to go where everyone can get whatever they want, and as much of it, for such a great price? Answer? Not many other places. I wish that I could leave it at that, but I'm afraid I've had enough unpleasant experiences with our local Billings, MT restaurant in the recent past, to be motivated to write this. This store has been poorly managed for quite some time now, and I think it's a crying shame. Every time we visit, the place is woefully understaffed, cleanliness is less than good, the food selection is everything from cold, past freshness time, and or just plain missing, and that is from the salad bar to the deserts. For example, our most recent visit was tonight (1 June 2016) at about 6:30 PM. There were items that were in sore need of replacement/ replenishment and in the case of the ribs, which are part of the monthly promotion, I was told they were out of them entirely, and it was still almost 3 hours before closing! The desert area, being managed by only one person, was a complete disaster, from the lack of several items, to the cleanliness, or lack thereof in this case. Our server was nice enough, when she finally got around to coming to our table. We were very close to being done when she finally came and refilled our drinks and cleared away all the plates that had accumulated. I have spoken with a manager before, and was basically placated with words, but little else. It is at the point where we are going to have to stop eating there, and that will be a sad time indeed, as we really do want to love the place. I think the owner(s) should take a good, hard look at the management team and seriously consider replacing them. I saw the 2 who appeared to be on duty a couple of times tonight. One was apparently in charge of the kitchen, though not doing a very good job considering all the things that needed attention, and the one who was apparently in charge of the floor, was more interested in walking around with a clipboard with some checklist or other form on it, than she was in actually helping the employees who were in serious need of it. When we walked in, there was one employee working the drink/ register station. There were 2 groups ahead of us and at least 3 behind us, and this poor girl was struggling mightily to replenish the sweet tea, get people their drinks, and take their money, and I saw the blue shirted floor manager walk right by as though there was no line or anything needing her attention. As I said, this store is in severe need of a management change and perhaps an employee morale booster of some type, and hopefully it can be rescued and we can return to enjoying our visits to what should be a great family restaurant.

text: I have never seen a store ignore their customers with so many people. People will see you, but will not stop talking to their co-workers long enough to help you. And you may say, "what do you expect from kids?" Well it's true that the older staff work harder on the whole, but they start to fold and sort and don't look up to see you even standing there. Just for fun I watched one staff member fold for 20 minutes and then went to another area. Never even saw me standing there. Online shopping is killing your business. When people come to your business they want to touch and feel the product and interact with knowledgeable staff. This is how you beat online shopping. If you don't do that, we don't need you as a consumer. You have an aesthetically pleasing store, just not interactive one.

resp.text: Hi Troy, I'm so sorry you had a poor experience and that your visit fell short of what Dillard's hopes to convey to all of our customers. name: Bree Cole
text:
Last night around 10pm. My boyfriend was the only person in line. Ordered a Bacon Quarter Pounder with cheese combo and an extra Coke. I just opened the box, excited for the burger he paid extra for because I was craving bacon, to find a burnt burger with pickles on ketchup on it.
I'm so disappointed. I've worked fast food and understand how hectic it could be but this is sad guys. He was the only person in your drivethru. Do better

name: Kevin Stalker
text:
This location used to be great, but has really slid over the last couple of years in every area. Our order was in the drive thru. My wife had a long wait for the food, and when she arrived home, we were missing items. My son ordered chicken strips and my daughter ordered the nuggets, but as you can see, the strips aren't worth the extra cost since they are the same size as the nuggets. My burger was pretty dry and the lack of condiments didn't help it out any.

My wife called to complain and they're going to refund the money on the missing items, but it is highly inconvenient that not only did she not get her dinner, but we have to go in-person during a six hour window to get the refund.

text: Is it me or is McDonald's getting worse and worse? I keep giving them chances over and over again. This time I keep switching between the two McDonald's the one on Main Street and the one on Main Street and wicks. This time I went to the one on Main Street in Billings Montana I went there because I had a free coffee. I was in a hurry so all I wanted was a simple burger and my free coffee. At the place where you ordered I said I had a free coffee card so I ordered a medium mocha latte cold and I wanted just a cheeseburger they told me I owe them $4 and some change by the time I got to the window to pay I was in such a stir I couldn't figure out what was going on because you know they have the dollar menu? So I get to the window all in Astor and I asked the lady why is it $4 and some cents and she said oh because you haven't given me your coffee card yet that's free and I told her she should have told me that over the talk box. So it ended up only costing me a dollar. All of this for nothing. Next I get to the window where I'm supposed to collect my food. Everybody was nice they handed me my free coffee and a bag with my cheeseburger in it I'm assuming my straw was in the bag like it usually is. I take off go around the corner get to the stoplight that heads on main street. I reach in the bag to get my straw so I can drink this medium drink that has whipped cream in it and guess what? I bet you can guess no effing straw!!! I was pissed! This is not the first time it's happened I was so angry I almost turned around drove back inside and swim them all back on the counter and ask for my money back. But I was on a one-way Street and I didn't want to go all the way around again because I was so angry I knew that's what I would do. I'm not going back to McDonald's again. I have given them so many chances I've been talked to by the manager she's tried to help I love her dearly but I'm done. Goodbye McDonald's.

text: I am so frustrated right now. What lead me here is the fact that I can't call the store to find out if the phones I ordered have arrived. I have called the cable and mobile side to get a number to the store... noone had a number! I voiced to the kind associate my concerns and she was able to put in a complaint for me. I was still not satisfied which brings me here, writing this review. This is so inconvenient for the customers. I have visited this store several times and every single time the wait time was over an hour. I witnessed 3 customers leave due to being skipped, long wait times, and the difficulty of signing in. I realize the shortage of employees and things are difficult due to the pandemic moving in. However, that does not excuse the unprofessional behavior I have seen within this store. The last time I was there a gentleman walked out after waiting so long and was skipped. None of the employees apologized or help make his wait time a better experience. During that same visit an employee totally ignored my visit to gossip about a former customer that was there inquiring about her phone. In my opinion, that was very unprofessional. The wait time in general is outrageous! The sign in station, at this store isn't drawing enough attention to the customer. Myself and other customers have seen pass the station not realizing it was there until later, noticing another person using the station. It is a hard to use station for the elders to follow. When I first used this station I was unsure how to move to the next page. I can only imagine how it must be for someone who isn't familiar with computers to understand the next step. I am a very patient customer however this has took me over the edge. I hope Spectrum makes changes and considers this as feedback to make their customer's experience a better one. Thank you for your time.

text: First trip to Redneck Pizza. We had broasted chicken and pepperoni pizza. Chicken was very moist, pizza was tasty and crust was nice, neither very thick nor thin, and we appreciate the slight charring. Meals arrived a few minutes apart but was done so that both were served while very hot. Overall food was good. Price was a little high, though not too bad. Dining room is simple and not, as one reviewer claimed, odd or politically driven (insert eye-roll). Suggest that menu should remain stagnant. Pictures fading in while trying to read the menu screen is frustrating. This, combined with unfamiliarity with the food choices (reference opening statement) made ordering take several minutes and seemed to annoy cashier. I chose to look beyond it, but my 16-year-old commented to me that he felt the interaction was unfriendly.

text: I posted a review of Redneck Pizza a week ago, and it was fairly harsh, as I didn't get what I realize was now was unusually high expectations. I was originally dissatisfied that I couldn't get the pictures I wanted for their delivery, but in reality, I shouldn't have expected the delivery driver to, in a sense, pose for me. Their food has been nothing but exceptional, for the most part, as I've ordered pizza on one occasion, chicken wing extravaganza(my word) another time, and lastly,  a couple sub sandwiches with potato wedges. Give them a try, you truly won't regret it!

resp.text: Darrel, appreciate your feedback, sorry you didn't care for food or the service.  It is clear you were looking for something special for  your review, not sure that is how the program is suppose to work, but you're the one doing the review.  As for the driver's photo, if he doesn't want it taken, that is his choice.  You are correct, three hours is plenty of time to complete a delivery, not sure why you wanted us to spend three hours on your order.  It was delivered on time, it was hot and it was what you ordered.  Seems like you are using your posts to get special attention.  We appreciate all our customers and their feedback. name: Stranger Danger
text: Speed of service was good. I had the Philly cheese steak and breaded mushrooms with ranch. A $5 order of mushrooms consists of 9 mushrooms. Mushrooms tasted good and were crisp. However, the ranch was god awful had a sour and tangy taste that was quite offputting. Cheesesteak was quite skimpy and blah. The meat had no seasoning. The strongest flavor I got out of the sandwich was from the edges of the bread that was charred. Despite being the only dine in customer I was not asked how the food was or if I needed anything else. Just dropped it my table to never return. The decor is odd at best with signs saying that there is going to be praying and customers packing guns mixed in with some duck dynasty memorabilia. I am not anti gun or anything but I go to a restaurant to eat good food not be exposed to somebodies political and social ideology. My advice would be to spend some more time learning to make good ranch dressing and putting basic seasoning on food rather than plastering the walls with your views on sociatal issues. Maybe take a second to check on your customers after they are served.

Even an hour later, someone will recall and take NOTICE to ask how my drink was, whatever it was they gave me. LOL! There is an attitude of 'holier than thou' in enough of the world today. I have had about 3 bad experiences here (and have only be here 3 times). The last time was enough to make it a bad review. I watched a car 2 cars ahead of me pull away. As I was waiting to be next o saw that same car pull up to the front door. I witnessed the drive through guy go out and swap drinks with her (assuming she got the wrong drink). They both had 2 straws in them. He came to the window, handed us our drinks and we pulled off. I noticed my drink had two straws in it and my husbands didn't. I looked closer and there were obvious lipstick marks and spit marks on the straw! He handed me the drink he swapped with. How do you think she knew it was the wrong drink?! I went back in to let him know and he admitted to it.

That is disgusting?! Flu season....NASTY.

text: Reese and Ray's IGA is a grand and simple grocery store. Seemingly never crowded, but with two seriously great extras that no other store on the planet offers, and I mean that sincerely. #1 They have the best deli, but beyond that, the BEST fried chicken period! Their awesome staff are quick, and offer a great special every day of the week. From the chicken--yes that is 1st--to the homemade pot pies on Monday, fish, ribs, and the list goes on. #2 Their bakery is fabulous! I don't know what they put in the flour, because the treats are delicious bar none. Actually I think they put their Love into everything they make. Whatever they do, it is a winning combination. I'll see you there tomorrow!

Went back again today, 6/12, and they forgot the ranch again, but charged us for it.  Also the person in the drive through was super rude and creepy.  Will think about ordering from them again...

We try this place off and on and it usually disappoints us...never fails, once again.  We ordered a small taco pizza today, the staff member told us it was a 10" pizza.  Went to pick it up, looked 8" at the most, he didn't know how big it was supposed to be and gave us $1.00 off.  I mean COME ON.  Still a joke!

resp.text: Jennifer, we apologize for your inconsistency via drive-through, although your first ranch is on us/per item.  Bigger orders, and extra ranch's cause for extra charges.  We understand you should not have to ask, but always please feel free to ask if you are unknown for your charges, and never hesitate to ask for a manager.  Please ask for a manager if this does ever happen again, we hope it does not.

Derek,
we apologize for your pizza recieved.  I had spoken with both staff members who were working, and neither of them had received a complaint or questioned any of their tables. text: What an awesome ticked away location! The camping looks really quite and private, tucked in the trees along the creek. Plus the small waterfall is right outside the campsite! There's a great moderate, wide trail that you can hike until you're tired. The sweet shop in Phillipsburg has the biggest and best candy selection in Montana but they are closed on Saturdays. If you take a left at Porters corner and go 16 miles you can spend the day searching for Sapphires at Gem Mountain.

text:
It's nice to see it open and it seems to be doing well.  Decent crowd on a Saturday, families, couples, live music. 4 of us had dinner there.  Sirloins, strips and prime rib were very good. My 10 ounce prime rib was probably the most flavorful I've ever had with only small pockets of fat and crustiness or grissly tissue than other prime ribs I've had at other locations. I usually order up sized on prime rib expecting lots of waste...hardly any on my plate!   Done to rare/medium rare it was very tender and juicy. Others at the table said the same of their steaks, my husband's was done more than he liked at medium request,  but it wasn't dried out and tasted fine.  He had the shrimp/steak combo. Shrimp was, well, breaded shrimp.  Service was great overall... server only brought 3 out of the 4 salads, but she kept our drinks filled and even after we paid the bill,  she came around asking if we still wanted anything to drink.  It was busy so we can't knock that!  It's nice to see all the game mounts, including several African plains game.

Seating in the main bar hall was scant so the bar was very crowded.  A few more high/low tops or at least more comfortable sofa combos wouldn't hurt. Standing room only at the bar. People were stacked 2-3 deep.

Great ride to eat location that we'll come back to again soon!

text:
Excellent place to stop while driving up or down I-90.  Great place to stretch legs and see some history. It's really a gem of an experience knowing you are standing at the confluence of the biggest river in the USA and all of the history that goes with it.

The pay station was unattended.  There is an outhouse bathroom by the pay station.   Recommend walking the mowed trail that goes by the old hotel. .  Kids enjoyed the park. We stayed about one hour total.

name: William Thorburn
text: The campsite itself is not much, but for any L&C fan, the park is a must see.  Located just north of I90, it is an easy visit.  Hike to the top of the rock where Lewis wrote down his observations of the Headwaters.  Downstream is a nice park that has great information on the evolution of the Headwaters.  Finally, take a dip in the Madison where the Jefferson enters and go back 215 years ago, the Gallatin saying hello about a mile downstream to form the Missouri.  5 Stars for the L&C experience; 4 stars for the aesthetics of the campsites.

text: There is something magical and sacred about the three major rivers coming together to form  the longest river in North America. There are various short but very interesting trails to hike. If you are a bird watcher its a treasure and a must see. The confluence of the Madison and Jefferson is great enough but then you have the Gallatin river joining the other 2 rivers only 1 mile further downstream. There are restrooms, picnic areas and benches placed around the park. There is even a small cave with a couple of  pictographs in it, that is well marked.

The memorial is above the open pit mine that replaced the underground mines that dotted the area.

text:
Avoid at all cost (until they get things fixed up).  Pool smelled nasty, was very cloudy, and slimy which caused us to slip on the uneven floor and stub our toes.  The hot tub was great at first but by the second night smelled like the pool (people weren't showering between them).  Neither the pool or the hot tub appeared to have any chlorine (which would have prevented the slime).  The AC in the rooms wasn't working even after they had fixed it (The AC is for the whole building they don't have individual units like most hotels) (sweated all night long even with a fan).  The outside door slams shut unless people hold it until it closes which reverberated through out the room all night long as well.  I think I maybe got an hour of okay sleep in the 2 nights we were there.

Pros: the staff are friendly and the hot tub was 104 degrees.  The beds are alright and some of the pillows were extra fluffy.

Cons: Wouldn't have stayed there in the first place if I knew we wouldn't have a clean pool.  The bathrooms are tiny.

Oddest Con: The key-cards stop working a lot while we were there and getting into the building could take up to 8 swipes on the door.  This wasn't isolated to just us as we saw a lot of people waiting with luggage outside of their room as one person ran to get new key-cards (the key-card never even worked for many).

name: My Experience
text:
I left this place to eventually stay at the nearby, LA QUINTA.
I originally was set to stay here (DaysInn), but it was fully packed, and several events made me, as a man, feel unsafe for my family who was also traveling with me. I was eager to sit in the hot tub, so I drudged on. Degenerates of society from Canada, based on the plates on their cars, were outside in the parking lot screaming at each other, “eff this, eff that”, half expecting them to go to blows. this was happening near the side entrance door, and near my room window. I have such a low regard for Canadians and these guys were proving why, with each new word they spoke to each other. My minor son could hear every word these fools spoke, or yelled. Ultimately, I ignored And tolerated that like a good soldier does. While trying to find a parking space, one customer hauling a motorcycle on a trailer took up literally 6 parking spots with his car/trailer, including the handicap spots. Ugh. Shrugged it off, but was highly annoyed. Inside the hotel, i sat my belonging downs, went to lay down on the bed after a hard busy day of traveling, and realized the top sheet was neatly placed over a bed. When pulling back the comforter I realized the bed was not freshly changed sheets. It had wood chips in it, or debris, and looked recently slept in and just covered up. The room server had not changed them out, but merely “made the bed”. We had a great rate, and it had a hot tub. Well, in talking to the desk clerk, it did NOT have a hot tub, but a few rooms had jetted tubs in them. That was it. I told my wife, we are leaving.

Got our money back and went to LA QUINTA which was close by, and a little more cash, but well worth it. The lot was half full with ample parking, best of all, the facility had a hot tub, kind staff and clean more inviting rooms, and nobody was screaming at each other. I regularly carry concealed, but I felt I didn’t have too here.

text: I stayed in late December.  Friendly helpful staff. Masking followed. Clean rooms, comfortable beds & pillows.  Grab & go breakfast. If you need anything for your room beyond linens, just ask staff.

resp.text: Thank you for the review, we hope you will choose us again on your next adventure to Yellowstone.

text: Rooms are clean and staff is nice, and steps to fight against covid have been taken. Very pleasant night at the Super 8!!!

name: Trudy Trowbridge
text:
We spent a week here at Super 8 n it was really nice n clean. The stuff was very friendly n very courtesy the stuff also like our dog. Its a very friendly dog Motel.

They always had coffee on in the office. You can sit at there patio n see some elk feeding right across the street or when u take ur dog out to potty u can almost walk up on a elk feeding in the back , like I did one time . lol.

Over All this is a very nice motel n is only 5 miles from Mammoth hot spring in Yellowstone park.

We would stay there again for sure .

This elk is at mammoth hot springs one of many u will see .

Thanks super 8 for n amazing vacation. Hope to see u again .

resp.text: Hi Czarina, thank you for taking the time to leave us a rating - we are grateful to hear from our guests and how they experience their time with us. We agree with you about the furniture - our bathrooms are going to be renovated this fall. Susie GM

name: Rhett Gibson
text: The loud Banjo and singing  started at 11:30pm.  I called the desk and they said when they booked their room they were told they would be able to play all night and there was nothing they could do.  They offered me some ear plugs.  - to update, the music stopped at 1am.  In the morning,  I asked for a refund, but they refused.  The music was actually pretty good, if it makes a difference.

name: Benjamin McGaugh
text: The checking staff at night (Brewster and Justin) were very hospitable and assisted in providing directions and assistance during our stay. In addition, the pool was great for the kids. Unfortunately, the morning/daytime staff wasn't as friendly when you asked them questions. And, if they run out of an item at breakfast, don't ask; it will not be provided. Great little town to play in Yellowstone National Park.

resp.text:
HI Benjamin,
I know this is a very late response but the hotel is under new ownership. We now have a HOT BREAKFAST in our beautiful new breakfast room (where the pool used to be). We have also upgraded all of our rooms .... hope to welcome you again some time.
Susie,
General Manager

name: Melissa Hammond
text: Friendly staff, good breakfast, the only downside was the hall way  didn't smell very good.

name: Completely_ Sideways
text: Firstly, the bathroom was atrocious, beard trimmings on the counter and obvious piss stains on the toilet seat. The shower doesn't drain correctly so you stand in a lake as you shower. The rooms have only cold to the feet laminate flooring, no carpet. I've never encountered that before and I stay in hotels at least twice a month for work. Pray you have courteous neighbors as you will be able to hear EVERYTHING that goes on around you thru these paper thin walls. Also the rooms have those hyper white LED lights and besides there being some eye strain trying to work or read it just doesnt feel cozy or comfy AT ALL. Keep a crooked eye out for vagrants here in the hallways here too, the fron desk will lie and say the outside doors lock at 11, but you can mosey on in at any old time. Severe atitude problems at the front desk too! I will never be back here.

text: Great exhibits, good to see multiple animals in the exhibit at once!

name: Ross Wilson
text: This is a great place to come and see some captive wolf, bear and otter. Plan to spend 2 hours at each visit. The admissions office include admissions for two days in a row, so plan accordingly. Kids will love this place.

name: pelican antics
text: The people at this center genuinely care about what they are doing, and the animals that are there. My only criticism is that the information on the plack's needs to be updated.

name: Renee Barauskas
text: Really cool place. There are otters, birds of prey, bears, and wolfs.

name: kristie rose
text: Fun little spot! Worth the stop

name: Brian DiVasta
text: Very nice educational center; rotates different bears through the habitat during the day so you can see more than a few bears during a visit (which includes 2 consecutive days of entry). The wolves are in separate enclosures of 2, and were pretty active late in the day when we went. The staff are knowledgeable and the chats and presentations are well delivered and informative. Considering the work they do, it is well worth the price of admission.

name: Lauren Howard
text: I got to see bears! #GoBears!  Super nice gift shop.

name: Emily Cox
text: If you are an animal enthusiast, this is the place for you.  There is a lot of education on the animals here.  We went during the winter, so a lot of the programs they have aren't available until summer.  My 6 year old did the keeper kids program,  where he went behind the scenes. The program included an educational talk from one of the keepers first,  then he was able to go into the bear enclosure and feed the bears.  Of course while none of them were inside.   The only thing that could have made that better, is if I could have gone into the bear enclosure.   We also really enjoyed the river otters.  They loved interacting with my son.  I hope one day they add in a mountain lion.

name: Jeffery Hill
text: Awesome place. Beautiful exhibits of Grizzlies, Wolves, and Otters.

name: Beverly Mae Pickett
text: Absolutely a wonderful and informative place to visit!  I heard the wolves howling before the doors were opened, just calling for you to visit.  Grizzly bears were wonderful to watch.  Majestic huge animals. The wolves were playing hide and seek, but when you saw them they were just magnificent!  Museum is a must to visit, as well as the gift shop. Be prepared to do some walking and watching.  Highly recommend a visit.

name: Sai Rama9
text:
This is non profit organization who maintains wildlife at WEST YELLOW STONE Village. I have visited this place 9Nov2019 from Helena through HIGHWAY 287 via BOULDER and ENNIS. This route is one of the beautiful scenic drive I have drove. Adult entrance ticket is 15$. Senior Citizen ticket is 12$. Very few wildlife exist here. I can see American eagles, red trail eagles, 2 Bears, 6 Wolfs, 2 Big Owls. I am not delighted with the number of animal collection here.
They have to include some Bisons, Mountain deers, FOXES, mountain tigers etc...
The gift  store is big but overly priced. Not purchased any item here. The staff is nice and customer friendly.
I am excited to see the bears here. They are fighting and playing with each other

name: chad harvey
text: Cool little zoo.  Sam was impressive. People were very nice there

name: Stanley Olsen
text: Would give a higher rating except their little mask nazis will pass you off.

name: Sasha Ivanov
text: It was great, yet not alot of selection of animals to look at yet still interesting and the giftshop was fun

name: Sam Muller
text: Really cool place. They have birds wolfs,bears, otters, fish. Plenty to see. Worth going!

name: Dawn O'Donnell
text: Love the the Grizzly & Wolf Discovery Center. Awesome gift shop. Everyone should stop and see the animals.

name: Mark Cybulski
text: Great place to see grizzlies and wolves also a great place to see some birds a few river otters great time can't wait until we get back to normal out here

name: Cassidy Pfaff
text: Incredible place, very educational and amazing to see. Great info on each individual animal and their personalities and stories.

name: Chris Kay
text: Displays were very well done. No breeding. Habitats are improving. Good information on the animals. Aviary area should be larger. There should be more hand sanitizer stations.

name: Brandi Boysun
text: GWDC is the perfect place to observe grizzlies and wolves in a safe, educational environment! We learned that grizzlies CAN and DO climb trees. We watched a grizzly fish a trout out of the pond on exhibit. We also heard wolves howl and watched the new wolf pups play to seemingly establish hierarchy within their pack. The naturalists are more than willing and able to answer any and all questions you may have about all animals at the facility.

name: Tim Burger
text: There are Grizzlies and wolves that can't be released back in to the wild,  along with some awesome birds of prey that can't be released into the wild.

name: Katy Deaton
text:
This is a really great place. To be able to see these majestic creatures up close and watch some of their natural behaviors.
They have a schedule of the different animals coming and going. They have chats about the different animals. They’re also working on a water venue.
I don’t like to see any animal behind gates, or in a zoo like atmosphere. Although these wolves, bears and birds were rescued from some pretty bad situations. So I can’t complain. Also to be able to do research and learn more isn’t always a bad thing.

The keepers of these babies do a lot of work to keep them stimulated and hide their food and snacks, so they can do what they would normally do in the wild. Forge for food. It’s so cute to watch.

name: Gabriela Adams
text: Amazing. Great exhibits that allow close viewing of all the animals. The staff is super informative and nice.

name: Davinia MacTaggart
text: This place does such a wonderful thing by taking in these beautiful animals and it's a cool place to visit.

name: Joy Heldt
text: Great place to visit. Wolves will howl in late afternoon. Any bear, wolf or eagle enthusiast will love it.

name: Shanice Luciano
text: Nice wildlife to view. Slightly expensive for how small it is but very educational

name: Skip Morris
text: Great animal habitat brown bears, grey wolves, river otters, ground squirrels, birds of prey. The people working there are very knowledgable about the people at the habitat.

name: Ashlei
text: Wonderful place to visit, the gift shop is nice too. Love seeing the animals out an about not just sad.

name: Matt C
text: Great place and ALL animals were very active unlike a typical zoo experience.

name: Anand Joseph
text: We were there for about two hours. We did see about four different grizzlies and two wolf packs. It was fun to look at a grizzly bear trying to open a bear proof food container.

name: Stephen Pedersen
text: We had our rehearsal dinner here for our wedding the following day. The owner (I assume) was very helpful and accommodating for my parents. The venue was unique and incredible, and the staff was very friendly and helpful all night. Not sure if they will continue to do events, but worth asking about.

name: Jack Rollett
text:
Well managed ... awesome ..
I saw bear first time here

name: Chad Knutson
text:
Amazing place to visit and learn something new every time ..
Also seems to be always expanding..

name: Scott
text: Really enjoyed the center and want to go back!

name: Richard Todd
text: Smaller than expected with more animals being rotated through moderate sized enclosures.  Animals seemed happy enough though and they did quite a bit to enrich the environments between rotations so they didn't look bored and had something to forage for.

name: Eben Howard
text: Great place with rescue animals given a good home.

name: David Shields
text: Great exhibits.

name: Hadley Youbles
text: This is a very cool place to see and learn about grizzlies and wolves. Seeing the aspiring bear proof coolers and trash cans is very interesting and a good reminder to be smart and safe in bear country. It3s always a little sad to see wild animals in captivity but they are there for a reason and seem pretty content. They are cared for by a knowledgeable staff.

name: Tony Geiser
text: Fun place to see amazing wildlife.

name: Belle Smolczynski
text: Absolutely love this place!! Always have

name: Deana Hayes
text: One of my favorite places EVER!!! Friendly informative staff,  kids love this place as the animals are so active! Play park for them too! Gift shop is well stocked.  Absolutely GO here!!!

name: M D
text: Excellent educational experience.  Great experience, especially in the winter or shoulder seasons. Kids love it but there is a lot of educational information for adults if you listen to the talks and read the material. As others have mentioned, this is not a zoo. It is a sanctuary for bears and wolves that would be put down or were orphaned and rehabilitating birds.

name: Amanda Reiser
text: If you want to be guaranteed to see a wolf or grizzly bear on your trip to Yellowstone,  this is the place for you! The animals here are rescued and treated with love and respect by the operators. There is also a museum before entering the area with animals which provides details onngrizzly bears. The bears in the outdoor area are rotated so you can see multiple bears during your trip here

name: Larry Lake
text: Enjoyable, always learn a lot. These are not rescue bears just in case you want to know up front. Wolves are 3 packs of 2. Very clean!

name: Roberto Guerrero
text: My grandchildren enjoyed the grizzly and 🐺 adventure

name: RickyThe Gypsy
text: Fun for the whole family!

name: David Green
text:
What an OUTSTANDING presentation!
Well thought out, clean environs for the animals . Excellent videos on the local wildlife.

name: Brian Svilar
text: Great place to see animals up close.  Also a great place to learn about them.

name: John Johnson
text: This is a wonderful opportunity to see and learn about the wildlife of Yellowstone. They have incredibly knowledgeable staff who are friendly and patient with visitors and will explain, share and advise you about your visit. A must see for family and friends.

name: Maria Skornia
text: Not a ton to do but well priced to get to see the animals. Friendly staff!

name: Carlos Báez
text: The gift shop is cool!

name: Dustin N
text: This place is doing a terrific job with conservation and is well worth the stop to see the wolves and the Grizzlys.  They also have some bird of prey including a hawk and an owl pair.  They are building a otter enclosure which will open soon.  This is a good place for kids, they have a playground and lots of areas to go inside and keep warm in the winter. The gift shop is really fun with a giant stuffed bear seat for photos!

name: Anthony Raynor
text: There were quite a few exhibits. Plenty of Photography to be had. Roaming bears and wolves. An educational area. A playground for the kids. Plenty to to do while there.

name: Angela Reeves
text: My Family really enjoyed this place!

name: David Coulson
text: Unusual for me to visit a for fee exhibit and feel I got far more in value than I paid. This is one place. Extremely educational, great exibits. The live exhibits were the weakest bit and still well done. If you're looking to understand bears and wolves and the role they play, then visit.

name: John Bowman
text: What a great place especially for the kids. Our twins loved it. Seeing bears and grizzlies up close was remarkable. HOW COOL is it to also see the cooler testing!!! Thank you Grizzly and Wolf Discovery Center. --John

name: RICHARD CHAPMAN
text: Worth the visit. Not over priced for all you get to see and experience. A must see if going to Yellowstone Park. Guaranteed to see bears, wolfs, many different large raptors, comical little ground critters, and when the Otters area open, that will make it even better. Military discount, senior discount and a good value for a family. At least a 2 to 3 hour adventure if you want to do it right. Great photo ops.

name: Alyshia Schwarz
text: This is a neat place my daughter enjoys coming every year! We recommend lots of bug spray! Especially this year 2019.

name: Mick Kammerer
text: Great place to see bears and wolves. And raptors. Great for kids.

name: Peggy Zeimer
text: This place is great and the river ottar  were great. Love how close you can get to the wolves.

name: Joyce Griffith
text: We loved this place and adding on

name: Russ Rosenlof
text: If you don't get lucky and see a wolf or bear inside the park, stopping here is the next best thing. There are some interesting displays inside, with some history and facts. The bear enclosure is very open for viewing and twice a day they allow younger kids to go in the bear habitat (supervised with no bears of course) and hide Bear food about the area. The bears can then demonstrate their amazing sense of smell and uncover the food. Fun to watch and great for kids too. There were also a few sets of wolves and some large birds. Well worth the $13.

name: Amad Azadi
text: Very nice people,  very interesting

name: Deb Pat Burk

name: Jean Mueller
text: This is a unique and special place featuring the two largest predators in the local ecosystem.  This is your chance to safely see both  Grizzly and Wolf.  They rotate the bears through the viewing enclosure so that they will be awake and active  while they are outside of their living area.  Between different bears in the outdoor viewing area a keeper will hide food and treats in logs and various areas of the enclosure for the bears to find and eat when they first come out.   If you have a child, they can assist the keeper (for a fee) in hiding these food items in the enclosure.  After the treats are hidden, and there area cleared of humans, the bear (s) come out for about an hour and a half.  Watching them search and easily move large objects to get their own good brings an appreciation for their size and power.  Watching then playing together later is also enlightening.  The wolves have a building between their enclosures that allow to get a very close up view as they walk around their enclosures again giving you an appreciation of their size.  It's also a nice place to go see a video about wolves and take sheller from the weather.  There are also some rapters (lathe birds of prey) - these are only shown once a day in winter.  There is a nice museum area that shows the local ecosystem and discussed it's relationships and problems.  All that said, it's a good place for a visitor to the Yellowstone area to get a better understanding of what to watch for in Yellowstone  Park.  And seeing Grizzly bears, Wolves, or large Rapters is a special and rare treat. Your ticket is good for two consecutive days You should use it that way to see different bears and different behaviors at different times of day.  Just drop in and out during those two days!

Great mixed drinks and a ample selection of microbrews on tap to choose from. If you are in Miles City and looking for a place to eat this is the place, if your not in Miles City drive to Miles City and eat here. The atmosphere is also worth the trip!

text:
Great place, great service, great atmosphere.

This amazing restaurant can be seen coming off Exit 138 into Miles City, Montana. The place is awesome. I love their food, and they carry gluten-free buns for those who have a sensitivity to said gluten.

However, this is not a restaurant for those with a low bank account. The place is rather pricey (my bill usually comes out to about $100 for 4 meals and drinks). On any given holiday or event, I would recommend that you reserve yourself a table or you will he sitting in a rather-small seating area for quite awhile.

Keep up the good work, Blackiron Grill!

I eat here every time I am in town. I am never let down by the service or the food. The Skirt Steak Salad with its delectible, tender steak and spinach greens set off with a fried boiled egg, a pickled asparagus, and a few homemade potatoe chips is my favorite, though the brisket is also supremely delicious.

The patrons are also great. I am a combat veteran, and a few days from Memorial Day I was dining here when a patron came by to thank me for my service (I was wearing my  Warriors Wishes combat veteran vest). Later, I went to pay for my meal and beverages and was told by my bartender that it had been paid for.  Supreme gratitude.

name: Haley Cohen
text:
Overall nice campground. Good store and clean bathrooms. The pool is indoor and huge. They have a cool setup for cooking.

The reason for the lower rating is that we had an issue with our cabin not locking and wasn’t happy with how it was handled. I felt the guy who fixed the lock was really condescending about the lack of crime in West Yellowstone. It’s not up to him to decide if I feel comfortable or not having my door locked. The park attracts more than just locals. He promised maintenance would come the following day and they never did.

Without the lock situation, this would have been a 5 star review.

text: Decent KOA. Firewood was inexpensive, and I got two packs of bacon for only $9! Store also had lots of necessities. Our tent site was a little sloped, so sleeping wasn't the best.
