name: JW E
text: Awesome camp ground! Our cabin sat right on the river! We enjoyed sitting out on the rocks and sandy area next to the river. They served breakfast the 1st time we visited but they only offer till labor day I believe. They even made my little girl special pancakes on her birthday! Staff was very friendly. The playground is nice and even offers work out equipment. The hammock park had 2 hammocks but one was broken. The campground does get very dark at night so make sure you bring a flash light if you are wondering around after dark. Overall a great place!

name: Dave Voice of NH
text:
Good location if you are visiting the park. I'm guessing they get filled up more during summer so make reservations if you plan to stay here. Some road noise, but not terrible.I think the rumble strips keep the bears away, which is good for campgrounds with kids and dogs. And as a general rule, if you are driving near this KOA at dusk or dawn, be VERY careful for wildlife wandering out into the road. They will not get out of your way, which is a big problem if you are going 60 MPH.

This KOA: all facilities work fine, nice little putt putt course for the kids, other swingsets and stuff too. Good size sites. Big laundry area. Catch breakfast there any morning, other meals as well.

You will probably be out all day at Yellowstone, and this is a nice safe place to leave your stuff while you are doing so.  This is on the western entrance -- and there are two KOAs here so be sure you are going to the one you planned to.

name: Dale I
text:
Total disappointment.
Relying on the KOA brand as reservations were made, we quickly found out how substandard this facilties is. Listed as having a heated pool, it was cold. Listed as having WiFi available at campsites, it is only available if you are at the main store.  Cabins had electrical but no A/C and cheap portable room heaters that don't work. Public restrooms are in poor repair and the showers that worked (not all) have poor pressure and low volume.
After  coming from sites by Glacier National Park where firewood is free, put-put golf is free, ice is free, internet works everywhere in the park, and they had a spectacular breakfast buffet, Yellowstone Park KOA charges extra for everything while fully missing the mark at all levels.
Understanding that location is king, I don't mind paying for convenience. This stay was a failure. We won't be staying here again and simply cannot recommend them.
Previous to reviewing I contacted the manager of the facility with my concerns. He appeared to be familiar with the complaints and uninterested in resolving issues.
Edit/Add:
Just returned from using the public bathroom. The first 2 stalls I tried to use had broken toilet seats. The 2nd stall I checked the toilet was not bolted to the floor and the whole thing moves.
My bigger concern was the trash. Overfilled, no lid, and is most certainly NOT bear (or any other animal) secure.

text: It’s a beautiful place to stay. Staff was amazing and friendly

name: Robert Capron
text: Little more expensive than anticipated. And they had a lot of seemingly nitpicking rules... No bikes on the hill (inclined portion), no large inflatables in the pool, no climbing/ hanging stuff on/etc the trees. I get that they deal with a lot of tourists, and tourists are accident prone, but it was a little much.  Make sure and make reservations at least a month in advance. It is a great location, has a great setup but a little crowded. It was also pretty full when we came. Staff was nice.

But the rest of the campground is surrounded by Highway or by a water treatment facility, or a hill. The highway is quite noisy throughout the night so make sure you request a site away from the highway.

text:
We were cooking lunch by the fire when a maintenance man came near spreading fertilizer, we took our veggies off of the grill in a pan and placed them next to the fire pit to cool. My dog was tethered to the picnic table my 6 year old playing in the grass, when the maintenance man came IN OUR campsite spreading fertilizer!! Went in front of my feet,  under our table spreading it into our dogs water dish and next to the fire. IN OUR FOOD!
Our 9 month old was just out there playing with toys and he puts everything in his mouth so I told my husband we are leaving to a different campsite. We called and spoke with someone for a refun for just the nite not previous one and he was so rude. Then we spoke with a manager Cody and he just said he was doing his job fertilizing. I was so appalled, and said again my 9 MONTH OLD CRAWLS IN THE GRASS. He said well he was doing his job. I guess im so offended that other children and dogs get to eat poison.

name: Matt Perrone
text: Billings KOA Holiday was the first Holiday KOA ever, and it sticks up to it's name. A higher end RV park, KOA has many amenities within it's community, with lots of space, electric and water hookups, super clean bathrooms and showers, and very friendly staff all over the place. You can check in late as your name and information will be up on the board outside the front office. This location has mini golf and a few other things to do which is great for the family.

text: Tried calling several times, at different times of the day, and no luck.

resp.text:
Hi Jennifer,

We’re sorry you haven’t been able to get ahold of us. Are you sure you’ve been calling the right number? Our number is 406-252-3104. We also have a secondary number that is 1-800-562-8546, and if you’d prefer to text us we have a special line for that which is 406-413-9778 We’re open 7 days a week from 8am - 10pm MST. If you’d prefer to email us you can always reach out to us that way too at billingskoa@gmail.com. We’d love to help you out. Thanks Jennifer, we hope to talk soon.

text: Very nice pools outside. Such a great atmosphere to relax in and enjoy the cool air in the evening. We visited in early spring and it was really nice. The fire features add to the experience as well.

name: Kyle Bigback
text: The facility and hot springs were amazing. The staff needs to get a better control of the younger crowd. I witnessed them drinking alcohol in their water containers, the horseplay getting way out of control outside, throwing snow balls, and water bottles. One lady complaining to the front office that she just got hit in the face with a snow ball. My family and I went back inside because of the behavior that was going on outside in the very low lighting.

name: Ester Sanitarova
text: Great place! My nose usually gets so dry and it bleeds non stop, coming to this place every week helps a lot.  The steam room and the sauna is where my nose heals. So love this place!!

name: Rachel Jentry
text: Amazing place to relax. People were friendly and none of the other guests were unruly. A great place to escape the constant drone of society.

name: Isiah Cooper
text: Prices these days are insane!!! Noone could afford to bring family there anymore.. At least weekly like we used to... If your single and have money to spare its a great place..

name: Elizabeth Johnson
text: When we drove up to the entrance, it was not so impressive. It looked a little run down. But once past the lobby, the facility appeared well kept, clean, and impressive. There are five indoor pools of various sizes and temps, and four outdoor pools in a lavishly landscaped and lighted setting. So relaxing. Very glad we decided to visit. Would love to return when there is some live entertainment in the outdoor stage!

name: Steven Shope
text: This place is great.  A bunch of different hot pools and a great looking gym. Check it out!

name: Jason Obert
text: Haven't been here in years (grew up in Townsend, but been Army for about 21 yrs). Absolutely loved it. The hot pools, cold pools, outdoor pools, sauna, steam room, etc. Phenomenal.

name: Molly Garland
text: Loved this place! Definately will make a return visit.  A little spendy but a nice treat for once in awhile.

name: Troy Stevens
text: Super spiritual place. No real mask enforcement though n don't seem very hands on cleaning in gym or sauna.

name: Olga Stepanov
text: We enjoyed the hotspring the outside are was beautiful,  they have great changing rooms and showers, the inside was good overall.

name: Jennifer Frantzich
text: Hot springs were great, facility clean and nice, fabulous at night. The staff was rude though.

name: Baha
text:
Clean and friendly location. But it needs little bit upgrade.

Entrance is $10.50 and 50¢ for locker. Some lockers doesn't have a key. You do not need to pay for locker if you want.
Showers are comfortable but some of showers doesn't have a light inside. Too dark. No hair dryer at all. You can bring your own flip-flops or sandals or you do not need to use one. Sauna and hot steem rooms are good. But they are not hygiene clean. They have kids stuff for swimming.
Outside pools are great.

name: AŃG FREINER
text: It was nice. Lots of pools. The hottest pool is super hot. You have to get in the cold pool first to get in it. The steam room was nice. Great spot to cleanse out the body.

name: Christopher Olson
text: What an excellent hot springs! I'm a Montana native and have been to most of the hot springs in the state and this has to be one of the top ones. The dressing rooms are clean and spacious, plenty of showers and lockers. The indoor pools are well maintained, clean, debris free. Plenty of room for laps in the large pool, shallow enough on the one end for younger people to play in and consistent temperatures. The hot pools are good sized, allowing spacing between people or even room to stretch a bit and not be rude, and there are 3 varieties of temperature! The cold pool is very cold, which is exactly what it should be. The outdoor pools are even larger and the size allows for groups to be separate and not interfere with noise or crowding. Over all, a great place to relax for an evening.

name: Jen H.
text: Good to visit if you are in the area. Outdoor pools have chlorine; indoor ones do not (but all are from natural hot springs). Temp range from high 90s to 106. The facilities are a bit outdated, and the showers need maintenance, but it is pretty clean for the most part. Staff are welcoming and helpful.

name: arizona storage innCarrie Fabiano
text: Very nice but pricey.

name: Anya Nura
text: Wonderful place, many pools with hot/warm/cool water, it is clean. At night there is beautiful lighting. In the evening there is live music. You can also visit a gym. The staff is very friendly! It's just a great place to have fun & relaxation!

text: Great place ,always a pleasant experience

name: Manuel Bright Wings
text: My family and I love it here! Good place to relax, the hot tubs are hot and the steam room is nice too!

name: Times Chu
text: Lovely place for a long soak. The outdoor pools are very pretty, if a bit overdeveloped. Each pool is a different temperature, ranging from cool to around bath temperature. Inside there are several more pools, including one cooking hot one, which feels great on sore muscles. Note that this place is popular with families, so if you want a quiet experience, come during school hours or later in the evening. If you don't mind the noise, its very nice to soak in the sun in winter.

name: Miranda Osteen
text: Such an amazing place! Will be coming back to visit!!

name: Brett McClellan
text: Excellent facility and friendly staff, i recommend this place highly.

name: Nancy Fred
text: Absolutely fabulous place. Can't wait to come back in the winter. And clean also. Pleasant staff, very helpful.

text: This is a great place but there's always a lot of people which I guess I shouldn't complain about but it's just something to be fair warned about

Besides why in the world would you want to be nickel and dimed to death with how many quarters you need in order to get in and out of the locker. I mean really you're in the water while you want to carry around a bunch of quarters so you can get in and out of your locker? Just charge a little more and make it make it easier for everybody. Waters both hot and cold were good.

name: Amanda Sharp
text:
It's lovely 😍😍😍
Relaxing....

name: Trenton Thomas
text: Very pretty and very clean. The lights in the pool were a nice touch. There's at least 4 outside and 1 indoor pool, 3 of them outside are hot, and a bunch of little hot tubs for everyone. Only reason it's not 5 star is because it was 21$ to get in for one person.

name: Doug Ireland
text: It's come a long way in the last few years but it's gotten to be really expensive at the same time. Me and my 8 year old daughter, and her 7 year old friend and cost $55 dollars for the day. It's way overpriced.

name: Janine Leff
text: It was fun. Relaxing

name: Wyatt Petty
text: A very nice establishment, filled with many different people. The staff is friendly and welcoming. They’ve got a great selection of heated pools as well as a sauna and steam room. If you like to work out, they’ve even got a great selection of equipment in their gym. Their hours aren’t ideal, but it is what it is. If you’re looking for a nice place to relax and take a load off during the weekend this would be on the top of my list for things to do!

name: Kimberly McGivern
text: Loved the springs and all the various temp pools.

name: Justin Lindsey
text: Wow! Who knew this place existed?! Very relaxing and the kids can't get crazy. Can't wait to see the band play and have a beer here.

name: Sean Smith
text: I've been going here since the late 90s early 2000s and it has only grown better! The indoors warm and cold pools were excellent and perfect for my pregnant wife. The new outdoor pools are really fun and very modern! Very family friendly.

name: Denver Spotted Bear
text: Bozeman hot springs is good for the mind, body, and soul... oh, and the aching joints. Several different-temperature pools, outdoor pools, kiddie pools, sauna, steam room, fitness center, and even a campgrounds

name: Jake Gabriel
text: A little expensive for 1.5 hours before they close.

name: Jagd Terrier WillAnderson
text: Natural hot spring water. Feels the same even after 35 plus years of soaking here. Love it!

name: pierre august
text: Its the best best to go after work

name: Darcy Skunkcap
text: Love this place ❤

name: Courtney Glines
text: I grew up swimming here, Barb taught me from 1st dunk to butterfly. I would always tell people to swing through for a great experience. In recent years the uptick in athletes foot, giant jellyfish-esqe air wads, and dungeon-like changing room atmosphere made it harder to support it. The dismissive teens at the front desk don't add much to the experience even though they are dealing with big crowds. I had a membership and was going often, I always felt like I was a huge inconvenience to the folks there. Now with the price hike (meant to limit over-crowding, instead of, ya know....a physical crowd limit) I will be telling people not to go here. Don't waste your time or money unless mean teens and cheese feet are your thing.

name: Tait Sougstad
text: Sauna, swimming pool, and small pools for hot and cold exposure. A great post-adventure soak.

name: Karen Perkins
text: Love to swim here,  this time 2 of the smaller pools inside had stuff floating in them.

name: Josh Howley
text: Steam room, dry sauna, and hot and cold pools were so amazing.

name: Cassidy McDuffie
text: So many pool options. Indoor and outdoor pools, a rainforest room and a sauna. Oh and all the pools are different temperatures. Live music outside is really nice as well. Very fun spot, even though inside can get very loud and steamy. Nice big locker rooms with lots of storage space for your stuff.

name: Bonney McNabb
text:
**Update** See below

Nice experience. Several pools, nice selection of temperatures, sauna, outdoor pools with cool lights and flame decorating on rock walls. It's worth the $10.50 admission fee.

**Update** I've been recommending Bozeman Hot Springs to many people for quite a while. When I hurt my back last year it was Bozeman Hot Springs I used to release those terrible muscle spasms. Sadly, I won't go back. I won't recommend it and I will warn all the people I've recommended it to in the past. I started today because my daughter and her family is here. While searching for operating hours I found the price had doubled. Shame on the family that owns it!

Yellowstone National Park considered doing the same thing. They proposed raising the price so high only the privileged could afford it. In that way a higher class of elites would be the users and few of the rabble would get access. Fortunately, locals could comment on their proposal. They had to shelf that idea.

name: PC Clark
text: What a great facility. We will be back again soon.

name: Mario McCullough
text: Verry nice place to relax only had one issue the swimming instructor on shift was rude to everyone she made the experience not so memorable

name: Anthony Johnson
text: I always have a great time, not so crowded earlier in the week.

name: Brenna Sovine
text: Great gym facilities. Tons of hot pools to choose from with cold pools as well.

name: Ben Kindgren
text: They stopped offering a student discount? Thanks but ill draw a bath at home where only one person (me) can pee in it. Great if you love huffing sulfur like my aunt tho!

name: Samuel Williams
text:
So I have been coming here since 2017 and it used to cost just $8 with the student discount. The hot springs were a great place to come and relax with friends. NOW its **17 DOLLARS** monday to friday and **21 DOLLARS** on the weekends.. and they no longer offer a student discount. The price increase here is totally outrageous, unjustified, and is probably so that locals such as myself will be driven out and replaced with obnoxious tourists going to Big Sky and Yellowstone.

It makes me sad to say that I will NEVER come here again. Thanks for selling out your local community Bozeman Hot Springs. Hopefully you are replaced with a more sensible competitor.

name: Chandra Jennings
text: Super relaxing and a must see in Bozeman! I loved the fact that there were tons of pools to choose from based on temperature and the staff were super easy going. Hung out with some coworkers for a little over an hour and felt amazing afterwards. I definitely would come back!!

name: Tamara Neidich
text: Super nice pools that are family friendly. Staff was quick and courteous even though it was busy. Only complaint was that a lot of the lockers in the women's room were jammed and unable to be used correctly (aka locked) because of quarters stuck in them.

name: Sheldon Young
text: Love this place especially at night after dark. Don't waste your time inside the building when its so much better outside in the hot springs. Still waiting though for them to finish the outside expansion to the property.

name: Dawn M Johnson
text: Absolutely amazing, just not much to do but swim.

name: Bryan Flammond
text: With the covid quarantine starting to open back up Bozeman hot springs has taken great lengths to ensure a safe and extremely enjoyable environment

name: Xin Chen
text: A great place to at night to relax and rewind.  It is ever better if you have company of your friends and family.  Enjoyed the pools of a variety of temperatures.  The hottest pool smelled sulfur, which would be good I figured.

name: Sharing Is Power分享吧
text: Pretty cool place to visit, friendly staff and reasonable price but a bit crowded specially during the weekend

name: Wyatt Wanders
text: This place was great. When I went they had a live band playing and there was alot of people there. They have a great range of different temperature pools and the sauna was nice. Overall I really recommend this place, I had a great time.

name: April
text: Very nicely done hot springs. The outside is pretty and the variety of the pools is good. They have a nice snack bar and also you can bring your own food and drinks ( no alcohol). Would recommend this place.

name: Chet Zaiko
text: A good place for families to go. A bit dated in the main pool area. Almost the same as it was 40 years ago. Still enjoy going there.

name: Mike Giroux
text: Fancy hot springs.  Nice locker rooms.  Good sized pools with range of temps both inside and outside.  Neat atmosphere at night with flames by outdoor pools.  Reasonably priced too.  Great spot.

name: Floyd Morris
text: A little busy,  but we went on a Saturday night.   Seemed like a clean place,  I liked the pools outside better than inside.   Before you go outside,  there is a map of the pools telling you the temp of each one.   I recommend looking at that prior to going out and jumping in.  The lockers in the locker room are coin operated, so be prepared with 50 cents.  Also another tip you can bring water bottles in with you...

name: John Reamer
text: The hot springs are great. The R.V. Sites are also nice. We stayed in the tent section. It isn't anything special, kind of an afterthought. They are near the highway and the main road in, as well as a gravel lot which seems to get a strange amount of traffic at night. There was also a sewer smell every now and then, turns out there was a backup that was being fixed on our last day. Overall it was worth the price for the amenities offered. Breakfast, hot springs admission etc.

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: The prices keep going up. I appreciate all the upgrades to the facility, the outdoor area is just gorgeous.  The guts of the place is what needs some attention.  The water pressure in the showers is SO weak and I feel grossed out walking barefoot in the locker room. For the prices I'd expect someone to maintain the locker rooms hourly AT LEAST!

name: Jim Cossitt
text:

name: winter cherry
text: This place was an experience! The lights and different pools wow! Lots of people but it wasn't awful.

name: Andy Henckel
text: My all time favorite, the hot and cold pools are the best right next to each other, and the sauna.  Loved it when I lived in Bozeman.  Now I stop any time I can.   Outdoor pools and expansion is rockin'.  My only complaint is that they should have a band on that outdoor stage more often than twice weekly for a few hours.

name: Andrew Lake
text: In January the price for an adult was $10.5 now in June after the Covid scare the price has increased to $17 for an adult and $21 on weekends. Money hungry! Greedy!  Even after receiving government assistance with the small business loan during Covid. I will not be supporting this business and its obvious this business does not support the community!

name: Joshua-Luke O'Connor
text: Love this place. Super fun atmosphere and easily the best developed hot springs I’ve been to in Montana. The dressing rooms are clean. It’s incredible family friendly. The live music times bring some added fun to it. The gym is huge and the staff are friendly and helpful.

name: Keith Scheeler
text: Got a cabin at a good price to stay in which was clean with a cement patio with a fire pit and a swinging chair next to the cabin on the porch. Included with the cabin purchase  you got your spa wristbands free. The hot springs had very hot pools and cooler pools to satisfy everyone. I'll be sure to go back!

name: Nick Pinkham
text: I loved this place, but sadly it is not worth $21 a time?!?!? It was already expensive, but come on, really?!?!?

name: jodi hunter
text: Sweet! If your in the area this is a must! Updates are incredible and definatly hand it to Bozeman for this beautiful atmosphere and design.  Go when live music is playing and during evening hours to enjoy the lighting and fired. Great date night. Tip: bring your own water container 👍

name: Greg Griffin
text: Warm pools.  Isn't complicated, exotic, or extreme.  Couple pools.  Lots of fake rocks.  but charging an additional $1 for a towel is crazy.  Also need to pay quarters to store your clothing in a locker. Just give us a towel and locker.

name: Confessions And Lessons
text: Bikini season is in the winter time. The outside area really made it a destination rather than a hassle. You can truly relax there now.

name: Allie Ballensky
text: love going swimming there but I heard that it's super pretty whenever you go at nighttime this one time I actually saw a white and black owl it was so prettyI'm pretty awesome because I was never come out a date they actually come out at night that's amazing

name: Henry Westra
text: Great facility! Good gym with available trainers and variety of weight and workout equipment. Great pools either for soaking or water exercise and aerobics. New good outside pools in front of outdoor stage, they are good soaking pools, but have never been there when a band was playing. Great sauna and steam room. Competitive membership rates.

name: Chaybo 1
text: Busy human soup type of day on the weekend and full of transplant MSU college kids. Great place if your hormones are over flowing...not so great for a grumpy old guy like myself. Ha.

name: Ashley Kejsar
text: We enjoy going here. I wish they had better family changing rooms. The temperature of the water isn't very consistent because they don't check it as often as they used to. We keep going back so it can't be too bad lol

name: Jennifer Henderson
text: Had a wonderful time relaxing and enjoying myself along with my best friend. Love this place!!!

name: Kimberley Geiger
text: The pools are hot and it is beautiful. But it was full of kids in the evening time. There wasn't supposed to be drinking but people were drinking everywhere and their little self brought containers. And I think after a certain amount of chlorine you can no longer call it hot spring water you could smell the chlorine the second you walked in! My skin itched within 10 minutes. But I have to say it was so beautiful to the eyes everything was beautiful there. But in my opinion this is nothing more than a heated swimming pool maybe there's mineral water in it but the amount of chlorine they put in cancels it out

name: Generals Four
text: The outside is quite nice but the changing rooms were terrible. Crammed and not clean, feels like there’s no ventilation.

name: Liz Wallace
text: Locker rooms are crowded. Pool is much cleaner than in the past though. Not very friendly to children here.

name: Russell Lindberg
text: The Bozeman hot springs are amazing, there is something here for everyone in the family to enjoy. From shallow pools for kids and a large pool to swim laps. They also have cold pools to do hydrotherapy. Good range of temperatures for the variety of pools. The facility is very clean and well managed. The pools are drained each night and scrubed clean.  We love to soak in the outdoor pools when it's extremely cold outside.

name: Reed Welch
text: Kinda crowded

name: jhk customs
text: Great place to go relax and enjoy some live music and and soak in some hot water.

name: Mostly Montana
text: A very nice place to visit. We were there during the day middle of the week and it was not crowded.

name: Stephen Seleb
text: The pools range from extremely cold to nice and hot, indoor and outdoor with a stage. How many places can you hear live music while soaking in mineral pools? Some folks are definitely pushing it with their PDA but it is a nice setting outside so I get it. Sauna and steam are major additions and the locker room has ample space. Check hours before arrival.

name: Cheyenne Crooker
text: There are lots of pools to go into, hot tubs, cold tubs, and extra hot tubs. They weren't overly busy on a Saturday night, which was shocking. The outside pools are nice too. The 'wet sauna' was gross. It's the reason I am only giving 4/5, instead of 5/5. It smelled awful and it was pitch dark... doesn't seem safe or sanitary. The 'dry sauna' was good, but it was SUPER hot and crowded. I wouldn't recommend being in there any longer than 15 minutes at the absolute max. The bathroom was pretty reasonably clean, could be better. Overall, it was a good, relaxing experience.

name: Jeramiah Rueb
text: I've been going here sense the 80s, but the new prices means I'll never go back. Bozeman come back to earth with rent and prices!!

name: Kathleen McHenry
text: Awesome and relaxing

name: Jacklyn Randazzo
text: This was fun! We loved the pools, live music, fire and bright colors!

name: Judd Schwartz
text: It is an affordable way to be able to enjoy a little peace of mind when life seems to be in a hurry.

name: Scott Hanson
text: $21 dollars, how do you all sleep at night?!?! What’s wrong with you guys, don’t be greedy!

name: Jack Gibbs
text: Love it

name: David H. Nguyen
text: Because of the geothermal activity in Yellowstone, I figured the surrounding areas there should be some Hot Springs, we found a real one in Chico Hot Springs, but we found this "fake" one in Bozeman.  It's more of a gym with a few heated pools.  But the entrance is only $10 so you can't complain.  It's nice because they have both inside and outdoor pools.  I came mostly for the outdoor ones, since it was about 40 degrees so that concept is amazing to me.

name: Harley Hunter
text: Best time to go is right at open or later at night.

name: Charlie Whiton
text: For a big public pool, this is pretty nice. The indoor space is just ok, but the outdoor is exceptional. Good for kids too

name: Michael Hughes
text: Soooooo relaxing! Very fair prices and the facilities are absolutely amazing! Clean and well kept with a caring wonderful staff! So many pools to choose from you're never crowded in and the outdoor areas are so relaxing! We go here every time we are near Bozeman and have camped there as well. Wonderful Place!

name: Karen Mocko
text: Amazingly restful and sooooo peaceful! Did not want to leave even after two solid days and nights there. Steam room, sauna...multiple hot and cold tubs with varying temperatures...So very relaxing, especially the outdoor pools. Fire pits, music, natural landscaping, not overcrowded...pure delight 🤗 day or evening... fantastic experience... It gets better every time we go

name: Melissa Pomeroy
text: Lovely place to relax and soak. Perfect winter activity

name: Sam Camino
text: I hadn't been here since they remodeled. If I lived in Bozeman I would come here all the time. The way they redid the outdoor area is beautiful. The landscape, music, and ambient lights made this a very soothing, relaxing place. It's an awesome place to go with friends or even alone. The building itself including the bathrooms were very clean.

name: Luke Stenzel
text: Best place to relax. Great price on good smoothie too

name: S. Gracie
text: Amazing springs and facility!

name: RJ Wilder
text: Nice. A little loud but nice

name: Shirley Morrison
text: I've always loved going to the hot springs and the Bozeman Hot Spring is exceptional. The locker rooms are clean and safe to use and there are varieties of pools to choose from. The sauna is amazing too, if you love heat but it's good that a room temperature pool is nearby. The last time I went there they couldn't find my pass but they said they were going to resolve it. I hope they do.

name: Nomadic Critic
text: Second visit for me, and it is a great place to relax and unwind. Steam room, sauna, and numerous indoor and outdoor pools with varying temps.

name: Jordan O'Donnell
text: Our second trip was just as good as the first!

name: Jon Ventura
text: Outdoor pools are great

name: BikerCowboy
text: This place is simply fantastic! A must do !

name: Gerardo Trevizo
text: Wonderful facility in a beautiful area. Very relaxing and soothing.

name: Matthew Campbell
text: If you want a spa experience for only 10 bucks, this is the place to go. Great variety of indoor and outdoor hot tubs, pools, and cold pools. They really have a pool temperature for everyone. Their recent renovation/addition outdoors is gorgeous. I love to sit in the outdoor pools in a cold evening and just relax.

name: Jason Karls
text: Great and plenty of space to not feel crowded.

name: Ian Sobol
text: Unethical to raise prices like this. will not be going back

name: Samuel Quick
text: Very high entry price but a well maintained facility. Lots of amenities and usually isn't super crowded.

name: Boyd Hager
text: The saunas are always hot.the out door pool and bands  are nice

name: Clint Croft
text: I can’t stop talking about how great the evening live music is. This was a great summer go to. Our kids had a blast and my wife and I felt like a date. Highly recommend this for your summer list of Bozeman must do’s.

name: Seth Page
text: Nice facility with good atmosphere. The mats are abrasive though-- bring water shoes.

name: Megan
text: I absolutely love this facility. It is beautiful since the remodel. My kids enjoy the multiple outdoor pools. I love the size and layout of the place. Fantastic place for families. Also quite nice for couples too, as the mood of the outdoor area is quite intimate in the evening.

name: Marta Millard
text: Such a wonderful family soak! These friends are making hot springs family experience to the next level! Love this place!

name: Kady Bucher
text: Hiking up prices “to lower foot traffic” is just wrong!

name: Matthew O'Leary
text: Excellent! No better way to start my day than with a hot soak! Extremely clean pools and I love having the option of soaking in pools with different temperatures

name: Jeff Laffin
text: Beautiful place for travelers I highly recommend it personally I would say best hot springs place in Montana

name: Drew Walt
text: We have gone several times and enjoy it. They offer a pool for whatever temperature you desire. Outside is really fun.

name: Jeremiah Rooney
text: It was relaxing... only problem was overcrowding. Made it hard to relax as we were there for our 10 year anniversary. I wish they had a way of separating different age groups... an area for 26 and older or something like that.

name: Obadiah Rouse
text: I love this place. In my opinion it's the nicest hot springs in the state. They continuously improve the pools and are adding on. I can't wait to see what else they do here.

name: Kyrie M
text: It's a cheap and family friendly place to relax and have some fun. It can get a little crowded at times but the multiple different pools and temperatures make it easy to find a place to sit and enjoy the atmosphere

name: Sean McCormack
text: Nice way to spend the night

name: Bryant Ellston
text: Yea like everyone in Bozeman cares about the owners  Religion.it would be nice to be able to  Soak and relax after working all week.it would be nice to see the ownership change hands.not even like they are the ones working .

name: Jenny Trottier
text: This place was very pretty. I loved the wall of flames surrounded the pools. The water was perfect!

name: Cousins Julia
text: The pools were a bit crowded, but the cabin was cozy and very affordable. We were thrilled to sit in the outdoor pools and listen to a live band while the sun set.

name: Monica Marbut
text: Love the Springs. It is so nice to go and just relax

name: Debra Johnson

name: David Lewis
text:
My favorite Montana Hot Springs! The hot and cold plunges will help heal what ails you and ease the aches and pains of advancing age and are great for those who have various health challenges. The wet and dry saunas are a must to release and dissipate accumulated internal toxins.

The atrium pools (2 hot and 1 cold) with a view to the outside with small, overhead "waterfalls" are an added plus. And check out the pressurized jets near the other cold plunge for a quick, powerfully-directed "massage" of specific joints, muscles, ligaments, tendons, etc.

Personally I like to swim, and the cooler (though warm enough) pool is wonderful for laps (bring goggles) if you come during non-busier morning or early afternoon hours. Check out the newer outside pools in good or warmer weather under the Montana Big Sky, though be aware that these pools are chlorinated.

For exercise buffs there is a huge gym adjacent to and looking in upon the main indoor pool through a huge clear glass (or plexiglass) window with plenty of equipment to beef up any muscle group or trim away undesireable pounds.

You can order either fruit or protein smoothies in the lobby area which also has ample sugary sport drinks, bars and candy. I opted for a $1 banana as I prefer healthier, fresh smoothies without the non-vegan, processed ingredients.

For locals, memberships are available to take advantage of all the facilities. For all comers,  the changing rooms, showers, lockers (2 quarters)and benches are exceptionally roomier and cleaner than any other Hot Springs I've been to, and I've been all over the world. Don't forget to bring your own towels!

My suggestion to the owners: add suit spinners to all changing rooms and, though I honor your choice to follow your Seventh Day Adventist religion, please stay open on Saturdays all day, because for most of us it is our family fun day and we LOVE coming to BHS with kids and visiting relatives or friends!

text:
Amazing... but.

Apparently the owners are Seventh Day Adventists. Okay, so I can explain how this works, from a people that worshipped on the sabbath LONG before you: live and let live. We don't all pray to your g-d, your way. For the great number of us, to shut off access to god's creation because some after-the-fact man-made religion wants us to be forced to follow suit, is completely wrong-headed.

I stood by the front counter at twenty minutes to eight, when a family who really wanted to get in, bubbly and full of joy, was shut down when the staff person told them in the kindest possible way, that their facility was closed on Friday at 8PM until 9PM the following day. A facility built to be a holiday destination.

You get someone else to run the place so those of us free from tyranny can enjoy god's creation. There is no reasonable idea behind closing the facility, that has a competant management and staff. Obviously, friday night till saturday night are major traffic times, and it's completely inappropriate to have the great majority of people, many of whom are Bozeman locals, be deprived of a natural resource due to a militant, oppressive and imposed disaster.

text: The Brewhouse is a Helena classic. There are two floors to the building. The lower floor is like a pub. Beer and wine, appetizers, light meals. It has a lovely fireplace. The upstairs is a restaurant with a large variety of foods. I love the cob salad (it's huge!) and the queen's fish. It has a beautiful bar that serves beer and wine. Lots of TVs dialed in to sports channels. If you go, be aware it's rather noisy and there will be a wait on the weekends. Enjoy!

My prime rib sandwich was so over cooked it was like jerky.  To the point I had trouble taking a bite.  My daughter's fettuccine was absolutely horrible.   She didn't even eat any of it. We tried to get the server to taste it to show how tasteless  it was.   My son's chicken strips were so over fried that they were dark brown, again almost to the consistency of jerky.  Usually we have a great meal here.  Brought it to the servers attention, and not much was done about it.  Didn't charge us for our sodas.   Sadly, it's going to be a while before we venture back.

name: Daniel Deininger
text: As always,  food was excellent!  I had one of my favorites - the Queen's Fish. Cod version. (And I love the fact they have malt vinegar available - just adds to the fish and chips! - and their tartar sauce is also EXCELLENT.)  This time since it was dinner time I went with a baked potato.  I was tempted to have their famous beer cheese soup, but showed restraint.  Their micro brew selection is really good, and I had been working in the garden before dinner, so i was pretty thirsty.  My choice was the Angry Orchard Apple Ale that they had ON TAP.  My usual choice would have been Harvest Moon Beltian White, but the apple ale was a great choice You won't go wrong with any selection on the menu!  If there's a line, don't despair.  They have lots of tables so it won't be too long.. and it will be worth it!

name: Rebecca Skeldon

name: Rev Bbq
text: Todays journey takes me to helena to the Brewhouse Pub &Grill. From the moment you enter you see that the interior is not like any other place. We were greeted right away and shown straight to a table. My waitress stayed consistent on checking on my table and filling drinks. The kitchen is considered an open kitchen meaning that all guests can see the cooks and hear everything that is being said. I ordered the New York steak cooked medium rare with beer cheese soup and fries. The reason for the choice of fries was because there were no mashed potatoes made. The soup was brought to my table very rapidly and was packed full of flavor. The rich creaminess from the 5 cheese's used was on point and the vegetables in it gave a interesting twist to such a traditional style of soup. In between the soup and my main meal I was checked in on very promptly that my order would be coming up soon. While waiting I noticed how clean the flatware and tables were. It seems that the uniform for this place is a casual setting. Which in term makes me feel at home and relaxed. Once my order had arrived my steak was over cooked by about 15 degrees. But the flavor was what disappointed me more. The steak had less flavor than the fries as if the cooks did not season it at all. It was a very disappointing with such an amazing cut. After service it is sad to say that the hi light of the meal and the star was the soup. If the steak had more seasoning and used a garlic butter the steak would of became the star of the meal. I can not say that I would return to this establishment again.

name: Billy Danford
text: I love the fact that Ace Hardware in Belgrade was the only store out of four corners Belgrade and Bozeman to still have Christmas lights Christmas decorations and everything else that has to do with Christmas. I went to the Bozeman Ace Hardware and they were nice enough to call ahead in the Belgrade and reserve a Christmas tree stand and a bunch of Christmas tree lights for me their customer service in both locations was on point

resp.text: Billy, how was your Christmas?  We hope it was awesome and safe for you and your family.  Thank you for the kind words for Belgrade Ace Hardware.  We tried hard to remain in stock on Christmas lights as late as we could and this year it wasn't easy.  We know many stores ran out before us.  We find that to be the case in many high demand categories throughout the year.  Quite often we are the last ones to have sleds, snow shovels, heaters, fans, AC's, Christmas supplies, blue light bulbs, soil, canning supplies, etc.  It's a long list but we are not afraid of inventory and do all we can to provide customers with the product they need, when they need it.    Thanks again for your kind words, we hope to see you again soon Billy!

name: Mark Keehr
text: They do not enforce the mask policy. I stood in line with three people who did not have masks on. Won't go back until they do

resp.text:
I do appreciate your input Mark.  We post a sign asking that all customers wear masks.  We require all employees to wear masks.  We assume that any customers who do not wear a mask have some kind of medical reason for not wearing one.  We as retailers.....well I won't get into it here because it just sounds like a bunch of excuses.  This hasn't been fun or easy for any of us weather you are a retailer or a customer.  I respect your decision and personally hope that one day I get to serve you as a customer again.  Please call me if you would like to discuss this further.

Cary MacMaster
Store Leader
406-388-6012

All of our employees are wearing masks and we do ask that all of our customers wear a mask as well.  If you wish to discuss this any further, please call me at 388-6012 and ask for Cary MacMaster.  I am the store leader.

name: Rubikens
text:
Used equipment rental. I called ahead, but still had a bit of wait while they did something unrelated on the computer.

They reassured me at pickup that my daughter would be able to get my deposit back at return being I would be unavailable (I live out of town.) The rental was for her, I just paid for it. When she returned the equipment they denied returning my deposit even though she had the receipt.

I also purchased excess material/accessories with the promise they would refund any unused items. Again, ate those expenses because they reneged on their verbal promise and assurance.

Very disappointed.

resp.text:
I am sorry you had an unhappy experience at our store.  It is hard to know what the problem was with a "deposit" or returning unused merchandise without knowing what it was.  I will check into it and post additional information here.  If you would like to call and discuss this further, please do and ask for the Store Manager Cary MacMaster 406-388-6012.  Thank you for your time.

I have done some research into this and need more information to know how to correct this problem in the future.  I am confused because we don't require deposits on rental items.  As for returning items purchased with the rental, like sand paper for a floor sander, we do return any unused supplies from rental items as long as they are in the original packaging.  Please call me so I can learn more about the situation and we can learn from this for future customers.

name: Roger T Bannon
text: Went in for first ever chainsaw, I’ve never even used one. I got a sthil brand one as I know they are a good brand. I got a smaller size one and they filled it up with oil and gas. Then another representative (Alan) came over to assist and asked what I would be using it for I said a little work now but I’m moving to an off the grid location so I would probably use it more often. He then informed me I had the second smallest sthil and he would recommend a larger size model. He showed me the difference in chain width. So I decided to go with a bigger model (MS 211) and they didn’t mind that they already filled the smaller one up. He exchanged it for me, took a little doing but they eventually got it starting up really nice and fine tuned it for me. He then told me about if I get a six pack of oil or the already mixed sthil brand gas it would double my warranty, yes please. They were very helpful and showed me everything I would need to do to run it and maintain it, very helpful. Great customer service and they took the time to make sure it was in great running order.

resp.text: Thank you for your kind words Roger.  I'm sure you will be pleased with your Sthil chainsaw.  It is a new line for us that we are very excited to carry.  Alan is right, it never hurts to have more power and length in the blade of a chain saw, you sure notice it when you have a chainsaw that is too small for the job.  Come in any time!

name: Stephen Boster
text:
UPDATE!! - Which I should have done a long time but COVID happened . . . .
Below you will see my concern about Christimas lights.  Here is the followup -
The manager contacted me about my concern.  He was attentive, gracious, and apologized about the situation.  He offered valid solutions as well as confirmed training for the staff in this situation.   He agreed that the defective lights should have been returned and would be sure that if a situation occurred like what I experienced it would be handled more positively in the future.

I appreciated the interaction so much that I never took the items back (COVID) but that I have continued to give them my business.

Moral of the story - if you have a valid concern, talk with the manager but do so graciously and cooperatively.  The manager will work with you as best as he possibly can.

Moved my rating back up to 5 Stars

_______________________________________________________
WARNING!!!  DO NOT BUY Christmas Lights from this store - they will NOT return them.

For the past year, after having a great experience with the manager on a poor product, we continued to give Ace Hardware our business.

A month ago today (Christmas Eve), we purchased a couple of hundred dollars on Christmas lights.  One the sets was defective and did not even work.  After the holidays and have the flu, I attempted a week ago (so 21 days later / within 30 days) to return the defective set.  I was told they did not return Christmas lights once they go on clearance.  Calmly (but frustrated), I explained that the set did not even work for 2 days.    They stated that if I had returned them then, they may have been able to do something.

There was no offer for store credit, exchange, or refund.

There was not even an offer of 'let me get my store manager to see what we can do for you'.  I didn't even ask to see the store manager, because I should not have to.

Here are my concerns:
1) To be fair, the sets were marked 1/2 off and with a note they cannot be returned.  Fine - I understand that - but what about defective merchandise?
2) If I bought BEFORE they went 1/2 off (and presumably with 'no return' notice), I still would NOT be able to return the lights because I was told that once they go on clearance - they can't exchange them or return them.

So in essence -
1) I feel like they stole $30 (after spending $275 that day on that specific receipt)
2) If I buy anything else, would I be able to return it? (even if the receipt states 90 day return policy.

Everytime I pass by the store now, I think twice whether or not to purchase anything.

I waited a week to write this edited review because I did not want to write it out of anger and frustration.
_________
Prior post from a year ago:
Great manager.  Great customer service.   Clean, neat and organized store.

resp.text:
Stephen, I am glad that you posted this reply here.  I don't know why this reply is showing "Feb, 20, 2018", maybe it's because you are modifying a previous rating.  I can understand your frustrations here and would like to do something about this, not because you posted here, but because it's the right thing to do.  I would like to take back the defective set of lights you tried to return a week ago.  When we sell something, even on closeout, we do expect it to work for the customer and it if doesn't work then there is a problem.  In the case of Christmas lights, we should do a defective return.  In the case of a lawnmower, there would be warranty service work done.

I plan on taking your review to our Leadership Meeting and discussing our return policy and then our leaders can take the information to their teams for additional training.  I promise you that your review will not end here with my response, it will be used for training.

name: Richard Beesley
text: There is value that must be acknowledged for nostalgia. I loved red lobster as a kid, it was the greatest. Have been back a couple times in recent years. Its not what it use to be. The service was very slow we had our entrees long before the cheddar biscuits showed up at the table, it took over 30 minutes to get the entrees. I'm sure we will go again to reminisce on the glory days but regret the decision later.

name: Shanice Luciano
text: Finally had my amazing red lobster with the best ultimate feast ever!!! Drove 2 hours just to have it and I'm happy about it. The drinks and apps were amazing. I cleaned my plate. text: Was well worth the wait the staff was excellent

text: Service was poor.  Menu is very limited and prices sky high.  Restaurant itself needs an upgrade. Food was nothing to get excited about.  Probably won't go back until we hear they have new management.

text: Always friendly staff. Never issues with the food. Only issue I ever had was a sangria I ordered was quite literally 3 sips because they put so much ice in it. So I paid about 8 bucks for a cup of ice and a couple pieces of fruit. Other than that it's our go to lunch place when we visit Billings.

resp.text: Jocelyn, glad you could stop in and that our Billings Red Lobster was worthy of your 5 star rating. We will forward your comments to our team and we're happy to hear you enjoy seafood as much as we do! 😍

text:

We will be back.

resp.text: Don, we’re loving the 5 star review about our Billings team. We hope to see you soon for more of our classic seafood meals 🦞

text: Our waitress was way too soft spoken. I ordered a "special" cocktail and they brought it out in a regular glass instead of the jar I was supposed to keep because they ran out of them. The cocktail didn't taste like it had any alcohol in it--just like their sour mix for margaritas. Our waitress forgot to bring us biscuits so we had to ask for them and got them after  our soup and salad. My salad didn't even have any croutons on it--just a single slice of onion, three tomatoes, lettuce and a ton of ranch dressing (ick). When I finally got my meal (long wait time) the butter for my crab legs had tipped over and spilled all over the plate that held the shell crackers, tiny fork, and wipe for my hands. Butter was all over everything. She said she'd bring me more butter, but she forgot so I had to ask for that too while using utensils doused with butter. I know you get messy eating crab legs anyway, but that was ridiculous. I couldn't get out of that restaurant fast enough.

text: Rented a car trailer and had a great experience, everyone was helpful and very nice. They made sure everything was functioning before I left.  Trailer was great to use, I was able to winch my car into it with no issues.  Straightforward, easy transaction.  Will definitely rent from them again.

name: Kenneth Hancock
text: Attempted to rent a Lund boat for labor day. Called four days ahead to reserve boat for two days and told them I would pick it up at 11 on Saturday. When I arrived to pick it up, he informed me that I would have to have it back by 7am on 2nd day or I would be charged another day, despite me picking it up at 11. After a bit of back and forth, he said he would cut me a "deal" and only charge me half day if I brought it back by 11. I reluctantly agreed because we had planned to do fishing over labor day. When I first saw the boat and trailer, it looked like something they pulled from a salvage yard, all scratched and beaten up. The trailer is too wide for the boat, the bumpers on either side do not rest on the sides of boat, so they had it held in place on the center of trailer with a beaten up ratchet strap. When we hooked up trailer lights, one of prongs was broken, so I didn't have a right turn signal. They said if I got pulled over, I could just tell cops, it was a rental! After looking over boat more, I noticed one of the fishing rod holders was broken. One of the employees went to find a bolt to fix it and never came back. So, after about 45 minutes of dealing with complete incompetence, I exploded and demanded my money back. After having a few choice words with the owner, they refunded my money and I left without the boat. They didn't inform me of the return policy when I made the reservation, tried to charge me $400 for a beat up unsafe rental, and completely wasted my time. I've never seen such unprofessionalism and I will never go back or recommend them to any of my friends.

name: Billy Danford
text: Palisade Falls was such a beautiful and amazingly wonderful hike. It was so easy did I was able to push my daughter in a stroller and make the hike in no time. The view is so beautiful the fresh air was crisp and smell so good I would definitely recommend this to anybody who wants to have a wonderful experience with their family or just a solo hike.

name: mortarhound78
text: The "hike" is extremely easy, its actually paved. Now it is uphill, so just know that. Besides, being paved it is one of the most gorgeous things I've seen in all my travels. It truly is beautiful and worth the 10 -15 minute drive from Bozeman. .....wow.....something this amazing so close to town, hard to believe!! The drive from Bozeman up to the trailhead is a beautiful one as well, so you get that even before the falls. Then you get the payoff, we'll worth it!! Anyways, now the down side. There were a lot of people. I mean, this IS a paved "hike" so there will be a lot of people. Other than that, no other down side. If you like quick trips from town, easy walk, beautiful scenery, and gorgeous payoff, then you should check out Palisades Falls!!

name: dadymike Miguel Acosta
text: The walk and the view was amazing you can really connect with nature just being there

name: William Gruenes
text: Easy short hike on wheel chair accessible trail.

name: Emily Cox
text: A nice stroll on a paved trail. The sign says 0.7 miles from trailhead. Vaulted toilet available, with a few picnic areas in the parking lot.  The only downfall to this trail is the crowd. If you want solitude this is not the hike for you.  If you climb up towards the waterfall you'll be able to see the crevices/caves in the huge rock formations to the right of the falls.

name: Jess Is Blessed
text: Excellent, beautiful paved trail to the Waterfall.   The parking lot is paved now,  which is really nice.   The outhouse- although much appreciated- doesn't have toilet paper,  so make sure and bring some along to avoid any issues 🤣.   The "hike" isn't bad,  we brought 2 toddlers and a stroller to the top, no problem. The waterfall is gorgeous and amazingly there was no litter other than one poop filled doggy doo-doo bag at the start of the trail (seriously? You went so far as to put it in a bag, but throwing it away was too much work? 🤔).  Overall,  it's a nice, quick,  beautiful way to spend some time with friends or family.

name: Kenzie Sacry
text: This waterfall is stunning!  It's an easy access trail (we literally passed someone pushing someone else in a wheelchair).  It takes about 30 minutes to get to the trailhead from downtown Bozeman.  It's a beautiful drive through the canyon.  It's an easy hike to the top.  Perfect for families with little ones!

name: Jill Strainer

name: Melissa Warfield
text: The waterfall at Palisades Falls was breath taking to me. The trails are good for all levels of hikers. Palisades Falls is part of the Custer Gallatin National Forest. We were fortunate enough to have seen two female Deer where we were. That was the exciting part because we never thought we'd see any wildlife at all. That was another highlight to our trip at Palisades Falls. Enjoyed our time at Palisades Falls. Please go there. You won't know what you'll see.

name: Richard Flint
text: Nice hike. Easy enough to bring children with.

name: kade estill

text: Gotta go must see .o7 hike, and worth it

name: Pancasatya Agastra
text: Quick, easy and gorgeous. This hike is perfect for families with little kids. I am a kid inside, so it's definitely perfect for me too.

name: Autumn Underberg
text: A bit of a steep income but it was paved.  People do not keep pets on leashes at all. The falls were beautiful.

name: Leif Wickland
text: Palisade Falls is a gorgeous destination well worth the short hike 0.7 mile on paved trail. Yes, the trail has steep sections, so if you are unaccustomed to the altitude or to hiking generally, plan to take your time. There is a dearth of level space once you arrive at the falls per se and it is typically already in use by other visitors, so while you may feels like charging in the last little bit once you hear the crashing water, I recommended slowing down if you're tired. The footing at the falls can be quite precarious due to the loose talus, so do be careful if you choose to scramble toward the foot of the falls.

name: Bri Culley
text:
Great hike! We were a little winded going up, but it is paved and pretty easy. Lovely views and peaceful, beautiful waterfall!

We weren't sure where we were going, but just keep driving on the dirt road until you see the sign to turn off it.

name: Jeff Woods
text: These falls are spectacular in my opinion. I would guess them at about 35 or 45 feet tall, taller counting the post drop runoff area. The neighboring rock walls and cliffs are beautiful too. Definitely worth seeing, and pretty easy to get children to. Very pretty short hike from trailhead, like 10 minutes. The trail is all smooth asphalt up until pretty much right at the falls, which provides for handicapped accessibility. There is a good unisex bathroom.

name: Cassie
text: Beautiful, easy hike. The waterfall is so pretty. Peaceful sounds of the flowing water too. Wonderful!

name: Justin Overstreet
text: Nice hike to pretty falls, paved trail nearly everyone can do.

name: Jeremy Novak
text: Great little hike, paved trail not to steep.

name: Glenn Christiansen
text: easy walk, paved trail and an impressive waterfall. Enjoyed the excursion

name: Steel Olson
text: Beautiful place to visit. The Falls are gorgeous and immaculate but the drive up to the falls is very pretty as well. Not a very long drive away from Bozeman.

name: Matthew Roam
text: Wonderful waterfall

name: Joe Cobb
text: Awesome hike/walk view to falls. Paved the whole way

name: Steve Darnell
text: It's a very short hike up a paved trail so access is great for everyone! A ten minute walk will get you to the falls. It's a very pretty location and the falls are about 80-90 get high! Well worth the trip!

name: Shane Gill
text: Be careful with road coming up, I saw some cars getting stuck. If you aren't used to driving on very snowy roads, park your car below and walk the mile to the trailhead.

name: Annie Buchwald
text: This is an easy trail that's been made accessible for wheel chairs by means of asphalt surfacing along the 0.7 mile walk to the falls.  I can't imagine getting a wheelchair up the trail because of the incline but it might be good for someone who needs more stable footing the asphalt provides. It's nice to have these beautiful falls accessable to those that struggle on rough paths.  And to see it winter is fantastic!  The falls form a chandelier of ice and it's fun to watch the ice climbers.  The snow trail is packed so it's easy to hike - you just have to go a little further than in summer.  It's beautiful, great for kids and you can take a continuing trail to the top for those that are looking for a more challenging hike. It is popular though so plan for people.  It's out of Bozeman not Livingston as Google indicates though!

name: Nathan Carsten
text: Nice easy .7 mile hike on an asphalt trail.  It is a really nice walk and view.  Wheel chair accessable too but it is uphill all the way to the falls it might be difficult but you can do it perservere!!

name: Daniel Deininger
text: Friendly, helpful staff. Quick check in. Lots of housekeeping staff in the morning to get all the rooms changed. Very clean pool and hot tub. Manager pointed out to me that the chlorinated pool  and hotub kill COVID, so no reason for them not to be open. And no health department restrictions on pools now, either.

resp.text:
Dear Daniel,
Thank you for your five-star review. It is wonderful to see you found our staff to be friendly and helpful and were able to enjoy our beautiful pool area. We look forward to welcoming you back when you are next in Helena.

name: Jody A. Huston
text:
I found the lodging at Baymont very satisfying. Easily accessible from Interstate 15. Ample parking and handicapped friendly. The jacuzzi and pool were found to be quite relaxing and refreshing. A gym is also available. An enjoyable breakfast and drinks began at 6:00 am. Ice and snack machines available.
My room was a single which furnished a King sized bed of nice comfort. There were amenities as in work table/desk with lamp. Large easy chair, microwave, refrigerator, and safe. Iron and board included. A quite sufficient lavatory and shower. Overall the room was very clean and refreshing. (See photos)
I found the staff very professional and friendly.
There are ample fast food restaurants very near as well as a grocery store.

resp.text:
Dear Jody,
Thank you for taking the time to let us know how much you enjoyed your stay. It is fantastic to hear you found your room to be clean and comfortable with plentiful amenities and also enjoyed some of the wonderful amenities available throughout our property. We are also pleased to see you enjoyed great interactions with our friendly staff members. Please come back and see us again when you are next in the area!

name: Riddlers Revenge93
text: This hotel is Awesome! Thank you guys.

resp.text: With so many hotels in the area to choose from, we're thrilled you chose Baymont by Wyndham Helena! Thank you for sharing your kind words and come back and see us again soon!

name: Kathy Frazer
text: When i got there they had the wrong reservation date. So they gave me a king bed and a fold out couch. When i got in the room I inspected the beds. There was long brown/grey hairs all over the big bed. Short grey hairs under the pillows. The fold out had brown chunky stains on the bedding. The pool looks like the top layer of jello that is almost set.  I checked out and got my money back.

resp.text:
Dear Kathy,
Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear that you had trouble with your reservation and decided not to stay with us. The accommodations you encountered are not typical of our hospitality, and housekeeping has thoroughly addressed the matter. Please consider staying again so that we can deliver the fantastic experience you expect.

name: Joan Havens
text: Nice accomodations. Like the pool.

resp.text:
Dear Joan,
Thank you for your five-star review. It is fantastic to hear you liked our clean, comfortable accommodations and that you were able to enjoy our beautiful pool area. We look forward to welcoming you back again soon!

name: Robert Day
text:
It was a nice place to stay. Clean.
The desk clerk was exceptional.
I needed a TV room guide as the one in the room was missing. And within 3 minutes he was there at the door of the room with one.
Clerk was very helpful.
Nice place to stay.
With a continental breakfast in the morning, also indoor pool.

name: John Collis
text: Had a big snow. Snow removal was very slow. If not for 4 wheel drive we'd have had a tough time getting out.

resp.text:
Dear John,
Thank you for your feedback. We're sorry to hear that the weather made it difficult for you to get back to your travels. Rest assured, we do everything we can to remove the snow on our property, and we appreciate your patience with this matter. Other than this, we hope your stay was comfortable, and we look forward to showing you an even better stay the next time you're in town.

name: Julieanna Peetz

resp.text:
Dear Julieanna,
Your review made our team proud to know that you had a wonderful visit in your clean and comfortable room. We are delighted that you found our customer service friendly and helpful. Should your travels bring you back to the area, we look forward to having you stay with us again.

At Baymont by Wyndham Helena, your happiness will always be our goal, and we hope to have the pleasure of creating more lifelong memories with you in the future!

text: They are okay for price but do not use the sofa pull out im sorry but the floor is softer. Only 2 floors which im fine with but for others just heads up no elevator or laundry area.

Dear Justina,
Guest satisfaction is important to us, so we're happy to hear you appreciated our competitive rates. However, we apologize for any issues with the pullout couch, and we'll look into this further. Thank you for your feedback about the onsite amenities. Our staff is always happy to offer available first floor rooms and direct you to nearby laundry facilities. If your travels bring you back to the area, please consider staying with us again.

name: Inicorn Refs
text: Excellent stay for a business trip. Rooms are clean and spacious. Hotel staff was polite and attentive. Free basic breakfast and they even provide a free simple dinner for hungry travelers to which I’ve never seen before at a Wyndham chain hotel. Parking isn’t the greatest.

name: Kitty Kat
text: Clean, with very comfy bed. Great front desk worker named Jesse. Parking lot is a little difficult otherwise great place.

name: Vernetta Wagoner
text: The room was affordable, clean and comfortable. The staff was pleasant, courteous and accommodating. The breakfast hot and fresh with a nice variety of options to choose from. We also enjoyed our time in the pool and hot tub. We look forward to staying again when we visit Helena.

name: Justin Miller
text: The evening front desk lady is amazing and helpful and the house keeping ladies in the morning are amazing as well. If I remember right the evening lady, her name was Ashley and the house keeping lady that went above and beyond was names Kayla

resp.text:

Thank you so much for your wonderful review, it's guests like you that keep us inspired! We're thrilled to learn that our friendly staff was able to ensure such a positive experience for you. From our entire team at Baymont by Wyndham Helena, we wish you nothing but the best and would be honored to serve you again soon.

text: Great place to stay!!

resp.text:
Dear Patsy,
Our team aims to provide a stay that is the epitome of comfort and quality, so we're happy to hear that your time with us was reflective of this goal. It would be our pleasure to welcome you back to Baymont by Wyndham Helena for another five-star experience.

name: William Hall
text: Great hotel at a reasonable price!! Room was clean, bed was comfortable, and staff was attentive and friendly! The Crock-Pot of soup in the lobby and plate of cookies were nice hospitality touches that I haven't seen many other places. The pool and hot tub looked well maintained, although I didn't try them out. I would gladly stay here again!!

name: jeremy gunnell
text: When we checked in the desk clerk asked me what brought us there.  I told him it was our anniversary.  About a half hour after we got to our room there was a knock at the door and when we opened it there was a nice bag full of popcorn, bottled water, candy and other goodies as well as an anniversary card signed by the staff.  They definatly went out of their way.

resp.text:
Hello Jeremy,

Happy Anniversary to the both of you and I'm so glad that my team responded the way they did and did their part to make your special day even better. We've had a few anniversaries in the alst couple weeks and all of my staff loves doing whatever they can to help make it more special. Thank you for staying with us on your special occasion and I hope it was a memorable anniversary.

Jake Lambert
General Manager
Baymont by Wyndham Helena

name: Anginette Bromlie
text: Decent place to stay. Centrally located

text: Older building, renovated and comfortable.  It's on a side street and difficult to see from the main drag.  That means less traffic noise!  Staff was helpful and courteous.

Our wonderful staff works hard to deliver a fantastic experience and will be thrilled to be recognized for their hard work. Thank you for counting on Baymont by Wyndham Helena during your travels. We look forward to your next visit.

name: Tristram Hokenson
text: The staff was incredibly helpful and kind. Even though Chase was busy with check ins and reservations, he was polite and helpful. The beds were comfortable and rooms clean!

resp.text:

Thank you for taking a moment to leave a review for us at the Baymont by Wyndham Helena!

I'm so glad you got a chance to enjoy our evening Manager's Reception which includes the soup on Tuesday, Wednesday and Thursday as well as our cookies and local donuts we had out. We do always try to find super friendly folks when hiring for the staff here to make sure that everyone enjoys their stay's here.

Thanks again for leaving us a review,

Jake Lambert
General Manager
Baymont by Wyndham Helena

name: Jessica LaQue
text: Best hotel stay so far in helena. Quiet and comfortable.

name: Tori Harris
text: The pool was nice.  The rooms; however, need updating.  The heater was controlled with a knob which made regulating the temperature difficult.

resp.text:
Hello Tori,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review for the Baymont by Wyndham Helena.

I do agree that the heater units that still have the knobs are our older units and are in need of replacing. We have been going through one or two at a time and replacing them so that we can get all of our newer ones in as we can. I hope that everything else during your stay was pleasant and you were able to get a good night's sleep!

Thanks,

Jake Lambert
General Manager
Baymont by Wyndham Helena

name: Christopher George
text: Didn't have my room available so they gave me a free upgrade to a king suite at 70 a day. Breakfast was great and the hot tub is superb.

resp.text:
Hello Christopher,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave a review for the Baymont by Wyndham Helena!

I'm so glad that we were able to provide you with a upgraded room during your stay while we were out of the room type you had originally booked. Our goal if there is ever a possible inconvenience like that is to try and give you the better option at our expense to give you the best stay possible.

Our hot tub is fantastic and I'll tell you, that is my maintenance man's largest focus every day is making sure it stays that nice. He takes a lot of pride in it so I'll be sure to share your comments with him.

Thanks so much,

Jake Lambert
General Manager
Baymont by Wyndham Helena

name: Ken Pollard
text: Good rooms for a decent price. Supposed to be non smoking rooms, but the one I had smelled like someone was smoking ribs and bacon in it. They did give me a different room, with only minor hassles and it was fine. Breakfast was adequate.

name: Ádám Máté
text:
I'm in Helena MT regularly, - usually a few times a year, - but this was the first time I decided on staying in a hotel. The Helena Baymont has a great choice.
It is really easy to find the hotel, though a bit tricky to park into the parking lot; downtown location, close to restaurants and grocery stores, and close to the interstate exit. The room was clean, well equiped, and in an really great shape -- all the amenities and comfy bed. The staff is friendly and helpful. And a plus: a breakfast was included with the room; although paper cups and plates, but rather divers selection of everything that's good.
I would stay here again, and would recommend Baymont to anyone!

name: Nicholas P
text: The hotel was clean, the staff were friendly, and the breakfast had some decent variety with hot and cold items. I didn't use the indoor pool or hot tub, but they looked nice and are, of course, a great amenity.

name: Dan Daniels
text: Great pool and hot tub, staff was very nice and friendly. Good location close to highway and lots of places to eat.

name: Chad Kimm
text: Friendly staff. Mostly clean. Affordable. Rooms a little dated.

name: Joel Holshue
text: The bed was very comfortable, breakfast was great, and check in and out process was easy. However the lobby which is mainly the area to eat the breakfast is tiny and very cramped. The biggest drawback was the ceiling in the King suite bathroom we had. Above the shower was missing most of the material on the ceiling and pieces were hanging off ready to fall. There was also a crack in the material above the where it looked like it was ready to come off.

name: Charlotte Fitzgerald
text: Great customer service, nice place to stay.

resp.text:
Hello Charlotte,

Thank you so much for taking the time to leave us a 5 star review! It really means a lot to us as our staff takes so much pride in this hotel. I love that the customer service my staff provides is so genuine.

Thanks and have a great day!

Jake Lambert
General Manager
Baymont by Wyndham Helena

name: Aaron R
text:
Very nice place! Feels clean and comfortable all the way through. Beds are comfy and pillows were great. Only bad part was no microwave and there fridge didn't keep anything cool, even on 7. But there's a microwave in the lobby and the morning clerk took note of the fridge. Everyone was very nice! Breakfast was nice and felt comfortable and cozy thanks to the smaller lobby, and not awkward like a lot of hotel mornings do. Food was ok, but I've had better eggs and biscuits. Table seating was a tad tight, but there were no complaints and everyone was polite and understanding about it. Pool was nice looking, even though we sadly didn't get to use it. Workout room didn't feel like an insolated closet like some places! Parking lot is a little tight and there's only one entrance (that I saw). People unloading or checking in ended up being in the way.

All in all a good stay :)

name: Traci Spencer
text: Very comfortable beds, great service.

name: stephan strickland
text: Parking was terrible not enough spots for the amount of guests if you have a trailer don't go into the parking lot no exit you have to back out we reserved a king bed but got a queen bed had trouble getting the key cards to work and had a cold shower that night. The one bright spot was the continental breakfast it was very good.

name: T R. Randall
text: Baymont is a good place to stay friendly staff good breakfast biscuits and sausage gravy scrambled eggs toast cereal juice you name it they have it I highly recommend staying here and price was right too

name: Haufski762

name: Shirley Lauren Bouldin
text: Clean, good prices.

name: Dori Dillon

name: Jodi Laney
text: The motel was easy to find, the Staff is very friendly, the price was right & the indoor pool - hot tub are nice. My only negative comment is that  our bathroom & carpet really weren't as clean as they should've been.

name: Jamie Herzog

name: Jim Hollenback

name: Jonathan Williams

Most importantly though I want to mention how friendly the staff is !!! Whether it was when we checked in or when we checked out, the staff was so friendly and helpful !!! Truly made this stop feel like being at home !!!

We will definitely be staying again !!!!

And I was like "can you look?" And THAN she checked. Idk why she wouldn't just check in the first place.

text: The location, rooms and service were above standard. Excellent customer service skills, clean room and amazing amenities.

name: Nicolas Van Tomme
text: It's an on hotel but for the price it is worth a stay. Breakfast needs to have a separate room not in front of the check in.

name: Gary Sorenson
text: Fun

name: Reen Reen
text: The experience was awful. Our sandwiches were greasier then usual, barely any meat and we simply asked for one of them to be redone. The customer service was terrible,   instead of being asked what they could do to fix the issue, we were told that nobody else has said anything bad. Then the owners continued to tell us we were in the wrong, when all we wanted was  for the sandwiches we paid for to be consumable.  The owner continued to tell us that we are wrong and rude,  when that was not the case. Then because of the bad customer service, and the fact the owners husband then came out to intimidate us, we asked for our money back. Which we then received thrown at us into our car window. I would definitely not recommend eating here. We have been eating here for many years, and are extremely disappointed with our experience today. Will not be back, nor will we ever again recommend to anybody for any reason.
