name: Brett Loomis
text: Food is good.  Salmon and burger was good. Free range chicken was good, just a small portion. We had the brussel sprout appetizer and it was very good.  My 3 out of 5 stars are due to the staff.  I had the coupon mailer they sent out and they would not honor the "plus $5 off any entree".  I understand newer restaurants have growing pains, but when I pointed out to our server what the coupon said, he first said it either or, but after reading it he said it's for a second visit. I am putting a picture of my receipt and coupon so someone in management can make sure this doesn't happen to others.  Why do a mailer if you are not going to honor it!?!?!

resp.text:
Hi Brett,
Sorry for the confusion. Yes the intent was for the mailer to drive multiple visits to each restaurant, but we would be happy to honor both in one visit if you’d like. I apologize if this didn’t occur for you.
I’d love to offer a gift card to our restaurant to make it up to you. Please shoot me an email at Blane.woodfin@bluecollarjh.com to confirm.
Thank you for the feedback and we look forward to serving you again soon.

Tanglewood

name: Orion Kubat
text: Brussels and Wine. I definitely need to go back for more of everything on the menu and everything on the wine bar. But the brussels and wine and good company made for a delightful evening with our server Mike. First of all, the draft wine style versus bottled wine wins hands down in my book. We drank an exquisite 750ml of the Recuerdo Malbec, but it was hard to choose from the comprehensive list. Mike said it was the best malbec he's had and I would have to agree. Not only was the wine itself good, but having draft wine meant I didn't have to worry about a fresh pour or the right temperature. The brussels were delicious as well. Everything is fairly priced, and I mean great compared to Bozeman's overpriced fake fancy restaurants. Tanglewood has great servers, great food, and a delectable interior. I'd go on... but you should just go on down instead.

resp.text: Thank you, Orion. It’s a pleasure to serve guests like you. We hope to see you again soon!

text:
This pizza is so succulently delicious. I was licking the sauce of my fingers good.  We had the roasted chicken pizza with barbecue sauce.   Nice ambiance.  It's  a limited menu.  There's a few appetizers, daily soup offerings and a selection of pizza choices.  There are no salads offered.
Yes, they have beer on tap and yes there's wine!  It's a simple easy to read menu. I went on a Monday at 4:45 pm. I can't say how service and wait times will be when it's busy.  There were only 2 other tables when I went.  🍕 I'll go back for more!

name: Rebeka
text: Beautiful restaurant, great service, and I loved that the gluten-free pizza didn't have an upcharge. The gluten-free crust was a little spongy in texture, but it wasn't so bad that I won't come back to try it again!

name: Jason Daughenbaugh
text: Great pizza, awesome caprese salad, good service, fun location.

name: Christine Armstrong
text: Partner and I ordered two pizzas. I had the Billie and partner had the Thai with vegan cheese. He was very impressed with the vegan cheese quality! Atmosphere is great with b&w street photography. Service was so-so. Our server didn't visit our table much, but got our orders right and served the food promptly. Beer and wine list is limited but still felt like it had something for everyone. I would recommend trying this pizza at least once!

name: E Beth
text:
Excellent pizza!! Fun menu combinations and good portions. Good atmosphere and location.  Friendly staff.
Thank you for supporting our First Responders!

name: Julie Smith
text: The pizza was very good. Will definitely return to have more. The service needs some work, on both the hosting and serving, but could have been a one off. Will update review the next time I go if it has improved!

name: Tori Thayer
text: Brunch! The egg sandwich and mimosas is my favorite. They say bottomless and they mean it. Awesome staff.

name: Johan Tate
text: Super good. Among the best pizza I've ever had.

name: Andrew Harris
text: Great service. Good food. Very enjoyable and decent price.

name: David Herbst
text: Loved these simple but perfectly executed pizzas. Even had a dairy free cheese offering which was great for my daughter.

name: Suzi Berget
text: They have an amazing half pizza/half salad lunch combo that is affordable and very filling! So good!

name: Caylin Lancione
text: I can already tell this is going to be one of my favorite new spots in Bozeman! We started with the cheese platter which tasted as wonderful as it looked. I had the pesto pizza and I was blown away. Often times pesto pizza is way overdone - too much oil and it just becomes a soggy mess. This one had a perfect balance of herbs and oil! Staff was great and we thoroughly enjoyed the ambience!

name: Brian Sweeney
text: Incredible atmosphere with lots of space, friendly staff, good beer and wine selection, and good pies.  They are facing tough competition and will need to step it up a bit to compete in the Bozeman pizza business.  I give them #4 locally for pizza but will definitely try them again.

name: Chad Mueske
text: Really great place. Super service. Food was great. Fantastic lunch special price. My new favorite.

name: Edward Johnson
text: Fantastic. Creates delicious pizza that competes with Red Tractor and Bridger Brewing pizzas as my favorite. Great appetizers; last had the 'seven mushrooms'. Extensive beverage selection and tasty dessert. Obviously this place is Fire. *inserts fire emoji*

name: susan dolam
text: Delicious pizza. We had the thai pie! Great atmosphere with cool pictures. Not too comfy chairs. Good service!

name: Travis Rogers
text:
Had the pizza/salad lunch with choices of gorg/Raz Vin salad and the meat pizza.
Loved the salad! So many dried cherries and the dressing was real tasty. The pizza was delicious and had a good variety of quality meats, flavor was on point!
We had the artichoke dip and man, that's really yummy as well.
Place was bursting with flavor.
Nice facility, seating is a little awkward/uncomfortable and there is some quirky artwork, but it fits in downtown BZN well.

name: Tyler Kern
text: This place has food that is to die for!! It has a really strong hipster vibe which I dont usually like but the staff was very friendly amd provided great customer service. Highly recommend the soup and any of their pizza's.

name: My Bowtie
text: Good pizza but not very filling pizza because two pizzas would equal a regular one.

name: Christopher Pasecznyk
text: So good you will want another to go

name: Kimberly Korzym
text: Very good! Pizzas are bigger than expected. Camino pizza & artichoke dip 👌

name: Chris Dahlhauser
text:
Great pizza,  good beer selection,  a little pricey.
Not a bad choice if you are downtown.

name: Richard Parker
text: Eclectic pizza options. True Italians would be appalled by having arugula on a pizza but the trust fund force in Bozeman will love it!

name: Official Alaskan
text: Fantastic hosting and wine selection, thanks Sam

name: Collin Moore
text:
Great pizza, nice atmosphere with windows opening onto main street.
The space seems like it might be loud if it's busy...

name: Bernie Massey
text: I had the gluten free pizza... it was excellent!

name: Draco Moonblade
text: Great smelling great tasting food good atmosphere

name: Jeff Mazer
text: Great pizza, excellent crust, nice atmosphere at a surprisingly reasonable price.

name: John Trapp
text: Great ambiance, and the pizza was very good! I don't know if it was the best in town, but I greatly enjoyed the place and would be back again!

name: Sheldon Young
text: The Pesto pizza is the one to go for and the staff are  great and friendly. I always will be a repeat customer for fire artisan.

name: Pete Coppolillo
text: Great pizza and salad lunch combo.

name: Briana Bell
text: Absolutely delicious and great service!

name: Jackson Cyr
text: Reserve a table. Relax, the movie is going to be good.

name: Desirea Rees
text: good pizza and service

name: Ben Lemon
text: There was a slice of cucumber in my water instead of ice...

name: Jessica Camp
text: Delicious. Nice and friendly.

name: Jane Foster
text: Excellent food excellent service great atmosphere!!! 🍕🍕🍕🍕

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: Delicious and creative pizzas

name: Kathleen Crocker
text: Best pizza EVER

name: Mary C. Hoffman
text: Very good lunch.

name: Robyn Young
text: Great food

name: Steven Atkin
text: A cool place with great atmosphere, excellent cocktails and good beer selection. The service was perfect, the architecture was cool, nicely decorated, and a really cool revolving front door that is worth trying to decipher the impossible parking lot entrance. The food, was entirely disappointing. A pronounced and forward flavor, apparently a trademark of their kitchen as it was found across every dish we tried, was a flavor that builds in your mouth with every bite until about 6 or 10 bites in where I put the fork down and refused to put another bite of it in my mouth. The burgers looked excellent and the stuffed pretzels come in a pizza box. They are tender and delicious if u can wash down the handful of kosher salt applied. Overall we had fun, they were nice about the returned meal. If we come back. We would definitely go the other direction with food and try a pizza! Good luck.

name: Shawn dunn
text: I came here on April 14th. I was very fond of their beer selection.  I was actually getting a show at the bar by one bartender training a newbie how to make different drinks.  That was pretty cool. It did take a long time for them to take my order (roughly 25 minutes) for food -- I had to ask. I ordered the Cajun burger,  and it was delicious along with the fries.  Another awesome place here in Bozeman,  MT that you should definitely try!

name: Callie Pedersen
text: Came here for some appetizers and some drinks and enjoyed our experience very much! Food is priced decent as well as the drinks. The bonus for us was that we ended up there for happy hour and our Margaritas were only $3 a piece 😍 Will be returning in the very near future.

name: Barbara Webster
text: Never tasted a better burger in all my days!!!  No wonder the place is always so crowded!  Excellent service, even if they did forget my military discount!

name: M Maz
text: Food was just ok. Steak was chewy and had lots of fat. Our table was next to the service area, so zero stars for ambience. Overall, disappointed.

name: Dukes Consulting
text: the service and atmosphere was outstanding. The  Philly steak sandwich and pretzel stick were amazing I would go back again.

name: Jen Villa
text: Good food. No paper menus! Very busy at lunch time and the staff just wants to get you in and out fast

name: Charlie Conner
text: Excellent food, fantastic beer selection, and the staff was very friendly. Will definitely be going back.

name: Jocelyn Maxwell
text: It's ok. Average burger and steaks place. Nothing about it is spectacular but it's not a place to avoid either. I do feel like the prices are a bit too high. The staff are always super nice though.

name: Renae Taylor
text: First time for us to come in. Our server Dani was amazing and very attentive. Food was on point and prompt. Very nice experience & we will be back. Thank you Sidewinders!

name: Ryan Villa
text: Food really was great. Hope you're in a hurry. Your server is. Which is great combined w/the 7 page pdf menu that you can peruse 1 item at a time.

name: Caylin Lancione
text: Great spot for everything from beer and football to date nights and family gatherings. Burgers are amazing, but there are several other options for the fancier crowd as well, and everything is done with love. Staff has been awesome coping with our state's back and forth restrictions, and they haven't let the stress of 2020 affect their excitement to host and serve their guests. 10/10

name: Brian Mueller
text: Amazing drinks and food. We loved the huge central fireplace.  Great service.

name: Nicole Gleason
text: What a fabulous place to eat! The scenery and decor is interesting and keeps you busy while waiting for your food to arrive. Despite my inability to settle on something to eat the waiter was patient and didn't smother us too much even though the place was busy! My family and I don't frequent Bozeman often so finding this little gem was a stroke of luck and indeed made our afternoon lunch memorable. Sidewinders not only has exceptional food but they also support local endeavors and individuals, host charity events, and offer an amazingly wide range of local Montana beers. This was a tiny gem we managed to find and will definitely be back again next time me and my family of 6 find ourselves around that way again.

name: Kristina Gale
text: I went here tonight and it was an amazing experience. The server was very friendly and the food was really good. I highly recommend sidewinders

name: John Rossetti
text: Good food, fun vibe & nice wait staff.

name: Dylan Hill
text: Great place to eat! Always look forward to the next time I can go in!

name: William Jakle
text:
Amazing Food, Plenty of Beer, Generous Staff and Veteran Owned!!
One of the best spots in Bozeman to hang out and get some food in a good atmosphere.
Plus you won't have to worry about offending the out-of-staters.

name: Richard Salonek
text: Vibrant atmosphere and friendly staff.  I had the cajon salmon and it was very good. My wife had the hot chicken sandwich, it was good but not as great as others.  We shared the cast iron cookie for dessert, it was excellent.  Huge selection of craft beers.

name: Tyler Goff
text: Food was delicious! Loved the appetizer and my BBQ burger. The waiter was not attentive. Slow to take our order, barely checked on us, and took forever to close the table. The patio get terrible hot in the afternoon! There is no shade to sit in... I was thinking they would have a shade screen.

name: Jennifer Frantzich
text: Food was amazing!! Great atmosphere.

name: Susan Thorp
text: It was our first time here and we had burgers.  My husband ate the Hawaiian burger and I ate the avocado and cheddar both were amazing.  The atmosphere was great and the service is excellent also the prices were good.  We will be back.

name: Carrie Arndt
text:
The first time I ate in the restaurant I had an awful experience...

But I didn’t give up, I had a get together and ordered pizza for my friends, it was delicious!

I also ordered a chicken sandwich (Nashville Hot) and it was also so good.

I never give up in finding good places to eat. This place was one!

name: Tammy Beattie
text: Veteran owned?  So cool...great menu!!

name: Tom H
text: Wonderful atmosphere. Top Notch staff. The chicken pot pie was phenomenal. And so was the cowboy cookie dessert.

name: Justin V.
text: I’d come to accept the harsh reality that the days of behemoth portions at restaurants was a thing of the past. Then I stopped at Sidewinders. Juicy, thick burgers with double (if not triple) the serving of fries compared to anywhere else, it’s one of the few restaurant meals that fills me up. And the flavors are incredible. Everything else on the menu looks equally appetizing, plus the staff is always extremely friendly.

name: Tristan Harris-Pearce
text: Always great wait staff, and the food is amazing

name: Eric M
text: Nice place to go after an afternoon dip at Bozeman Hot Springs. The place is clean and inviting. Hardly any wait for our party of 10. Good food and fast service. Recommend highly.

name: Ryan
text: I’ve only had to-go but it is one of the best restaurants in the Bozeman area. I would recommend the truffle fries to share with the table. I definitely will be back hopefully in person.

name: Chad Karch
text: Awesome food and service. I was expecting a restaurant of this type to probably have smaller portions than they did but was quite surprised

name: Angela Elser
text: Fast, friendly, absolutely wonderful service and the food is delicious!!

name: Mary Descheemaeker
text: My steak was wonderful and we are to please. We raise beef so we like a good steak. Tbey put tbe NFR on the big screen for us and we were delighted. They messed up one order and without even telling us corrected the order and gave us the extra food. Great restaurant in Bozeman!!!

name: Bobby Sipes
text: Great atmosphere nad food with a great solute to the military 🇺🇸

name: mortarhound78
text: Food is great, staff is great, ambience is wonderful. We sat down at the bar, ordered our food, and asked for a certain baseball game which they actually had. The other thing is that this restaurant is owned by two veterans, which has a special place in my heart.

name: Timothy Whittenberg
text: Great atmosphere, and awesome food!

name: Chris Anderson
text: The staff is always so friendly!

name: Leinani Hance
text: Great food! My guy LOVES their bison burger so much we make special trips to Bozeman just for that. Wonderful service also. Keep up the good work!

name: Jon Ventura
text: Great food delivered quickly and with a smile

name: Katie McAfee
text: This place is awesome and the food is to die for

name: Stacey Hildebrandt
text: Excellent service and very good food!

name: Barbara Dierenfeldt
text: Covid19 precautions followed.  Clean. Friendly server. My rib eye steak was cooked perfectly and tasted delicious!

name: Kavin M
text: Food is fantastic, I recommend starting with the "S"idewinder pretzel, nachos, or the French onion soup! Meals are delicious and portion sizes are great! The atmosphere is bustling with energy and is a great place to eat with friends and family!

name: Eat Well Travel Often
text: Atmosphere, decor, drinks, & overall vibe get 5 stars. Food gets 3 stars. In our opinion, this is the perfect place for drinks & an appetizer, & we’ll be back for that. We won’t be back for dinner, though.

name: Darajh
text: Always great food, I love how they have introduced modern tech into their restaurant for waiting for a table as well as accessing their menu.

name: Shane Naki
text:
3.5/5
Pros: Awesome beer selection. Great Reuben.
Cons: so-so service.  Nothing ruins a great beer like a bad bartender.

Would go again because of its convenient location, but would not go out of my way to return here.

name: ryan galliher
text: Affordable, quick service, good food. Family atmosphere as well as a nice sports bar feel up at the bar.

name: Kristin Koetz Nunn
text: Consistently good with a broad menu and great rotator selections

name: dcjulian5
text: Excellent food, service and atmosphere. So glad we have this awesome spot nearby!

name: michell baca
text: Good food and customer service. Had a good night on our date

name: Toni Halbritter
text: Love it and everyone there are awesome

name: Josh Winterrowd
text: Good beer selection. Had a BBQ burger that was pretty sub par for the price. The 1/3 pound burger disappeared into the monster sized bun. Couldn't really taste much burger. The bacon was paper thin. The fries where very greasy to the point of soggy.  But they have a great beer and wine selection. Lots of local and state breweries plus a nice selection of national ones. The atmosphere is pretty loud. The place has a nice open layout with a cool bar and fireplace. Will try it again just won't get a burger.

name: Thomas Willis
text: Outstanding food and service at a fair price.

name: Annie Venters
text: Lots of beer on tap, and pretty good cocktails. Not happy with the food though. Very greasy, not cooked to order, fries and burger were served lukewarm.

name: Chris Clark
text: nice deck good food

name: Jasmine Spivey
text: Loved it. Was busy when we went and we had a large group. They got us right in and the food was amazing

name: Bridgette Hyde
text: They offer nothing to the neighborhood. At least they have salads. The business model is old, tired, and robbing culture from BZN. That place doesn't belong here but in FL! The  employer's model is the direct cause of employees working two jobs to pay rent, weakness in their body and immune system, and they still cannot afford a quality Health Care plan so they require everyone else to wear mask and pay the employees wages. That business model needs to be retired!  Your food isn't enough! Shut down or reinvent!

name: Jason Kirch
text: Great place to relax and great good.

name: Lauren Whiddon
text: Always good food, and they have gluten free buns!

name: Aaron Blakeslee
text: Always great food!

name: MJ O
text: Other than having to use your phone for the menu, I found the food to be good and fairly priced.  Incredibly fast in receiving our order !  Would recommend.

name: Tanner Johnson
text: High quality food and high quality service

name: Dieter
text: I just think this place is a bit too pricy for what it is. My pulled pork sandwich came out with no bbq sauce at all. Had to ask for it. And I can't quite put my finger on what's wrong with the fries, but they just aren't good.

name: Chris Woods
text: Had cheese ravioli with spinach and shrimp, and the shrimp were surprisingly good. I really enjoyed it. Large portions and pretty good service. They have a great beer list and many food options. Its regularly packed  Friday and Saturday night so go another time.

name: Michael Banville
text: I enjoyed 2 appetizers - very large mozzarella bars (not sticks, believe me, an entire meal in and of itself) and amazing pot stickers. The selection of wines by the glass was also impressive, and way more reasonable than other dining establishments in town. My new go-to place that allows me to stay on the outskirts of town, avoiding cross-town traffic

name: Bill N.
text: Family showed up around 945pm for dinner on a Thursday night. Didn't know they quit serving food at 10pm, sorry. Service was great! Had dinner and some drinks,  all was good. Comfortable atmosphere, cool place to be, thanks!

name: Andy Amidon
text: Gone here several times in large groups and small. Very good at accommodating large groups with reservations and a non busy time. Long waits and delays with food when I've gone with smaller groups. Great beer selection, probably average prices. I wasn't blown away by their famous pretzel, and other food items were about average. Pretty cool atmosphere

name: Korissa Harmon
text: Food tasted great but it gave my boyfriend and I food poisoning. Not sure if it was the Baja chicken sandwich, the truffle fries with ailoi sauce or both. 😫

name: Michelle Henry
text: Great service, great food & plenty of food and beverage choices.

name: William Gruenes
text: Great place. Good cold beer and drinks. Amazing food.

name: B B
text: Best on tap variety in town, pretty good food also. Insider secret is they are willing to stuff the sidewinder pretzel with pretty much anything so you can build some great favorites. Personal favorite is pepperoni, gruyere, basil, and roasted garlic.

name: Laura Myrstol
text: Great food, great service and great atmosphere.

name: Savannah Donnelly
text: Sidewinders has great food, although it's a bit pricey. I'm giving a low review because they over charged me and after 3 different calls to try and correct the situation they never did... even after they took down my credit info twice. I like supporting smaller restaurant chains, but after this I won't eat here again.

name: Jon Gfeller
text: Good stuff happens here.

name: Jessica Downey
text: Great selection of beers! The service is top-notch too. Thanks for a great girl's night!

name: Matt Klawiter
text: Absolutely fantastic. The stuffed pretzel app and the chicken pot pie were both excellent. There a nice beer selection as well

name: Eric T.
text: Everything ordered was great. I had the calamari. It was the best I've ever had. I will be stopping by here again. The beer is good too with a decent selection.

name: Samantha Boyer
text: Amazing atmosphere .. Great food .. Loved the patio area. Fish and chips were to die for.

name: Mitch Shattuck
text: Amazing food and amazing service (:

name: Robert Barrows
text: Good food, good service, good price.

name: K Johnson
text: Assortment of beers is great. Food is mediocre. Best we've had is the chicken pot pie and the pretzel. Those are tasty. Everything else has been nothing to write home about.

name: Roderick Byrne
text: Food  was awesome,  great  service as well.

name: B
text: Update: I was refused carry out,being a dedicated patron, I will never spend my money here ever again. Your business is terrible.

name: bla blublu
text: Have never had a bad meal there, I've been around half a dozen times now. Can definitely recommend the chicken pot pie. Staff is pleasant although sometimes stressed.

name: Susan Horton
text:
It is a large restaurant so it is usually easy to get a seat for lunch, but pretty busy for dinner. Can get noisy.
About $12 - $15 for lunch. Food is tasty and portions are generous. Especially liked the potato fries.
We had a group of 12 and they did a great job accommodating us. Friendly and efficient.

name: Molly Garland
text: We had 15 minutes till the kitchen closed and they still were friendly and willing to do our orders perfect.  I hate doing that to servers but they made it seem like it was no big deal.  The burgers were wonderful, fries were great and my salad was plenty big and had lots of taste.

name: Geo-Fry
text: Great food and atmosphere. Decent selection of beers on tap.

name: Jacy Morris
text: Not only is Sidewinders overpriced,  but they upcharge things beyond what is priced on the menu.

name: jordan wagner
text:
Yummmmmm.
Everything here was amazing!
Everything.

name: Jenny Collins
text:
Went there for our first time tonight for a celebration dinner. I have never felt so welcome at a restaurant. Like they actually appreciated our business! It was super busy but the service did not reflect that at all. Not rushed or pressured. Kate was our amazing server and so patient and knowledgeable with our questions and adjusting our order in such a busy atmosphere.
The food was out of sight. Fresh, homemade, cooked and plated perfectly. Many options and variations. Definitely something for everyone. Fantastic prices. And there's even an arcade room! Sidewinders has now moved to #1 for our family favorite.

name: Brant Gilbert
text:
Patriot themed sports bar.
Brought kids because of "game room" they played on the phone instead. Also wouldn't eat their mac and cheese , tasted and agreed. Burgers are decent, but don't stand out from every other one in bozeman.
20 minute wait with 12 open tables and booths visible from entryway. [They text you from 15 foot away when your table is ready]
New place that has a lot of potential if they pay attention to their reviews.
Of course if you're  there to drink and watch sports they have that part figured out well.
I'll  give them a second try in a few months and change my review if they get things better.
Just added on a cup of soup (french onion) was 8.00 ouch!
Finished the soup, was the high point of the meal, very good. (Maybe not 8.00 good though).

name: Angela Moore
text: I love going here!! The staff is incredible, efficient and friendly. The food is consistently amazing and fabulous quality. The atmosphere is fun and happy!

name: Ron Hale
text: Very nice atmosphere. Had fish and chips they were excellent except needed just a touch more seasoning. My wife had salad said it was good.

name: evan sapp
text: I love Sidewinders! Great service and beer selections. The Nashville hot chicken sandwich is my favorite thing for lunch in Bozeman

name: Jae Evans
text: Sidewinders has a great beer selection. If you run out of places in Bozeman to find a $13 hamburger, give it a try. I've had a couple of different burgers here and I have to say I had trouble telling the difference between the two of them. But the service is fast and friendly, the food is good, and did I mention the beer selection?

name: Jane Foster
text: Ben did an awesome job! 👍 great food and great service!

name: Matthew Yetter
text: There's a reason this place is always hopping.  There atmosphere is good... able to handle lots of people without feeling crowded. The staff has always been friendly. Prices are reasonable for the quality and quantity of food. Everything tastes great, and their spinach & artichoke cheese dip appetizer is amazing!  Sidewinders has become one of our favorite spots in town.

name: Caroline & CG Feldman
text: Service was good, burger nothing special

name: Courtnie Lemirande
text: Great food and great atmosphere! Staff is extremely nice, and always willing to help! They have a huge variety of food and drink here. Every time a family/friends have a birthday dinner, this is always the place to go!

name: Patricia Palmer
text: Good food good service great patio!!!

name: River Burns
text: Try the strawberry margarita!

name: Bill Kopell
text: Excellent food, helpful pleasant service

name: Brian Vincent
text: The first few times coming here it was great.  However, it's too popular now, it's hard to get a table and service has gone downhill.  I don't think I've ever had the same server twice or even seen them again.  Tonight it took them 20 minutes just to bring us menus to where we were sitting in the open bar, the food order was messed up and had to be sent back, and no one bothered to ask if we needed drinks refilled. There's also much more interesting places to eat and drink in Bozeman.

name: Dustin Finck
text: Great service and delicious food! One of my favorites!

name: Stace Ewing
text: 9/30/19 Had an excellent dinner and wonderful service (Terry)!  My what a big menu you have...I enjoyed the Party Melt with your delicious fries and my friend liked you French Onion soup and French Dip! Glad you had the game on! Will for sure be back in the future!

name: Emily Lawrence
text: I normally love this place, however I recently had a sub-par experience with both the food and drinks. My partner ordered a White Russian, and it came curdled - actual chunks floating around in it. My margarita came with wayyyyy too much salt on the rim, I didn't even know that was possible. (And I've orded them before) We ordered nachos and weren't really impressed - it was almost completely just cheese and the rest of the toppings lacked (we paid extra for pork). Their sweet potato fries are normally a hit, so we ordered that to "try and leave satisfied" but alas, they came undercooked. I'm not sure if they just had an off night or what (it wasn't that busy). I'll definitely give it a another chance but I was bummed. Used to be one of my favorite places! Despite all this, our server was very polite - so at least there is that!

name: andrew stewart
text: Meh, it's alright. Big bar with above average bar food. Patio on roof in the summer is pretty sweet

name: Julie Smith
text: Their fries are great!! It’s always super busy so come early. Really expansive menu, you could find something for everyone. They also have great drink options, and I’ve had really awesome service each time. The space is unique and huge but can get a bit loud. Definitely try Sidewinders out!

name: Scott D
text: I don't like to leave negative reviews so I won't.  Love the fireplace.

name: Tawnia Wilson
text: They were insanely busy but very efficient. We got our food within a reasonable amount of time. It was a little expensive for my taste but very good quality.

name: UwU Toga UwU
text: I have gone here 3-4 times, I cant wait until next time! Their food is delicious, the staff are amazing, the decor is beautiful, and the wait for a table or food, isnt long. I highly recommend this amazing place

name: Eric Eichel
text: Busy and huge place on the west side of town. Really good food options, beer choices were nice too. You can tell a big effort has gone up on that side of town. This place is situated for long term success.

name: Jan Bowman
text: I really liked their beer battered fries, nice and crispy. Sports bar atmosphere, open, bright and spacious. Generous servings. Large variety of choices, pizza, salads, sandwiches, burgers.

name: Mary Ellen
text: Attentive waiter, not intrusive. Decent food. Busy for a Monday lunch! Will go again. Tea drinkers note: hot tea is loose leaf, I think five choices! Terrific.

name: Dave Johnston
text:
The steak with blue cheese bacon butter could change your life.

Servers are good, but need a touch more training on how to be great.

name: Amy Zmolik
text: Great food,beer, service and views.

name: Dave and Reine Broome
text: My family and I eat at Sidewinders about twice a month. My kids love the "S"idewinder Pretzel and order it every time. Sidewinders is always a good option for us!!

name: Linda Hogg
text: Our waiter was incredible tonight! Thanks for consistently providing great food and awesome service, Sidewinders Staff!

name: Jennifer Astrin
text: I really love it

name: Lance Picton
text: Good food. Good beer. Fun atmosphere. Friendly wait staff. What else could you want?

name: David Langkiet
text: Great atmosphere... Lots of beers to choose from, the food was great. The service was great. We had 20 people in our party and not one thing went wrong. There's a small game room for the kids to play in.

name: Gary Allen
text: Food is good. Cool atmosphere. The military/discount is pretty pathetic.

name: Lucretia Berardinelli
text: A single slice of their delish pizzas

name: Stevie Croisant
text:
Make sure you’re super hungry when you get here as the portions are always huge! I’ve never had anything here I didn’t like (do yourself a favor and get the pretzel appetizer).

Hunter was an amazing server. He was friendly and was super patient with our large group!

name: Montana
text: Best vegitarian burger I have EVER had. So excited this is an option! If you love a good burger but want to try an alternative to meat without giving up the flavor, this is your burger. I had to ask if it was veggie or beef because I could not tell the difference! Great service! Great atmosphere. Can't wait to come back.

name: Todd Roblyer
text: This was the 1st time here and when I'm in town again I will be back great selection on menu cool atmosphere veteran owned Semper Fi family place can't wait to go back!

name: Jazmin Gutierrez
text: Great Service/food outside dining was nice

name: Jim G
text: They have very good food.  Portions are big but not too big. You will not leave hungry. Great place for friends to meet and have a meal.

name: Rebekah Mohr
text: Really good food. I enjoyed the Chicken Pot Pie a lot. Good sized portions. Great beer list and family friendly. This place is pretty popular and I would recommend getting there early for a table on a Friday or Saturday night.

name: Kurt Lineback
text: I have enjoyed Sidewinders everytime I eat there. They have a good menu, quite a variety of food to choose from and for the most part it's comfort foods. For example, my wife had a Dagwood sandwich with roasted broccoli and I had a Mushroom Swiss burger with fries. They also have pizza, chicken sandwiches and a bunch of other stuff. That mysterious good touch as well it is comfortable, and relaxing. I feel at home at this place. Give it a try, you won't be disappointed.

name: Bozeman Review
text:
Great atmosphere for young people or perhaps a night out on the town.  Not a family place or a place suitable for kids.

Big bar, very loud, pretty hip.

Food is decent.

4 star for the atmosphere.  We would rate it at a 3 for food and 1 star for a family night out.

name: Jackie Stults
text: Great service, even better food. Hannah gave great service. While service in Bozeman has been on the decline, Sidewinders has maintained service and is quick to make things right if they make a human error. Kudos!

name: Rachel Turner
text: Tasty food, excellent service every time, even when we came in with a large group!

name: Tim Burger
text: Good food and friendly atmosphere

name: Mik'haela Digan
text: Great food, nice atmosphere with high ceilings and really open spacing. Has a game room for kids. The service was wonderful, we didn't wait long for our food even though it was busy. It also has a lot of gluten free options.

name: Mike Scully
text: Beer was good, food sounded great but I didn't get any.

name: FingTim Halbritter
text: We really enjoy the food and the staff we've gotten to know some of them thanks guys for everything

name: Robert McNellis
text: Solid beer choices, good food, great atmosphere. Server was inattentive but didn’t ruin the experience.

name: Chet Zaiko
text: The burgers are probably the best in town and they have an exceptional selection of microbrews plus the wait staff are excellent.

name: gottsdamn
text: Great food but the Packers game was on while I was here and they won :-(

name: Sheldon Young
text: Sidewinders is such a good place for games, food and drinks. It's a wide open and spacious place. Never really cool fireplace that you can sit on a nice couch and enjoy while drinking your favorite martini or iced tea lemonade.

name: Jena Nash Reno
text: Great night.  Riley O'Leary made our night.  Great server, great food.

name: She Talks
text: Love this place! USMC!!!!!! 🇺🇸 This is a great place to go out for an enjoyable meal and a drink.  With our Children sometimes sitting out and eating is not an option and the staff is so helpful and kind in getting our takeout order ready and on time.

name: Dustin Shoemake
text: Great atmosphere and service. SUPER salty gravy on the chicken fried steak

name: Terri Hatch Johnston
text: Comfortable, clean and inviting atmosphere. Very friendly and accommodating staff.  The food is great. The pizza, pretzels, burgers and sweet potato fries are among our favorites. Highly reccomend!!

name: Sam Solak
text: So many delicious food options! Their nachos with pork and their avocado burger are astoundingly tasty! Will definitely be back!

name: Ann Wright
text: Ordered ribeyes, chicken fried steak and a French Dip. The only thing we didn't care for was the cucumber, tomato farro. The waitress offered us another side and we were pleased. The waitress was excellent. The food was cooked perfectly, seasoned well and tasty! We will be back!

name: Jake Vigesaa
text: One of the coolest large sports bars I've ever been to, with a fantastic beer selection!

name: Terek Beckman
text: Fun, friendly atmosphere. Love bringing folks here from out of town. Love the pretzels!

name: Winter Blackmore
text: Fun atmosphere and great food. I will say its pretty loud in there but over all it's nice. We love the S pretzel and the adult milkshakes. Their fish and chips are also good. Wouldn't order the cowboy Mac 'n cheese again, just too much going on there.

name: Luci Edwards Bzn Realty Listings
text: I love the ambience of this place! Great food great beer and the service is amazing!!!

name: Kirk Bailey
text: Only had the Ruben but it was good. Home made 1000 island dressing was amazing. Great environment.

name: Eileen Murley
text: Very cool place.  Had a great server. Friendly. Food was great. Had onion soup,  very nice, hubby had chicken pot pie, huge and very tasty

name: Kelly Palmer
text: Wow! This is such a cool place. Jumpseat seating chairs, cool details throughout.  the drinks were fantastic and the food amazing. the service was fantastic and to make sure that everyone was having a good experience the manager went table to table to make sure they were satisfied. I will definitely go back.

name: Brent Nagy
text: Trey is consistently awesome. Didnt skip a beat with 12 of us and we had zero issues, fast and great service. Awesome experience.

name: Carl Mayes
text: I like this place, great sportsbar with great food, service could have been a little better

name: Tom Hessler
text: Was there for Veterans' Day. Our waitress Amy gave us great service and made us vets feel especially welcome. The food was very, very good - I had a BBQ pork sandwich that was excellent. The booth was large enough to accommodate our 6 veterans. Just a real good experience.  Thanks!

name: Beau Anderson
text: Excellent food, amazing staff. Loved the atmosphere. My in-laws were able to take advantage of the military discount they offer here which was good. The food was made well.

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: The salmon and the pizza are really good, good service, huge space.

name: Courtney Reisig
text: Their spinach artichoke dip is THE BOMB! So are their stuffed pretzels for that matter. I have never had food there that I disliked. It is almost always busy and they quote you 30 min wait times but I have never waited longer than 15 minutes. Even though it is busy, we always get a nice cozy quiet seat.

name: Andrew Kaufman
text: Really good food. A little pricy, but great atmosphere.

name: Dawn Gormely
text: Great atmosphere.. loved the wood fireplace

name: David Green
text: Very tasty food. Oooops held the kitchen open for our late order. Thanks to our server. Great stone fireplace !!

name: Priscilla Chamberlin
text: Veteran Owned,good food,fun atmosphere,patriotic decor.Friendly service,wide variety.

name: Ashley Stednitz
text: We absolutely love it here! The food is great, the service has been nothing but stellar, and the atmosphere is fun! We have been here many times and will continue to go! Very family friendly as well.

name: Jack Scherman
text: Had a lovely experience with tasty food and great service from Trey.  Really liked the fantastic beer selection, good portion sizes, happy hour and the apple pie.  Cant say enough about the customer service, had a couple requests and we were accommodated fantastically.  Will certainly return when I'm dining on the west side again.

resp.text:
Hey Jack,
Thank you very much for the feedback. We're so sorry for the mess-up on your food order. We would love to invite you and a friend in for lunch or dinner one of these days at your convenience. If you're interested, please shoot us an email at blane.woodfin@bluecollarjh.com.

Thanks again, and we look forward to serving you again soon.

name: Katherine Vogel
text: If you love fried foods, there ya go.

name: SabinOfFigero
text: Had reservation for over a month. Now I'm standing in a line. Waiting on a table. Others without reservations have be seated. My party has not.

text: This location has a solid menu. The food has always been great. Their drink line up is awesome and the staff have always been polite and helpful.

name: Mike Giroux
text: Really enjoyed the food.  Pretty busy and at peak times it is loud so not perfect for a mealtime meeting.

name: Dharma Mcryhew

Food was good.  Had the fettuccini alfredo with salmon added.  Salmon was flavored well and cooked perfectly.

Drinks were good, as well.  Had the Long Island Iced Tea.

text: They make a delicious chicken sandwich (Hot Nashville) and killer fries. The calamari is perfectly cooked (no mean feat) and the potstickers are killer. Will definitely be back.

text: Nice and fun place.  Would prefer a little divider between booth tables and the people next to you

text: I eat here a lot. Great salads. I especially like the shrimp on the southwestern salad. The reason I didn't give them a 5 is that their burgers aren't good. I expect a place like this to have outstanding burgers. Their pretzels are awesome and the atmosphere is too.

name: Sean Austin
text: A wonderful menu, the people are really friendly too, but it's probably the noisiest restaurant in Bozeman.  If someone suggests a list of restaurants for a meeting, we automatically veto Sidewinders.  Today they brought out the wrong entree because the staff member taking our orders couldn't hear us clearly.

name: Brian Rauch
text: This is a really fun place to eat. Had an opportunity to meet the owner as he hosted our Veteran group. He is great. Beautiful balcony on the outside. There is a game room for the kids. And the menu is diverse enough the whole family can eat. Fully recommend.

name: Belle Smolczynski
text: Good food and friendly/attentive staff. The liquor menu is good, and their adult milkshakes are a must try!

name: LucidSex
text: Friendly staff, great atmosphere, good portions, and great food.

name: Cyrina Wilkerson
text: Went for the first time today got the ranch hamburger, fires and side salad. The salad was delicious. Then our food came I cut my hamburger in half and started to munch away it was very good then I look down and there is a black hair in my plate, I have pets and I get there hair in my mouth alot so my mom who had nachos had a extra plate and I was just going to move my food over to a clean plate and I went to grab the other half of the hamburger there was a long black hair sticking out of it. I was done. The waitress was very apologetic and her service was awesome along with the atmosphere. I will probably give this place a other try sometime down the road just cause from what I did taste that was hair free was amazing!!

name: Rylie Hunt
text: Very good food everytime, the pretzel appetizer was the highlight of the meal and our server Rio was a refreshing change from the usual boring "customer service voice" type of server you usually get at restaurants. He talked to us like we were actually people having a conversation and chatted about mutual interests A+

name: U R
text: Nice place. Excellent selection on draft beers

name: Devin Sabec

name: Janet Marchington
text: Great food, service was great. Say outside and it was awsome, nice weather. Will :go back.

name: Joceline Wyatt

name: Jessica Camp

name: Chris Lovelace

name: Lisa
text:
I can't believe it took us so long to come here after hearing such great things, and we agree with all the rumors.
Our food was delicious and came out in a timely manner, same with drinks. They've got an extensive menu which will be fun to explore in the future.

name: Luke Greenwood
text: Friendly service and relatively good food

name: CroChick5
text: Great service and Tasty food! Can't wait to try a few more other dishes!!! Big portions and lots of beers to choose from!

name: Kristin Drain
text: Fun atmosphere,  good selection of beers and apps, good service. Love the patriotic decor.

name: My Bowtie
text: First time going out anywhere that everyone ate all of their food. Our server Emily was awesome! We had black & Bleu burgers with fries, garlic mashed potatoes, chicken tenders, pork chops,chocolate and vanilla milkshakes. YUM!

name: Les Craig
text: This place just keeps getting better. Food quality of preparation has gone way up since opening. Venue ambiance and beer selection, best in Bozeman - ample parking and great location between downtown and four corners. Management team is world class, family owned and operated - deeply vested in community, job creation, and workforce culture. Great spot for parties and events - rooftop open in the late spring/ summer/ early fall.

name: Jana Cichowski
text: Excellent selection of beers on tap and fantastic burgers. I enjoy the burgers so much, that I haven't tried any of their other food, but from what I've seen it all looks delicious. There's a small game room too, so there's fun for the entire family. Beautiful atmosphere too!

name: Arin Peters
text: Very good food and service. Fun atmosphere too

name: William Mauritsen
text: Great atmosphere, good food, could be a little lighter inside.

name: Jay Szott
text: Great service and excellent beer selection. Only came for apps but the pizza pretzel was fantastic. I would definitely come back again!

name: Lance Steeves
text: Great place fun atmosphere, attentive staff. Had to try the French onion soup because it was featured on diners, drive ins and dives. And it did not disappoint! Will be back

name: Riley Wegner
text: Great food, helpful employees and fun atmosphere!

name: Debbie Couch
text: Wonderful ❣️ We got to sit outside for lunch with a beautiful view of the mountains 💖

name: Cassandra Wise
text: Great food, great tap selection. Family friendly. Attentive staff.

name: John
text: Chain feel.  U order with someone and some other person brings it.  Salad was soggy like it was made in the morning.  No crunch to the crutons,  and the pot pie is not a pie but casserole with some after thought crust on top.  Nice building, but service and food have not won me over.  (3rd visit, near work)

resp.text:
Hi John,
Sorry to hear about your experience tonight.
We certainly are not a chain restaurant, and it is important to us for our service and atmosphere to not create that feel. We are a family owned and operated business and we do our best to provide a sense of intimacy and personal touch for our guests; I'm sorry that didn't occur tonight.
We cut and serve all of our lettuce fresh, and make our homemade pot pies daily. Your feedback on these items is certainly not what we aim for, and we will strive to make improvements accordingly.
We would like to invite you and a friend or spouse in for dinner on us. Please send an email to blane.woodfin@bluecollarjh.com if you would be interested in giving us a chance to redeem your business.

Sincerely,
The Sidewinders Team

name: Chase Matthews
text: Amazing food and quick service. Well done!

name: William Oliver
text:
Darn good tap selection and good food. Definitely the pick for NFL Sundays.

Updated to 5 star due to their service and food improving a ton in the past few months. Keeps improving as time goes by!

name: William Johnson
text: They have a good variety of options for food and drink.  The ambiance is clean, but not overly sterile, relaxing and open like a lodge.  There is a game arcade.  The staff is very friendly, relaxed and helpful.

name: Dick Schmidt
text: The beer was nice and cold and the burger excellent. Very large order of fries with it also.

name: Jen Wakefield
text: Food was fantastic! I'm Celiac and they made sure I was safe, which I appreciate enormously. Great waiter. Music is really loud, so don't expect to have a quiet conversation. I'll definitely go back.

name: Charytin Ubaldo
text: Its just a different type atmosphere good food from tap beers to really good cocktails.

name: Colton Philp
text: Awesome food with a great wait staff. Rio is the best waiter there. The Broccolini is fantastic!

name: Shane Somerville
text: Great place to eat, very friendly staff. Food was prompt, delicious, and as ordered. Couple mistakes with drinks but they were quickly corrected and even comped. Just be prepared to wait due to its popularity.

name: Sami Thomas
text: Excellent food and service at a reasonable in a wonderful atmosphere!

name: Sarah Lilly
text: Huge helping of nachos and a couple of ciders on a cold night. Cant beat that!

name: Bob Quinn
text: The chicken fried steak was good but the sides were mostly potato variations that lacked much flavor.

name: Mark Harding
text: Great food with a very cool atmosphere!

name: Roy Whitworth
text: entering. Food but never quiet hot enough good beer selection.

name: Michelle Dammen
text: Excellent lunch spot. My go to for work lunch meetings!

name: Tyler Kern
text: It is hit or miss if you are going to get a good experience here. Often the waiter and waitresses are not very attentive. The food is mediocre and the menu never changes. They do how ever have one of the largest beer selections in town whoch does make this place worth a visit.

resp.text:
Hey Tyler,
I'm sorry to hear you've had less-than-ideal experiences with us. We'd love to make it up to you. If you're willing, please shoot me an email at blane.woodfin@bluecollarjh.com and we'll set something up. We truly value our guests and we will do whatever we can to make this right.

name: Rona Van Luchene
text: Good food...

name: Karl B
text: The back of house does a spectacular job. Truly phenomenal! The salad I had was possibly the best I've ever had.

name: Nick Combs
text: The food is amazing. I would recommend the chicken pot pie for a main meal. If you are looking for a good appetizer, I would recommend the spinach dip, it is easily the best I have ever had. The only reason this place doesnt get 5 stars is because the service has been hit or miss.

name: Cam T

name: Kevin Wylie

name: Jonathan Hoag

name: Geoff Dowell
text: Great food. Fun atmosphere. Love to eat here.

name: Janice Combs
text: Great food with lots of selections.  Staff was super friendly and the service was great!

name: Dan Lee
text: Great beer selections. Tons of taps. Several entrees are Good. Can be inconsistent. Same with service. Regardless good non pretentious hangout on Bozeman west side. Glad there are there

name: Bayard L
text:
The salad and burger choices have my tastebuds watering every time and the beer selection should make any beer snob satisfied.

The menu has enough choices that vegetarians, bird eaters, and steak lovers in a group can all be happy with the food options.

You can’t order food at the upstairs outdoor bar, but that is the only major downside so far. The parking lot is usually pretty full and parking could become a problem once the adjacent market opens (currently nearing the end of construction).

name: Andrew King
text: They have a great and wide variety of beer and other alcohols. The food they make is amazing, and the portions are huge. The Nachos could have been a meal for 2 people alone.

name: Mark Sigler
text: Excellent food, great service!

name: Wendy Harvey
text: I did not go there. I went past it to go to the dermatologist office

name: Dude Mann
text: This place has a great atmosphere. Bring the kids too. Great food.  I'd recommend the pretzel appetizer and hawiian burger.

name: Eric Sterkel
text: Great atmosphere and location.  The food is solid and staff is great. If you go you have to try their pretzel. I know I know a pretzel? Seriously it’s the best thing you’ll ha e on the menu guaranteed.  Their carne asada meet is amazing.  You wouldn’t think for an American food establishment it would be but watch out!! The drinks are good if the bar tender is paying attention. The wait staff is always generous and attentive.  If you have kids the game room is a life saver and time killer.  Hard to find a testy that my kids and the adults like.  This does it.  The outside patio is stellar, wish it was open year round.

resp.text:
Eric,
Thanks so much for the feedback. We would love to know what we could do to earn that fifth star!
Looking forward to serving you again soon.

-Sidewinders

name: Matt Merry
text: Newer place in Bozeman. Impressive and creative structural design. Huge fireplace.  Lots of seating.  Went they're last week with a group of friends for lunch.  I had the Reuben sandwich with truffle fries. Fantastic! We all really enjoyed our food.  Amazing beer selection...seriously!  Looking forward to going again.

name: Bill Gombita
text: Really enjoyed it. Good food and great service. A server, not ours, saw us struggling with a selfie, not really our thing, and ran over and took are picture.

Upstanding service! Very America! I had the Ranch Hand***PARTY IN MY MOUTH***

My wife bought an alcoholic beverage and presented her temporary ID (the paper one they give you while you wait for the plastic one), and our server asked her if she had another ID with her name on it. text:
Update 8-1-18
Way to go Sidewinders you are setting the standard in Bozeman.  I'm a fan.

They cant seem to accommodate for food allergies, but the service and food quality has improved a lot.  Keep up the good work, but work on your accomodations for food allergies.

70+ tap beers, the food menu is diverse and overall quality/consistency is ok (and getting better), as well as a great atmosphere (except that the live music on 7/3 was WAY too loud and I love live music)

Bottom line...I will go back and probably give 4 stars next time because its getting better and they are ironing out the kinks.

text:
This is the only place I've visited from DDD that has really disappointed me.  Maybe it was better when it was in Jackson.  It's not much different than an Applebee's, now.  The food is bland and generic.   We've been to Sidewinders more than once, and nothing I've ordered has really stood out to me.  It's edible, don't get me wrong, but not somewhere I'd go out of my way to eat at.  Pass on the appetizers, nothing was worth getting. Even the pretzel that they rave about was mediocre.  The crock of french onion soup was a crock of lies.  Just a cup (not a crock) of barely enough liquid to soak the crouton but enough cheese to keep you backed up the next day.  I guess some people like it that way, though...

The kid's game room would be a nice touch, if the kids didn't blow through ten dollars in five minutes.  They're a bit expensive for the duration.

The beer selection is the only thing I will not complain about.  It was on point.

There is a massive bar as the focal point, waitresses walk around in butt shorts and giant tv screens with stations that play commercials with horror movie ads or sports, sports and more sports. Just another blah restaurant to cater to the 20 something year old crowd. Nothing special. And sorry, but just because you started out in Jackson, WY means absolutely nothing to real Montanan's. text:

text: It’s a Saturday night and we received our 7 pm reservation right on time.  Very nice.  And then everything stopped, even beverage service was slow. We’d very clearly asked for no sauce on the tacos, and when finally arrived sauces, trying to wait for a fix was not advised.

name: Joseph Bernhardt
text:
This place seems to be a roll of the dice.  Some things are good, but others aren't great.

The "large" pretzel is about the size of the palm of my hand, so not large by any sense of the word, but at least the price doesn't deceive.  The Plank o' Fries, on the other hand, is almost too much.  Only order that if you have a group of four or more (although my wife and I devoured it).

The buffalo wings were weird.  They were sprinkled with blue cheese crumbles and came with buffalo sauce for dipping.  Backwards?

As for main courses, beware of the popper stack burger, which was almost too hot too eat.  Jalapenos are hot, yes, but this was intense.  The fish and chips wasn't bad.  It was cooked well with a decent portion size, but the mushy peas weren't mushy!  They were just peas.  I would have been offended had I been English.

The bar is great, though.  Good selection of beers and a fantastic bloody ceasar.

name: Michael Parker
text: We stumbled across this quaint little pizzeria tucked away on the edge of our own neighborhood one day and decided to check it out. We were pleasantly surprised to find a quiet atmosphere with comfortable seating that doesn't try to cram 50 people into a space suited for 30. The menu was robust with a wide selection of specialty pizzas all named after local streets or you can always build your own of course. I highly recommend the "gut buster" pizza bread as an appetizer, it was surprisingly large for being so cheap. The pizza was absolutely delicious, the best we've had in town so far. It comes on a thin and airy, crispy crust and the ingredients all seemed fresh and high quality. It isn't quite guilt free, but you certainly don't feel like you're filling up on dough. If you want to avoid the downtown scene, give this place a try, you won't be disappointed.

name: Jess Is Blessed
text:
My daughter and I recently went to see "Scary Stories To Tell In The Dark".  I hadn't been to a movie in about 2 years and was floored that the price was nearly $12 a person!  I know the movies are expensive, but it seems like they increase their prices like crazy.
Then,  we were asked to choose our seats on a monitor, which was also new to me.   We chose the two seats in the very back,  in the center.  I was excited because those are my favorite seats and I thought it was neat you could "reserve" your seats.  So instead of rushing in to claim our seats we went to get popcorn and soda (Another $15) and went happily in the theater to claim our seats... and there sat 2 young men in our seats.  I was disappointed but didn't want to cause a scene, so we just sat a few seats down from them, in the back.   Then another couple came in and up the stairs and by the look on their faces,  we were clearly in THEIR seats.  Basically,  everyone else who entered after that started up the stairs and looked around in confusion as someone was clearly in their seats and so I'm pretty sure that very few of the "reserved" seats ended up being correct.
If the movie theater enforced the seating it would be great,  but as it is now,  it doesn't appear to work and most people don't want to say something to a complete stranger, so they just sit in a different seat.   It just seemed to cause a lot of confusion and uncertainty.
Other than the cost and the seating issues,  the theater was clean and wasn't a freezing 50° degrees, so that was nice.   The employees were all professional and friendly.  There was also a crazy amount of previews, I expect 5-10 minutes but it was nearly 20 minutes of previews which is insane.
Overall,  for an occasional treat,  a movie here is a ok, just expensive.

name: Alistair Asuncion
text:
Why are majority of the reviews so critically harsh? Could it be many of the reviewers get what they give when it comes to customer service? Not to dismiss any of the criticisms people have experienced from this theater, but think about how most people behave in public while being served by others; most of the time it's the customer that's rude, too demanding, and expects a quality of service that may exceed their expectations.

I find the staff friendly and accomodating, the technology is up to date and functioning (excellent viewing and auditory experience from a small theater) and comfy seating. And when there have been technical difficulties, the management has quickly resolved any issues from the technical down to refunding the customer and/or issuing a re-ticket of the same movie for a later time and date. Yes, food and drink could be cheaper, but I can't complain too much about the prices at the concession stand because I don't fully understand the cost of operating a movie theater.

Based on my experience, I give 4 out of 5 stars because there is always room for improvement; not just from the staff, but from continually updating the facility and finding new ways to enhance the experience of attending a movie.

name: Charles Kendall
text:
Edit(5/02/2019): The theater has a new movie board that's a large screen and looks fancy and sleek. Noticed the seats have numbers and letters on them now, I believe the theater is getting ready for reserved seats. Having reserved seats would be great! For now it's still a free for all seating arrangement. More improvements should happen in the near future.  I'll update my review again when that happens.

The staff are still doing a great job. I have a great time, every time I watch a movie here. I have over lifetime points of 250,000 on the regal rewards program and its 99% from this location (only large theater for 90 miles)

Edit(9/15/2016): They recently changed the carpet and fixed a few of the chairs in theater 11.

This theater is a little run down but it is around 13 years old so things break. (But they are working on replacing many parts of the theater, it just takes time). Sense regal entertainment started running this location it has gotten much better. There is a few auditoriums in the theater that suck(theater 11) but some that are in great condition (theater 8,9,10.) For awhile I disliked how they did things but know I am a big supporter after they have helped and shown customer support time and again. Don't give a one star just because you don't like paying $10 for a ticket. The theater can't change it. It may seem like a high price but it is not. It's called inflation and in 10-15 years it may be $20 per ticket. That is just how it is.

name: Shane H.
text:
Not what it used to be.  This theatre was originally part of the Carmike chain when it got bought up by Regal.  The first thing Regal did was raise the prices on everything.

Two tickets, a large popcorn, and two large drinks set us back $42 dollars.  We used to go to the cinema once a month but with a 30% increase in prices, now we frequent it once or twice a year.

The theatre itself has fallen into disarray over the past three years.  Alot of the seating is in need to be replaced.  The cinema is poorly kept and the floors are not swept between showings.

Unless you "have" to see a certain movie, I would stay away from this movie theatre.  A good alternative (if you are willing to drive a bit) is the outdoor drive in cinema in Butte.  Prices are 1/4 of what you will pay at Regals.
