name: Caleb Potts
text: Delicious food at fair prices, but the menu can be a little intimidating at first.

name: ANDREW Boughter
text:
I lived in Colorado for years, and really enjoyed eating at authentic Mexican restaurants. I make my own salsa verde, dabble in Chinese, French, Spanish cuisine,  etc, and I grew up in Portugal so good food is not something I take for granted.

Taco Montes has the best and most authentic tasting Mexican food I've had since moving to Montana.
Everything was perfectly prepared and the price was very reasonable.

Andrew

name: Marianne Pester
text: My favorite taco place! Amazing tacos and non meat options! Cheap and next to campus.

name: Kayla M
text: This place has the best food, but the worst hours. A very unique menu with delicious combinations. Just wish the hours were expanded!

name: Trenton Thomas
text: Such good tacos!!!! And with so much variety and flavor you can keep coming back for more. Well priced and the place looks so cool!

name: nate l
text: yumm if you like tacos

name: Brian C
text:
The atmosphere is quirky. I absolutely love the chalkboard walls with some fantastic art. The staff was wonderful and they all have a great sense of humor.

Recently, we met for lunch at Taco Montes. I had the pork belly taco, and a chicken taco Santa Fe style. They were fantastic! The pork belly had crispy edges and tender meaty bits, which is exactly how I prefer it.

I will definitely be back

name: CJ Williams
text: Bomb tacos and good value. Try all the kinds of tacos, they're delicious.

name: Tawna BellaBee Steele
text: Awesome taco place off the beaten path. So worth it. The tacos are insanely yummy

name: Jordan Dood
text: A world class taco

name: Erin Helms
text: Loved it!  Amazing variety and soooooo delicious

name: Danielle Elder
text: This place used to be better. The staff are a little underprepared it seems for their postitions, but the pork belly tacos are great!

resp.text: We were actually short staffed today, so we did the best we could with what we had.  That tends to happen sometimes during flu season.  Glad you still enjoyed the tacos!

name: Michelle Dammen
text: Such good food! Fun atmosphere. The nachos were super yummy!

name: Anthony Rigalatoni
text: Best tacos in town. I dream of the day they get a beer/liquor license.

name: Justin Allred
text: Taco montes was the first taco joint we came to after moving here and 8 months later it's still pretty much the only taco place we go to. They have it all, friendly staff, cool atmosphere, delicious food, and acceptable wait times. Try anything on the menu and you won't go wrong.

name: Confessions And Lessons
text: This is literally the only edible mexican food in the entire Bozeman area. Homemade tortillas, sold!

name: Ryan Swimley
text: I have been going to Taco Montes for years, and every single time I have been there the staff is friendly and the food is (mostly) quick to get out. Easy party destination on Friday nights.

name: Sarah Croteau
text: So tasty and fresh! Lots of unique flavor combos that made it hard to decide. I would like to go back but their hours are inconvenient for dinnertime :(

name: Luke Murphy
text: Imagine, if you will, several good bros starting a taco shop:  because that's exactly what you have.  A strong, friendly vibe pervades the restaurant which regularly hosts local music acts and whose walls are covered in art from local artists.  If you want a good, quick, bite near campus, you'll be hard pressed to find a better choice.

name: Seth Page
text: Great spin on Mexican cuisine. Don't come here expecting greasy ground beef tacos with iceberg lettuce-- "no such thing as a regular taco".

name: tiffany austin
text: The BEST tacos I've ever had! They always come up with fun creations that is just flavorful art on a homemade tortilla.

name: gottsdamn
text: these tacos satisfy my late night rumbly tummy

name: Máximo imperatorum
text: Good place to grab some food and relax after class or a test.

name: Pchere Hughes
text: So yummy the nachos were the best I have ever had

name: Tim Dolan
text: Delicious variety. Convenient. Outside seating when weather permits.

name: Kent McVay
text: This is a great idea place. Your choice on meat, toppings, tortilla from a list of many in each category. They could use a better selection of sides but the tacos are excellent.

name: Brianna Braukmann
text: The menu and quality of food seem to get better and better each time I go! I love the nachos that they make.

name: John Mathias
text: Gourmet meets hole-in-the-wall! Amazing, flavorful, unique and big portions. Long line at noon, but well worth the wait. Excellent value, and the best tacos & nachos ever!

name: Montana Review
text:
Edit: Owner is so stuck up he thinks his restaurant is on the same Rating scale as a fast food chain.

Overall Rating: Avoid unless you're hungry late at night.

First came here late at night, as a hungry, drunk, college student and loved their tacos. Came here again as a hungry not so drunk student during the day, and was disappointed to find out their food does not taste as great when you're sober. It's nice this place stays open late on the weekends, but the food isn't that good. They try too hard to make 'unique' tacos that just aren't very tasty and the prices just for a few tacos is a bit ridiculous.

resp.text: Dude you gave Arby's four stars.  I think we can do without your opinion.

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: I love the food. The place could improve its aspect, but the food is really good, tasty, nice serving size, fresh and healthy.

name: Katherine Stout
text: really great food. the santa fe tacos are amazing and they have good salsa

name: Taylor Stults
text: Some of the best tacos in town. Hours are slightly hard to catch (open 10-3pm and 11-3am on weekends) but if you can get in there you won't be disapointed. House made tortillas and chips. Different and creative topping choices for tacos. So much to love!

name: B L
text: The taco choices here are awesome! Get the chorizo, you won't regret it

name: Ben Kindgren
text: Best taco I ever did had

name: Brittani Ferris
text: Great food: terrible service. The man who took my order was rude and acted like it was a huge inconvenience to take my order. I wanted one taco-one- he got every part of my order wrong, three times. He wasn't even listening to me and was just so incredibly rude. Not the only time I've had terrible service here.

name: Rio Gonzalez McCord
text: Everything is gluten free except their flour tortillas, the recipes are all amazing, and the price is competitive. I love it!

name: Ryan Schwab
text: Really some of the best americana tacos!

name: I Haps
text:
Editing my review with a heavy heart.
I love this place and love giving them money, but I can't in good conscience support a business staffed with people who can't be bothered to wear a mask at the height of a pandemic that is literally killing members of our community.
Airborne virus in a small place like that... Wear masks, folks. Sad and dumb.

name: Diane Cole
text: Yummy. Had the shreded beef. If your allergic to any meat make Sure they keep yours separated from the meat ones. My daughter is allergic to comercial meat. Our tacos came together and she had a allergic reaction from the juice getting on hers.

name: Kenna Christensen
text: Taco Montes has really great street tacos that are actually large enough, I usually get 2 and it's a full meal. But I docked 1 star because the place is always dirty.

name: Owen Burroughs
text: This is the best taco you will ever have, hands down. I highly recommend you get an egg on anything you get, it's worth it

name: Sage Triantis
text: Amazing food. College hot spot at lunch and especially for their late night food. One of the only places open that late (3pm) and right on campus.

name: Monkey Belle
text: It was okay. In my opinion not the best tacos. I have had better

name: Ben Clapp
text: An eclectic eatery- something that you would only find in a college town! Always packed during it's late night hours, and for good reason. Tacos, chips made in house, and nachos with a variety of proteins and styles to choose from. Delicious and a unique experience, but don't be expecting a refined venue.

name: Tim Leonhardt
text: Needs a deep clean. Food is great!

name: Jessica Johns
text: I love this place. Great nachos, excellent tacos and flavor combos. The staff is always very friendly and I love that they extended their hours. Yum.

name: Michelle L
text: Delicious fusion tacos and reasonably priced.

name: Hunter Ament
text: The tacos are awesome. The people are so sweet! Honestly the best place in town and the best part is that they are super cheap

name: Paul Kropatsch
text: Excellent food and service

name: Jim Ward
text: Fantastic quick late night TACOS!!! Super helpful and friendly staff :)

name: Kelly Mullins
text: Not Tex Mex!! Great tacos though and super good prices. Friendly staff. Love this place!!

name: James Willich
text: Pretty good. Tasty taco.

name: Trevor Beitman
text: Quick tacos, definitely check it out

name: Kate Koller
text: Consistently awesome food and pretty fast lunch spot even if there's a super long line!

name: Renae Mattimoe
text: Hears this is the place for late night eats. Not being "college age" anymore we decided to stop for lunch instead. Awesome thick cut homemade chips,  the cheesy ranch sauce on the Santa Fe nachos made me want to lick the paper lining the cute plastic basket. Love the rules,  especially the $20 charge if a guest pukes on the floor.

name: Bayard L
text: One of the best fresh and healthy meals you can get in Bozeman for under $8. The protein choices and topping styles will give you room to experiment and help find what combinations get your taste buds cheering!

name: Providencia Stuart
text: My favorite place for tacos. I keep coming back for more, and cannot get enough! Ingredients are fresh, tacos are flavorful, and come in a large array of topping choices. Guacamole, Pico de Gallo and Salsa are perfectly seasoned, and the tortilla chips are delicious. Very friendly and helpful staff This place is missing a cold drink fountain, and I wish it had more conventional opening hours. But that doesn't prevent me from coming back again and again!

name: Keegan Mackenstadt
text: I love that this place stays open late on the weekends

name: Patrick Gescheidle
text: Delicious varieties of street tacos are creative and affordable.

name: Floyd Levi
text: Best tacos in town. Highly recommend

name: Andrew King
text: The tacos are extreamly flavorful and the meat is cooked to perfection.

name: Marianne Marchette
text: They are great and friendly service, I wish there was a customize option though cuz you can't change any of their tacos, really good and filling food though!!!

name: Emily Grosswiler
text: These are the best tacos in town!

name: trouvaillesaurabh
text: Best late night food in Bozeman and near University too

name: Daniel Arenas
text: Most excellent tacos.

name: Patrick Webb
text: These may be the best tacos in Bozeman. Such a great variety and quality ingredients!

name: Saundra Strasser
text: Delicious street tacos for a very fair price. One of my favorite lunch spots in town!

name: Kris Castle
text: Lots of choices, loved the braised pork.

name: Beau Baxter
text: Classic place to grab some tasty tacos. They're open late on weekends as well which is pretty fantastic for students, especially considering the proximity to campus.

name: Bill Kopell
text: Excellent tacos. Good value. Interesting combinations.

name: Brad Martin
text: Perfect late night spot. Live music and a taco for everyone's taste. I want to be a regular here.

name: Danielle Cunningham
text: If you go late night, be prepared for a line. Worth the wait though!

name: Maria Abbot
text: Amazing food and atmosphere.

name: Jesse Thomas
text: Prices are good for Bozeman. Lots of options for tacos. Music is sometimes too loud to eat inside. They do have a patio for summer.

name: Seb Stokhof De Jong
text: Incredible tacos, chips, home made salsas, delicious horchatas.. I am from New Mexico and so thankful for this place. Definitely my favorite in town!

name: Official Alaskan
text: Best damn tacos period

name: C Spen
text: Nothing fancy but the food was very tasty.

name: Casey Chrison
text: The manager is a creeep.  Told my friend he would give her free tacos if she came in to see him, then gave her a 'tour'of the back showed her the bunk beds he has setup in the office.  Gross dude people eat there...  Not anymore though.

resp.text: I did some investigating and it turns out that your "friend" was a girl that was trying to get away from you and one of our employees (who was actually a friend of hers) helped her out.  Seems you're the real creep and I fully stand behind the actions of my employee.

name: Amber Hoadley
text: Awesome food, nice people, unique atmosphere with outdoor seating during the summertime

name: Dieter
text: Great little hide away place to eat during the day, and entertaining drunken gathering at night! Food is amazing and wait times are small given the quality of food.

name: Karl Molina
text: Asked for 3 random tacos, always good.

name: Nate Blaseg
text: Best tacos in town. Super friendly service.

name: Dylan Weber
text: Best variety of tacos in the state. Watch out, this place has the power to take over Bozeman.

name: Benjamin Walker
text: I cannot recommend Taco Montes enough. Excellent prices, excellent tacos, & excellent staff.

name: David Herbst
text: Best tacos in Bozeman. Head and shoulders above the competition.

name: Sylvis Robertson
text: Delicious everytime, cool atmosphere, and is best place for tacos, be it sober or intoxicated.

name: Scott Hanson
text: Great food! They charged me extra for a to go container... come on guys, what a joke.

name: Jennifer Pearson
text: Great food for a great price!

name: Esmeralda Thrace
text: The tacos are cheap and good. The hours are weird. I was sure there was a typo on Google maps, but nope!

name: Amy W
text: My fav lunch spot for a quick bite.

name: Matthew Campbell
text: Best tacos i've ever had. Anywhere. Period. A must-visit place, especially for college students.

name: Taylor Reese
text: Pork belly Korean taco is delicious

name: Alex Calderwood
text: Best college food around. Voted best late night restaurant in Bozeman, rightfully so. Tons of taco styles and options.

name: Orion Kubat
text: Tacos tacos and lots of chacos. Your hipster place for excellent street tacos.

name: benvasey
text: Awesome food, but the place is very lacking in cleanliness to the point I don't like eating inside anymore.

name: Kirkwood Donavin
text: I love the food here. Not happy that they are closed for student holidays, but I understand.

name: Mike Walker
text: Fantastic tacos. I can't wait to return.

name: Derek Hetherington
text: Delicious tacos, perfect for lunch, dinner, or even a snack after the bars.  Expect to wait in line after midnight during the school year.

name: Jennifer Algeo
text: Just good food and good people.

name: kai hogen
text: Great tacos, they offer multiple international styles of tacos. You can get a general idea of many regions of the world here.

name: Jason Palevsky

resp.text:
You know it's possible to promote one restaurant or food truck without trying to tear another one down, right?

Btw, I just looked into Los Jarochos.  Looks like great stuff.  Gonna go check it out today.

name: Rayshell McDonald
text: Extremely nice and friendly staff. Every one of their food items is amazing. Love the ambiance, one of my favorite spots to stop into on my way to Big Sky. Best bakery in the Valley.

name: Apparittia Matthews
text: They messed up my order, I get an iced latte with oat milk and honey. They made it hot! But it was still delicious, I avoid hot lattes because it's soooo common to burn the milk, they didn't— it was a relief and then a delight. Their selection is phenomenal and the service was super. They offered to fix it but I didn't have time! 10/10 !!

name: Jessica Evans
text: This place is adorable! There is a bakery/dessert/breakfast/light fare cafe, as well as a pottery and local crafts shop. The prices for both areas seem a little high...but the place and the wares and the food are so special, they do a strong business!

resp.text: Jessica, thank you so much for taking the time to send us your honest feedback! We are so glad you enjoyed your visit :). Setting prices is always the age-old struggle; we've chosen to keep ours a bit higher so we can maintain the quality of our handmade pottery, and made-from-scratch foods - it all takes a little extra time, and we want to make sure our team is taken care of for their hard work! Thanks again for visiting us, and we hope to get the chance to serve you again soon. Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Paolette Matute
text: The most charming coffee shop. The food was very tasty. Highly recommend!!

name: kade estill
text: Latte with vanilla...housemade vanilla is so delicious... take n bake lasagna us fantastic! Breakfast burrito and delicious pie!! A must stop!!

name: Courtney Reisig
text: One of the best kept local secrets! They have everything from their beautiful handmade pottery shop which is filled with pottery of all kinds and colors, to their delicious baked goods and wonderful take home & make meals! They have all kinds of take & bake pies & dinners such as soups, lasagna, cookie dough, & more! There was so much to see in such a little store. I will absolutely be returning and can't believe I waited this long to check it out when I live right down the road! Their huckleberry tea was fantastic. I cannot say enough good things about this place!

resp.text: Hey Neighbor! Thanks so much for taking the time to review us! We truly appreciate your business, loyalty, and kind words. Looking forward to seeing you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Michelle Thielke
text: We love this place. Great snacks, delicious drinks, and lots of things to look at while you're waiting for your order.

resp.text: Thanks for taking a minute to send us a review, Michelle! So glad you enjoyed your visit and hope to see you again soon! - Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Justin Armer
text: Great spot for a quick bite. Order ahead.

name: Idaho_B&T Newman
text: The food here is amazing!!  We go out of our way to swing by this place for their food and coffee.   This is just such a quaint, game-like atmosphere.   My family simply adores this establishment.

resp.text: Thank you SO MUCH for your kind words, and for taking the time to put them into a review! We're so glad you enjoy our place - see you again soon! :) Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: William Gruenes
text: Excellent carb loading fuel station. Haha... with pottery

name: Jason Daughenbaugh
text: Always good.  The Lockie family makes great food, pie, and pottery.

name: Doug Ireland
text: Their baked goods and take home family dinners are just amazing every time!

name: Only Nate
text: My family is enjoys this place.  Great coffee and pastries including gluten free items. Plus the pottery is fantastic. It’s a must go.

resp.text: So glad your family enjoyed being here.  We try to make delicious gluten free options for people who can't have gluten, so we appreciate the kudos!

name: Tony Cagle
text: The strawberry rhubarb pie is crazy good as well as the brownies, raspberry bars, and pretty much everything else. Very nice customer service and they are very respectful of the Covid issue as well and seem very clean. Highly recommended!

name: Michael Zacharisen
text: Nicest people you will meet, beautiful pottery and the best treats!

name: Devinne Curbow
text: Delicious treats, yummy sandwiches and soups. This place has a nice selection of Montana made gifts including pottery, leatherworks, stickers and jewelry.

name: Jah W
text: If you want a good breakfast come out here! Friendly staff in a cozy setting.

resp.text: Jahvorn, Thank you for the review! We are so glad you enjoyed your visit, and hope we get to see you again! Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Artisans at the Dahmen Barn Hartwig
text: Always my favorite stop when I am in town. Very comfortable eating there, the crew did a great job making their small space safe to eat during these times.

name: Erin McKenna
text: Always SUCH a treat! The baked goods are so delicious and the pottery is just beautiful!

name: Kaci Noble
text: Love this place awesome atmosphere. Delicious food and treats

name: Jamie Severson
text: Comfort food heaven! This is my family's go-to when we need some "to die for" baked goods. Their pie, cookies, muffins, everything are so good. Chicken pot pie for dinner is also delicious.

resp.text: Jamie, you are so kind! We're grateful for your loyalty and kind words - so glad you've found your comfort food heaven with us! :) See you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Sherry Hodges
text: Great little spot! Coffee,  food,  dessert!!

resp.text: Sherry - thanks so much! We are very glad you enjoyed your visit; our team works very hard to make that happen, so it means so much to them when kudos are given :). See you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Cliff Cooper
text: Great breakfast

name: Davis Parker
text: Amazing food, great friendly, God loving people. Lovely pottery

name: Tes Mercier
text: The food was good and the gluten free options were amazing the only downside I found about it was there is a lot of people in a very small amount of space. And as much as they try to accommodate there's no Room

name: Tom Gibson
text: Love seeing the owners busting it and bring completely hands on!

name: Bozeman Review
text: This establishment sold and we had to do a redo!  No more faith based atmosphere.  Food quality down, atmosphere is more San Francisco than Montana ;)  More of a melting Pot, than a coffee pot :(   sad to see such a good place fall.  We will revisit in 3 months.  As always we send 3 families to review.  I want to be clear.  This review is based on quality of food and previous expectations.  THIS IS NOT THE SAME COFFEE POT.

resp.text: Oh my goodness, we're blushing! Thanks so much for taking the time to send us kudos - it means the world to our hard-working team. We so appreciate it, and hope to see you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Misty Lundberg
text: This place has the best baked goods outside of your grandma's kitchen! A little off the beaten path, it's worth the drive. Their selection of beautiful pottery and other gifts is nice, and the owners are the best! I can't recommend this place enough.

name: Tim Hart
text: For premium baked goods, this place is the place.  Oh my goodness - where do I start - probably the cinnamon rolls - huge, moist and bursting with flavor.  Once you have their cinnamon rolls, you will NEVER buy at the store again.  The pies are fantastic and the staff is incredibly friendly.  There is something special and different when you walk in their front door.  Be sure to visit to and from Big Sky and so close to the Hot Springs.  Enjoy!

resp.text: Tim, thanks so much for taking the time to give us such a great review! Our team works hard to provide a great experience, so this will mean the world to them to hear. Thanks for your business and loyalty! Cheers, Kathy

name: Micah Westra
text: Coffee Pot is one of our favorite places to go, especially for local eats. Every bite of food is made with great care. The food is fresh and delicious. Our only problem is finding the willpower to stop eating. Their selection of sweet and savory items are excellent. The staff is friendly and eager to help. The owners are always present to oversee our experiences and answer questions. This place is usually packed, so we prefer top eat outside. We would recommend this place without hesitation.

resp.text: Micah, thanks for taking the time to send us a review! We're so glad you enjoyed your visit!

name: B
text: Delish!

name: Bayard L
text:
The incredible baked goods selection with have your sweet tooth hollering for joy. Homemade pies, turnovers, scotcharoos, and other irresistible treats are nicely displayed.

The mocha and latte my girlfriend and I tried were both delicious and I would stop in again for those.

Their pottery selection offers gifts with good craftsmanship.

name: Sienna Scheid
text: The food and coffee is delicious. Such a cute spot! The owners are the sweetest people you'll ever meet. They care so deeply about their business and are very dedicated to customer experience. Their pottery is all handmade right behind the cafe, local clay, and glazes mixed in house. I love this spot!

resp.text: Sienna, thank you so much for hopping on here to send us a review! We loved meeting you and are so happy you stopped in! Hope to see you next time you're in town - enjoy your salad bowls :). - Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Stephanie Blasenak
text: Quaint, rustic family-owned and run business with DELIGHTFUL and DELICIOUS breads, pastries, soups, sandwiches, hot and cold beverages, and delicious from-scratch dinner packages. A sandwich will run you about $7-10, and salads are $13, I think. Vegetarian and gluten-free options available, but the kitchen is not certified gf, so dine at your own risk.

resp.text: Stephanie, thank you for taking the time to send such a thoughtful review! We are so glad you enjoyed your visit, and are grateful that you're passing along important info to our future diners! See you again soon. Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Nomadic Critic
text: Fabulous selection of baked goods, hot drinks, and the food items look amazing.

name: Ev Frad
text: This is my favorite breakfast place, if you can find parking. That's a compliment, the small drive it takes to get here is worth it every time! The from scratch everything to the handmade coffee is the best I've had in a long time. They even have lunch and take and bake dinners. This is must stop!

resp.text: Ev, thanks for taking the time to share your thoughts with us! (and our future customers :) We're so grateful for your loyalty, and for your generosity about our limited seating - we know that can be frustrating, and are working on some ideas to help that when we are able! See you next time you're in! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Lu LoCoco
text: Comforting food, friendly and helpful staff, cozy rustic atmosphere. I'm very fond of this place. Good spot for a lunch date. LGBT+ friendly.

name: Josh Erickson
text: Great pastries and good! Fun lunch spot.

name: Grant Kammeyer
text: Some of the best food around. I have always brought my family here whenever they come to visit, and I have never been disappointed. Turns out they still visit the Coffee Pot even when I'm not here!

resp.text: Thanks, Grant! We truly appreciate your loyalty and business, and love the fact that you've started a family Coffee Pot tradition! Hope to see you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Thomas Hawkins
text: Convenient location for food and coffee. I’d like to try their chocolate chip cookie dough some day.

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: I love all their savory food, I find their desserts too sweet and too big. I love their coffee, and the spaces inside and outside, front and back, are really nice. Having more decaffeinated tea or infussion options, plus more gluten free desserts would be great.

resp.text: Lucia, thank you for taking the time to give us a review! We appreciate your honest feedback, as we're always looking for ways to improve. Thank you for your business, and we hope to see you again soon. Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Bri Culley
text: I've been to the coffee pot a few times and it doesn't disappoint! We've enjoyed their biscuits and gravy, green chili breakfast burritos, cinnamon rolls, and pecan caramel rolls. There are so many other sweets that I wanted to try, but my stomach wasn't big enough! The staff is friendly!

resp.text: Bri, thanks for taking the time to hop on here and send us a review! We are so glad you have enjoyed your visits, and are grateful for your loyalty and business! Looking forward to seeing you again next time you make it out! Cheers, Kathy (Co-Owner)

name: Beau Anderson
text: Incredible food! The atmosphere is amazing, staff are always happy to see you. I'll be back many times in the future for sure!

resp.text: Beau....thanks for taking the time to review us! We are so happy you stopped by, and look forward to seeing you many times in the future. We appreciate your business and your kind words! See you soon, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Judi Treston
text:
Nice little homey restaurant. Home cooked soups and desserts. Delicious  sandwiches.
Staff very nice.
Half of the room is a country store. Pricey but nice stuff.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to send us your kind review, Judi! We are SO glad you loved your visit and had a great experience - that is what we strive for!

name: Ronald Martin
text: Great food, hard working staff.  Cozy atmosphere

resp.text: Ronald, thank you for your kind words! Our staff does indeed work hard - we are very grateful for them! Glad you enjoyed your visit, and we hope to get the chance to serve you again soon! Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Carrie DeSalvo
text: I think the photo explains part of why I LOVE this place! Sweet sweet people.

resp.text: It's true.  A picture is worth a thousand words!  But thanks for adding the words, too.

name: J Clifton Meek
text: Good coffee. Insanely good baked goods. Fun location to sit and have a break. They also have cinnamon rolls frozen and ready to bake; my wife and I weren't happy with these -- ate half of one each and tossed the remainder. Nowhere near as good as buying what they've baked.

resp.text: Oh my!  I'm so glad that you let us know that you were dissatisfied.  We try to make our baking directions as clear as possible, but they can be confusing.  Please come back in and we will replace them.  We typically have a baker on the premises and she can go over the instructions again.  Hopefully, these will be as good at home as at the Coffee Pot.  Thank you so much for the review and for alerting us to a potential problem.

name: Melissa Hoaglund
text: Had a good brunch today. Tried the Mediterranean quiche. Very filling. Great flavor. $10 was pushing it, though. The staff was very friendly. I'll be back to try more of the menu! Also, I loved how they serve things in the hand made pottery. I may go back for a utensil crock.

resp.text: Melissa, thank you for your feedback! We're so glad you enjoyed your visit, and that we'll get to see you again soon. The conversation of how to price food when taking into account all the various costs is constant, so we appreciate your input. Our goal is always to provide tasty, homemade meals that are prepared completely from scratch by our skilled kitchen crew, so we hope that the quality and flavor are reflective in the price!

name: Lynda Andros-Clay
text: Great coffee and food stop. They have delicious food, baked goods, and coffee. It can be a little crowded at times but definitely worth the wait for homemade deliciousness.

resp.text: Lynda, thank you for taking the time to send us a review! So glad you enjoyed your visit (and tasty food), and hope to see you again soon! Not having enough seating is one of our constant struggles, and something we're working step by step towards improving! We truly appreciate your graciousness in the meantime! Cheers, Kathy (Co-Owner)

name: Lynn Kujala
text: Most beautiful pottery, the greatest collection of food for every pallet. Such a treat to go!!!

name: Julie Ramsey
text: Wonderful place to visit with friends over a nice snack

name: Daniel Cain
text: Great ambiance! The old timer is really good and the Carmel pecan rolls are bomb! Small space gets crowded though

resp.text: Daniel, thanks for taking the time to send us your review; we're so glad you enjoyed your food! Thanks for sticking with us even though our space is tight! Hope to see you again soon, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Ethan Efram
text: Really good quality food. You it's fresh ingredients. A bit pricey and the panini  was too small of a portion. Wish they had more seating.

resp.text: Ethan, thank you for taking the time to write us a review, we truly appreciate your feedback and honesty! We are actively working on plans to improve our seating options as time and finances allow - in the meantime, thanks for sticking with us in our small space! As for the portion size - I'll check in with our team on this - we are traditionally known for having larger portion sizes, so I'm very sorry yours turned out smaller. Thanks again for the input, it is invaluable to us! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Dee Dee Foley
text: Don't go to Bozeman without visiting this place!! Awesome homey food and beautiful pottery and gifts made in MT!

resp.text: Dee Dee, we're so thrilled and honored that you make our shop one of your must-dos while visiting! Thank you, thank you, thank you. We truly appreciate it, and are so glad you enjoyed this visit :). Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Clint Croft
text: It is a family tradition to go have a birthday treat at the coffee pot. We buy pies for the Fourth of July, thanksgiving, Christmas, Easter, funerals and whenever the urge hits us like anniversaries. This is a great place and part of what we call home in Bozeman.

resp.text: Clint, thanks so much for your kind words and feedback! We're so thankful for your business and loyalty. See you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: CroChick5
text: Stop in doing for lunch tried their meatloaf sandwich. Roughly I believe it was a half sandwich for around $ 7 to 8 dollars. Wasn't quite I expected it was okay nothing to brag about. Maybe this sandwich isn't a big thing here? I probably wouldn't get it again but I try another sandwich on their menu. Delicious baked goods however and beautiful pottery.

resp.text: First of all, thank you for taking the time to send us your feedback - we truly appreciate it. So glad you enjoyed the baked goods and browsing our handmade pottery! We'd love to have you back for a second visit so we can make sure your experience is top notch; please ask for me personally (Kathy) and we'll make sure to find you a tasty lunch to fit what you're looking for!

name: Jason Heisey
text: Remember the McDonalds scalding hot coffee bit? My water was sooooooo hot even after 1/2 hour. I can normally tolerate and regulate consuming hot beverages, but this was the only time in my life I can recall instantly spitting something out (onto my self and in my car).

resp.text: Jason, first of all, thank you for taking the time to give us your feedback. We regularly temp our hot water levels (used in both hot tea and coffee), and it consistently comes to right around 160 degrees, which is within a reasonable health code range. We take our customer feedback very seriously, so we did an extra temp test after your above message, just to make sure our machine didn't get off-calibration, and it was at that same level of 160 degrees. In the future, we are always able to temper it with some cooler water or ice by request, and would be more than happy to do that. Thank you for your business, and for your honest feedback. -Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Peter Carparelli
text: Wow!  First time here!  Fantastic breakfast menu.  Quality food, excellent quality and presentation.  Great coffee.  Friendly folks.  Can't get much better.

resp.text: Peter - thanks for taking the time to send us a great review! We are so glad you enjoyed your visit - our team works very hard to create the tastiest homemade food and a great atmosphere :). Hope to see you again soon! - Kathy (Co-Owner)

name: Dustin Liudahl
text: We love this place. Great food, great atmosphere, great coffee.

resp.text: Dustin thank you for taking the time to write us a review! So thankful for your business, and that you enjoy our place. We look forward to seeing you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Marion Eve Shepley
text: Oh, man! The pastries and pies are to die for! Food is lovingly made. What keeps this from being 5 stars is the parking is limited in front and scarily right off a highway with fast, impatient drivers. Extra parking in back, but awkward and in winter very icy. Walk with great care. Take out service excellent. Gets super busy around noon on most days.

resp.text: So appreciate your taking the time to send a review.  You're right.  Parking has always been the conundrum out here.  We appreciate that we're busy enough to have parking issues, but wish that we had a better parking situation as well.  Hope to see you again.

name: Jeremiah Rooney
text:
Excellent little place to get breakfast and excellant coffee.

Only downside is when its busy, it gets very crowded because it's pretty small.

resp.text: Jeremiah, thank you for taking the time to send us a review! Thank you for your business, and for your feedback. We are working on plans to move towards some better seating options in time as we are able, and appreciate your patience in the meantime! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Gretchen Sultzer
text: Great flavorfull feel food food.  Cozy homey. Great coffee.

resp.text: Gretchen, thanks for your kind words and great review! We're so glad you enjoyed your visit - thank you for stopping by. Hope we get the chance to serve you again soon! Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Carmen Mayer
text: Excellent food, pastries and pottery!

name: Megan
text:
My favorite thing at the Coffee Pot is the breakfast burrito. The burrito is good - the salsa is what makes it. With huge chunks of tasty veggies, there is never enough salsa - ask for extra, you won't regret it.

The baked goods are wonderful, fresh, and flavorful. I have a weakness for the pecan shortbread, especially if I let it sit for a day or two before eating it - the flavor gets richer.

Take-and-bakes are handy and tasty. Pies are so down-home you wonder how you bought it because it tastes like a loved one made it for you,  special.

Make sure to peruse the pottery and local goods. There is so much to peek at!

Fun fact: Check out National Park gift shops nationwide - you will find that a lot of those beautiful handmade mugs  with custom badges come from right here in Bozeman. #letsguide

resp.text: Thanks for the review.  We try to feature all Montana made gifts and our own hand thrown pottery to promote interest in local artists and products. While we are a stop for those on their way to Yellowstone and the wonderful sites around us, we are also a local favorite.  Hope you'll come back in to see us again!

name: Chris Bauer
text: Ooey gooey cinnamon rolls are the best!

resp.text: Chris...ooey gooey is right! So glad you enjoyed them :). We still use the recipe created by my mother in law (Jennie Lockie - one of the founders), and they do not disappoint! Hope to see you again sometime - thanks again! Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: D E Visser
text: Terrific food, always busy so be prepared.  Coming a bit before or after peak breakfast and lunch times is helpful.

resp.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to review us! Good insider tip for timing your visit - seating is definitely a struggle for us; we're working to come up with ideas to help that a bit. In the meantime thank you for your business, and we look forward to seeing you next time you're in.

name: Amber Hoadley
text: Amazing pastries and food, great coffee, and gorgeous unique pottery . One of my favorite places to go when I have friends or family visiting in town! Love it

resp.text: Amber, thank you for taking a minute to hop and here and give us a review! It means the world to us - our team always works really hard to make each visit a great experience. See you again soon! - Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Lolita Morgan
text: This is a local favorite for me. I try to stop here whenever I come back from a hike. The food is amazing, and its the perfect place for a quick snack, dessert, or even a full meal. The atmosphere is super cute and cozy, too.

resp.text: The weather in Bozeman is approaching the hiking stage.  Don't forget that you can pick up homemade meals to go so that you can spend more time hiking! I hope you'll come in soon and visit us.  We really appreciate your taking the time to send us a review!

name: Brian Globerman
text: Excellent food, prompt courteous service.

resp.text: Brian, thanks for taking time to give us a review! We are so glad you enjoyed your experience, and look forward to serving you again soon. Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Jael Helton
text: Amazing food and homey atmosphere. Pretty high prices though

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave us a review, Jae! We are so glad you enjoyed our homey atmosphere and food. Our team works very hard to make all of our baked goods, soups, sandwiches, and treats completely from scratch. The extra bit of love reflects in the price, but we hope all in all it was worth it, and that we'll get to see you again soon!

name: Robin Nagel
text: Yumminess and oh so fresh. Love their pottery and their story!!

resp.text: Robin, thanks so much for your kind words! We are so thrilled that you enjoyed your visit with us, that means the world to us and our team. Hope to see you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: My Bowtie
text: Best coffee anywhere. Best food around! A must go to restaurant.

resp.text: Maureen, thank you so much for taking the time to review us! We are glad you had a good experience, and hope we get the change to serve you again soon! Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Joey Knappenberger
text: I would give this place 6 stars if possible, the staff is helpful and welcoming, and incredibly attentive. The food is amazing, (might I recommend the caramel pecan roll and a glass of cold brew coffee), and the atmosphere is warm and cozy, only on thing, get there somewhat early, ideally 9ish, because they often sell out of their rolls later in the morning.

resp.text: I'd give you a 6 star review!  We are proud of our food and coffee, but we are especially proud of our amazing staff.  Thanks for highlighting their attentiveness.  Hope you'll be back!

name: Deborah Causey
text: Best breakfast outside Grams kitchen!!

resp.text: Deborah, thank you so much for taking the time to send us a review, and for your kind words! Our team works incredibly hard to provide a great breakfast, so they're always encouraged to hear when people like it :). See you again soon, and thanks again! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Diane Reese Leach
text: Amazing baked goods, lunch menu, cool pottery.

resp.text: Diane - thanks for your kind words! Our team works very hard to make it all possible, so we're glad you enjoyed yourself! Hope we get the chance to see you again soon, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Larry Johnson
text: Amazing food and the best customer service in Bozeman. A must stop if you want to go to a quaint little coffee shop that captures the essence of small town Montana.

resp.text: Your review really warmed my heart!  We have amazing food, quality pottery and gifts, but hands down, our Team is what makes this place click!  I love it when they are recognized for their fantastic customer service.  Thank you so much.

name: Austin Baldwin
text: Absolutely the best breakfast around! Breakfast sandwiches, epic pastries, generous mugs of coffee. You'll be planning your next visit before you leave.

name: Marsha Locker
text: Great food and coffee

name: Marcia Borst
text: Great quiche and more.

name: Jesse Knapp
text: BOMB sit down breakfast, plus coffee shop with drinks that aren't too sugary, plus super cute gift shop. Also there was a very friendly cat outside

name: Lorena Jimerson
text: Nice place! Gorgeous pots!

resp.text: Lorena, thank you for your kind words! Our pottery studio team works very hard to create that beautiful stoneware, so it means a lot that you liked it. :) Hope too see you again soon! Best, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Ariel Gobble
text: Their food is amazing! Better than homemade, great comfort food. Best. Bakery. For fifty miles. Legendary meltaways, take and bake, they even have izzys.

name: Connie Hahn
text: The most kind and polite service I've ever experienced...not to mention amazing food

resp.text: Connie, thanks for taking the time to hop on and send us a review! We're so glad you had a great experience - our team works very hard from start to finish to make that positive! Look forward to seeing you next time you make it in! - Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: William Mauritsen
text: great place for brunch or breakfast... great service and delicious fast food

resp.text: Thank you, William! So glad you enjoyed our place - we are grateful for your business!

name: Susan McCartney
text: Good service, nice people, and good food!

resp.text: Susan, thanks for taking the time to review us! So glad you enjoyed your visit with us, and hope to see you again soon! Cheers, Kathy Lockie (Co-Owner)

name: Mike Rooker
text: Ever since marcy retired the food is hopelessly average, I could stay home and do the same

resp.text: Mike, thank you for taking the time to come give us your feedback. We miss Marci every day - she is truly outstanding in so many ways! Our current team works very hard to provide high quality, made from scratch food, and I'm very sorry to hear that you do not feel it is up to the same standards. What types of dishes are your go-to? Do you have any specific feedback as to what you've noticed that is different? We are still using the same staple recipes, starting with Jennie's cinnamon rolls, and developed from there over the years with amazing people like Marci. We take quality seriously, so we would truly love to know what you've noticed is different, as we are always looking to improve! Feel free to message me here, or email directly at info@thecoffeepotbakery.com. Thanks again for your honest feedback and for coming to our cafe for so many years. Best, Kathy Lockie (Current Co-Owner - Daughter in law of Dave & Jennie, Founders)

name: Karen Kropp
text: Great food, good atmosphere, easy to locate. Interesting pottery shop.

name: Eileen Mitchell
text: Super friendly, good food and desserts.

name: Leif Wickland
text:
We really enjoyed our visit here.

The menu had a nice range of options that allowed the trepidatious to dial the spiciness down to a safe level or the adventurous to crank it up to a face-melting level.

Our waitress was helpful and not in the least condescending about our questions.

The food was very good. We ordered the yellow curry and the pineapple fried rice. The yellow curry was my favorite by far. It wasn't quite as spicy as I make it at home. However, it had a richer flavor than I'm able to achieve at home which I really liked.

I don't often like fried rice dishes but the pineapple fried rice was one of the best I've ever had.

The ambiance was pleasant: well lit, quiet, tidily decorated.

resp.text: From your helpful server to our delicious yellow curry, Leif, we are so pleased that you had such a great time here! Our team is always ready to answer any of your questions to make sure you get the tastiest meal possible. We hope to see you back here soon to try out more of our menu! -Thai Basil

name: Guy Seavey
text:
When I first pulled up to the parking lot, it felt like it was going to be weird. The restaurant is brightly lit like a cafeteria and the seating didn't look comfortable. I was going to be proven wrong.

I ordered green curry chicken with jasmine rice. It came to the table piping hot and the flavors were spot on and fresh. The menu said the spice level for the green curry was 3 and it was spicy. The heat lasted for a few moments with each bite but did not overwhelm me. It has been a while since I've had thai food, so my mouth and tongue may be more wimpy than another person's. Their thai iced tea with coconut milk ( you can opt for half and half, but why?) was fantastic. They bring it to the table with the coconut milk floating on top of the tea, and it looked awesome. The taste was perfect as well. I ordered the Tom kha soup with chicken to go with a spice level of 3 (wish my tongue luck). I cannot wait to have this when I return home from this business trip.

Bozeman is not my favorite Montana city. The ratio of transplanted Californians to Montanans is way out of whack. There are restaurants that pretend to be something they are not and charge a premium because they can. Thai Basil is NOT one of those places and I am thrilled that I tried it out. The service is friendly and efficient; even during a busy dinner hour. Many thanks to them for showing me that I can enjoy a meal in Bozeman and to not judge a restaurant from the parking lot.

resp.text: We're thrilled that you gave us a try too, Guy. Thanks for stopping by and checking out some of our satisfyingly spicy dishes. We hope your spice tolerance is back to normal and ready for some more heat the next time you're back in Bozeman.  -Thai Basil

name: Mike Hickert
text: Really Great! Finally got a chance to grab some food - being new it's been really busy especially during the evening dinner rush. Had to try the curry - since it's imported from Thailand - did the red and it was rich and flavorful. Although for being the spiciest curry on the menu, while it certainly wasn't weak, I've definitely had hotter. Also tried the beef salad and it's really fantastic, the dressing in particular. I would like to see some more cold dishes if possible for the warm weather - the curry comes out muy caliente - which isn't the best choice for a hot sunny day.

name: Cheri B
text: Looks like they got a fancier menu cover and new SMALLER bowls for their curry. My family and I have gone to Thai Basil since they opened. I was let down by this new set up. I had my usual Green CURRY I had more rice on the side then curry. The Calamari was terrible I guess that isn't one dish I would ever try again. Very disappointed!!!!!!

resp.text: Cheri, we're disappointed that you didn't love the changes we've made, especially since you've been a fan of ours since opening. We value each and every bit of feedback, and we're sorry that you were let down. We're always open to hearing this in the moment so we can do our best to make things right. We hope we can welcome you back soon to show you an experience as awesome as you expect from us. -Thai Basil

resp.text: Though we're glad you enjoy our food, Aidan, we're sorry that our prices are higher than you were expecting. We want you to know our prices are based on the quality of ingredients we use. text:
Edit 8/7/19: They have ditched their styrofoam!

text:
This place is so much fun solely for the people who were there. I know their days must be really difficult sometimes but they seem really peppy and happy to be working there.
And no one can complain about the donuts. Still the best I've ever tasted!

name: C K
text: I'm not overly fond of commercial donuts to start with, but when I go in bright and early (before 6am) and get two dozen donuts for an office, I don't expect to get UNDERCOOKED DONUTS. They were nasty. Doughy inside. This isn't even a flavor thing... this is a "cook until it's actually done" thing. Will never go back, even if it's just for donuts for the office.

name: Decker Tode
text: Delicious donuts, cheap price, fast service. Couldn't be better, will go again.

name: Colleen Rodriguez
text: Always super polite and helpful. Donuts are always fresh, and being as popular as it is, mostly have all the donuts.

name: Jeremy Wendt
text: Employees were dressed well and very courteous . The donuts were made perfectly soft and with the right amount of glaze very soft and airy

name: Savannah Stellner
text: I love Krispy Kreme but when I went , they were out of almost everything!

name: Andy Harlow
text: They  get a little bogged down when you and everyone get the bright idea to grab a quick dozen. But they are always worth the extra wait in the end, just something about those little glazed circles of joy they call a donut .

name: Sheri Guenther
text: The donuts are okay, mostly just sweet and not really any depth of flavor.   But the employees are very nice.

name: Emily Olsen
text: Yum. Who doesn't love a doughnut? Only reason for not putting 5 stars is I wish there were some way to make a doughnut healthy.

name: Ken Burch
text:
The they have very good donuts they're always very friendly and quick with their service.
I just wish they would have chocolate donuts more often.

name: Braeden Roesler
text: Krispy Kreme donuts are a love it or hate it thing.. Most people I know (including me) hate them, but others rave over them. Got some the other week and thew them out after a few bites. They also forgot my coffee and had to make it after I showed them receipt and had to throw the latte out too because it tasted bland and gross, I've had better coffee from gas station cappuccino dispensers for $4 less.

name: Don't put me in a box
text:
FALSE ADVERTISEMENT!
Not only is the wait exceptionally long but the drive from the Heights for a poorly advertised product makes this entire endeavor a slap in the face. My friend drove 45 minutes round trip, waited in line for only God knows how long and spent $60 on Valentine’s Day donuts for her daughter’s class only to arrive to her class with donuts that she couldn’t have made WORSE if she’d tried to do them on her own. She could have gotten a way better at any grocery store but what makes it worse is little mom and pop shops, who take PRIDE in their product, have to work 10x harder to even stay in business when big business like Krispy Kreme come to town. On top of that this mogul decides it is acceptable to waste peoples time, effort and money by sending out a product like this in the HOPE that no one reviews it or posts their subpar performance for others to see. This is unacceptable and frankly it’s insulting, I highly doubt she’s the only one to receive such crummy treatment. I am very disappointed and know from now on to steer clear when I expect a quality product.

name: Jack Scherman
text: Fantastic place to see live music in downtown Bozeman.  The theater is large enough for a good number of people but still feels intimate.  The decor is understated and tasteful.  Bathrooms are always clean and convenient.  Drink price aren't bad by venue standards.  The burn box, bar upstairs, has a lovely view of mainstreet and often features local artists.  There's even a space you can rent for private events.  Would highly recommend a visit!

resp.text: Jack - thank you so much for this thoughtful share, covering so much of what we offer at Rialto. We are very grateful for the community support as it encourages our team to keep improving and focusing on the experience for guests, team members and artists.

text:
Great acoustics, friendly staff. Small,  intimate venue that Bozeman needs more of!
Three floors with a bar on each. Tabs started on one floor can be accessed by all other floors which is an excellent idea.
Limited beer and wine which is a little surprising considering they do not have a liquor license. They have steadily improved their selection and are making some beer or wine based cocktails.
The intimate experience is perfect for many acts that may not fill the field house but are too large for bars. Check their expansive schedule and go see some live tunes!

name: Samuel Quick
text:
Not even a Goodwill.

At this point, this location is barely a Goodwill. 1/4 of their stock is generic items behind a counter or on the floor. Overstock mostly from local major stores. Product is sold at same cost or higher. Most items can be purchased online at half the cost.
Clothes are a plus, decently sorted and well priced.
Toys and household is always a mess. There is never even an attempt to organize it.
Electronics are outrageously priced. Occasionally find something decent, but that is rare.
Furniture is overpriced and usually broken.
Belgrade goodwill is immensely better.
Staff is friendly most of the time.

name: I Haps
text:
Standard Goodwill; completely hit or miss on whether you're going to find anything cool, but it does have a large selection. The one thing that knocks a star off for me is the people working the registers are often lifeless. I get it, it's a "charitable" chain that's "helping people" (it is, it's just also very much a corporation), but dang could the people working registers at least say hello or look at you? The individual who helped me just prior to writing this was a zombie.
That being said, if you're self sufficient and just hunting for whatever it's worth checking out.

resp.text: Thank you for sharing your feedback.  We will share this with the manager to address with staff.  We are sorry you didn't get good customer service.

Interesting store, crying children everywhere, and workers that look like they really really don't want to be there.

Really stupid and frustrating, i shop at the goodwill in Billings and I know they certainly don't do this!

text: The food is ordered piecemeal so you can pay for exactly what your budget will allow.  It's homemade and very good.  And what a good cause to be part of!  And the food comes instantly! I got a very big glass of lemonade, a very tasty salad, a delicious entree with a roll and a melt-in-your-mouth brownie for just $7 and added some to help pay for someone else's meal who might need some help.  Such a great place!

name: Amanda Young
text: The Fork and Spoon is an amazing restaurant run and operated by equally amazing people. It is definitely worth it to come visit and have an awesome meal as locally grown and made as possible. You won't be disappointed! I truly can't say enough great this about this place.

text:
Eat here!

No, this is not a regular restaurant.  No menus, no wine list.  But it is good food, filling a community need.

For those who can't afford a good meal, this is an option for a good meal, free of charge.  For those who can afford it, pay $5 and help keep it going for those who can't.

name: Jeff Muehlbauer
text: I spent the summer of '16 volunteering I'm Bozeman and living off of pennies. Community Cafe prepares delicious, nutritious meals for everyone, regardless of the contents of your bank account. I would donate $5 when I could, and other nights I would eat for free. The cafe is staffed by volunteers, often from local organizations. The volunteers are always warm and compassionate and care about the service they are providing. God bless the Community Cafe. Please donate if you can.

name: Joseph Bernhardt
text: The Fork and Spoon is a pay-what-you-can establishment.  This does not mean that it is a soup kitchen!  In fact, it's the farthest thing from it.  Nightly meals consist of homemade entrees, sides, salads, and desserts.  Occasionally, guest chefs from local restaurants will cook up meals fit for a king.  The Fork and Spoon is one of unique places in Bozeman that make me proud to call this place home.

name: Start Loving
text: Everyone's intentions are good here. Most widely cited passage in the Bible is from Corinthians, without love it is nothing. It is a nice clean attractive facility. The food was tasty although the portions too small. I was born to wealth and for many years have lived homeless to free my life to fight for the neediest. I have some background in all this. I found myself wondering who was this really for? Was it for the huge needy and displaced by gentrification population of Bozeman? Yes, somewhat. But it seemed more for the wealthy including the students to feel good about themselves although that was not their intent. This is not a bad facility but if efforts stop here rather than start here it is a bad thing. The needy of Bozeman do not need a hospice. They need their more fortunate sisters and brothers to aggressively create life opportunities for growth. And to self sustain.

text:
Do not try to order food through GrubHub. I ordered a deep dish pizza tonight and when I went to pick it the hostess had no idea where to even look for my missing order. She finally found the order on one of the 3 tablets she had and said "someone" must have forgotten to put it in and that it would be about 20 minutes. Well, I'm not too keen on sitting in a lobby for 20 minutes so I asked for a refund. She said there was nothing she could do and that I needed to contact grub hub. No responsibility, no solutions.

Update: GrubHub refused to refund me! I had to go back to the restaurant and wait for my pizza.The manager did his best to make it right.

resp.text: Sky we’re sorry to hear about your recent Graubhub order experience. If you are willing to chat with a manager, please connect with us here: http://oldchicago.com/contact-us.  Your honest feedback is always welcome.

name: Chad Armstrong
text:
First thing. This is not a service related issue. Our service was great. Tony's bill $62.00. $15.00 tip. Tony was new. Okay.....I am done not getting what I pay for.
I remember these Old Chicago joints when I lived in Chicago. I never went.
Today was a celebration between my wife and I. I thought going to Old Chicago would be great since we've never been to one.
The food looked like some I baked in the oven after I got home from school....However, the ketchup I used then was more flavorful.
When have all chains like these lost their way? You couldn't have developed this model unless. you had something special.
Just like Buffalo Wild Wings, Pizza Hut, McDonald's etc.
At one time your food was worth sharing with the world.
Now the world is better without you.

name: Heath Hoffman
text: A perfect experience! A total 180° from our previous visit. The food was epic, pizza was made to perfection, everything was delicious. Tried the new Oktoberfest Sausage and Gouda stuffed mushrooms in an Alfredo and bacon sauce. I highly recommend it. Their Greek side salad is the perfect addition to any meal. Only thing that would have made it better would have been sliced pepperoncinis. Kids loved their chick strips and fries, fried to crispy excellence. And the kids ice cream sundaes topped with cookies, fudge, whipped cream and a cherry on top was truly the metaphor in real life. Maya is an amazing server. If you can request being in her section, she will take care of you like Royalty. A+++ visit. Can't wait to have another evening like this at Old Chicago again.

text: Great service and food. Happy hour is awesome.

name: Randall Field
text: Sesting not within six feet at l booths.

name: Carol Bruneau
text: After about 12 hours of driving, we were very glad to find this place still open at 9:00 pm.  And we were very pleasantly surprised by the friendly service, great food and huge beer selection.  My craft beer burger was absolutely delicious...juicy with yummy toppings of onions and beer cheese sauce. And the onion rings were some of the best I have ever tasted!  My guy had a mini pan pizza that was also tasty with generous toppings.  While I had wine, he had a flight of local beers...we were both happy with our choices!  Our server, Cheyenne, was very friendly and attentive!  It was a wonderful way to end a very long day!! I hear an Old Chicago is coming to my home town.  I predict we will be regulars!

name: Bozeman Review
text:
Good place to eat!  Good staff, good pizza!  I'd recommend it and eat it again!!  Located near the lowes store it's easy to get in and out.

We sent 3 families here and the same report.  Good food and good service

name: Katie S
text:
Shae was adorable as a server, however, we were seated in the bar since there was only one waiter on- with 2 toddlers. Timing was good for her to bring menus and drinks. We then waited for 10 minutes after we were ready to order. I had to ask the hostesses for booster seats (they were given to me very dirty- sticky with stuff stuck all over them). We then waited another 20 minutes for sub par food. The spaghetti pie was incredibly dry, to the point that there was not nearly enough marinara on top to eat but 1/3rd of it. My kids had cold spaghetti with a cold meatball. Literally the only thing in our 4 person order that was warm was my fish for.fish n chips. The fries were inedible, but the fish tasted good.

It definitely was not a place I'd eat again in the near future especially since there are so many options here in town.

name: Ty Walsh
text: Honestly one of the better beer selections in town. They have an open seating which is a plus and outdoor which I really enjoyed. The bar is ample and there are TV's to watch sports. The menu is very American bar food. Worth the try if you're looking for something safe

name: Madison Galloup
text: Willow "Like the tree" served my mother, my autistic brother and myself. She was super understanding and charismatic! She checked on us regularly and was super friendly. I even left my car keys and she ran out to the parking lot to bring them to me. Great customer service! Thank you Willow!

name: Juli Betterman
text: Great Pesto chicken pasta & server was very nice

name: Gary Hunter
text: Predictably good for lunch. Eat lunch here frequently. Their lunch specials are a good value.

name: Angela Massey
text: Good food, great atmosphere. Drinks are yummy too. Pretty fairly priced.

name: Regn Boone
text: Thin crust pizza yummy!

name: Rodney Grund
text: The service was spot on. The selection was outstanding. The price is right for the food offered. Old Chicago is absolutely an ideal spot for that Italian urge. The only downfall on this trip was the appetizer, the pepperoni rolls didn't actually have any pepperoni in them.

name: Eric Tonn
text: Happy Hour is amazing.

name: Brandon Schuff
text: Went to outback steakhouse which was suppose to be open until 11 pm based on what was posted online. Arrived and doors were locked. The door said open until 10 pm. It was a little before 930 pm. We called to speak to a local "outbacker" and were hung up on. Ended up going to old chicago and had awesome food and service.

name: Scott Payne
text: Nice place in Bozeman for an afternoon lunch and beer. Good food and nice beer selection.  I'll be back.

name: Jeremy DeVries

It has an entrance accessible from the parking lot but also one near the restrooms in the back. Good selection of games, reasonable drink prices, and nice attendants.

name: Juli Crew

name: Jerry Abercrombie

name: Ann Mary Joseph

name: William Donaldson

name: Mary Dean

name: Cheryl Fitzpatrick

name: George Stark

name: Justin Rucks
text: Family friendly restaurant that offers bar seating with a number of taps. The food itself is pretty good, and the setting of the restaurant is pretty casual, so there's no need to dress up unless you want to. The service is great. On a busy night you might have to wait awhile, but nothing more than five mins or so.

name: Jessica Kuipers
text: The Tipsy Grasshopper was yummy! Try one if you like mint shakes!!

name: Chad Knutson
text:
We had a great experience again

If you dont mind that and just want to keep your eyes on the sports playing all over the place, this would be a fantastic place for you!

text: Great pizza in amazing environment for people looking for good pizza. Customer service is great and couldn't ask for any better. Service time is usually and surprisingly quick. Five stars out of 4 stars for their friendly accommodations cleanliness and delicious food. I've been there once and wish I could go again as I plan to though I got a deep dish pizza and I recommend getting any kind of pizza there as it is their specialty.

name: Montana Review
text:
Overall Rating: Decent.

This place always surprises me. I come with the notion I'm going to have a lack luster meal, but leave satisfied and happy. The pizza is actually quite good, and their Mac N Cheese and salads are a good side or replacement. The atmosphere is fun if you sit in the bar section, but the dining section is quite boring. They're also pretty slow on bringing out your food, and there has been times where I needed something and my waiter was no where to be found and never came to check on us.

name: Bobby Criss
text: Pretty good burger. Good vibes.  I didn't try the pizza because I have low expectations outside of the NYC/NJ area, but my daughter liked it.

name: Michelle H.

name: Gaby Hidde
text: I would say it's hit or miss at Old Chicago. The last two times I've been, my plate was on point. I also loved the Buzzed Hippie I ordered on tap. However, my daughter had subpar Mac & cheese (which is her favorite) with very dry & unflavorful broccoli. The next time, her order of spaghetti & sausage was good and she enjoyed much better. That's how it always is with food quality there. Now the service we get is always good. To me, it's a great restaurant to take a kid to. With all the TVs and other noise, as a parent, you can let your kid be a kid (mostly) here.

So they should have known better that it being a family restaurant some people don't like hearing f_ck and c_cks_cker while they are dining. Bad form.

text: Old Chicago is one of my guilty pleasures. They have a great beer selection and, since the new remodel, the bar is great place to hang out and relax and have a beer and a calzone. However, if televisions in a bar bug you, this is not your place especially on a Bobcats game night.

name: Melanie Hoffman
text: Hit or miss, it really depends on the visit. I've had great food and service. I've also left feeling like I didn't want to go back. If it's a good visit it's usually amazing. Friendly service, quick turn around on food, quality eats. But when it's bad, it really sucks. My last visit was a busy Friday evening. Just wanted some drinks an apps to tide me over until our friends arrived and we were heading to Logan. Sat in the bar and our server was either overwhelmed or new, or both. Hubs ordered a Captain and 7 (mostly ice) I wanted to try a cider on the menu. I was told it might not be available. Pregnant pause. Ok, can you please check? Begrudgingly left to go check. Came back, no not available. Ok I'll have this instead. Ordered appetizers. Before they arrive she asked what we were ordering for dinner. Let her know we were just having apps. Huffed and left. 10 minutes later our pick 3 appetizer arrives, but the runner hands it to the table next to us. And they just take it and dive in!!! Who does that? So another 10 minutes goes by, no appetizer. We flag down our server because she had been MIA and even intentionally went a route to avoid walking by. I mean we both have been in the service industry, we aren't aholes and are polite. Ask her if she could check on our appetizer. Huffy again. 2 minutes later the manager comes over and apologizes for how long our food is taking. Tells us it will be right out. Gives us half off the food ticket. Um, alright... Ok, so they are firing it in the kitchen as we speak in other words. 2 of the 3 apps come out??? And they are so hot it's scald your mouth you aren't tasting anything else tonight. The jalapeno pretzels and deep fried pickles we're good. The pretzels we're actually amazing. Then the onion rings arrive. My husband had a couple, I take one and bite into it. The inside was raw batter. 🤢 Time to pay the tab. Annnnnd where's our server. Haven't seen her since she went looking for our food. Well we've seen her, just not at our table. So hubs goes up to the service station to pay. Oh yeah, I'll be right over, she says. Pay, tip (although not 20% as you can imagine) and head out. Haven't been back in the past couple weeks, but we will. Just going to make sure not to sit in her section.

name: Nigel Anselmi
text:
Called today for a quote on fencing material and was excited when the pricing was good. We went in and tried to pay, but they said their counts were likely very off, so they told us to go load up, then pay after. When we went to pay, the total was more than 3 times as much as it should have been. Never once did they apologize, after I pushed them a little, they gave a small discount, but not enough to make it right. It was a waste of my time and the last time I try to support Kenyon Noble.

Last time is was in there, I asked for help finding foam insulation sealant, the response I got was, "we probably have that". They didn't try to help me, I walked around the store looking for someone else, but didn't find anyone.

Every time I've been in there, the service gets worse and worse. I always try to support local, but it's impossible for me to support Kenyon anymore. Every recent visit I've taken there has been a waste of time.

I highly recommend steering clear of Kenyon Noble

text:
Typically understaffed. In many many visits I have not encountered a staff member with definitive knowledge of any given department. As an example, the "guy" who knows the price of the pedestal sink was "off for the weekend" so I couldn't buy it even if I wanted... There is very little variety in various departments - one brand or variety of knobs, toilet repair kit, etc.

If you know what you want exactly, they can usually help you locate the item within the store. For anything other than the most basic items, I suggest calling ahead to confirm they have it in stock.

Unique items they have that many other stores often do not: various chalk paints, glow in the dark coating, glass frost kits, metallic chrome finish spray paint, plastic fusion paint, heat resistant bbq/appliance paint. Also, the best putty knife/scraper selection in town. (Quality craftsmanship - solid steel construction.)

You go here to "hike the M."

name: Jose Manuel Rodriguez Gomez
text:
(Translated by Google) An ideal trial to get in touch with nature and appreciate beautiful views of the Bozeman Valley. The path has difficulties due to permanent climbs, but it is not difficult to do for a person in good health. You must wear comfortable clothes for walking and comfortable shoes, preferably for hiking. Of course I'm talking about times without snow. In winter, the path is difficult due to the traction and the push of some climbs. Do not be discouraged and take the climb very calmly and without haste, there are seats on the route to rest .. Bring your bottle with water and a camera to enjoy the view .. A very beautiful and unforgettable place .. Cheer up in one day sunny with family.

If my comment was helpful, please give me a * Like *.

(Original)
Un trial ideal para entrar en contacto con la naturaleza y apreciar hermosas vistas del Valle de Bozeman. El sendero tiene dificultades por subidas permanentes, más no es difícil de hacer para una persona en buen estado de salud. Hay que llevar ropa cómoda para caminar y zapatos cómodos preferiblemente de caminatas. Claro estoy hablando de tiempos sin nieve. En el caso de invierno el sendero se dificulta por la tracción y lo empujado de algunas subidas. No se desanimes y tomen la subida con mucha calma y sin apuro, hay asientos en la ruta para descansar.. Lleven su botellita con agua y una cámara fotográfica para disfrutar la vista.. Un lugar muy bello e inolvidable.. Anímense en un día soleado en familia.

Si fue de ayuda mi comentario, por favor darme un * Me gusta*.

name: April
text:
My husband and I have had meals at this restaurant 3 or 4 times since we've moved to the area. Besides the (more expensive) steakhouse, it's our favorite place to eat.

The service has always been pretty good there. I haven't had much of a problem getting refills for my drinks and they've never messed up our orders.

The complementary chips and salsa are fantastic--you get a spicy kind as well as a mild salsa that seems to have cabbage in it. The latter is my favorite and I plan on trying to make my own salsa to match.

The food is hot and fabulous and you get a lot on your plate. Lots of refried beans, rice, and some vegetables too (lettuce etc..). I'm a picky eater and I have never had cause to complain there. While some people might be overwhelmed at the huge menu, I love it because of my picky-ness and it gives me so much more to choose from that I would enjoy rather than narrowing it down to just one or two items I might consider.

I tried the chicken mole last time, and it was so delicious I can't wait to get it again! A friend of mine says the fish tacos are great there too with delicious seasoning.

If you want a casual atmosphere with good comfort food you should give this restaurant a try. And it's DEFINITELY better than fast food! I don't like mexican fast food and you certainly can't get mole at taco johns!

text:
The burgers taste fantastic for a $5 burger and the fries are out of this world delicious when the fry oil is fresh.

However, unless you're ready for an assault on the senses, I would steer clear of this burger joint. The music is about 20 dB too loud, the place smells very strongly of onions, and you can't step very far without walking on peanut shells that litter the floor.

I understand this is supposed to be a fun burger joint, but I would never bring a family here unless they were all high school students that could handle the loud music and atmosphere.

You'll get a great tasting burger, but you'll also walk out smelling like onions every time.

text:
People are so easily pleased...

We LOVE Five Guys...however, this is by far the worst Five Guys we've ever been to.

Multiple times, they have undercooked our burgers.  They are not as generous as ANY other Five Guys with their fries.  Their soda machine is often on the fritz.  They are NOT very clean - and no, I am not talking about the peanuts - that is normal.  I am talking about tabletops, bathrooms, glass, floor, soda machines...

Prices have gone up though....so there's that too.

REVISITED OCTOBER 2018 ----
I so wanted to like this place and was hoping things improved.  We arrived for an early lunch (shortly after 11am).

Strike 1 - They didn't have enough change to break a $100 bill....on a Saturday (their busiest day).  My change came back in $5 bills.  The cashier (female) was super nice and apologized for her manager's inadequacy.

Strike 2 - They used to put extra fries on the bottom of the bag.  They don't anymore or didn't for us the last 2 times.

Strike 3 - The place is FILTHY.  Bathrooms are constantly out of stuff (soap, toilet paper, etc).  The floors are filthy.  They don't do any night time cleanup on the tables even.  We got there just after they opened and their tables were filled with grease from the night before's customers.  That is DISGUSTING.

Won't be back.

Rating dropped as it was a worse experience.

text: Look -  you probably know what you're getting into here. Boilerplate but reliable burgers, a surprisingly decent beer selection, and an overpriced arcade for the kiddies.
