Fermented cabbage.

name: Amanda Young
text: Quick service, good food for the price. Family of 4 ate for less than $50 and that's alwaysa good thing! Beer order was a little confusing because you don't order at the same station as food and there wasn't a server available so we decided not to order beer. Looks to be decent prices for beer but just too complicated. Overall good experience and would recommend! Loved the old pictures and Elvis when you first walk in!

name: Mlle Aanee
text:
It’s always the worst experience with Fuddruckers. They hav such greasy food that it taste like having oil and that’s it. I thought thanksgiving dinner might be good. But it turned out to be another disaster. Though it was free but it wasn’t worth it. It seems like they cooked garbage and served it as free meal. Plus they were only coffee, milk and sweet tea which was pathetic. No sodas. Height of stinginess. And the female staff was another disaster. I asked for coffee and she got me just a sip in the cup telling me that it’s brewing and she’ll get more later which she never did.
Looks like fuddruckers can’t afford to maintain the restaurant. All the machines were out of order or maybe it was due to their stinginess. My strong recommendation: Never visit this place or you’ll regret it!

text: Pretty much have the best burgers. Fast service. Not too expensive. And... free unlimited toppings! BONUS!!!!

name: Angie Menning
text: Good food however the staff would rather be on their cell phones or socializing with each other rather than helping the customers. Looked as though a tornado ripped through the condiment buffet as there were tomatoes mixed in with the lettuce and onion tubs, dabs of mustard on the ALL of the condiments. We saw our order come up however the staff did not because they were too busy socializing...finally had to walk up and inform them our food was ready.

name: Mike Kiedro
text: This place is gross.  I've never been to a more filthy restaurant.  Smells like old garbage in the entryway.  Take a look at the floors...when is the last time they were mopped???  Really makes me wonder what the kitchen looks like.  Any reputable restaurant mops their floors nightly.

text: Descent local selection of beer,  a cool little bar in the front. Great burgers,  and game to keep the kids entertained while the adults get some free time to chat over a meal.  Not to classy not to trashy perfect for any occasion.

name: Stephanie U
text: WENT TO THE NEWLY RE-OPENED RESTAURANT! Guy that took our order looked uninterested, confused, stoned, or maybe a combination of all three. When we ordered a beer he stared long and hard at our selection as we pointed at it (a good 30 seconds) (Is anyone in there?). Paid $25 for 2 burgers, one fry and a $6 IPA. Beer is too expensive considering we can go downtown and get the same thing for $4. Burgers decent, but not worth the price. Atmosphere the same as the old Fuddruckers. Some of the tables were not cleared and just sat unattended. Guy that poured our beer at the beer counter needs to be retrained. There should not be 3 inches of foam on top of the beer. Probably won't go again.

text:
The wife and I are at a local hotel. Ordered food from fudrukkers via a delivery service. She had the fish and chips. I had the rib eye steak sandwich. The sandwich came with nothing but the sandwich itself.
I called and asked for the owner. She picked up the phone and simply said WHAT. No I am in no way joking. I conveyed my concefns, she replied ( THAT IS JUST THE WAY OUR MENU IS).
I couldn't believe what I heard. An owner of a very famous and busy resturante responding in that manner. I further conveyed that we would not be patroning fudrukkers again.

Bob. B  Bozeman

name: Roamer1
text:
Overall, our stay was quite the experience!

Saloon: the food is nothing to brag about, we got the nachos and bbq burger, but after soaking in the hot springs you don’t care that much, definitely not bad though.

Room: the bed is a spring mattress and the pillows are flat but otherwise beautiful area and the tub is wonderful!

Dining: wow, I can not say enough about this place. The service and food were great! Rachel the server was kind and prompt. The food was phenomenal, we got a salad with creamy goat cheese w walnuts and candied raisins. Meatloaf was good and the filet crab meal was really good! The moose track cake was only ok but the orange w marshmallow meringue was unique full of fresh flavor.

Overall, Chico Hot Springs is nice. It has an outdated look and most of the clientele looks sketchy but we minded our own business

name: Alley T
text:
They empty the Hotsprings and give her a deep clean every night! That's such a nice thought, knowing it's sanitized. But they kick everyone out at 10pm, which sucks I wish they had longer pool hours (maybe some adult only hours)

The food at the pool side restaurant was awesome. The staff on 3/5/21 at the end of shift were amazing. THEY HAVE TRUFFLE FRIES AND THEY ARE ADDICTING! I highly recommend the $8 pound truffle fries 😂  you can get them togo too.

resp.text: Thank you, Alley!  Pre-pandemic we kept the pool open until 11:00, hope to return to that soon!

name: Sean Kellogg
text: This place is off the chart. The restaurant is world class! Service is 5 stars.

name: Leo Schuman
text:
What a remarkable meal. We stayed here for our anniversary, as the place holds old childhood memories. We’d heard the “new” restaurant is good (last time I ate here, the meals were still served ranch style), and were not at all disappointed.

It takes a strong kitchen to have Beef Wellington on the menu, so we chose to try it. Table side service and all. And, it was the most tender and delicious beef we’ve enjoyed in many years. The last time we had this, it was at El Gaucho, in Portland. And, this topped that. Imagine roast beef with the delicacy of cake, wrapped in a pastry soaked in its juices. Every bit was savored. We then also had a flaming chocolate orange for dessert, a house specialty which was both fun and tasty.

While the “hot springs” here are more warm swimming pools (with cocktails!), than hot baths, this restaurant, the friendly staff, and the natural beauty of the area make this longtime family friendly destination well worth a visit.

resp.text: Leo, thank you so much for your review!  So fun to read that you were here in your childhood and remember the "ranch style" service in the Dining Room!  Thank you for sharing!

name: Brent Turner
text: Incredible coursed meal in the tasting room. David Wells blew us away!

resp.text: Thank you, Brent, we love Chef Dave's Tasting Room!

name: Mason DeMedio
text:
This place is wonderful and very cute!!! The hot springs are so nice, have a nice view, and the walk-up bar window is great! I thought I was gonna be weirded out by sharing a bathroom but it was honestly totally fine. The vibe of this place is so relaxing and magical.
The only reason it's not 5 stars is because the breakfast was honestly...bad. And expensive. If you're going here just pack some granola bars for the next day. Close enough to Yellowstone, and also a cheap stay if you get a smaller room!

name: Dixie Stark
text: The hot water was just perfect. The restaurant was excellent. The beef wellington was delicious--a bucket list experience.

resp.text: Thank you, Dixie!

name: Danette Christiansen
text: Very relaxing atmosphere. Good food. Nice staff.

name: Jim Cossitt
text:
Beautiful mountain setting, one of the better places Montana has to offer.  We locals like it during shoulder seasons.

We like the entire state during shoulder season.

resp.text: Thank you, Jim!

name: Brice Ligget
text: One of my favorite quick getaway locations.  I probably shouldn't even do a review as it's almost impossible to get a room.

name: Jake Roberts
text: Great experience!!! Went at night when it was snowing and was absolutely wonderful! Staff was very friendly!! Also very reasonably priced as well!!!

name: Moutaz Jwiehan
text: Stayed there for a couple of nights upon the covid mishap , truly excellent and unique especially after 3 nights of camping in yellow stone . Excellent welcoming , tip top staff members and an ancient lay out . We went for  dinner twice and it was formidable . alot of things to do other than dipping in the pool , i bet its amazing in winter time to soak in the pool and enjoy the day pass away . Thanks for all the front of the house team members 4 your energy  and for the back of the house staff member i do salute you

resp.text: Thank you, Moutaz, especially for the thanks to our staff!

name: Angela Pryce
text: Nowhere near capacity due to covid19. Government mandates shutting certain services at 10pm, such as bar and pool. Still has it's casual, cheerful charm! Love Chico. "Chico abides!"

name: Yolz Moreno
text: Great bloody Mary's and pretty relaxing. Mae was a complete doll !

resp.text: Thank you, Yolz, let us know how to turn your 4 stars into 5!  We love Mae too!

name: Dustin Liudahl
text: Really cool place. Go here if you can, make sure to get reservations they are always pretty booked.

resp.text: Thank you, Dustin, good advice too!

name: sandeep kommuri
text:
Maybe it's the temperature outside but hot springs are barely reaching 40°F and shower is spraying cold water
But it's nice place for sure in summer with and next to it

resp.text: Hello, Sandeep.  On a normal day, our hot springs pools are at a minimum 96 degrees F in the large pool and 101 degrees F in the small pool.  We did have some -20 degree F weather which certainly effected the pool temp on the large pool with the large surface area and very cold weather a couple of weeks ago (February 2021)

name: Michael Thomas
text: Fantastic experience acr board. Our cabin was clean and the views were incredible. Dinner Sansone of the best dining experiences I have ever had. The water was relaxing and the bar was serving ice cold drinks. Life is good at Chico.

name: Kristy Hagen
text: Its more built up with a convention. Center that wasn't there as a kid. Nice you can walk up and get beverage services .

resp.text: Thank you, Kristy!  We have seen a lot of changes in our 121 years!

name: Darren Hubbard
text: A great place that needs a lot of renovating. Great food, wonderful atmosphere and awesome staff.

name: Janelle Garza
text: Great pools, food, and drink. Clean facility. Lodge rooms are a little noisy.

resp.text: Thank you, Janelle!  Try the Lower Lodge or Fisherman's Lodge next time, they tend to be a little quieter!

name: Bryan Kendrick
text: Chico is a very special place. You won't drown in the pool, but possibly on ambiance. Very clean and super helpful service.

name: Lynda Swearingen
text: Stopped in for late lunch at the poolside grill. Excellent food and service.

resp.text: Thank you, Lynda!  The Grille will enjoy reading your comments!

name: Jody Wooden
text: The ONLY positive statement I can make is the people in the office/check-in were very nice and accommodating. When we booked our 'luxurious' room, we should have been told the restaurant (which was one of the reasons we went) was booked 2 weeks out. We would NOT have traveled that far, for a 'Montana' experience. We both are from Montana, and I was quite shocked at the disappointment. Since we were in the middle of nowhere, we had to sit in the bar to order a third rate dinner, by the door to the pool, which apparently the bartenders have to push a very loud button for patrons to enter....over and over. Rediculous. If somebody is brave enough to walk through a bar in a swimsuit without paying, oh my word! Let them! I found nothing about the experience to be worth the $400 we paid. Not a lot of money, but would have been better spent elsewhere in Montana!

name: Laura Rossi
text: Lovely little place. Amazing food

resp.text: Thank you, Laura!

name: Jennifer Page
text: Large sized pool to swim in or just hang around the edges and enjoy the warm temperature of the water.  Also has a smaller pool with hotter water directly from the hot springs. A great place to soak sore muscles and  joints, while enjoying a nice adult beverage from the walk up bar.

resp.text: Thank you, Jennifer!

name: Forrest Hermanns
text: Qaint little resort. Good food. Spring wasn't very hot but still enjoyable.

name: Tracy Preston
text: It's always wonderful! Heaven on earth

resp.text: Thank you, Tracy!

name: David Smith
text: Great experience, good food, fun experience.

resp.text: Thank you, David!

name: Crystal Phillis
text: Overall we really liked Chico the pool is awesome. Walking to the pool for one of the lodges was quite cold but they did have locker rooms if you wanted to change first. Dinner in the main dining room was the highlight for us! The beef Wellington and the drinks and desert was to die for. Our room in the lower lodge was find beds could be more comfy but not bad. There was no AC in our room but a celling fan and it didn't get to hot but I don't think I would want to visit in the middle of summer!

name: Angelo Giallombardo
text: Loved soaking in the hot springs pool. This place is legendary. Only point is beware because they don't have air conditioning in the summer heat. Still love this place

resp.text: Thank you, Angelo!

name: Vicky CASTONA
text: Food is amazing. Rooms are small water was not very hot.

resp.text: Hi Vicky, not sure when you visited, but the natural hot springs did have a fluctuation this winter which seems to have corrected itself.  Our large pool is running at or above its years-long average of 96 degrees, and the small pool is running at or above 101 degrees.  This is as of 2/25/2021.  We have a vast variety of rooms - sizes, prices, amenities, location, etc.  The smaller rooms being in our Historic Main Lodge, built in 1900, are of course at the lower end of our offered rates.  Thank you for your positive comment on our food.  Safe Travels.

name: Josh Howley
text: Great and relaxing time at Chico. The cabins are amazing and cozy, with tons of bathroom space

resp.text: Thank you, Josh!

name: Wayne Lin
text: Super laid back and chill hot springs. The water is lovely and naturally fed. I also loved that you can order drinks at the walk up bar and drink them in the pool. Food was standard bar fare and delicious. We had chicken tenders that were perfectly fried and an order of nachos. Both were big servings and we didn't manage to finish them. Overall a very relaxing experience after a long hike.

name: Kimberly McGivern
text: Nestled in a beautiful valley, Hot Spring lodge with Bar and Grill. Had a great get away, will be back.

resp.text: Thank you, Kimberly, looking forward to seeing you again!

name: Scott Abel
text: Nice place, beautiful scenery, close to Yellowstone.

resp.text: Thank you, Scott!  Yep, just about a 35-mile drive to Yellowstone National Park from here!

name: Peter Ford
text: We really like this place. Decent Covid protocol. Great food and grounds. Nice bar

resp.text: Thank you, Peter!

name: Trudy Healy
text: I went to a friend's wedding ceremony for the first time at this location. It was beautiful. The view, the service,  the food wa all top notch. I highly recommend this venue.

resp.text: Thank you so much, Trudy!  And thank you for adding the great photos!  We hope you'll be able to visit us again someday!

name: Brian Cortese
text: Great place, beautiful area, & excellent service!

resp.text: Thank you, Brian, appreciate your review!

name: Heather Olson
text: Fun place to hang out n relax

resp.text: Thank you, Heather!

name: Robert Toombs
text: We always love coming here. So peaceful and relaxing. The staff is exceptional,  and makes you feel at home. Plenty of different room options, from private cabins to the inexpensive.  Dinner in the Dining Room is highly recommended,  a bit pricey but well worth it.  They offer a breakfast buffet in the morning.  Well worth the trip for a relaxing getaway.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to write your review, Robert!  Really appreciate it!

name: Gregory Alan
text: Every time I go, It is wonderful anytime of the year.  I feel like I have been dipped in the magic of the Yellowstone volcano and reborn.

resp.text: Thank you, Gregory, what a creative way to look at life!

name: Amy Bertolino
text: It's a lovely wonderful relaxing place to go.

name: Kyle Buck
text: Always a great place to soak with a great atmosphere!!

resp.text: Thank you, Kyle, really appreciate your review!

name: David Arnold
text: Lots of history, wonderful pools and a great restaurant. Even with Covid restrictions, it's a wonderful place to visit. Will be back. Hotel rooms are small because they are from a past era, but the draw it the pool.

resp.text: Thank you, David!

name: Andrew & Whitney Erb
text: My family loves chico! ❤

name: Bryan Rask
text: What an awesome place to spend a blizzard! Over the top staff, great food and experience in the bar.

resp.text: Bryan, thank you!  Blizzards are best enjoyed in the hot springs!

name: David Hickman
text: Always a blast!!! So great to come & relax in the pools.

name: john wilson
text: What a great place,  covid hasn't slowed this spot down! Great tubbing place with good service and great day rates! Diffently a spot to swing by!

resp.text: Thank you, John, let us know how to turn your four stars into five!

name: Russ Palmer
text: Love this place!

resp.text: Thank you, Russ!

name: Tyson Leavens
text: Loved this place relax soak drink

name: Christian Henslin
text: Love this spot, great food, friendly people. Amazing rustic vibe.

name: Ty Walsh

text: Really a nice restaurant great winter getaway package price.  Wife loves it there our cabin was clean but the heater did not work temperature was single digits we brought our blankets and sleeping bags out of the truck. resp.text: Derrek, we've sent the guys up to check out the heat and door in 504 - so sorry you had this trouble!!

name: George Stark
text: Pools were alot of fun! Cheap and great place to spend time with family and friends

resp.text: Thank you, George!

name: Bitterroot Seabee
text: Went to the Hot Springs had a wonderful soak had dinner at the bar . A Montana melt and a BBQ chicken pizza both very tasty. Just went to Chico again today 6/2/19 tried some more delicious food the kitchen sink burger and the Philly Soo good hot tub was up to 105 mmmhmm

resp.text: Thank you, alaskaseabee!

name: Emily Natale
text: Chico is a must-do at least a couple of times a year for us.  We love the chill, family friendly vibe with some upscale options. Just make sure you ask lots of questions about the room/cabin you are renting as they are all very unique and some are quite rustic.

text: Best massage ever. Go see Darrea if possible. She works limited hours so call ahead.

resp.text: Thank you, D, appreciate your comments!

resp.text: Come visit us mid-week in the winter months, George, it's much quieter then!

name: Jared Garner
text: Because it's close to home, employees are pretty good..

name: J. T.

name: Cyndi Smith

name: Stephen Rybacki
text: Nice little "town" there with a beautiful hot spring pool, and very good food.

resp.text: Thank you, Stephen!

name: MD Powers
text: Loved our little cabin. The hot pool was pretty crowded during the weekend afternoons, but I'll bet weeknights are peaceful. Enjoyable coffee / gift shop. Sunday brunch has superb selection, if you care for that. (I can't eat $20 worth of breakfast food.)

name: A Bart
text: Enchanting place. Clean. Relaxing. Very friendly and accommodating staff.

resp.text: Thank you, A, happy you were able to relax here!

name: James Bjork
text: We stopped in to visit the hot spring fed swimming pools. It was an excellent way to relax after a long day hike in Yellowstone. food and drinks are available in the pool area and they have a good selection of local brews. It gets busy in the evening on the weekend but wasn't really over crowded. We'll certainly return and stay in the resort.

resp.text: Thank you, James, we look forward to having you stay with us!

name: Micaela Hoag
text: Wonderful place for a getaway. Great staff, excellent food, perfect atmosphere.

name: Adam Ugorowski
text: Perfect everytime!

resp.text: Thank you, Adam!

name: Kory Chosa
text: Love going here and relaxing in the pools

resp.text: Thank you, Kory!

name: Paula Dempsey
text: Beautiful place, room was very nice. The staff is friendly and helpful. Super relaxing soaks and fun at the saloon. Great experience!

resp.text: Thank you, Paula!

name: Esther Peek
text: It is great here, they treat you like family. Everyone is so friendly and helpful. Breakfast buffet is terrific. We had dinner one evening Gene had Prime Rib he said was great. I had the green garden salad  which was great and Beef Tenderloin Tips and they melted in your mouth. I would recommend Chico to everyone. Thank you for a fabulous time.

resp.text: Thank you, Esther!  We love our huge family of Chico guests!

name: Sheri Gustke
text: Always love Chico! The food in both the restaurant and the saloon was delicious, and great service all around!

resp.text: Thank you, Sheri!

name: Jaclyn Stensrud

resp.text: Thank you, Jaclyn!

name: Ryan Hennessy
text: Love it up here.

name: Cole Heitman
text: Whether you decide to go for the day or spend the night Chico has you covered. They have pretty much anything everyone would ask for. Definitely worth the trip and money well spent

name: Brenna
text: Old fashioned atmosphere, not for everybody.

name: Skip Price
text: Nothing like a good soak

name: Mikel McGee
text: My goodness the food was amazing. Duck Confit, Pumpkin Swordfish, Curried Sea Scallops. Wow oh wow. I'll be dreaming of this experience for ages!

resp.text: Thank you, Mikel....my mouth is watering just reading your comment!

name: Sugar Babe
text: All I can say is Chico Hot Springs is my happy place. I come here as often as I can. The rooms are reasonable I like to stay in the old part cuz you are close to the springs and it's just a wonderful place in the staff is fantastic come here if you can.

name: Bryant Tingler
text: My wife and i went on an anniversary trip here for the weekend following labor day weekend. Neither of us had ever been to Chico and didn't know what to expect. We had stayed in the main lodge, which apparently has communal bathrooms, which was almost a deal breaker for my wife. In addition to no tvs we were skeptical at first. However we ended up having a great time. There's something therapeutic about having a few drinks poolside and then unwinding in the hot spring water. The attached restaurant had decent food, even if it was a bit extra proud of itself, which showed up in the bill at the end.

name: Susan Horton
text: We went for the Winter Getaway ($235) which included the room, anything from the dinner menu (1 appetizer, 2 entrees, 2 desserts) breakfast buffet for 2 and 2 passes to the hot pools for 2 days. As always, the service, food and pool were great. The atmosphere is casual and a little "rustic Montana", but the great service makes you feel pampered. There are additional services like massages if you want a little extra pampering. Very enjoyable and the food offered is exceptional. A real Treat!!

resp.text: Thank you, Susan, for taking the time to write your review!

name: Hal Everett
text: Busy tavern. Did not visit the resort proper. Nothing special other than the setting.  Food and beverages were average.

name: Lisa Summers
text: Great getaway!

resp.text: Thank you, Lisa!

name: J T
text: Staff was friendly and efficient. Lodge is dated, but has a nice rustic ambiance. Took a day pass to the hot springs and enjoyed a long soak. It being a holiday weekend, it was relatively crowded and a bit more of a party atmosphere than we were expecting. Ate at the poolside cafe which had a delicious burger and gluten free options.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback, John!  Happy to hear you enjoyed the hot springs and Poolside Grille!

name: ben yetter
text: Chico is always great. The restaurant is first rate, staff is very professional

resp.text: Thank you, Ben!

name: Ellie Knight
text: Everyone who works here is incredibly friendly. The hot springs are amazing and very fun with a walk up bar. There is one large open pool, and a smaller, covered, and hotter pool. Drinks are amazing and the restaurant in the hotel is not to be missed. Bar food is also excellent.

name: Paul Pope
text: A great place. Their drink service rules are a bit childish. They don't let you buy drinks for other people. Other than that, pretty good.

name: Lawana Beebout
text: Nice place

name: Nancy Douglas
text: Really fun place to stay, soak, eat and drink

resp.text: Thank you, Nancy!

name: Deborah Thistlethwaite
text: Excellent service and staff!!! Best Restaurant in Park County!!! The Beef Wellington just melts in your mouth and the Smoked Trout appetizer was superprisingly different and yummy!!!

resp.text: Thank you, Deborah!

name: David Dobbins
text: Excellent first visit to Chico Hot Springs. The rooms were great. Food was great. Drinks were great. Pools we're great. Service was great. Was there on a business conference. Great location for meeting with 100+ people. I'll be back.

resp.text: Looking forward to seeing you again, David, thanks for your review!

name: Tyler Hagan
text: Fun little place with hot spring, horses, rafting, and a great bar

resp.text: Thank you, Tyler!

name: Montana
text: My favorite place on earth! Everything you need to chill out and enjoy a day or several days. Amazing food and drink choices.

name: Eric Lucksley
text: Our stay at Chico was awesome as always. The cabin we stayed in was nice and clean and spacious! The food was also amazing. I'd highly recommend the Beef Wellington! The pools themselves are relaxing and rejuvenating. All in all, it was a great stay.

resp.text: Thank you, Eric, happy to hear you were able to relax and rejuvenate!

name: Colleen Chapple
text: A charm all its own!

resp.text: Thank you, Colleen!

name: steven sullivan
text: This place has a cool vibe and the wait staff is excellent but my burger and fries was just ok.

resp.text: Hi Steven, thanks for letting us know - always appreciate as much information as possible on how we can make improvements!

name: A R
text: Normally a great place to enjoy a romantic getaway but not so much this time (and lately). Staff wasn't as friendly as normal. Ordered take out from the poolside grill by phone and person taking order told me they didn't have time to give me info about 1 item I asked about. The pizza we ordered tasted like it was 2 days old. Could have been just one of those trips because everything has been great in the past so so I'm sure we'll try again. We usually come once a year but not happy about this last trip.

resp.text: AR - can you let us know a specific date and time so maybe we can pinpoint a specific employee?  We've just made a management change in our Poolside Grille and we are very excited for the days ahead!  I'm so sorry you did not experience that genuine Chico service you've grown to enjoy!

name: Kestrel Swift
text: The hot spring pool is large and a very comfortable temperature.  With a second, hotter pool for an even more relaxing experience.  The mountain view and fresh air really complete the refreshing atmosphere.

resp.text: Thank you, Kestrel!  We know you've spent some time in the Chico Gardens too!  So appreciate your appreciation of us!

name: Larry Long
text: A very good time! We didn't avail ourselves of the pool or any spa treatments but just got a drink in the very cool bar.

name: Tatjanna Miller
text:
I wasn't very impressed with this location. What I did like: the rural feel, the absence of modern room amenities such as TV and cell service, which truly let's you get away from it all. The garden where they grow the food they serve. The older rooms reminiscent of days gone by.
What I didn't like. This was a group meeting, the clerk's did not seem prepared for us, lots of confusion and unwillingness to accommodate. I have social anxiety, my manager had asked that I be placed in a specific room where I wouldn't feel anxious. It was still a shared room he requested. Instead they put me in with complete strangers in a shared room with beds only 6 inches a part that shared a hallway bathroom . When asked if the Mistake could be fixed they refused to help or switch me. Instead I slept on a small sofa in the room I was supposed to be in. The staff was unapologetic and unsympathetic to the error. It made the experience terrible. It also made me feel not welcomed at the hotel. My business now goes to White Sulpher, while not superior in location and accommodation, far superior in customer service.

resp.text: Thank you for your comments, Tatjanna.  I'm so sorry you did not feel your accommodations with your other group members suited your specific needs.  I'm not certain of your dates of stay / group information as I'm not seeing any specific guest history in your name - however generally when reservations are made by a group, especially in the context you have given, we place guests exactly where the group leader has requested.  Once those room assignments are made by the group leader, our front desk team is not at liberty to make changes.  In other words, we don't choose your room or your room mates, your group leader does.  It is possible he/she made that communication with his/her sales person and the change did not get made, and if that is the case I am very sorry.  The front desk should have shared this information with you and helped you connect with your group leader to make changes.  We hope you will give us another chance another time.

name: Paul Kyle
text: Lovely old school interior. The outdoor hot springs pools are brilliant. Decent grill too!

name: E Richardson
text: Chico is always a good time.  Hard to be hot water coming up from the ground in winter with a poolside bar window.  Albeit the wait is cold.  Wish they had a poolside waiter that also sold admission.  Bar food is awesome with gluten free options and a fun atmosphere.  Great for couples or families to get away.  A good stop while in Montana if you can book a room.

name: David H. Nguyen
text:
While we were at a conference, we met someone from Montana, and they told us while we were visiting Montana we should make a stop off at Chico.  I was skeptical, but when I looked it up, seemed interesting and we had a lot of extra time.  It's about 30-40 minutes north of the north entrance to Yellowstone, so not too far out of the way if you plan your day.  We were done exploring Yellowstone and this ended up being a relaxing change of pace.

When you arrive, it's a resort, so many of the guests are at the hotel for the long haul.  However, they do allow for day passes to the pool area.  It's less than 10 per person.  There are 2 heated pools, the one under the canopy is a little bit warmed, and the larger pool that is open air.  We spent more time in the bigger pool, because it was so nice that it was snowing, and about 38 degrees while you're in a pool that is about 95 degrees.  You also get to overlook the mountains, the whole scenario is surreal.  If you have extra time, make the drive and relax here.

name: Diane Cole
text: Nice place to take a dip. They have pricey drinks. Pool side grill is tasty and prices are affordable. The restaurant inside the hotel is an expensive 5 star fancy full.

resp.text: Thank you, Diane, let us know how to turn your 3-stars into 5.

name: Shellie Cavazos
text: Lovely grounds, plenty to do for the family & also fun for the adult crowd with live music on the weekends.

resp.text: Thank you, Shellie, let us know how we can turn your 4-stars into 5!

name: Mattie Curtis
text: Cozy place, hot water, and great drinks next to the pool. Fun for young and old.

resp.text: Thank you, Mattie!

name: Tania Kenner
text: The pools were great for a nice soak. Clean, no chemicals, but also no view. I thought we would be able to see the surrounding area while we soaked. Food in the restaurants was outstanding. Good cappuccinos in the coffee shop. The sleeping accommodations leave a bit to be desired though. Wasn't expecting super fancy, it is an older historical place, but they could upgrade their linens, towels, and mattresses and seriously improve the comfort of the place. Great for a day trip and bite to eat!!!

name: Jessica Christensen
text: Always a terrific experience.  The staff is terrific no matter where you are; restaurant,  store, front counter, bar, room cleaners. And our dinners have always been delicious,  but this last trip was one of the best.

name: Diane Reese Leach
text: Wonderful amenities...towels, food & bar service.  Excellent fun staff.  Hotel is lovely with a high end restaurant.  A great experience for both day trippers or overnight guests.

resp.text: Thank you, Diane!

name: Hunter Johnson
text: A nice quiet place.

resp.text: Thank you, Hunter!

name: Jessica Camp
text: Super nice. Everyone is friendly great food

resp.text: Thank you, Jessica!

name: Matthew Cichosz
text: The restaurant is amazing. Great food and great drinks.

resp.text: Thank you, Matthew!

name: Robert Crabtree
text: Alex and Melissa are a real benefit to Moscow!  Wonderful experience.  Cordial, friendly, prompt.  Presentation and taste were as good as any damn big city restaurant.  A real gem.

name: Tammy Schmidt
text: Staff was great and the hot springs were sooo warm! Felt great on a snowy day!

name: Jeanie Engelke
text: Oasis in Montana. Fun atmosphere, clean, cozy. Very relaxing atmosphere. Staff were always friendly and helpful.

resp.text: Thank you, Jeanie!  We'll share your comments with our staff!

name: Will B
text: We tried out the Winter Getaway package. Enjoyed our stay. Room was nice and clean. The restaurant was very good. The prime rib was well seasoned and perfectly rare. The dinner waitstaff was excellent. Enjoyed soaking in the pool. Good spot to go for a rustic MT hot springs experience.

resp.text: Thank you, Will.  Come see us again!  Winter Getaway runs every year from January through April.

name: Lorena Currie
text: This place is awesome, everyone that works there is very friendly and helpful. And the food is REALLY GOOD!

resp.text: Thank you, Lorena!  We have a great staff who love our guests!

name: Janelle Nelson
text: Great place for conferences and relaxing and  soaking! The main restaurant offers amazing  food and selection. The grill is great too!

resp.text: Thank you, Janelle!

name: Erin Lovett
text: 5 star restaurant with the best food & service. Cute old hotel in the heart of Paradise Valley. Great place for a weekend getaway!!

resp.text: Thank you, Erin!

name: Dee Dee Foley
text: Fun family place to swim during the day, even in winter! The Grille serves great burgers and pizza!! Very fun with kiddos!

resp.text: Thank you, Dee Dee!

name: U R
text: I love this place. Must visit while you are in Montana

resp.text: Thank you, U R!

name: Amanda Petrik
text: Sure wish there was a way to get to the pool without going through the hotel.

resp.text: Amanda, you can enter the pool through the Saloon and Poolside Grille as well.

name: Chris Bredberg
text: Loved it! The food was scrupulous! The service excellent, the rooms clean and quiet. The pool, relaxing! I cant wait to go again!!

name: Linda Hogg
text: What a relaxing time for lunch and a soak mid-week... Sunshine and all!

resp.text: Thank you, Linda!

name: Janice Adair
text: Step back in time.  Great service.  Wonderful Sunday brunch.  Enjoyed swimming in the hot pools of spring water

resp.text: Thank you, Janice!

name: Ronnie Kuchtyn
text: The food was absolutely delicious! Staff was very friendly and helpful. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay.

name: Peter Sunden
text: A classic Montana experience with an excellent restaurant, saloon, and accommodations. The pools are spacious and accessible. Great locker rooms, nice mountain views, and everything else you would want for a nice soak away from home.

name: Larissa Donahue
text:
I stayed in one of the old timey single rooms and it was just fine. Comfortable mattress and quiet floor, and the shared bathroom was very nice, never had to wait in line. The pools were very nice, although crowded. I got a deluxe massage package and although everyone was very nice, I did feel like I had overpaid for what I got.
Chico is something of a Montana experience, and I'm not sad I went. :)

name: Patrick Keifert
text: Excellent food, including new and old menu items combined with very fine service. John was excellent.

resp.text: Thank you, Patrick, we'll share you comments with John!

name: Simon mozer
text: Came here for an anniversary. We had a small cabin which was just lovely. No TV in room but the veiws around there are spectacular and it gets really, really quiet at night. The pool is maybe a little outdated but the water temperature is great. They have a few places to eat on site, if you want to eat at the fancy place make a reservation early! There are no other places to eat so either bring your own food or try the bar or sandwich shop.

resp.text: Hi Simon, thank you for your review!  Our Poolside Grille and Saloon both serve lunch and dinner (same menu), and our Main Dining Room serves breakfast and dinner.  Reservations are strongly recommended for dinner in the Main Dining Room.  Let us know what would turn your 3 starts into 5!

name: Sean McCleary
text: Great place to get away. The rustic cabins are cute and they do the job for a short stay. However we really enjoyed the larger cabins . The hot springs and adjoining bar are lots of fun. The massages offered at the top of the hill a great as well. We have stayed here twice in the past year. We will continue to visit in the near future.

name: Michael Kuebler
text: This is a fun, old resort with a lot of history to it. It was nice to shut the phone off, and not watch any tv. To sit in the pool while it snows after a wonderful dinner is the most relaxing thing to do. If you want turn of the century charm this is place to be...

name: Andy Wildenberg
text: Chico is consistently awesome. Everyone is just chill, so it's a great place to destress.  I think the pizza place's quality went up a notch since last time as well.

resp.text: Thank you, Andy!  I'll share your comment with the Grille, they will enjoy hearing your feedback!

name: Pete Youngstrom
text: Perfect for a relaxed weekend.Great food great massage and love the hot springs.

resp.text: Thank you, Pete!

name: HN406 North
text: Great place. Go relax and enjoy you will have a great time. The service and people are awesome. The food is amazing at the restaurant. You totally get what you pay for. I'm going to be a frequent visitor.

name: the kyleigh show with me
text: 22 degrees, a light snow and chillin in hot, toasty spring water  feeling wonderful

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Jason Palevsky
text: Amazing venue for a Wedding!0

resp.text: Thank you, Jason!

name: Madisen Robertus
text: Beautiful, quaint, worth the drive. The two pools are always very clean and the perfect temperature, and so are the locker rooms. The grill next to the pool has excellent food, especially if you're looking for  a good burger.

name: Russell O
text:
Historic hot springs that used to be used as a hospital. Beautifully transformed into a rustic/modern experience. Good (but expensive) food and nice soaking pools that were recently resurfaced.

I like to stay in the main lodge, but it's cheaper to stay in the chalets if you have a lot of people.

Lots of fun activities to do when you aren't soaking like dog sledding, horse back riding, and hiking the nearby peaks.

Lovely place.

name: Jerry Mumm
text: We stayed in the Shooting Star cabin and loved it! It was secluded, romantic,  peaceful, and we ha our own little deck! Dinner and the breakfast buffet was outstanding. It was easy to charge everything to our cabin and make 1 payment upon checkout.  We will be going back as soon as we can book the shooting star again! The only bummer is you have to reserve your rooms so far in advance, for example, I asked how far out to reserve the Shooting Star Cabin for a Friday or Saturday night and the wait was 3 months.....to reserve the same cabin for a whole weekend was 6+ months.

name: John Campbell
text: As always, our visit to Chico was a pleasant experience. A nice soak in the hot pool was followed by a relaxing dinner with friends. Wait staff was friendly, efficient and helpful. All members were very pleased with their meals and drinks. We took out of state friends here because we knew that they would have a great time.

name: RYAN HALBERT
text: Warm bath with strangers

name: Randy Culbreath
text: Pool is great.. food is only marginal and high priced ..drinks are expensive.

resp.text: Thank you, Randy.  So sorry we did not meet your expectations with food quality and drink prices.  We do have two restaurant options:  Our fine dining Main Dining Room which offers a menu featuring many local and sustainable products with all items made in house, this is our more expensive restaurant.  We also offer a less expensive option in our Poolside Grille with delicious hamburgers, pizza, sandwiches, and salads.

name: Rachel Shamp
text: Don't recommend attending on the weekend at night. Alcohol was freely drunk by the pools and it was loud because of the Saloon. Not family friendly.

resp.text: Hi Rachel, so sorry we did not meet your expectations!  The pool is the quietest in the weekday mornings.

name: Michael Midgley
text: This is such a fun and cheap getaway for me and my family. The rooms are a little expensive but if you live in billings or nearby it's very easy to go up early and come home that night. The cafe has really good food and if you want to spend the money they have a very nice 5 star restaurant as well.

name: Anthony Bourne
text:
Old but that's part of the charm.

My wife booked Chico for my birthday. Upon entering I was slightly disappointed with how outdated the building was. That feeling quickly melted away by great customer service due to a warm a welcoming staff throughout. Amazing food in the restaurant almost demands you eat there at least once. Again our service there was second to none. The hot springs is split between a warm pool and a hot pool. Both pools were perfect even in the low temperatures during our visit. I had no cell service but solid WiFi that we were able to stream our favorite TV show late at night. A calm relaxing atmosphere that ended up being just what I needed.

It's hard to put a finger on what made my stay so amazing but my wife is already planning our next trip. I would recommend booking early as they tend to be full. It's easy to see why.

resp.text: Anthony - thank you for your kind words!  We prefer "historic" over old (just teasing you a little!).  Please come visit us again!

name: Stacey Faldetta
text: Always a great time at Chico! Relaxed, chill atmosphere. Love that there is a poolside Cafe and a bar too!

name: Ben Cetrone
text: Stayed in the lower lodge, and it had the worst bed I've ever experienced

name: marcus schwarz
text: All the people at the horse barn are amazing and will make your trip to chico worth while!!!

name: Krist Pliley
text: One of a kind.  Hope they don't change.

resp.text: Thank you, Krist!

name: Paul Stanley
text:
I love chico! I've been going there for 25 years since I was a child and they keep getting better. The dining room meal was incredible as always (we had the duck two ways and the prime rib), and the pool and saloon afterwards were all the entertainment we could handle.

I can't wait to try out their new stagecoach type rooms which look amazing.  As long as chico keeps improving while maintaining the charm and tradition I've seen them deliver my whole life I'll keep coming back.

resp.text: Thank you so much, Paul.  If you'd like to stay in one of the wagons, they are Camp Conestoga (the group of 5 with a bath house) and Cowboy Camp (the single with private deck and "outhouse").  Looking forward to having you as our guest for years to come!

name: Missy Jennings
text: Fun and relaxing atmosphere. Would love live music outside at night when its warm enough. A high stage so everyone can see from the pool would be awesome.

resp.text: Hi Missy, thank you for your comments and suggestion!

name: Vincent Stephan
text: Beautiful old school lodge feel with modern cusine and creature comforts. I can feel the history just waking down the long narrow Halls of the main Lodge. I looked for the white lady on the third floor but didn't spot her to my dismay. My wife and I visited for the first time and couldn't have been more pleased .We had dinner reservations and we're so impressed with the food and service.!! Beautiful place to get away and relax .Loved the main lobby and fireplace . Great place to hang out and have coffee in the morning. Thanks Chico! We will be back

resp.text: Thank you, Vincent, we are looking forward to your return!  Maybe Percie (the white lady on the third floor) will pay you a visit next trip!

name: Annmarie Baker
text: The people and food r vantastic better then Qunns

name: Kennan M
text: What an amazing place. The charm of the main Lodge along with the best restaurant in the state and a beautiful outdoor pool make this an essential place for locals and visitors. Being a Montanan myself it pains me a little to recommend this to so many people because it is a priceless gem nestled in Paradise valley.

resp.text: Thank you, Kennan!  I'm a Montanan too, happy to be a caretaker of this great Montana gem!

name: Courtney Glines
text: About as classic as they come, Chico has managed to retain its charm while offering decent food and swim prices. Be prepared to pay out the nose for craft beer and boozy slushies.

resp.text: Thank you, Courtney.

name: Kevin Hannegan
text: Such a great place to relax and unwind. They have a bar that's right next to the pool which is a huge plus. Everything is well maintained and the staff is super friendly. Highly recommend.

name: Steven Near
text: Nice worm water

resp.text: Warm!  Thank you, Steven!

name: A Brady
text: My boyfriend and I went up to stay a night this past weekend and it was amazing. We stayed in the caboose suite up on the top of the hill and it was fantastic! Not only was it probably the coolest hotel room I'll ever stay in, but it was so cozy and clean I didn't want to leave. The bathtub in the room is huge, more than enough space for two. There were even wine glasses in the cupboard we could use while we enjoyed watching the sunset on the front steps! We had dinner in the restaurant there and our waitress' name was Purity. She was such an amazing waitress to have, always making sure we had plenty to drink and we didn't have to wait long for anything we requested. On top of her being friendly and full of smiles, she was hobbling around with a big boot on her leg and it didn't slow her down a bit! Kudos to you, girl! You are a rockstar! Overall, I'd give this place a solid 5 star review. I will most certainly be returning!

resp.text: Thank you so much for your kind review!  We'll be sure to share your comments with Purity!

name: Barb F
text: We have been visiting Chico for over 30 years.  The food, the hot springs fed pools, the staff, all make for an incredible stay.  We love staying in the main lodge where the rooms are not fancy, no TVs , but free wifi . The atmosphere is very relaxed and rejuvenating.  Stay during the week when it's a little less crowded.

resp.text: Thank you, Barb, for being our guest for over 30 years!  We appreciate you!

name: Rodney Lee
text: Amazing atmosphere, great staff

resp.text: Thank you, Rodney!

name: Rodney Gottula
text: Nothing beats the rustic charm and friendly staff at Chico. Excellent restaurant, too! Visited again last night and food continues to exceed expectations of deliciousness.

resp.text: Thank you, Rodney, very kind of you1

name: Tom Mason
text: Went for a soak and lunch at the Poolside Grill. Hot springs are nice but appear to need a little more upkeep. Staff is very friendly and helpful but seem to be stretched thin. Promptness of service is lacking. We go here often and it isn't always like this. Still worth a visit.

name: Robin Nelson
text: Always a favorite.  Great rooms, service and swim.

resp.text: Thank you, Robin!

name: michell baca
text: Love that small little spring water

resp.text: Thank you, Michell!

name: james k
text: We came for the horse rides and the hot springs,  both of which are on-site.  Bonus experiences were the fine dining as well as a pool side pub style diner and a full blown saloon. Lots of wild life in the fields and the mountains surround you.  The yellowstone river is nearby for fishing as well as guided float trips.  The hot springs aren't the best we have been to,  but they are decent and all of the amenities more than make up for it.  They are open year round and i believe they have live music most weekends.

name: luke dovel
text: Did the winter getaway package which was a good value, however I disliked the structure. The first night they forced my dinner reservations to 8pm and all of the prime rib was gone. Second night I asked to be sat around 6:30. Could not get a massage because they wanted reservations and could not go horseback riding because we didnt make reservations. Felt like I couldn't do what I wanted the entire trip.

resp.text: So sorry to hear this, Luke!  It really can get busy even during the winter months, sorry we could not accommodate your activities and preferred dining times.  If you come back on another Winter Getaway Package, please let us help you book your activities and dining when you make your lodging reservation!

name: Erin File
text: Food was great.  Service on the other hand could have been better.  We stood and waiting while waitresses passed us numerous times and didn't even acknowledge we were there.  After waiting we decided to bus our own table and sit.  Took them almost 20 minutes after sitting down to get our drinks and food ordered.   The waitress seemed very stressed and it wasn't even busy at that point.  We had bought wristbands to go swimming and she wasnt the nicest with my 4 year old.who was more excited to go swimming then putting a wristband on.  She looked at me with an attitude and told me here you do it then.  I believe her name was Sandy.

resp.text: Erin, we are so sorry you had this experience at Chico!  We want all of our guests to experience outstanding guest service, and our Poolside Grille team is normally a great example of great service.  We'll work with that team directly to find out what happened.  Thank you for your time!  Please always know you can ask for assistance while you are here, we like to solve any challenges that come our way right on the spot!

name: Becca
text: Great pool, bar and hotel!

resp.text: Thank you, Becca!

name: nautimuskie
text: I love chico. Born and raised in Livingston, I have been going here sense I was four years old. Chico was where I learned to swim, and it is we're both of my boys have learned to swim. We love coming home to visit and hitting Chico!

resp.text: Thank you, nautimuskie!  We love our local friends and stories of their younger years visiting Chico!

name: Jared Page
text: Great place to relax and enjoy an adult beverage with a wonderful staff

resp.text: Thank you, Jared!

name: J T
text: Great spot to relax after hiking in the Park.  Great food and drinks as well.

resp.text: Thank you, JT!

name: Katie Weidenaar
text: We have visited Chico consistently for 20 years. One of my favorite places to relax! It's very nice to see the same staff year after year! Amazing service and awesome venue!!

resp.text: Thank you, Katie!  We are so lucky to have longevity in our staff and our guests!

name: Jon Gfeller
text: Home away from home.

resp.text: Thank you, Jon!

name: Kamala Gibby
text: My husband and I come here every year for the Winter Getaway package. Best dining experience we've ever had. It's like a bit of heaven for us for a couple of days. Highly recommended!

name: Mark Keehr
text: Great food. Plenty of warm water in the pools. Thoroughly enjoyed the band in the bar.

name: Jon Franklin
text: This was my sixth time staying here and as always had a wonderful stay, great hot spring pools, great saloon and one of the best restaurants in Montana. Highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you for being a return guest, Jon!

name: Loren Zahn
text: The food is tops, service is great and always a wonderful experience!  It's a little bit of a drive, but its worth the time and the scenery is beautiful!

resp.text: Thank you, Loren!

name: Cory McGahan
text: Not fun at all.  People shouldn't go here.  It's way too sunny, water is way too great.  The staff isn't wonderful at all.  This place needs to be way less popular.  🤣👍😉  by the way the food wasn't absolutely amazing and to die for....it wasn't one of the best steaks I've ever had🤗.  This once hidden gem is spectacular

resp.text: We love your sense of humor, Cory!  Thank you!  Stop and visit us again someday!

name: Jilla L
text:
The best rack of lamb I have ever had. Possibly one of the best meals I have ever had.
The service was exceptional.
The Writer's Block red wine was a perfect pairing.
A very memorable meal.

name: Joe Sherbon
text: Nice and relaxing. Bar was great

name: National Parks or Bust
text: Great experience. Love the pool and bar

resp.text: Thank you!

name: will it can it should I
text: Prices are high but the water is nice and warm.

resp.text: Thank you for your review, let us know how to turn your 4-stars into 5!

name: susan dolam
text: Rustic, beautiful, good food, great staff.  Hot pools. What is not to love! Quintessential Montana.

resp.text: We agree, what's not to love!  Thank you, Susan!

name: Amy McKinley
text: the bar was so fun and the band was great. good whiskey!

resp.text: Thank you, Amy!

name: Dale Burkhart
text: Very nice place. Come see for yourself. Lots to do.

name: Dan Wood
text: We have been coming here for years now. We love it! Outside temperature was -17 F but we spent hours in there amazing outdoor pools. Rooms are super affordable and cozy. We will continue to come here and enjoy ourselves.

resp.text: Thank you for your continued business, Dan, we appreciate you!

name: Cyrstal Cain
text: Every visit is wonderful, a culinary delight, activities galore. A beautiful place with an awesome staff and just a great getaway! And of course a relaxing soak is a must.

name: Jack McAllister
text: Great place for a weekend getaway or a day soak. Live music on the weekends. Fine and casual dining. Historic atmosphere with modern luxuries.

name: Dave Whisenhunt
text: Genuine Montana. Restaurant normally very good, a little below previous experiences and our expectations this weekend. Wife's prime rib overcooked, but manager personally delivered an acceptable replacement. Halibut special was not that good either. We love this place and will come back, but seems like restaurant kitchen was down a bit from what it used to be? Service was great and as expected. Seemed very busy this time, maybe part of the reason.

name: Brent Wilting
text: So fun for adults. Kids under 6( I think) big pool only. Bar with bands at night. Dining was great. Breakfast buffet with omlet chef+++.

name: Court Harris
text: Hot soaking bliss. Show up at 1000 for the best kids swimming.  Stay late for the party.  Food and drinks are served poolside.  If you want to stay and play lots of outdoor activities, or just chill in the hotel spots.

name: Paul Mabie
text: Such a wonderful historic place.  Great hot springs which fill two pools, one very hot one slightly less.  The pools have a grill and saloon attached.  The saloon offers live music on the weekends.  Great two steeping in Montana!  The restaurant is Fantastic!  The lodge is rustic and historic, but great service.   It is like stepping back in time.  I love it.

name: Denver Brehan
text: The food is excellent. The hot springs and facilities are top notch. Daily lake is just down the road. Highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you, Denver!  Did you do any fishing in Dailey Lake?

name: Gail Plo
text: Always a good time!  Excellent food, cozy rooms, perfect soaking, friendly staff, kid friendly... We LOVE this place!!  Keep up the good work Colin!!  ❤❤😁

name: Rob Webb
text: Great place to unwind and relax a bit, even have your drinks too, if you're into that!

resp.text: Thank you, Rob!

name: Mary Ann DeHaven
text: Fine dining, with signature cocktails to start off a delicious dinner and finished off with Lemoncello creme brulee with white chocolate crumbles and fresh blueberries. Have a wonderful spa treatment and then a warm soak in the pool filled by their own hot spring.

name: Nick Esp
text: Love Chico. One of Montana's gems. Kelby is one of the best bartenders around.

resp.text: We love Kelby!  Thank you, Nick!

name: Elizabeth Zielinski
text: The staff was very accommodating! The food is awesome! My only complaint is that the keys for our room didn't work properly!

resp.text: Thank you, Elizabeth - we'll take a look at those keys!

name: arizona storage innCarrie Fabiano
text: Historic site. Lucky to experience it. Great pool.

resp.text: Thank you, Carrie!  We feel lucky to be the caretakers of this historic beauty!

name: Sabrina Baukol
text: A little off the beaten path but still convenient to get to this hot springs has plenty to offer year round - pool, hiking, horseback riding, dogsledding, fine dining, bar, etc. Fun get away for the adults or perfect family adventure. We live in the general area so for us it's generally a day trip but I have also stayed in a cabin before which was also quite nice. The spa offers massage among other services too....had a great massage here on another visit. Highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you, Sabrina!

name: Marilyn Short
text: Very relaxing. Good price for seniors particularly. Clean.

resp.text: Thank you, Marilyn!

name: Diana S
text: The go-to hot springs for central Montana. It's clean and an overall good experience. It's in the beautiful Paradise Valley. Has an excellent restaurant and bar. Depending on how much you want to pay - there is everything from rooms where you share a bathroom with others to private cabins. There is an excellent spa on location. Gardens and gift shop.

name: The Den of Tools
text: Can a place be fancy and Casual at the same time? Chico seems to somehow manage that. This is a place you can go for a romantic dinner with the wife or take the whole family for an afternoon.

resp.text: Thank you, Red Beard, really appreciate your review!

name: Josh Erickson
text: Fun place for the family. Relaxing.

resp.text: Thank you, Josh!

name: aS.axcory lopez
text: Great place for kids. The kids love the heated pool! No towels so don't forget yours. The restaurant is good especially the pizza and shakes.

name: Judi Treston
text:
Nice quaint little village. We were in a cabin sleeping maybe 10 people. Scenery and wild life was awesome.
Dinner was excellent. Server was great. We had a large party. The individual who cleared the table had a terrible attitude. He was rude.
Breakfast was not great has I heard. Eggs and potatoes were cold. Couldn't eat them. French toast was not replenished until I brought it to servers attention.
The pools were very warm and felt good as the air was very cold. Only drawback you couldn't see a thing in the pool areas. It was rather erie.
The main building is interesting as the bar is.

name: A.J. Rohrer
text: Went to a wedding here. It was fantastic. The field of dreams is beautiful!

resp.text: Thank you, AJ!

name: Stefan Larsson
text: Rude gentlemen  in cafeteria. I happened to park my car with trailer in a spot he did not like. Cane into the grill cafeteria and acted  like a rude bully.  After waiting nearly 1 hr for the pizza we left. I been to chico's many.many times  and had good times but this last visit surely put a bad taste in my mouth.

resp.text: Stefan, I'm sorry you had this experience at Chico!  We do not, however, have a cafeteria?  We do have some parking regulations because of the country road which passes through Chico, and the safety of our neighbors up the road in Old Chico.  We'll certainly share your comments with our team, as you know from previous experiences, our staff is known for great service.  Thank you for sharing so that we can better our service!

name: Dave Smith
text: Reasonable good food relaxation

name: Kelsey Burton
text: Really fun and warm pools, but really crowded!

resp.text: Thank you, Kelsey!  The best time to visit the pool is in the early mornings mid-week!

name: Elliott Keck
text: One of Montana's legendary treasures, does not disappoint.

resp.text: Thank you, Elliott!  Your review makes us smile!

name: William Stamper
text: Not too fancy but very relaxing and all natural. Great stop after exhausting hikes in Yellowstone.

resp.text: Thank you, William!

name: Michael Chambers
text: Great, out of the way place to go to relax. The water is always at the right temperature and the drinks are good. Many options for food from fine dining to bar fare. You have to visit at least once.

name: Daniel&Kari Francisco
text: Great place with live music. It could use a remodel

resp.text: Thank you, Daniel!  We are making updates all the time while trying to hold onto the historic nature of the property!

name: kade estill
text: 8$ soaks. Towels for rent available. 2 pools range about 96-100 degree. More like a warm bath. But it's old rustic charming atmosphere is pleasant

name: Robert Houssian
text: As always, great!!

resp.text: Thank you, Robert!

name: Steven R. Schmidt
text: Warm water on any cold day!

resp.text: Thank you, Steven, the hot springs are great on these cold snowy days!

name: Patty Barnes
text: Water is natural, food is great?

name: Miranda G
text: This is a fantastic getaway for even 1 night. Relax in the healing hot springs, have fun at the bar, and enjoy a world class meal. All at this unassuming little place tucked away in the mountains. Call early for reservations, they book up quick!

resp.text: Thank you, Miranda, come see us again!

name: Amy Green
text: Great time with the family soaking in the hot springs. Had a great lunch(pizza) as well!

resp.text: Thank you, Amy.

name: Ashley Schneider
text: Every time I visit, it's an amazing experience.  The whole place has a feel that you can't get anywhere else.  Make sure to make reservations at the restaurant, and if you can...don't miss Sunday morning brunch.  It will change your life!

name: Maggie Mynier
text: We love Chico. Great food, great fun, great price.

resp.text: Thank you, Maggie!

name: Laura Drager
text: Great place to get away. Fine dining, relaxing environment and friendly staff. You won't be disappointed.

name: Loren Mccauley
text: Such a great place! Great environment, great food and great hospitality

name: Mary McConnell
text: Lots of people, the water wasn't as hot as we wanted but still nice. The dinner was amazing, and the service was phenomenal

resp.text: Thank you, Mary!

name: Lyndsi Huck
text: This place is amazing! From the food to the bar and the relaxing pools! My boyfriend and i love it!

name: gottsdamn
text: I loved staying here, my only issue was that I cut my hand on the metal blinds on the outside door while turning the door knob. Kind of my fault, but the blinds were sharp and unusually close to the door knob. I'd be happy to come back.

resp.text: Perry, Thank you for your review!  So sorry to hear about the metal blind and cut hand, hope it healed up quickly!  We're actually replacing all of the Lower Lodge blinds with non-metal blinds during the month of November, it's just time for new ones throughout the building.  We'll look forward to seeing you again!

name: Patty Houston
text: Best part of my entire trip. Would definitely recommend this to anyone with thoughts of coming here.

resp.text: Thank you, Patty!

name: RaeannaCody Griffis
text: Chico is one of my family's favorite places to spend the day. The water is awesome and hot and refreshing at the same time as being relaxing the staff is very friendly and the poolside grill has some of the BEST food in the area. Everything we have tried at the grill is delicious but the BBQ Bison Pizza with pickled red onions is AMAZING!

resp.text: Thank you, CodynRaeanna!  The BBQ pizza is new this season, happy to hear you enjoyed it!

resp.text: Thank you, Jack!

name: Times Chu
text:
The nicest hot spring resort in the Bearpaw Mountains. Clean and fresh hot water fills a large pool, which is overlooked by a beautiful mountain view. In the evening, the restaurant serves fantastic steaks and game, finished off by decadent desserts, my favorite of which is the flaming orange peel fill with ice cream and chocolate.

If you decide to stay, be sure to request a room in the original building. The historic ad unique rooms more than make up for any modern amenities lost.

name: Will

resp.text: William, early mornings are the best!  Thank you!

resp.text: Thank you, Mark, really appreciate you taking the time to write this!

name: Lisa Savard

resp.text: Thank you, Lisa!  It's my happy place too!

name: John
text: Rooms are sub par.  Always hot and communal bathrooms.  Someday they will upgrade them hopefully.  But;  the bar is great,  the restaurant is incredible and the water is hot.

resp.text: Hi John, thank you for your review and comments regarding many aspects of the resort.  We do have many more modern lodging options on the property - our Fisherman's Lodge, Lower Lodge, Warren Wing, and all of our houses and cabins all have full in-room bathroom facilities.  Some of the suites also have air conditioning, although most of our rooms do not.  Be sure to ask about some of our other lodging options the next time you visit!  Thank you again!

text: One of my favorite hot springs to go too! Been coming here since I was a kid. Very relaxing & great food too!

resp.text: Thank you, Kasey, keep coming back!

name: Sandy Dickey
text: Always excellent, just beginning my stay and I'm so excited as usual.  I am sure it will be wonderful.  Thank you Colin and staff!

name: Mach1joe Cope
text: Pool was cool. Hot pool was warm. Coldest I have ever seen them.

resp.text: Hi Joe, we do mix in some cold spring water in the summer months as the pools tend to just be "too hot" for the average summer soak.  It's a challenge when the weather changes and we have a cool or overcast day.....and some folks just prefer it to be hot like it is in the winter!

name: Doug Franks
text: Great place to stop on the way out of the park .

name: Alex
text: Its honestly just a heated pool.  They pump it up like its something more.  It's not worth the price.

resp.text: Hi Alex, actually it's a natural hot spring pool!  We don't provide any heat source to the water, it comes out of the earth on our property at up to 112* Fahrenheit and is directed to our two pools which average 104* in the small pool and 98* in the large pool.  Temperatures can and do fluctuate throughout the years/months/days.  Sorry you didn't enjoy your stop here and hope you found many of the other great places to enjoy in our area.

name: John Mason
text:
A medium three. If you want something more individual and more Montana, go to Symes.

This place clearly caters tourists with money to throw around, overcharging for sugary, watered-down drinks.

They've warmed up the water to an acceptable hot springs experience since the last time I visited. Your experience is limited to one smaller hot pool, and one larger warm pool; there are no separate adult areas, without loud kids, and the way the pools are both in the same courtyard, it is extremely loud; not peaceful.

Overall, disappointed. The drive in from the north is amazing. The destination though is a tepid, courtyard open pool. Overpriced, weak bar drinks, and overall mediocre, showing the owners have a complete lack of imagination.

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to comment, John.  Mother Nature dictates our hot springs temperature, which runs about 96 in the large pool and 103 in the smaller pool.  The best time to visit for a quieter experience is during the weekday mornings, the evenings are busier and the weekends are the busiest.  Our entire property is in fact kid/family friendly - with the exception of the Saloon after 8:00 PM.  Sorry we were not able to meet your expectations during your visit.

name: Theresa Colvin
text: Great atmosphere soaking. Friendly bartender, tasty bevs, and not too busy! Perfect way to ring in my first evening of vacation!! 🙌🏼🌟🌟🌟

resp.text: Wow!  Thank you, Theresa!

name: Jack Scherman
text: Fun bar experience with a good selection of montana beers.  Enjoyed the free wifi as cell service is poor to unavailable here.  The hotsprings are nice and large enough to have your own space.  The restaurant is separate from the bar and has good food.  Offers a little of everything to please all members of a group.

name: Monica Latham
text: Awesome drive to hot springs. Hotel is old but unique. Pool could use some updates.

name: Stephanie U
text: I have kind of "warmed up" to Chico over the past several years. They have a nice, scenic location. Their 2 pools are very family friendly and I like that they have pool-side bar service. The dressing rooms are ok, the water that comes out of the showers is pretty cold. The hot tub is large and great for ADULTS. The one thing that gets to me is that parents let their kids splash and play in the hot tub. I understand this is not Chico's fault but it gets annoying and disrupts the relaxation. Expect a lot of people, especially if you visit in the afternoon.

resp.text: Stephanie, thank you for taking the time to write!  If you live nearby, try coming to soak in the early morning - or even better yet during the weekday in the winter months!  Those locker room showers have been challenging, but I think our guys have got it this time.

resp.text: Thank you, Mike!

The grill has good affordable options while the fancy restaurant has amazing food for gourmet prices. The gift shop has lots of unique choices not just standard junky gift shop stuff. You can choose to spend a lot or a little here. WiFi was included but slow.

name: Julia Maguire
text: The hotspring is more of a warm public pool than anything - and although the hotel is nestled in the mountains there are no views from the pool! (Which seemed like a major design fail to me, but oh well.) The trip from our room to the hotspring was COLD COLD COLD but that's probably unavoidable I suppose...still, I thought they might have provided robes or slippers or larger towels or something for hotel guests. We had a fun romantic weekend here with dinner at the hotel restaurant and plenty of time spent playing shuffleboard in the dive-y poolside bar. Fun live music. The rooms were nothing to write home about - small and drafty - but thank goodness we opted for the private bathroom instead of the communal ones in the hallway. Definitely not the height of luxury, but we had a good time!

name: Lonny Mayo
text: Great old go to but, could use some updating.

name: Emma Laatsch
text: They treated me like I was a thief when I tried to reclaim my own forgotten swim gear (who would want to steal used swim gear?!).  The saloon is nice though.

resp.text: Hi Emma, we’d like to hear more about this to better understand the situation.  Was your suit in our lost and found or another location?  What department did you deal with?  Do you remember the employee’s name?  Please give us a call at 406-333-4933 and ask for the hotel manager!  We have hundreds of lost and found items move through a month, all handled with a great amount of professionalism!  We love matching lost items with their rightful owners, especially since storing those items takes up a lot of space!

Be aware that there is a huge difference in the quality of the rooms depending on which lodge you stay in.  The last time we stayed in the main (historical) lodge, the temperature in the room dropped well below freezing at night.

resp.text: Thank you for your review, Joseph!  You're right, we have a wide selection of lodging.  Sorry to hear about the room being so cold - normally the Main Lodge rooms are quite toasty!

name: Danielle Carlson
text: I love this place, but beware the poolside grill. The spa and pools itself are great, but you will definitely get obnoxious children (and adults!) during summer rushes. They sell pool toys at the grill, and more than once unsuspecting people were hit by toys or had their drinks spilled by rude children followed by rude, uncaring parents. Pretty typical for a public pool space. So, dont expect to be relaxed in the pools. The water, however, is heavely! The poolside grill has good food, but the people who work there really detract from it. Workplace drama is like a theatrical show there. Each time my husband and I went there, we basically got to catch up on all the stupid drama between the workers, and got to see them have drama right at the tables. One time there was telling across the small restaurant and a waitress rolling her eyes and yawning at our table while taking our orders. It's suuuuuper awkward and I don't think we would eat there again after giving it 2 tries.

resp.text: Hi Danielle, thank you for taking the time to write a review.  I'm so sorry the actions of other guests (children and parents) negatively affected your time in the pool....I do love the weekday mornings in the pool as they are normally much quieter and relaxing!  We also have pool attendants and/or security staff on duty while the pool is open, be sure to ask for their assistance if needed as the area should be enjoyable for everyone.  Thank you also for your comments about the Grille.  We've had some healthy staff changes there recently, and will continue to work with that team - no one wants to be in the middle of someone else's drama - especially as a paying customer!  It's really embarrassing to us that you had this experience, and we will make improvements!

name: Dean Phillips

Come when there is snow on the ground and venture out to the large pool that is open to the outside, but protected from the wind, or sit in the hot pool which has a bar to serve you while in the pool area. Options for dining as well. Family friendly and tons of fun!

resp.text: Thank you for your kind comments Mik'haela.  We also have rafting in the summer months and dog sledding in the winter months!  We offer 110 different guest accommodations, a few of the Main Lodge rooms do not have bathrooms, and do share with others on the same floor - but there are multiple bathrooms per floor, I've never heard of someone having to wait or not being able to find an open shower / toilet.

name: Simple Science
text:
This is fed by a hot spring but it's not the steamy pool u would expect.

I got there in the evening and I wasted 8 bucks here. It's just warm and not even that clean.

If u want to come here u should check the pool before u pay.

resp.text: Dear Simple, I'm so sorry our hot springs pools did not meet your expectations.  Our pool temperatures are pretty consistent, although the air temperature can have an effect on them, or at least how they feel.  Our hot springs pools average a temperature of 96 in the large pool, and 103 in the smaller pool.  Our pools are drained and cleaned on a nightly basis, and we have pool attendants who work to keep the area clean throughout the day.

text: Gross pool, broken water system made it too hot to swim anyway. Mediocre hotel.

resp.text: Kelly,  sorry to hear you did not enjoy your visit to Chico Hot Springs.  I'm concerned about your comments as our pool is drained and cleaned nightly.   I'm also confused by your comment of "broken water system" - our hot springs pools are filled with natural hot spring water, just as it comes out of the earth - there is not a "water system" to control the temperature of the pools.  As far as lodging - we have 110 different guest accommodations - from basic rooms in our 117 year-old Main Lodge to luxury suites and cabins across the property.

name: Dave Voice of NH
text:
Great location, all facilities. Also nice layout for getting in and out with big rig. The KOA is next to a river with a great paved walkway, good for walking your dog(s) and bike riding. Also next door to the Chamber of Commerce, who has lots of info and maps for what you might want to do. Take the trolley around town to get an idea of the area. It's a hundred steps from your campsite.

I'm very pleased with this KOA, including the great people at the front desk - very helpful.

name: Micaela Hoag
text: Kamping Kabin was a great place to stay to get out of the rain. The owner was very nice at check in and their little store had a good selection. The new shower complex is great.

name: John Brown
text: Great helpful staff members the tent spot was ok. We had no fire ring so we had to eat cold food for dinner. Pool was open and clean. Amazing bath and showers. They were private so the wife and i could use one together. Shower were very clean un up dated Amazing rain shower head. The spot was a bit load but to traffic on highway but quite at night. Highly recommend foe a quick over night stay.

text: Overall, an average and acceptable KOA. Our site was not ideal for our vehicle, which made getting the trailer level difficult, and complicated hook up. We told office staff that upon check out and were told "yes, we know. You shouldn't have been given that site." Thanks a lot!  Water turn-on knob too close to stake; hard to turn. name: Wade Hampton
text:
Wife and I have stayed at several KOA Kampgrounds over the last 8-9 years, from Utah to Washington, Idaho, and Montana.
It is true that the Butte KOA is different from most others we've experienced.
We have not found the differences to be disturbing or unappealing, just different.
The staff have been very kind and helpful with our transition to being Butte residents, and have gone out of their way in anything we've asked of them.
Butte, Montana is a different kind of town.  Therefore, different rules apply here.  That is a fact.
We are happy here until we finally move out to some other place, but for now, it's our little home.  We like it.

name: Rich Field
text: This was a different kind of a place, a Superfund site turned into a tourist attraction.  The history is that it became more economical to strip mine versus underground mine.  The mine was closed and the water that had been pumped was stopped.  The pit filled from the surrounding mines and the water is toxic.  There are air cannons and other noise makers that scare off birds that go off on an irregular basis.  There is good news...the water is being cleaned and reclaimed and is being used in an adjacent mining operation and the plan is to return the water to a pristine state and reactivate the creek that has been diverted.
