text: This Lemon Poppy Seed Cake was yummy! My salad w quinoa and 🍤 was phenomenal.  I wish the potatoes on the breckie we're cubed smaller.  Other than that I'm happy!

resp.text: Thank you so much for the kind review Diana! We're so glad to hear that you enjoyed your meal, and thanks for the feedback on the potatoes - we always like to hear how things could have been better.

name: Bayard L
text:
The food has always been stellar here from day one.

Trying the lake trout sandwich for lunch was one of the best casual meals I've had in Bozeman.

The prices for their delicious flavors and unique dishes are fair and match up with other similar offerings in Bozeman.

The freshly made homestyle potato chips will have you wishing they were available to take home to the pantry.

resp.text: Thanks Bayard! We love that you love our food!

name: Karl Beck
text: The food was ok at best, I got chicken strips that were overdone, the house made ranch was very thin and tasted nothing like ranch.  Asked for ketchup and it took about 10 minutes to come back to the table.  Way overpriced for the amount of food you get.  Asked for the check and had to wait at least 5 minutes to get it and another 10 to get the card back and sign for the tab.  Maybe it was just an off day or something but I was not impressed.

resp.text:
Hi Karl,
I'm really sorry to hear that your visit to Lot G was disappointing! It does sound like you may have hit us on an off day because that is not the way we want our food or our service to be. We really appreciate the feedback and I will pass this on to our manager so she can follow up with her team and figure out what happened.

name: Gaby Hidde
text: Fresh, delicious food and tea. Excellent service. I'm always happy to return to Lot G for breakfast or lunch.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the stellar review Gaby! I'm delighted to hear that you have enjoyed your visits to Lot G. Good tea can be hard to find and I'm so happy to hear that you enjoy ours. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Thom Hughes
text: Amazing breakfasts!  Crispy fried polenta with sausage gravy and fried chicken all gluten free.

resp.text: Thank you so much!

name: Tim Dolan
text: Had the Healthy Salad. The toasted almonds gave crunch and flavor. Filled me up. My associate liked the fish tacos. Good space to talk and rat.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the review Tim! We really appreciate it and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Mitchell Meyer
text: The atmosphere of the restaurant was nice if you are into the "hip" Bozeman scene (VERY fitting for the Cannery) but the food was definitely lacking in flavor, which is something everyone at our table agreed on. As far as service goes, it seems like they should have more servers, or at least servers who can attend to all their tables. Our "bottomless" coffee was left empty and only refilled once, and the same goes with the water. It might be cute to put the water in wine bottles but it is definitely not enough for four people ESPECIALLY if it is not going to be refilled. Overall, pretty much what you can expect from the new "hip" places in Bozeman. Maybe next time I'll just go to McDonald's.

resp.text:
Hi Mitchell,
I'm very sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy your visit to Lot G and I appreciate the feedback about the food lacking flavor and the service not measuring up. We definitely want coffee and water to be refilled as needed and I'm sorry to hear that didn't happen for you. We use reviews as an opportunity to improve what we do and I will pass this on to our manager to make sure our staff is clear on expectations about revisiting tables. I hope you'll give us another chance to show you that we can provide great food and great service.

name: Diane Cole
text: Very over cooked deep fried food. I could hardly eat my fish and chips they where so over cooked. My friends salad looked really fabulouse.

resp.text:
Hi Diana,
I am so sorry to hear that your food was overcooked! That is definitely not the way we train people to cook that dish and I apologize on behalf of our entire team. I appreciate your bringing this to our attention so we can address with the staff and make sure it doesn't happen again. I very much hope you'll be able to come in again so we can show you that we do know how to cook a good fish and chips.

name: Rick Varnum
text: Delicious food in a peaceful cafe atmosphere. It's a great place to relax by yourself or to bring a date.

resp.text: Thank you so much Rick! That is really wonderful to hear and we appreciate your taking the time to leave a review. We look forward to see you (and a date?) soon.

name: David Brownlee
text: Food is all gluten free and even more importantly very tasty. The sausage gravy, in my humble opinion, is the best in Bozeman. The service is always friendly and prompt.

resp.text: Yay! That is music to our ears because it is exactly what our mission was when we opened Lot G. There's so much delicious food out there that can be made gluten free, including sausage gravy! Thank you so much for your business and for taking the time to leave such a nice review. We hope to see you again soon - we'll keep some sausage gravy warm for you!

name: Paul Manning
text: Good food, way extra trendy if you're into that sort of thing. Not great service but adequate. I'm not saying it's bad but kinda has a California well to do vibe...

resp.text:
Hi Paul,
I'm so sorry to hear that you weren't overly impressed by your experience at Lot G. I'm glad to hear that you enjoyed the food and I appreciate the feedback about the service - I will pass that on to our manager so she can follow up with staff to make sure we're doing everything right.

name: Mark C
text:
Yummy, healthy, friendly, good atmosphere, totally gluten free. (Warning: no longer gluten free, see edit.)

EDIT: Sadly they have made the decision to stop being totally gluten free. I'm sure it's still tasty, but disappointing to lose a safe place to eat. We just barely noticed this before placing a takeout order - they need a warning on the website about this change.

resp.text: Thank you Mark! That is wonderful to hear! We really appreciate the review and your visit!

name: Jessie May Campbell
text: What a treat to dine at Lot G, I don't have to think twice about what I'm ordering, the entire menu consists of gluten free delicacies. The ebelskivers are simply divine.

resp.text: Thank you so much Jessie May! That is so wonderful to hear - and it's exactly why we opened Lot G. Pretty sure we also need a fanclub just for those ebelskivers! We really appreciate your dining with us and taking the time to leave such a nice review. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Chad Watkins
text: Good food.  Personable staff.  Food came out quick.

resp.text: Hi Chad - that's wonderful to hear! Thank you so much for your nice review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Taylor Stults
text: Small space with limited seating makes for a tough time finding a spot to sit down. Great place to go for lunch if you need something quick on your break. The food is delicious! Lots of variety from chicken strips to salads and noodle bowls for any kind of personal taste. Worth a try! I know well be back for sure.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Taylor! We are working hard to figure out a solution to the seating issue so stay tuned. And thankfully soon it will be warm enough to eat outside on the patio!

name: B Michaels
text: You know that feeling when you eat somewhere for the first time and get a gut sense you’ll be back there a lot?... happened today at Lot G Cafe : )

resp.text: Yes! And yay! So happy to hear that! Thank you so much for the nice review - we'll see you soon!

name: Martha Colby
text: Love Lot G! If you have a gluten intolerance, this is the place to go! Even if you don't have one, the food is delicious and service is great.

resp.text: Thank you Martha! That is truly wonderful to hear because that is exactly what we are trying to do - to create gluten free food that doesn't sacrifice flavor or quality. It makes us so happy to hear that we are achieving that goal. Thank you so much for the nice review and hope to see you again soon!

name: Sarah Lilly
text: I like they had a lot of southern food that I really miss back home like grits and shrimp and biscuits and gravy and grits was a little different than I'm used to but was still good

resp.text: That is so nice to hear Sarah! I'm really happy that you liked our take on those Southern classics. We are so grateful for your review and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Lee Elder
text: Went here for brunch with some friends. Everyone enjoyed their food. I had the chicken fried steak which was really good. It's a pretty hip joint in an up and coming area of Bozeman

resp.text: Thank you Lee! We're so glad to hear that you and your friends enjoyed their visit and we appreciate your taking the time to leave a review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Michelle Dammen
text: Super cute little place and food was really good! I wanted to try everything on the menu which is rare for me!

resp.text: Hooray! We love hearing that! Thank you so much for coming in and for taking the time to leave such a nice review!

name: The Cliff Scarber Experience
text: Amazing breakfast! Great service and amazing food

resp.text: Yay! Thank you so much Cliff! That's so lovely to hear and we really appreciate your leaving such a nice review - they help us a lot. We hope to see again soon!

name: Ashton Ferruzzi
text: Great. My wife has celiac. Best and most reasonable.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the nice review Ashton! Our goal in creating Lot G was to create a gluten free restaurant where both people with celiac and the people who love them could eat safely and enjoyably, without sacrificing flavor. It's wonderful to hear that we succeeded! We appreciate your business and your review and hope to see you again soon!

name: Sandra
text: Table of 8. Hour wait to get food. 4 orders that were in the deep fat fryer came out burnt.  Soup and tacos were a safe bet. Disappointing since not that many gluten free options in Bozeman.

resp.text:
Hi Sandra,
I am so sorry to hear that you had a bad experience at Lot G! I assure you that is not the kind of service or food that we try so hard to provide and that must have been really disappointing. I really appreciate your letting us know so we can follow up with our team while it's fresh. I will reach out to our manager right now and see what happened, so we can make sure it doesn't happen again. I hope you will consider giving us another chance to show you that we can do better. Thanks again for letting us know so we can fix it.

name: Chris Blake
text: A gluten free establishment that doesn't promote itself as such with Costco meats and juices sold at boutique prices.  Come clean y'all and folks would probably love you.  Food is usually cooked well, if they remember to actually fulfill your order and no one accidentally takes your food when it is called which seems to happen every time I'm there because they just call out a first name instead of a number or something so no one really knows what is theirs or not.  Avoid pancake lasagna, its an unsavory abomination.  Do try the danish pancakes.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback - we do read and take to heart what people say here. We are working hard to figure out solutions to the ordering issues - you are not the only one to experience that and as a new restaurant we have had some growing pains. Regarding ingredients, we try to always ride a balance between locally sourced and organic ingredients and the best quality and price we can find, and sometimes that means kale grown here in Bozeman and other times it is products from Costco. It's a  constant juggle to provide the best tasting food at prices that allow us to stay in business. Thanks again for the feedback and we hope you'll give another shot.

name: Thomas Lutey
text: Good breakfast spot. Shrimp and Grits are a favorite.

resp.text: Thank you so much Thomas! I'm delighted to hear that the Shrimps and Grits are your favorite - they have their own fan club! We really appreciate the review and look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Rachelle Cowart
text: I have Celiac, so I was very pleased to discover they have an entire gluten free menu!! The chicken fried steak was to die for, and I cannot wait to come back to try other menu items.

resp.text: Hooray! That makes us so happy to hear that! You have a whole menu of delights waiting for you. I highly recommend the fried chicken as well. See you again soon!

name: Gregory L.
text: The food is always so good. These folks run some great restaurants.

resp.text: Thank you so much! Hearing that makes us so happy. We appreciate the nice review and your visit!

name: Chris Smith
text: Great food. All gluten free.

resp.text: Thank you Chris! We appreciate the nice review!

name: Jack McAllister
text: Never disappointed. Great food and service. Good selection of breakfast foods and salads.

resp.text: Thank you Jack! That is so wonderful to hear. We very much appreciate your regular visits and the nice review!

name: Marcelle Shyne
text: The wait staff were friendly and tried hard. The salads looked good. Many orders were burned.

resp.text:
Hi Marcelle,
I am so sorry to hear that your food was burned! That is most definitely not the way we want food to be coming out of the kitchen and I really appreciate you letting us know so we can talk to our kitchen crew and figure out what went wrong with your meal. I hope you will come back again so we can serve you a much better meal. Thanks again for letting us know so we can make sure it doesn’t happen again.

name: ad M
text: Finally, found a restaurant in Bozeman where I can get delicious food, without having to eat meat! I ordered a lemon curd parfait and a curry bowl, both were delicious. I'm so glad I found this place! Will definitely be back

resp.text: That is so great to hear Aditi! Our goal is to provide yummy food to everyone, no matter what they can or can't eat, and it's always lovely to hear when that works. Hope to see you again soon!

name: Brett Loomis
text: Nice place. Not too crowded on weekend.

resp.text: Thanks so much Brett! We're so glad to hear that you enjoyed your visit this weekend!

name: Shea Bette
text: Tried this for the first time, loved it. Different food combinations. Helpful staff,  very clean

resp.text: Thank you Shea! We're so glad you tried us out and that you enjoyed your experience! Thanks so much for taking the time to leave such a nice review.

name: Marlena Burton
text: Ambiance is nice. I had a very expensive kale salad.   Literally whole kale leaves on a plate. Disappointing. Banana curry was bland, unremarkable.

resp.text: Hi Marlena, I am so so sorry to hear that your experience at Lot G was disappointing! We are currently revamping our menu and both of those dishes will be tweaked, so your feedback is timely and helpful. I apologize on behalf of all of us for the disappointing meal. We very much hope you'll give us another shot in a few weeks when we've revamped the menu and dialed things in.

name: Vincent Stephan
text: Overdone breakfast food. It's what I expected. Service was great and all. Just not my kind of breakfast place. If you're looking for big portions and the usual bacon and eggs, don't go here.

resp.text:
Hi Vincent,
I am so sorry to hear that you didn’t enjoy your experience with us. We try to offer options for different tastes and appetites but totally understand if our menu just wasn’t to your liking. We appreciate your coming in and giving us a try.

name: Akyra Moto
text: Great food every visit, relaxed atmosphere, great service.  One of my favorite places to eat.

resp.text: Thank you Akyra! That is really lovely to hear. We so appreciate your visits and your nice review!

name: Rio Gonzalez McCord
text: The æbleskivers are unbelievably delicious! They come with a lemon curd that is just phenomenal!

resp.text: Thank you Rio!

name: William Donaldson
text: Great food. Reasonable prices, and good cozy ambiance.

resp.text: Thank you William, that's wonderful to hear and we very much appreciate your taking the time to leave such a nice review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Only Nate
text: This is one of my favorite places to eat in Bozeman.  Amazing food and atmosphere. Gluten Free Fish and Chips!!! I like the casual atmosphere but it can be difficult to find a seat.

resp.text: Thank you so much Nathan. I cried the first time I was able to eat gluten free fish and chips in 15 years! We are working on expanding our seating area so stay tuned - we know it can be frustrating.

name: Priscilla Chamberlin
text:
We tried for breakfast.Was good,but first issue was there is no prominent sign out front identifying the restaurant so we drove in and out Canary several times before seeing the small prop sign on sidewalk out front.Pancake lasagna was delicious,need more classic tastes like that to satisfy us older folks.Husband had chicken fried steak,steak quality could be better had lots of grissel.Coffee was great!
.

resp.text:
Hi Priscilla,
Thank you so much for the feedback. We're very sorry to hear that you didn't see our signage. That's frustrating when you're hungry for breakfast. We appreciate the feedback on the menu and the steak - I'm so sorry to hear that your husband's steak wasn't top notch, but glad to hear that the pancake lasagna and coffee were winners! We hope you'll give us another visit sometime.

name: My Bowtie
text: It's surprising that everything is gluten free because it tastes so good.

resp.text: Thank you so much Maureen! That's wonderful to hear. Our goal is to make food that is both delicious and gluten free so that everyone can enjoy eating here. It's nice to hear that we are accomplishing that!

name: Amy W
text: Great food, coffee, and service! Unique space, great vibe.

resp.text: Thank you so much Amy! You ticked all the boxes on what we are trying to achieve, which is wonderful to hear. We appreciate your coming and and taking the time to leave a review!

name: Kris King
text: High quality food, super tasty, great coffee.

resp.text: Thank you so much Kris! That is really wonderful to hear and we appreciate the review.

name: Steven Tveter
text: Second time here and the food was as good as the first time. Really nice place. Was surprised by the pancake lasagna, that doesn't sound good at all but was tasty!

resp.text: Thank you so much for coming in and for the nice review! That pancake lasagna gets everyone - such a good invention on the part of our chef!

name: Chris Ballinger
text: Always great food, love the atmosphere!

resp.text: Thank you so much Chris! That is really wonderful to hear. We appreciate your visits and your review!

name: Grant Pearson
text: Great, unique food, friendly staff!

resp.text: Thank you so much Grant! Hearing that makes us so happy. We really appreciate your visiting Lot G and taking the time to leave a nice review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Peter Costanti
text: A new gem for breakfast and lunch in Bozeman.  Great food.  Great people.  Great location.  I'm a fish and chips guy and they nail it!  Highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you so much Peter! That is so great to hear!

name: Tristin Fleetwood
text: Was not at all what I was expecting. So much better than what I gathered from their online menu. The food was delicious and their portion size was spectacular!

resp.text: That's great to hear - thank you so much for the review Tristin!

name: Wynona Larsen
text: Had to wait 8 minutes for someone to acknowledge us waiting outside the door, another 6 minutes to be seated. Food was way over priced for burnt and greasy, I won't be going back.

resp.text:
Hi Wynona,
I am so sorry to hear that and I apologize on behalf of our entire team! There is no excuse for a long wait or burnt greasy food and I really appreciate your letting us know. That is definitely not the kind of service or food that we work hard to deliver and I will follow up with our staff to make sure that it doesn’t happen again. I hope you’ll give us another chance to do better.

name: Jeffrey Stevens
text: Nice little cafe. Was when we lived here.

resp.text:
Hi Jeffrey-
I’m sorry to see that your visit to Lot G didn’t earn more than three stars. We’d love to hear any feedback you’d care to share about your experience so we can work to make it better. You can email us at hey@lotgcafe.com with anything like us to know. Thank you!

name: Tim Cherwin
text: The food is well made and delicious,  large variety.

resp.text: Thank you so much Tim! That is fantastic to hear and we appreciate the review!

name: Alex Nordlund
text: Top 5 best meals I've had out since discovering I have celiac. Brussel bowl rocks. Great staff and service!

resp.text:
Hi Alex,
That is so awesome to hear! We love getting to feed people who can't always enjoy everything on the menu - that's a big part of why we created Lot G. We really appreciate your taking the time to leave a review, and hope to see you again soon!

name: Fay Wing
text: I had heard great things from many people,  but I was very disappointed.  There was also a child with us that wanted just a plain salad and that was a little hard to get. The chicken and chips we ordered was well over done, we couldn't even eat it all it was so hard.  I want to give you a second chance but I'm not sure.  A little pricey to be disappointed.

resp.text: Thank you for your candid feedback Fay. We really appreciate hearing it, although that is certainly not how we would hope your experience would have been at our restaurant. We take reviews like yours very seriously and bring them back to our staff as an opportunity to learn and improve. We do serve a salad that is simply greens and vegetables but it sounds like that wasn't communicated to you. And there is absolutely no excuse for overcooked, inedible chicken and chips. We sincerely hope that you will give us one more chance to do better next time, as I know we can. Thanks again for the feedback.

name: Jason Marble
text: Breakfast was awesome! Will definitely be back next time I'm in Bozeman.

resp.text: Thank you Jason! That is so great to hear! See you again soon, I hope!

name: Cole Robertson
text: Great Food.  Urban atmosphere

resp.text: Thank you Cole! We appreciate your five star review very much!

name: David Lewis
text: Great food. Service took forever and the loud, raucous music destroyed the atmosphere for a family meal. Would never go back for a sit-dwon family meal, but a great place to order take out to eliminate the wait.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the honest feedback David, and apologies for taking so long to respond. We are working hard to find a solution to the noise and space issues inherent in the space, and we hope you'll give us another chance. When it's warm enough to sit outside on the patio that can be a lovely spot to dine.

name: Sam Viall
text: A little over priced; I felt like you're paying for what they are trying to do and not what you get. Every dish is a little to fancy at the cost of a little quality.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Sam. That's definitely not how we want our food to come across and we go the extra mile to bring in quality ingredients and prepare them well. But we do take these reviews to heart and I will pass it on to our kitchen staff.

name: Michelle Breen
text: Didn't know what to expect but figured it out. Before you get the register know your food order. The grits and sausage gravy...delicious. It gets busy but they do have optional seating areas.

resp.text: Thank you for the nice review Michelle! We're working on ideas for expanding to provide more seating so stay tuned.

name: Lucy Coley
text: Tasty food. Great atmosphere. Limited seating.

resp.text: Thank you for the feedback Lucy! Were you able to sit in our newly expanded dining room?

name: Mike Hume
text: Was always at the top of our list, but now that they cook only with soy oil my wife can't eat anything they fix. Our last visit was our last visit.

resp.text: Hello Mike, I very sorry to hear this especially because it is just not true. The only things that contain soy oil currently are our muffins. Everything else is cooked with canola, corn, or olive oil and clarified butter. So your wife should be able to eat almost everything we serve except the muffins and a few dishes that clearly contain tofu or soy sauce. I apologize for the fact that you were given the wrong information - which must have been extremely disappointing and frustrating for you both! My guess is that you may have spoken with a new employee who was misinformed and so this is a good opportunity for us to circle back with all of our staff and make sure they have current and correct information. I very much hope that you will give us another chance to put us back at the top of your list.

name: John
text: Great gravy.  The crispy polenta and fried chicken is Dynamite.  Everything else is fairly average

resp.text: Hi John, I'm sorry to hear that we didn't rate higher this time around despite the fried chicken and gravy. We really do read every review and take all feedback seriously. If there's anything you'd care to share about your experience, or what could have made it better, we'd love to hear it. You can email us at hey@lotgcafe.com .

name: Malikai Caputo
text: Good food, not enough seating, can't really blame them though

resp.text: Thank you for the nice vreview Malikai. We're working on the seating issue - stay tuned for exciting news in the fall!

name: Gretchen Sultzer
text: Food was great.  Nice change.  Service was great.  Nice staff.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Gretchen! We really appreciate it.

name: Phaedra Nielson
text: Great coffee, so/so food

resp.text: Hi Phaedra, I'm very sorry to hear that you weren't impressed by your meal with us. We'd love to hear more about what you ordered and what was disappointing about it, if you'd care to share any further information with us. You can email us at hey@lotgcafe.com - and I hope you'll give us another opportunity to provide you with a more satisfactory meal to go with the coffee you enjoyed.

name: Scott Lundberg
text: Cozy restaurant for quick breakfast or lunch.  Fantastic food and quick service.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the nice review Scott! We really appreciate it.

name: Todd Green
text: Best breakfast I've ever had.

resp.text: Hooray!!!! That is so great to hear! Thank you so much for coming in to dine with us and for the stellar review. We appreciate it!

name: Chris Bredberg
text: Very good food and great service too!

resp.text: Thank you Chris!

name: Felicia Hamilton
text:
Love the savory dishes.

*edit one year later. They've made alot of  changes and I'm not a fan. 45 minutes after we sat down, nobody came by so we had to refill our coffee. I asked for extra aioli on the side and they "just put it on top for me".... not the point. And the food wasn't as good, aioli shouldn't taste like mayonnaise. Bummer.

resp.text:
Hi Felicia,
I am so sorry to hear that your return visit was not as good as your first! We have made a lot of changes in an effort to improve what we do, but it sounds like you did not experience any of that. I am very sorry to hear that your server was not more attentive and that your food didn't taste as good. This is all excellent feedback that I will pass on to our management team so we can make sure it doesn't happen again. I truly hope you'll give us a third try to prove that your first experience, not your second, is representative of what we do here at Lot G.

name: Rachel Turner
text: Came for breakfast, it was mediocre and bland. Polenta cakes were underseasoned, eggs oily, "specialty" sausage was not house made, I could pick it up at Costco. My almond milk latte was well made, and the service was friendly and welcoming. All in all, not a bad visit, but I'm not excited about returning.

resp.text: Thank you so much for taking the time to leave an honest review Rachel. We appreciate it and take it all back to our team as an opportunity to improve. None of those notes sound like how we aim to serve our food, and we hope you'll give us another chance to do better.

name: Marina Schreckengost
text: Ridiculously amazing, 100% gluten free food! Not having to worry about the risk of cross contamination,  for those of us with celiac disease,  is seriously a treat. The fish and chips are out of this world! The Ebelskivers (Danish pancakes) are fluffy deliciousness! Great customer service and a fun environment to top it off. You will not regret reading at Lot G, celiac or not. Yum!

resp.text: Thank you so much! That is so great to hear!

name: Amber Hoadley
text: Awesome food ! I wish they had a little more space, but the staff was very friendly and I felt the prices were very reasonable and the food was absolutely worth it!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Amber! We wish we had more space too - and we're working on solving that, so stay tuned. We're so delighted that you enjoyed your meal, and really appreciate the review.

name: Ken Marshall
text: Great, unique dishes! Cool atmosphere.

resp.text: Thank you Ken! That is so great to hear!

name: Dean Keith
text: Great place for breakfast or lunch! Eclectic food choices but all we tried were tasty!

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Dean - we're so glad you enjoyed your visit!

name: Marylee Gravens
text: You can't go wrong with anything on the menu. Favorites are the grits and gravy and the ebelskivers.

resp.text: Thank you so much Marylee! We really appreciate your review, and recommendations!

name: Anthony Rigalatoni
text: good food! its a little bit cramped but it is a great place to have breakfast, really great atmosphere.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the kind review Brett! We're working hard to figure  out a solution to the space issue - stay tuned!

name: Jason Kubichek
text: The best of the best for breakfast and lunch in Bozeman. So good.  Did I mention it was good???!!!!

resp.text: Thank you Jason! That is so great to hear!

name: Katie Mazurek
text: I’m a little obsessed. The lamb polenta is amazing, but you can’t really go wrong with anything on the menu.

resp.text: Yay! That's an obsession we fully support! Thanks so much for the nice review, we really appreciate it.

name: Sam Kupersmith
text: Super tasty. Great atmosphere.

resp.text: Thanks Sam! We really appreciate the nice review.

name: Matthew Wenger
text: Great atmosphere, and even better food! Prices are cheaper than I imagined they’d be.

resp.text: Thank you so much Matthew!

name: Joshua Huffman
text: Seating and wait times can be interesting, but the food is great!

resp.text: Thanks for the review Joshua. We're working on expanding our seating options - stay tuned!

name: Ron Callantine
text: Good food but pricey

resp.text: Thanks for the review and the feedback Ron!

name: Chris Webb
text: Great food and amazing service!

resp.text: Thank you Christopher! That is so great to hear!

name: Heidi Young
text: Great food and staff

resp.text: Thank you Heidi!

name: Rich Noonan
text: deli style service with really good fare.

resp.text: Thank you Rich!

name: Karl Baer
text: Great tasting creative breakfast and lunch items.  Seating is tight, but small groups will fit.

resp.text: Thank you Karl! We hope you've been able to come in since we expanded with a large new dining room!

name: Paolette Matute
text: Amazing food!!!

resp.text: Thank you!

name: Merrilee Thomas
text: I'm in love with lot G. Great food and people!

resp.text: Aww, thank you Merrilee!

name: Madison Fichtner
text: The food was good, but I feel like it was slightly overpriced and we, despite asking for maple syrup, got a different dipping sauce to begin with.

resp.text: Thanks so much for your feedback Madison. We take reviews very seriously and I will pass your comments on to our staff. We hope you'll give us another chance to get your order right on the first try!

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: Matcha Latte was wonderful !!

resp.text: Thank you Priscilla! That is wonderful to hear!

name: Bruce Scanes
text: Food was good but service was poor

resp.text: Hi Bruce, I'm very sorry to hear that that you experienced poor customer service at our restaurant. We take feedback like yours very seriously. We have been working hard to improve that aspect of our business over the past few months and we hope that you will give us another chance to do better.

name: The AutumnBunny
text: So good.

resp.text: Yay! Thank you so much for the nice review Brittany! That makes us very happy to hear. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Jennifer K
text: Good food, casual atmosphere.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Jennifer!

name: Ken Olson
text: Great food and service

resp.text: Thank you so much Ken!

name: Bailey Nitschke
text: Love the industrial plant design

resp.text: Thank you Bailey! That is so nice to hear!

name: Chris Sedgwick

text: Delicious. Gorgeous Mountain Views on upper level - both outside and inside. Seafood soup the day we went was some of the best I’ve had. Southwest salad got the spot for what I craved that day. Have already gone back once to bring family to enjoy the awesome food and views.

Unfortunately they no longer serve espresso downstairs but they do have great ice cream. It's not very well known in Bozeman so its rarely packed making it a lovely place for a conversation and good food while watching the game.

text:
Just had dinner with a company party this evening at Red Chair. Decided the "Red Chair Burger" with pastrami sounded unique. It was fantastic. Great flavor and concept. The best part was the fact that they actually cooked the burger medium rare like I asked. Restaurants always ask but rarely deliver on that.

The sweet potato waffle fries were awesome as well. Nice to see sweet potato fries that are actually crispy.

We tried the wings such were pretty tasty as well.

Andrea served our group and did a great job with our group of about twenty. My first time can't be my last! Very impressed.

name: Steve Olp
text:
Through a few ups and downs Red Chair has become one of the most consistent places to get food in the West End of Bozeman. It is relatively easy to park at, doesn't have a one way turn in to the place and it's patio offers a view that's shaded on one side and isn't just Huffine or a car dealer lot.
The food has improved to the point I actually crave a few menu items (the red chair burger being one).
Service remains high with a friendly staff and great bartenders. There's just the right number of beers on draught and the cocktails are solid. They have now worked out many of the kinks they had initially and have made the best out of the slightly poor layout of the building. It's earned it a rightful spot as a great place to spend a few nights a week.

text:
Chose Red Chair for my first burger in 11 years (recovering vegetarian).  Picked it because I wanted local, grass fed beef and they have it.  We sat at the bar and Kelsey was our bartender and she provided great service.  The burger arrived, looking amazing, but it was cooked medium, and since it was my first in so long, the texture was definitley off for me.

I want to be really clear and say it was NOT undercooked, & I didn't specify well-done.  In other words, the restaurant didn't drop the ball, I did!  Anyway, I kind of picked at it but didn't really dig into it.  When the server came to get plates, he actually cared that I didn't seem to eat much and asked if it was ok. Since it wasn't their fault, I wouldn't have said anything, but my boyfriend explained the situation because he wanted my first burger to be amazing.  Well, John and Kelsey were rockstars, they offered to make a new one, even though they delivered a perfectly fine burger the first time. Not only that, they seemed excited to do it!   And, what they delivered was the most OUTRAGEOUSLY delicious burger I've ever had. John even explained where the beef is processed...he cared enough to go tour the facility before selecting it as his source for beef.  I really liked that they were into locally sourced, high quality ingredients!

This isn't a one-time thing with great service there, either.  The last time we went for dinner, it was a busy night, so we explained that we were trying to get to a school Christmas program and asked if they thought that was possible. Our server was outstanding, very attentive... she and the rest of the staff got us in and out for dinner WITH bar service in under an hour so we could make it to the school on time.

Food and service always seem to be on point...I'll be back for my second burger soon!

text: I'm a fan of this Staggering Ox.  The restaurant is a Montana chain specializing in unique sandwiches.  The food is good, but they're just sandwiches. It's gigantic, with themed rooms and plenty of art to keep your eyes and mind busy.

name: Jessica Cooper
text:
I LOVE this establishment! This spacey environment is surrounded by a lot of local art & unique antique & vintage artifacts.

The front of the restaurant offers a wide variety of hot & cold sandwiches, along with some rice and vegetarian dishes. Food is in excellent quality with fresh baked & different bread options. (The Roast Beef has excellent flavor!)

The rear has a separate espresso bar, and also offer italian sodas. Both staff sides are friendly and knowledgeable.

Kid friendly, relaxed environment, with good food. They also do a really cool open mic night on sundays, and other special live music on wednesdays and thursdays.

Comfortable seating by a fire, or fish tank.

The only reason im not giving five stars is because many of the tables were dirty and not quickly bussed, and staff didnt seem motivated to keep up on keeping tables clean (there was only a single table in the front with people at it, while ALL other tables had dirty dishes, and there were no drink cups by the rear soda fountains) .... i feel like staff could be better about bussing/cleaning tables, and stocking essentials, even though they were exceptionally friendly and helpful.

A lot of local art on the walls and many vegetarian and healthy options on their menu.

The Red Atlas in the back of the Ox is a cool place to hang out too.  It has an amazing atmosphere, a fireplace that shoots a five foot swirl of fire through a big glass cylinder, a salt water aquarium and lots of ambient lighting make this a cool place to enjoy a latte or a beer. The selection of gifts, toys, and cards has made shopping for my relatives, young and old, a consistent joy. The staff recommendations for best albums in the music section are always worth looking over. I found Courtney Barnett's 2018 album Tell Me How You Really Feel there, and I was rewarded with masterfully-crafted chords and a surprise Kim Deal appearance. name: Caleb Klaus
text:
Great selection and variety. There's just the right amount of smug hipsterness, intermingled with resigned helpfulness(from the staff) to make me feel at home here. An eclectic decor underlines the pervasive sense of cool emanating from the walls, floors, even ceilings and heating vents. Decades of musical knowledge and wisdom have saturated the air, spiced it with an exotic aroma reminiscent of the silk road bazaars in the East. It's pungent odor lays heavy upon your brow as you peruse the vast collection of physical media(available at competitive prices!) Blissful and unaware of your slowly eroding sense of fashion, your musical taste, your impending existential crisis as age turns against you as a reminder of innocence lost instead of experience gained, you will find peace in these perusals. In these moments you will find zen. Simply because...

....it's a music store. The ideologues interest in intriguing instrumental ideas is instantly increased in an inspection inside it's aisle's. In an interest in ending this increasingly idiotic and imbecilic collection of idioms, I implore in earnest: Shop here for your Music and Media needs! Or don't. I'm just a silly review on your screen. I can't make you do anything!

name: Alex Anderlik
text:
A hip, quirky shop full of unique, interesting, and often hilarious gifts.  The store is roughly divided into four sections:

The first room is dedicated to cards, calendars, and notebooks of all kinds - beautiful artsy greetings sit right next to raunchy gags.
Next are (mostly) novelty gifts and toys of all shapes and sizes; there are a lot of funny and strange things here that you're not going to find in very many places, but you might be content just to look around and not actually buy anything.
Farther back you'll find a big collection of CDs, DVDs, and vinyl - some items are a bit pricey but others are steals, and there is a pretty complete collection you could easily spend an hour or more browsing.
Finally, in another room (as well as scattered around the others) you can find a variety of more serious decorations, posters, clothing, and jewelry that are all pretty and many of which are handcrafted.

All in all, there are a lot of bizarre and fun things here that you're not going to find anywhere else - some of it is a bit gimmicky but that doesn't make it any less enjoyable to browse around.  If you have some time and a little bit of spending money, definitely check this place out.

resp.text: Hi, Ty.  Thanks for the good review.  Our nitro flows more slowly during the colder months.  You were indeed on it regarding its age -- about 6 weeks old.  Nitro's freshness is far greater than any other coffee, but we like to flip kegs each month.  Come on in -- we just loaded a new keg!  Thanks.

text: Great coffee. Eggs and bacon shipped in bags? Disgusting. won't be buying any more sandwiches. Even McDs uses fresh eggs.

resp.text: Hi, Justin.  Thanks for the review.  Actually, we've got a corral of pigs and chickens in the back room.  We slaughter in the morning and then ... Ha!  Just kidding.  That'd be gnarly.  Like pretty much every restaurant in this world, we use a mix of ingredients that are fresh and minimally processed.  We use a liquid egg mix that contains scrambled eggs and citric acid (preservative).  The mix is pasteurized and thereby makes for safer food handling.  Contamination from raw eggs (salmonella and all) is a problem in the restaurant world.  We scramble the equivalent of hundreds of eggs every morning and use those eggs for our breakfast burritos.  We use an expensive, pre-cooked bacon that costs more per pound than a New York Steak.  It's a delicious bacon that we run through our oven with the eggs and any other burrito ingredients, open-faced before we serve it to our customer.  Farm fresh?  Well, no.  Beware that label, though.  Out of a bag?  Well, no.  And, yeah, McDonald's doesn't use shelled eggs either.

text:
I've only been once, so maybe they were having a bad day. We got a coffee and americano, which came in a paper to-go cup. We were staying in, but okay, that's what people do. I ask for a refill and the barista looks at me kind of weird and says usually they only do refills for dining-in mugs, but she can do it for me. And the refill is only for 12 oz. I suggest she just fill my cup 12 oz. full, and she agrees. I finally pry out that a refill is $.50, which is fine. And, no, they won't refill an americano with coffee. I don't understand that at all, but whatever. We stay longer. I can't make heads or tails of their refill policy, but I go to see if I can get another. A different barista asks if I paid for it, to which I nod, because I paid for the coffee today and am here for a refill, but that's not what she meant and she looks at the original barista, who looks at me like I'm asking to unload the till into this burlap sack, and shakes her head. Oh, I'm sorry, no I didn't pay the $.50 for this refill, but my wallet is open and a dollar halfway out in case there is any confusion. She fills my 16 oz. cup full. I am confused, and feel slightly like someone getting too much change back, but in this case I can't return the change, because germs, so I take it and drink it.

I know that I am spoiled by City Brew's unlimited refill policy, but I would have had a much more pleasant experience if someone had noticed these first-timers and laid out the rules.

The art is nice.

Edit: 4-stars for the responsive owner. Hopefully, next time we are in town they have their cup/refill policy a little more understandable. Also, I'd recommend they allow refills of drip coffee even if the customer had an americano or latte or something.

resp.text: Hi, Tait.  Thanks for taking the time to give us feedback.  As with so many other things, Covid has disrupted our refill policy.  In normal times, we do 50 cent refills on our 12 oz for-here mugs.  You can do 50 cent refills until you pass out or spin your head off.  We normally don't do refills on our to-go cups, as they're variously sized and we experienced abuse of our refill policy in the past by a few customers who would leave, come back, leave again, and come back days later, insisting on a "refill."  We're trying to be more lenient now, with the reality that most drinks are served in paper cups whether a customer is staying or going.  I'm sorry for any confusion with our policy and perhaps by the staff -- I will add a reminder to our next store note.  We buy our coffee from a local roaster -- Ghost Town Coffee Roasters -- and it's not cheap.  The 50 cents for a refill covers the material cost (coffee beans) of our coffee, but only that.  You'll find that most places that do unlimited free refills serve coffee that is inferior because, well, it's cheap enough to serve for free.  I'm sorry for the confusion today, and I appreciate your feedback.

resp.text: Genevieve, I'm sorry you didn't like the Nitro.  It's not for everyone.  It's straight coffee, cold brewed for 14 hours at a strong ratio (of coffee grinds to water) and infused with nitrogen.  Many black coffee drinkers really love it, but it's less sweet than a latte or any sweetened coffee drink.  I'd be happy to refund your purchase -- give us a call at our Kagy shop 586-4121 and I can look up the transaction and credit your card (assuming you used one).  Or email me at tom.gibson@mtcafem.com.  I just need the last four digits of the card.  As for sizing, our normal hot drink sizes are 8, 12, and 16 ounces.  Our Nitro is 8 and 12 ounces -- we size those smaller because of the increased caffeine content in our Nitro.  The Nitro contains about 50% more caffeine than regular drip coffee.  A 12 oz Nitro has the caffeine of about 18 oz of drip coffee.  I'm sorry you didn't enjoy our Nitro, but it's good to experiment and figure out what you really like and which shop or shops really serve what you like.

name: Sam Evans
text: The people were super friendly, which is about the best I could say. I bought an expensive accessory for my truck, had them order it, and waited two weeks for it to come in. I had gotten a price 6 months before hand, and finally pulled the trigger. When it was finally time to install it, the process took nearly 3 hours, and they had already started assembling it before it got there. I had talked with the accessories guys at least 4 times about price, and installation, etc. Never once did they mention the $150 installation fee until it was already in my truck and I was handed the paper work. I could have installed it myself, in half the time, and all of the parts would have been in place. Instead I got home and had to put in to structural braces myself because the tech thought they were optional dividers. I also bought a new truck shortly beforehand, but I bought it elsewhere after they tried to offer me half of market value for my trade since it would have to go to their older used car lot. Needless to say, I'll be going elsewhere when the time comes to buy my topper. EDIT: and they order the wrong tie down rails to go with it.

resp.text: We appreciate the opportunity to reply to your comments. We can assure you that the price was exactly what was quoted, the install fee was broken out on the invoice for our records but did not represent an increase in cost to you. We do apologize for any mix-up in terms of the installation time.  The installation of the topper and deck system is quoted as a 4 hour job.  If something was installed incorrectly or if you are having any issues please do not hesitate to let us know and we will be happy to take a look at things for you.

name: Peter Butler
text:
I came down from Helena to trade my truck for a Tundra.  I was preapproved, and had my title in hand. I called the day before with details on my trade and was specific that my time was limited.  When I got to town the next morning, my first stop was at Ressler so they could see my trade and get paperwork ready for when I came back that afternoon.  When I did go back, nothing had been done.  The sales person I had initiated with was busy, and I had to start over with another.  What could have taken 10 minutes to figure out, instead we wasted 2 hours of eachothers time to not come to a deal.
Don't confuse their "best price" gimmick with hassle/haggle free.  There was 2 hours of haggle and negotiations over what they'd give on trade.

resp.text: We apologize that we did not handle your time more effectively.  It is always our intent to make the car buying process easy and as quick as possible.  We appreciate your patience on the day you were here.  We have addressed your review with our team and are looking at our processes to ensure that this does not happen again. Thank you for your comments.

name: Eat Well Travel Often
text: New to town & stopped here for breakfast. We were expecting the normal cafe/diner food, but we were pleasantly surprised. Of course, you can get the usual dishes, but the menu is quite large & everything seems to be extra special compared to most others we’ve been to across the United States. I ordered a taco omelette (came with hash browns and toast). First impression: it’s HUGE. Taste test: surprisingly delicious (I was on the fence when ordered it... lol). It was packed full of delicious taco meat (not the fast food kind), black olives, & tomatoes, and comes with generous sides of sour cream and salsa to slather all over the top. A+👍🏼. The Hubby ordered a hamburger steak, eggs, toast, & hashbrowns. All perfectly cooked. They don’t allow substitutions, but that’s plainly stated on the menu. Service was efficient and thorough. Prices were exceptional. Great value. It’s nothing fancy, but we feel like we found a gem. A note on the menu said they have a buffet on Sundays, so we’re looking forward to trying that out soon. 100% recommend👍🏼👍❤️!

text:
One of the downtown best stops to get a fresh and healthy quick bite that is not expensive. Two Tacos for $7-7.50 in 2018.

The fish tacos are delicious with the white sauce they add and the tomato salsa pairs well with these tacos.

My one gripe is that the tacos are usually a mess to eat and I need to have several napkins on hand because the sauce pools in the bottom of the foil wrapper.

There is usually plenty of seating, especially in off-peak hours. They also have a small beer selection if you don’t want to go into a bar.

Terrible experience. Although staff was decently pleasant, the food was atrocious. The burrito was less than lukewarm mere seconds after paying and sitting down, even with a full foil wrap.

Flavors were bland on both burrito (shredded pork) and quesadilla. No personality!

Their salsa’s were terrible. The mango habañero tasted like a snow cone syrup with siracha. Gross. Tomatillo was sugary and bland.

Finally, the guacamole was laughable. It may have been powder an hour earlier. A local mexican place that doesn’t make their own guac? Really?

Beware any made to order place with a heat lamp. Never again.

The only reason for the four star rating is their lack of a solid cross-contamination policy for their gluten free options. If you aren't a Celiac you'll be fine; however, I've noticed that they allow their serving ladles to touch the flour tortillas in order to spread the meat, guacamole, etc... evenly. It's enough cross-contamination to make a highly sensitive Celiacs ill.

name: Kory Sutherland
text:
I've long been a fan of Taco del Sol, since their early days in Missoula at the Higgins location. It was our go-to spot for a fresh & filling meal that didn't leave our wallets empty.

For under $10, you got a burrito stuffed with beans, rice, cheese, and meat, with no extra charge for "all the fixins" like guac, pico, etc — I'm glad to say that's still the case to to this day at the Bozeman location, and true to memory, the taste & quality are still outstanding.

I love that the staff are always friendly & laid back, the floor & tables are clean, and the food is always made with fresh ingredients right in front of you — And the foil sculptures are always a nice touch too.

Regarding some of the other reviewers experiences, I can't help wondering if they're confusing this for the other "Taco del" restaurant in town (next to TJ Maxx) which is just a sad imitation of this place. The cost, cleanliness & food quality from those others guys absolutely doesn't compare by any means.

name: Eat Well Travel Often
text: The Hubby picked up breakfast here this morning for the two of us, right at opening (6a.m.). WOW. We’re new to Bozeman and have already tried a fairly long list of restaurants here in town. The food at Mama Mac’s is in the Top 5, for sure. I’ve never eaten a quiche that I’d describe as delicious, until this morning. The perfect balance of veggies, meat, cheese, egg, & crust. Super filling yet not heavy. The cinnamon rolls are not only picture worthy, but mouth watering. The entire roll tastes like the center (which is usually the only part of a cinnamon roll I eat). Pretty excited to see if their lunch items are as delicious as their breakfast. Service was A+. 100% recommend👍. 😍

name: Bozeman Review
text:
Bozeman Reviews is not know for 5 stars.  You have to earn that!  Mama Macs has been a life line to the work force and guest of Bozeman and Bigsky from the start of this "Pandemic"??

Take out, curbside or dine in.  Pick what your comfortable with.

Hand sanitizer for guest and staff and very clean establishment.

Plus great Food!!!  Owners are onsite daily making sure everyone is staying safe.  If you see something concerning tell them, they Re the ones cooking and taking orders daily!!

Super friendly folks.

Thank you Mama Macs for keeping us fed!

name: Eric Sterkel
text: This is a great stop for tourists, locals, our guides. We’ve been eating here for years and you recommend it to anyone and everyone.  They always have solid food and good selection, great customer service, and prices are competitive.  It’s exactly what it says mama’s restaurant.  The owner goes above and beyond to make you feel welcome and cared for every chance she can.  Not to mention she’s got a great sense of humor.  The line can get long during breakfast and lunch rushes so come either ready for that or hit it before or after.  However they are really good about keeping the line moving so you aren’t waiting.  Their sandwiches both for breakfast and lunch are super filling.  Their breakfast burritos are big enough to fed to adults. If you want some healthy home style cooking this is the place to go. When people say “I would like a marshmallow milkshake”

Respond with “would you like small, medium, or large?”

Everything was great except I really wanted medium but got a small...

Food is mediocre. Service was even more mediocre.

name: Kassidy Bowman
text:
The kid didn’t ask what size of shakes we wanted. No big deal because we didn’t tell him... but ask if they don’t tell you. A lot of people don’t. I’ve spent too much time asking what size of coffee they want at a drive though. Haha!

What really tipped me over the edge was the under cooked burgers... it also had no flavor. Did I mention I had to cook my burger when I got home?!

Maybe I’m hangry... maybe I’m mad about the $20 I just lost. I don’t know.

Will be back for a medium milkshake though... maybe I’ll remember to say “medium” 😂😂

name: William Johnson
text:
This is a local family restaurant with character and roots in the valley.  It is a one of a kind burger joint.  The food tastes like it is all locally sourced, and it probably is from the same sources that the Butcher Boy (their parent's beefburger restaurant) had come from a generation ago.
Excellent burgers, waffle fries, sweet potato fries, and milk shakes.  They do high quality fast-food for the same price as national fast food competitors who have much inferior products.

text: Great burgers, shakes and fries. I recommend you bring cash, but they will take plastic as well. The only not great thing I can say about this place is that while I highly commend them on teaching the younger generation how to use an "old fashioned" register (no touch screens or menus, just a big calculator basically) & having them actually count change, they're not very accurate at it. I can order the exact same thing multiple times & the total is never the same. One day I recalculated the order at the table multiple times & still could never figure out what the cashier had rung in to come to that amount. It's never been a large amount, so I've never been all that concerned with a 35 cent or 15 cent or 60 cent discrepancy & it certainly hasn't stopped my weekly visits.

name: Matt Elkins
text: Being recently diagnosed full on Celiac and being forced to change my entire diet. I got a craving for a good meal I could handle. I had heard about the gluten free buns offered here, so I called and inquired about their processes to accommodate someone such as myself. To my grateful surprise the gentleman I spoke to assured me they would change gloves and scrub off the cook top just for me and their gluten free buns are separated and in their own sealed bags. What a feeling to be taken care of like that. Needless to say we ordered our meal over the phone and when I got there to pick up my amazing burger the gentleman I spoke to on the phone remembered and told me they went the extra mile to make sure I didn't get glutened.  I'm happy to report the job they did was perfectly executed just like my mushroom Swiss was. Got me for life guys. Great job again.

name: Barbara Dierenfeldt
text: Friendly, helpful staff. Clean restaurant.  Burrito and hashbrowns good. My fish tacos were overcooked and dry, seasoned with pepper so much I couldn't taste fish. Skimpy on coleslaw,  which was good. My decaf hazelnut latte was perfect. Restaurant at 11:30  had about 10 customers. Terribly sad they don't do gluten free pastries and baked goods anymore with new owners. They've taken a super menu and perfectly cooked food and not handling change well. It used to be 45-60 minute wait to be seated. Hopefully they can get their act together

resp.text: Hi Barbara! I'm sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy your most recent meal with us. The transition between owners on top of navigating COVID has proven difficult but we are working hard to keep everything running smoothly and are optimistic about the new direction the restaurant is heading. We hope you'll come back soon and give us another shot!

text: We have gone to three different places and they all had a waiting line. I looked across the street and saw people walking out and told my husband, "let's try Nova Café." We did and staff were helpful, friendly and just smiley. We were not rushed and didn't feel like we were rushed. The staff were quite busy but not too busy to check up on us. The food was delicious and we would definitely go back and recommend this place. If you decide to go, try the Belgium waffles. Oh, they do not serve lunch on Sundays. Enjoy!

resp.text: Thank you for taking the time to leave such a nice review, Wilma!

Really could have done without warm salsa and a hostess with an attitude. Other than that was a really great experience. The barista was in training but her amazing attitude surpassed little hiccups in the order taking process. Would definitely return.

resp.text: Hi Barbara! Thank you for taking the time to leave such a nice review! We're working on our new fall menu right now and are adding lots of new yummy vegan dishes- I hope you'll come back soon to try them out!

name: Brett Marshall
text: Nova Cafe has possibly displaced Main Street Overeasy as the best breakfast in Bozeman... If not, it is a close contender... A variety of Benedicts, hashes, blue cornmeal pancakes, cottage cheese pancakes. One thing MSO does not offer, but Nova does, is espresso... And they make a better classic macchiato than many coffee shops. They have come a long way, improving year after year... if you haven't been there for a while, I suggest you give the new Nova a try. There may also be a few other contenders in town...but Nova has become a great breakfast... Also I recently had kidney surgery and they made substitutions to fit my complicated dietary restrictions with no fuss... Well Done Nova! (The photo reflects my diet... Not the Apex of their culinary capacity but very good!)

resp.text: Woohoo! Thank you so much Brett! That is great to hear. We are always working hard to improve what we do, and it's wonderful to hear that we are achieving that. And we're so glad to hear that we were able to cook up something that worked for your diet. Hopefully your recovery is going well!

name: Kristen Oaks
text: It seems this normally well oiled machine has gotten rusty under the new ownership.  I sat at my table, alone, and wasnt greeted with water or anything for 6 minutes. Looking around the room you could see similar experiences from other diners. Waiting impatiently to order, get their bill etc...to be clear it is not busy even fairly. Upon unrolling my silverware the butter knife had food stuck on it, I never received a clean one even though I asked. The food was good! Waffle and local bacon cooked to perfection, but the roughness of the FOH service leaves something  to be desired.

resp.text: Hi Kristen, thank you for taking time to leave a review. I'm sorry to hear that your visit with us was disappointing. We take reviews seriously and I will be checking in with our team about your review. We strive to provide both quality food and service and I promise that this is not the norm. I hope you'll come back again soon and give us a chance to make it up to you!

I'll be sharing this with our team in the back to make sure everyone stays vigilant about putting out consistent and delicious food.
