We take our reviews seriously and pride ourselves on accommodating any/all dietary restrictions, particularly for our vegetarian/vegan guests. I'm sorry to hear that this wasn't the case when you came in and would love to make it up to you!  If you would care to share more with me about your most recent visit with us so that I can follow up with my team I can be reached at hey@thenovacafe.com. Thank you!

name: Leah Ford
text: Food is fresh, reasonably priced, and taste fantastic!!  It's a funky little restaurant worth the visit.  Each time I've been there has been a wait but it's never been long and always worth it!

name: Anna Cox
text: Delicious food and coffee. Also support a local shelter for women/families with their specials!

resp.text: Thank you so much Anna! We're so glad to hear that you enjoyed everything and that you appreciate our commitment to helping out community. It's something we believe in strongly and it's always nice to hear when people notice and care about that part of our business.

name: Mikki Van Vuren
text: Always yummy food! I love that there are a few sidewalk tables.

resp.text: Thank you for your review Mikki!

name: Debra Ziegler
text: Great food.

resp.text: Thanks Debra!

name: GM Faux
text: Delicious pancakes and their bacon is very n I ce and crispy though its going to be a wait but it is well worth it.

resp.text: Hi GM! Thank you for taking the time to write such a nice review. You can't ever go wrong with pancakes and bacon!

name: Kim Potter
text: I only ate breakfast here once with a friend but I really enjoyed it. There were nice options for someone with dietary restriction and the staff was friendly and accommodating.

resp.text: Hi Kim! Thank you for taking the time to leave such a nice review, that is great to hear!

name: Joseph Schumacher
text: How do you make Eggs Benedict better? Add a Maryland Crabcake. One of the best things I've tasted. ❤

resp.text: Thank you, Joseph!

name: Aeden DeGraw
text: Best vegan options in town and nice servers.

resp.text: Hi Aeden! Thank you so much! We love being able to offer delicious food for everyone to enjoy, and are currently working on lots of new vegan options for our fall menu updates. I hope you'll come back soon and try them out!

name: Jamie Shelhamer
text: Creative delicious food

resp.text: Thank you Jamie!

name: Michael Parker
text: Bustling downtown cafe with concise but diverse menu, quality food, and excellent service. I was surprised by the modern touches in the reservation system which is extremely useful on a busy weekend morning. I highly recommend checking Nova Cafe out if you want a modern twist on a classic diner.

resp.text: Thank you so much Michael! That is really wonderful to hear. You hit on all the things we try hard to provide and I'm so happy to hear that you enjoyed your visit. We hope to see you again sometime!

name: Daniel Gavinsky
text: Nice and quaint little cafe in downtown Bozeman. The service was above average and the food was great. The menu has some exciting options and priced decently. Thank you Nova Cafe.

resp.text:
Hi Daniel,
That is all so wonderful to hear! You hit on everything we try hard to deliver and we really appreciate your letting us know that we achieved it. Thank you so much!

name: Andrew Rossiter
text: Always good. Probably the best eggs benny in town.

resp.text: That is so great to hear! We love our benny as well. Thank you for leaving such a nice review Andrew!

name: Grovom Painting
text:
Just Average... Service from waiter was really poor. Coffee actually cold. Prices pretty high.

Environment was fun though.

Coffee was incredible!! (once they brewed a new pot)

Probably won't be back

resp.text: I am so sorry to hear that you had a disappointing experience at Nova! We do not want our servers or our coffee to ever be cold! I am passing this on to our manager so she can follow up with the staff and make sure it doesn't happen again. I appreciate the feedback and hope you'll give us once more chance to show you that we can provide excellent service and good coffee in every cup.

name: La Tingai Bozeman
text: The food was very good.  The service very regular.

name: Bryan Rask
text: Great food. Off the wall dishes.

resp.text: Thanks Bryan! So glad to hear that you enjoy them!

name: Kristin L. Erickson
text: Food is fantastic. Fresh, flavorful, and friendly, just wonderful.   Would be 5 stars if it were comfortable. Chairs very uncomfortable particularly if one is a bit short.  Husband 6'1 & he was cramped at the small table.  Oh Goldilocks...was looking for just right.

resp.text: Hi Kristin, aka Goldilocks ; )  Thank you so much for coming in and taking the time to leave a review. I'm sorry to hear that the chairs were uncomfortable for both of you! That's helpful feedback that we'll take into account the next time we replace chairs. We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the rest of your experience at Nova and we hope to see you again soon, maybe at a booth this time to see if that seating arrangement is more comfortable?

name: Aaron Blakeslee
text: Awesome! Asked the waitress for a vegan suggestion and am glad I went with it. Best breakfast I've had in a while.

resp.text: Hey Aaron! That's so awesome to hear, we're glad you went with it too! Thank you for taking the time to make such a nice review!

name: Colter Metcalf
text: The food is great, but the service was awful.  My wife ordered simple oatmeal with brown sugar.  They didn't provide brown sugar. We had to ask twice more before they brought it out.  I accidentally knocked my silverware to the ground and the waitress says she would bring me a replacement. She never did.  Also, there were numerous empty tables, so I can't say the mistakes were because the staff was overwhelmed.

resp.text:
Hi Colter,
I am so sorry to hear about your bad experience at Nova! That sounds incredibly frustrating and I am so glad that you provided so much detail, that way we can track down what happened and follow up with our team. We use reviews as an opportunity to make sure we're doing everything right and we clearly did not achieve that when you were in. I promise you that is not the kind of service we aim to provide and I very much hope you'll give us another chance to show you that we can do a lot better.

name: Chris O'Bleness
text: Favorite spot for breakfast in Bozeman! The specials are great!

resp.text: Hooray! Thanks so much for your nice review!

name: Chris Mellott
text: This place is hit or miss anymore. Use to have a fantastic staff. Food is often either over cooked or rushed out. Portions are often unreliable. On the positive side I feel I can trust the quality of the raw materials to be higher than most. So I keep coming back and bring out of town folks here. Hoping the negatives are just a phase.

resp.text: Hi Chris, I am so sorry to hear that! We have had some staff turnover in the past few months but that is no excuse for ever under or over cooking your food. Consistency is something we value and work hard to achieve with every plate we send out of the kitchen. I really appreciate your feedback, which I will pass on to our general manager so she can follow up with her kitchen staff. We really appreciate your willingness to give us another chance because I assure you that we are doubling down on training to deliver what you remember Nova Cafe for.

name: Lindsey Rue Marrow
text: This restaurant is a staple in Bozeman. The service is wonderful and the food just amazing! Anytime we have company in town we take them here. Coffee is always hot and delicious!

resp.text: Thank you so much Lindsey! That is really wonderful to hear - being the place to bring company is high praise indeed. We so appreciate your visits and your taking the time to leave such a nice review. We look forward to seeing you again very soon!

name: Karen Lorance
text: Great little restaurant. Nourishing whole food. Eager staff. Good coffee.

resp.text: Thank you so much Karen! That is really lovely to hear and we appreciate your taking the time to leave such a nice review. We hope to see you again!

name: Confessions And Lessons
text: Busy and delicious. Not a greasy spoon. And this place has definitly saved my life once or twice.

resp.text: Aww, thanks Laura! That's really good to hear. We appreciate the nice review and we are here for you and time you need saving in the form of breakfast!

name: Bill Hanson
text: Been awhile since I’ve eaten here. Glad I came in again. Remodel to retro 50s style with colorful surroundings for starting the day cheerfully. Menu redone too. Lots of tempting offerings. Had the bargain of the day (not the exact name but you’re gonna know it hen you see it). Eggs, bacon, toast, and half a waffle. Plus fresh squeezed grapefruit juice. Endless good coffee. I’ll be back.

resp.text: Thank you Bill! We're so glad you came back in too! We're delighted to hear that you enjoyed the Early Bird Special, and the rest of your experience with us. We very much appreciate your coming and taking the time to leave such a nice review. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Willis von Werner
text: Love this place!  Specials are always great as are the regular menu items.  Modern take on the old school cafe.  Service has always been ON IT no matter how busy.

resp.text: Thank you so much Willis! That is so great to hear. We appreciate the nice review!

name: Rio Gonzalez McCord
text: This place is fantastic! Gluten free options, wonderful coffee, the best orange juice ever, a great staff, and, of course, delicious meals. Everything I've tried had some real heartiness to it. And don't forget to check their pastries! Wow!

resp.text: Thank you so much Rio! That means the world to us. We really appreciate your nice review and are delighted to hear that you are able to find gluten free deliciousness with us!

name: Audrey Samuelsen
text: Super fun and funky atmosphere with awesome staff! Really love this long time favorite of mine!

resp.text: Thank you so much Audrey! That is fantastic to hear! We really appreciate your being a regular and taking the time to leave such a nice review! See you again soon, hopefully!

name: Cheyenne Crooker
text: Awesome food, attentive customer service, and tasty coffee. If you are vegan and visiting this restaurant, ask for the vegan menu. I LOVE a place serving local fare. The coffee, veggies, breads, potatoes, etc. are all as close to local as they can get. I love that and I think it really makes a dining experience better. This is an excellent place to eat if you have a gluten free, vegan, and carnivore in your group. It will please everyone.

resp.text:
Hi Cheyenne,
Thank you so much for the kind review! We are so delighted to hear that you enjoyed your meal and your experience with us. That's a huge goal of ours - to make sure everyone at the table can find something delicious to eat. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Mohammad Alkhaled
text: Great place to eat breakfast or lunch. The menu is great. You can customize.

resp.text: Thank you so much Mohammad! That is really wonderful to hear and we appreciate your taking the time to leave a nice review - that is so helpful for us. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Darla Sather
text: This local breakfast establishment defines Bozeman. It is a cool diner with excellent food and character.

resp.text: Thank you Darla! That is so so wonderful to hear. We really appreciate your kind words about Nova and we look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Cat Creech
text: This place is amazing!!!! My friend brought me for the first time, amazing food great prices so friendly, more trips to come!!

resp.text: Hooray! That is so wonderful to hear. Thank you so much for the nice review - and thank you to your friend who brought you in! We look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Tim Dolan
text: Great food, roomy attractive space. Allow extra time. Our waitress was too busy to come back and take the order before we had to go. Bad planning on my part.

resp.text:
Hi Tim,
I'm so sorry to hear that you weren't able to dine with us! We appreciate your taking the time to leave a review anyway, and we hope you'll be able to make it in again when you have a little more time.

name: helal al-ganem
text: Vintage style. You'd sit down and feel like you're living in the Jetsons TV show with the different decor. The servers are super nice and sweet. I'd definitely take a friend or a date there!

resp.text: Thank you so much for the nice review and for stopping by! We really appreciate it and we hope to see you on a date here soon!

name: Daniel Deininger
text: Delicious food, pleasant atmosphere, friendly service.

resp.text: Thank you so much Dan! Those three things are what we strive to deliver and it makes our day to hear when we achieved that. We really appreciate your coming in to dine with us and taking the time to leave such a nice review. We hope to see you again sometime!

name: Scott Soltis
text: Great staff and good food. Popular place so be prepared for a wait.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the review Scott! We are glad to hear that the food and service were worth the wait - and we're working hard to reduce that wait time, so hopefully the next time you're in we can get you served more quickly. See you soon!

name: Mike Giroux
text:
Friendly and fast service and tasty food
Great place for weekday work breakfast  meeting

resp.text: Thank you so much for the nice review Mike! We really appreciate it and we look forward to seeing you again soon.

name: Sandra
text: Great food. Great prices and service. On site coffee / tea batista. Nice menu with gluten free options.

resp.text: Thank you so much Sandra! That is really wonderful to hear! We are under the same ownership as Lot G Cafe so I saw your review come through for there as well - I am delighted to hear that you had a better experience at Nova so you can see what we are capable of! Thank you so much for the honest feedback for both places - we really appreciate it.

name: Brad
text: This place has awesome staff, excellent coffee, and a very good home feel to it. The place was extraordinarily busy but service was good and fast. I would not recommend this place I'd you want to grab a quick coffee as the amount of coffee orders will take awhile and there is no real good place to wait. It was totally worth it though. I will definitely be back!

resp.text: Thanks so much for taking the time to leave such a nice review, especially after you had to wait for your meal. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Tom Lawrence
text: Always great food at the Nova...

resp.text: Thank you, Tom!

name: Nauni Griffith
text: If you like a light atmosphere and great food this is the place for you. There was a short wait that came as no surprise when you were seated and received your food. I ordered one of the specials for the day and must say it was the best eggs benedict I had ever eaten. The asparagus was the perfect touch. Very environmentally friendly which came as quite a surprise. I will definitely recommend to all my friends and family.

resp.text: That is so wonderful to hear! We take pride in our eggs benedict and it's so fantastic to hear that they are enjoyed! Thank you so much for taking the time to leave such a nice review.

name: Paul Manning
text: The Nova is delicious, I frequent breakfast here and have never been disappointed. Can't vouch for lunch but I imagine it is just as good as breakfast.

resp.text: Than you Paul! That is so wonderful to hear. We really appreciate your choosing to dine with us so often and your kind words about Nova - that really helps us and we appreciate it!

name: Theo Petersen
text: A Bozeman classic. Quality locally sourced food, good coffee, great service, and plenty of hipsters.

resp.text: Thank you Theo! We really appreciate the five star review and we hope to see you again sometime.

name: Marianne Marchette
text: Good food, very tasty and well seasoned and pretty good breakfast selection. I wish they did shredded hashbrowns instead of home fries. Our service was quite slow and they don't have real menus, its weird reading the menu off your phone in a restaurant.

resp.text: Hi Marianne, thank you for taking the time to leave  us a review. We opted for QR codes for our menu because of the pandemic, but we do provide physical copies if needed. I'm sorry to hear your service was disappointing, I will be sure to check in with my team about this. I'm glad you enjoyed your meal and I hope you'll come back soon!

name: Katelyn Maspero
text: I love the atmosphere here and the food is amazing. The staff is friendly and you never have to wait long for your food

resp.text: Thank you so much Katelyn! That is really wonderful to hear - you hit on every single thing that we have been working really hard to create and it is so nice to get feedback that we are doing it right! We hope to see you again very soon.

name: Brian Hare
text: Yummo breakfast

resp.text: Thanks Brian!

name: Alexa Adamson
text: To be honest I was pretty dissapointed with this place ecspecially after reading the reviews. The environment was crowded and felt overall stuffy. The coffee was too weak for my taste, felt like I was drinking dirty water. I got an omlete with artichoke hearts & spinach, both veggies tasted like they came out of cans, it was very watery with no flavor, even my fiance couldnt season it enough with salt pepper or tabasco to eat it. I let the waiter know, and was super nice about it as I never complain when I eat somewhere, its awkardness i'd rather avoid. The waiter got super defensive and sassy with me asking if ive ever eaten there before and how do I know if it doesnt taste right if ive never had it. I'd like to say it was just a freak expirience but I have a hard time ever wanting to go back. I wouldnt discourage anyone from going, hopefully you have a better expirience than I did

resp.text:
Hi Alexa,
I'm so very sorry to hear that you were disappointed by your meal at Nova! We most definitely want everyone to enjoy what they order and your feedback is really helpful. I'll pass this on to our general manager so she can figure out if something out of the ordinary happened when you were in yesterday because that is not how our food or coffee should taste, ever. It does not sound like your server dealt with it in an appropriate way either and we will follow up on that as well. We really appreciate the feedback and hope that you will give us one more chance to show you that we can deliver excellent food, coffee and customer service because I promise you we can!

name: Mike Davis
text: Good breakfast... waffles were a little soggy but rest was Good.

resp.text: Hi Mike, Thank you so much for coming in and for leaving a review. I'm so sorry to hear that your waffles were soggy! I promise they aren't usually soggy and I'll pass this info on to our kitchen crew too to see what might have happened.  I hope you'll be able to come back in and try them again.

name: Kyle Blackmore
text: One of the best places in Bozeman. whether you are a regular or traveling through. You have to go here. Their food is off the charts and awesome!!!

resp.text: Thank you so much Kyle! That made my day to read! We really appreciate the kind words about Nova. Hope to see you soon!

name: Peter Hofacker
text: Interesting menu, acai bowls as well as bacon and eggs. Friendly and attentive service. Comfortable atmosphere. I'll definitely go back.

resp.text: Thank you Peter! That is wonderful to hear. Coming back for another meal really is the highest praise possible. We appreciate your nice review and your coming in to dine with us. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Brian Grainger
text: Good food and good service with a friendly atmosphere.

resp.text: Thank you so much Brian! That is so great to hear - you hit on all the things we are trying hard to deliver. We appreciate your coming in to dine with us and then taking the time to leave a review!

name: Christina Broadhurst
text: Very good good, but long wait times.

resp.text:
Hi Christina,
Thanks for the review! We really appreciate it. I'm not sure if anyone told you when you were in, but you can now get on the waitlist and see how long the wait is remotely by visiting our website. I hope that helps with future visits.

name: Richard Hofacker
text: Food outstanding. Service, location, and atmosphere are enjoyable.

resp.text: Thank you so much Richard! We are so delighted to hear that we hit all the important categories. We really appreciate your taking the time to leave such a nice review and we hope to see you again soon!

name: Ryan Johnson
text: The food was fresh and filling.  It was reasonably priced. The service was excellent.  If the food had been more memorable I would have given it five stars.  If you're looking for standard fresh food, go here.

name: Gabrielle Milligan
text: Fast and friendly service! Best waffles I've ever had in my life. They are amazingly delicious. Everything else is wonderful, but make sure you try the waffles! With all of the butter and syrup, too.

resp.text: Hooray! That is all so great to hear! Thank you so much for the nice review and for coming in Gabrielle!

name: Susie Chapman
text: The waffles with whipped butter and warm syrup are so delicious. I just thought it was a little pricey for a dinner.  Since its located on main down town I guess that understandable.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the review Susie! I'm delighted to hear that you enjoyed your waffles. We use Montana sourced flour in everything that we make and source other local ingredients wherever possible. Our kitchen creates everything from scratch in-house. Those two things unfortunately drive prices up, but we hope it was worth it for the breakfast you were served!

name: Osiris
text: One of Bozeman's finest breakfast nooks, outstanding service, amazing food, great espresso they really are a fantastic place to grab some delicious grub. All of which is why it's a good idea to show up early before they get crazy busy! Enjoy ♡

resp.text: Thank you so much for your nice review James! We really appreciate your taking the time to leave it, and that's an excellent tip about getting in early. Hope to see you again soon!

name: Jessica Pilch
text: I have mixed feelings about the Nova because there are a few other breakfast places in town that I just prefer. The food that I've had there is just different the serving sizes don't quite match up with the price in my opinion. However if you have dietary limits. I suppose it's a good option. Their coffee is not too shabby.

resp.text: Thanks for the review Jessica. We appreciate your honesty and respect that everyone is looking for something a little different from their breakfast spot.

name: David Crow
text: Best biscuits and gravy in town! Cool atmosphere. Toddler toys in the back!

resp.text: Thank you so much David! That is so fantastic to hear! We really appreciate your business and the nice review.

name: Charli Ann
text: Did not like pancakes..very different texture and tasye. Test of the meal was good. Crowded so be prepared to wait

resp.text:
Hi Charli Ann,
I'm so sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy your pancakes. We take reviews seriously and use them to improve. I'm curious which ones you had - we have buttermilk, blue cornmeal, and this weekend we ran a peanut butter buttermilk special. Do you remember what you ordered? If you care to share more, we'd love to hear from you by email at hey@thenovacafe.com. Thanks so much for the feedback and we hope you'll give us another shot to do better.

name: Allison Miles
text: Super tasty breakfast! Coffee came promptly and was hot! Breakfast arrive and was exactly as the menu described. Minimal wait and prompt staff

resp.text: Thank you so much Allison! That is so good to hear as you hit on all the things we try hard to deliver. We very much appreciate your coming in and taking the time to leave such a nice and comprehensive review.

name: Dieter
text: Great breakfast food. French toast is 👌, but unfortunately the portion size is kind of small for the price.

resp.text: Hi Dieter, Thank you so much for the review. I'm glad to hear that you enjoy the French toast and will pass on the feedback about the portion size. We hope to see you again soon!

name: Montana Moments
text: Awesome place. The meat lovers omelette was hands down the best I've had in bozeman.

resp.text: Thank you Kelly! That is so wonderful to hear. We really appreciate the nice review.

name: Doreen Neely
text: Awesome little place with a cool vibe, friendly staff and fantastic food

resp.text: Thank you so much Doreen! That is really wonderful to hear and we appreciate the review.

name: Ruth Story
text: Love Nova! Great food and great variety including vegan choices.

resp.text: Thank you so much Ruth! That is so wonderful to hear. We try hard to make sure everyone can enjoy a tasty meal, and it's always great to hear that we accomplished our mission.

name: Nicholas Thomas
text: Bozemans best breakfast with the most moderately priced high quality local goods.  A lot of vegan and gluten free options as well as kid friendly.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the nice review Nicholas! We so appreciate the kind words about Nova, and  you hit on all the things we try so hard to provide. We appreciate it!

name: Kellyn V
text: Super fantastic food, we went for breakfast about 9 and the wait was 20 minutes. But it was definitely worth the wait! The waitress wasn't the best But she was extremely young, great atmosphere. Would recommend

resp.text: Thanks so much for the review. We strive to provide good customer service and use reviews to circle back with and encourage our employees to do better. We hope you'll give us another chance to wow you with customer service as well as food!

name: Providencia Stuart
text: I've been there countless times, and each visit lives up to its expectations: very friendly staff, and delicious food. They know how to cook, the flavor combinations work well together, the produces are fresh, local and/or organic, and the poached eggs are always cooked to perfection! Logical consequence is a packed place around brunch hours, but it's definitely worth the wait.

name: Tom Goldsmith
text: Wait times a little longer than previously. Food remains good, but a couple of orders were gotten wrong. Server was invisible when members of the party wanted coffee refills: come on, this is breakfast. Inconsistent with many prior meals, so we'll probably be back.

resp.text:
Hi Tom,
Thank you so much for letting us know about this. That is most definitely not the experience we want customers to have and feedback like yours helps us make sure that it doesn't happen again. We do hope that you will come back for another, better experience with us!

name: Joshua Huffman
text: Always a delight! They do simple very well and their staff are always super friendly and polite!

resp.text: Thank you Joshua! That's delightful to hear! We so appreciate your choosing to dine with us, and and the nice review.

name: Jenny Porter
text: Still one of my favorite breakfast places after all the years I have been here. The food is always amazing and the staff is just well....excellent. I love supporting this local restaurant!

resp.text:
Jenny,
Hooray! We're stoked to be one of your favorite places! Thank your for your support.

name: Jack McAllister
text: One of the breakfast staples in Bozeman. Healthy delicious food. Love the mermaid bowl/smoothie.

resp.text: Thank you Jack! We really appreciate the nice review and are so glad to hear that you have found a fave in the mermaid bowl. We look forward to seeing you again soon!

name: Ben Vanni
text: Had a great denver omelet. Big chunks of ham and very fluffy. Service was ordinary, but I wasn't looking for anything spectacular. Wish my omelet came with hashbrowns. Only got toast and there was jelly on the table. Jelly was in a jar of some type. Didn't use it, as that's kinda weird and seems unsanitary. Restrooms are unisex. I'm picky about chairs and their chairs slope back, making me feel like I'm in a recliner. Would like to try more of their menu. Some other items looked really good on paper, at least.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the detailed review. I'm so glad to hear that you enjoyed your omelette! We are always happy to provide our homefries with any entree. Your concern about the jam is totally understandable, but please know that we empty and clean the jam jars every night. That's great feedback about the chairs and we'll definitely keep it in mind when we're looking to replace them eventually. I hope you'll be able to come back and try something else on the menu. Thanks again for the feedback.

name: Fred Button
text: Enjoyed our breakfast here. Great food and ok service. I liked the Eggs Benedict and Meatloaf Special. They have gluten free muffins, scones, cookies, cake, and 2 types of bread. There's gonna be a wait on weekend mornings (unless you are there before 9) so be ready for that. But it's worth the wait so stick around!

resp.text: We are so glad that you enjoyed your breakfast! Thanks for taking the time to leave a review - we really appreciate it.

name: Jim D
text: Great place. Excellent biscuits and gravy

resp.text: Thank you so much Jim! That's wonderful to hear!

name: Eli Anselmi
text: Great place for breakfast! Always fresh and made to order. GF and DF options as well. Very reasonable prices! One of my go to places

resp.text: Thank you so much Eli! That's so wonderful to hear. We appreciate your taking the time to leave such a nice review!

name: Brittany Martin
text: My girlfriend and I ate here for lunch one day and got the vegan Veggie Rancheros and it was so delicious and such a big serving! They also have this California pepper sauce on the tables that is to die for. The decor is also very cute and retro, will hopefully return before we move! Thanks :)

name: Todd Lightfield
text: Great breakfast

resp.text: Thank you, Todd!

name: Sam Viall
text: One of the better and more interesting breakfast places in Bozeman. A little expensive and can be really busy on the weekends.

resp.text: Thank you so much for the review Sam! We really appreciate your visiting Nova and taking the time to leave such a nice and honest review. We hope to see you again soon.

name: Adam Broden
text: Great food great coffee great service and great atmosphere. If ur a friend of Bill come support another friend's success. If not then just come for the great environment. Highly recommended.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Adam! We really appreciate it!

name: Casey Chrison
text: Used to go there every morning for a hearty breakfast before training.  What i love about nova is all of the local fresh ingredients.  Omlete with potatoes inside mixed with your favorite mix ins is the way to go with some fresh squeezed juice.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the nice review Casey - we really appreciate it! Hope you're still able to make it in.

name: Joshua Francis
text: Great breakfast and lunch spot.

resp.text: Hooray! That's great to hear. Thank you so much Joshua!

name: Ce Ce
text: Delicious food, great coffee , super nice staff. I love the Tom Avo, it’s the best! It does get crowded so get there early otherwise it’s a wait.

resp.text: Thanks so much for the kind review CeCe! That's an excellent tip  - the early bird definitely gets breakfast, well, earlier!

name: Keith Aldrich
text: Awesome breakfast! We've always had good food here. The service is top-notch and you can tell the staff really love working there. Sometimes it is a bit packed and there is a bit of a wait but it's totally worth it.

resp.text:
Keith,
Our job is awesome, and we're glad it shows! Thank you for the accolades.

name: Monica A
text: I was excited to dine here and had high hopes based on reviews. They had a good selection of local items and offer GF options, but overall our food was not spectacular. The chai tea lacked flavor and tasted only like almond milk, and the potatoes were slightly burnt. The acai bowl was good and thankfully they use GF oats. The place overall felt a bit run down with a wall damaged from tables. I didn't care for the shared restrooms either.

resp.text: Hi Kohanaa, I'm so sorry to hear that you didn't enjoy your visit to Nova! We really appreciate the feedback and I will pass on to our team the notes about your chai and potatoes. We use reviews to  make sure we're doing the best possible job and we can't do that without customers like you reporting back on their experiences. We hope you'll dine with us again sometime so we can do a better job delivering delicious food.

name: Mickey Dayton
text: Handles large volume of customers well. Delicious food & friendly staff 👍😊

resp.text: Thank you so much Mickey! We really appreciate the nice review and are so glad to hear that you enjoy dining with us!

name: Jonathan Hilgeman
text:
There are so many good breakfast places in Bozeman that it's hard to declare any one of them the BEST but Nova Cafe would be in just about anyone's top 5 list.

We've come here for 3 years and have yet to have a bad experience. Great specials add to an already-fantastic menu. They serve up a nice variety of food (the Gusto Chorizo omelette is my personal go-to favorite), specialty sausages, traditional entries like pancakes and waffles and eggs and thick bacon, as well as some options for those who are more particular about their diet.

They also have a small selection of specialty smoothies that have all been delicious (we have tried 4 different ones to date), and their coffee is tasty.

The only problem is that there's only one Nova Cafe and that means there's usually a decent wait for a table (30-45 minutes on average at around 9 am on the weekends when walking in). However, you can still have free coffee while you wait, and read some of the various postings on their bulletin board or some of the magazines in their entry area, so it's not too bad of a wait.

name: Miranda Hodge
text:
Minus one star for me making reservations in advanced, only for us to wait twenty minutes because they forgot to set aside the table, while we watched them sit other customers. It was only after I continually complained that they finally got a table together.

Minus one star for the host's snarky attitude and general inability to make up for not having our reservation set up. I've been a hostess at one of the busiest brunch restaurants in Dallas. Not only did I always have the tables set up before hand, I had a chart where I marked tables off for reservations and communicated that with the bussing staff 30 minutes before the table arrived. NO ONE got set at a table that was marked off 30 minutes beforehand because we all know that no one eats and leaves within 30 minutes. It sucks for the waiter, perhaps, but when I waited I knew a table that was happy at sit down was one that paid well. So in the end it was worth it. This host never apologized and had to have the wait staff tell him to not sit tables in their section so that they could get two tables put together for us.

Minus one star for me having to leave because even when I expressed I am allergic to chili peppers, the hollandaise had some in it. I already took a bite. Weeks later, I am still suffering the consequences. My husband and sister tasted the hollandaise and even said it had a "bite" and they could taste it. I had to rush home to get my medication so I didn't go to the hospital.

I would rate one star, except I know they can do better. However, be wary to go to this place if you have allergies. They seem accommodating, but you will suffer the consequences, not them. Don't trust them. Otherwise, if you can handle the host ineptitude, you should enjoy yourself.

resp.text:
Hi Miranda,
We are SO sorry that you were accidentally served peppers in our restaurant! We do our very best to accommodate all food allergies, and we take them very seriously. We never ever want anyone to have a reaction to anything we serve them, and we are so terribly sorry that it happened to you. Something obviously went wrong somewhere between your table and the kitchen. Apologies as well for the wait and the unsatisfactory service. We will take this review as an opportunity to circle back with our staff to try and figure out where the communication broke down. We really appreciate your bringing it to our attention, and we very much hope that you'll give us another chance to do better.

name: Marilyn Oliver
text: Went to Scott's Table to celebrate friend's 50th Anniversary.  Great meal and great service

resp.text: Thanks for the positive review, Marilyn! Please also leave one for Scotty's Table, if you feel so inclined :)

name: Jerry Mumm
text: Best sound system.....3 bars, no wait. Go see your favorite band here, you will have a great time.

name: Craig Walker
text: A Missoula Classic, intimate, yet room to dance, seating recently reworked brilliantly. Top notch Line Array PA, no need for earplugs. Eat downstairs at Scotty's Table, highly recommend as well.

resp.text: Thank you Craig!

name: sabrina bayha
text:
Big enough venue to feel like a huge concert and small enough also to feel like the band is playing just for you. ❤️🎸
There is a balcony if you want to sit and relax . All the views to the stage are good up there. Down below in front of the stage is room enough to dance, although sometimes it gets tight, way tight. Most concerts do though, right? They have bars where you can order beer, wine and every kind of cocktail, bourbon and whiskeys.
This place is great and being right downtown by the river it's awesome to walk around before and after the show.👍🎸

name: Korey Hayden
text: Awesome venue for concerts...not big and open like an outdoor, but not small and confined like a basement or bar concert, its perfect for an indoor good size show. The,  Hellyeah & Nonpoint,12-3-19 concert was another great show.... Lots of room, audio and visuals were on point....unlike in the last few years, all around a great setup!

resp.text: Thanks Korey! Glad you had fun!

name: Think
text: After the renovation the acoustics are way better, I always have fun there.

resp.text: Thanks for the review!

name: Martha Stewart
text: Hi, I'm Kaelei Trontel 👋 My husband Reed & I are locals (Whitefish, MT) who love to enrich people's lifestyles with suggestions and ideas! ....  we stayed in an apartment AIR BNB above the Wilma.  As a Real Estate Agent in the Flathead Valley I loved the apartment.  It is definitely a place I'd want to buy!!  We loved it more than staying at our favorite hotel in Missoula!

resp.text: Thanks Kaelei!

name: Deb Meyer
text: This is my favorite venue over all others to see live music! Never disappointed with the acoustics, volume and balcony to be able to sit and enjoy the show! 😍😎👍

name: Rashelle Ross
text: I went to the Milky Chance show and had an amazing night! I absolutely love the remodel of the Wilma. Great crowd flow with a feel good atmosphere! With the upper balcony seats it made for a great viewing platform! I am definitely going again soon!

name: Julie Small
text: Seen a couple shows there so far. The acoustics are great and the old building is gorgeous.

resp.text: Thanks for coming, Julie!

name: Hamdroid Crandroid
text: Felt close everywhere... really well laid out and an amazing sound system. The lighting was great too. Can't go wrong with this venue.

resp.text: Wow, thanks Hamdroid!

name: Loklin Nord
text: Interior looks amazing after the revamped it recently. Was able to play there with my string trio. Had lots of fun, and the room sounded awesome.

resp.text: Thanks for coming Loklin!

name: Anna Moura
text: Beautiful, Spacious and always a great venue for shows. Two bars that they work quickly if there is a line. The shows booked have been great each time and still feels intimate, no matter where you stand and watch. If anyone visits and has never been to this venue, I let them know they won't be disappointed at all. I love The Wilma!

name: Shawna Pratt
text: Such a fabulous venue! Not a bad seat in the house! We saw Melissa Etheridge and she was amazing!

name: Trenton Thomas
text: It's a little pricey but well worth it. The people who come are so good and the performances are professional. Just be ready to pay a lot for food and drinks.

resp.text: Thank you  for  your honest feedback & support, Trenton!

name: Eli Nyght
text: Saw the Adam Trent holiday magic show at the Wilma tonight. It was fantastic and the venue is great. Love the remodel. Tremendous location.

resp.text: That was a great show! Glad you enjoyed, Eli :)

name: Bill Duffey
text: Fun spot to stay -- the restaurant is very good

resp.text: Thanks, Bill!

name: Miranda Jane
text: rarely have ever had pleasant experiences here. staff comes off as very aggressive, and the locals are a bit defensive and unfriendly. an EMT here once told me to go bl*w some random dude so I can afford to travel to another show. very tasteful. support more DIY scenes and you wont get treated like human garbage y'all

name: Bob Wood
text: The old Wilma is a beautiful venue.  It has a great sound system. The place is wonderful.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback, Bob!

name: Bearcat Şándor
text: The Wilma is a great venue to see a show. While the stage isn't big enough for bands with large stage shows such as Kiss or Metallica, it's a perfect stage for medium bands. Even in the balcony you feel close, you can see everything and the sound is clear. The Gin Blossoms were awesome here.

name: Hannah Woods
text: Seats are WAY too crammed. My knees were hitting the seat in front of me, even if I shifted diagonally in my seat. We pay a lot of money to sit there for a couple hours. Make it more comfortable.

name: J S
text: Great venue for live music!

resp.text: Wonderful to hear JS!

name: Jason Wilhelm
text: One of my favorite venues, great staff,  good selection of shows and the sounds and lights are some of the best.

name: Diana Nettleton
text: I've attended several concerts here. I love that the owners maintained the historic architecture, because I think creates a definite Missoula level concert experience.

resp.text: Thanks Diana! Glad you noticed the historic integrity :)

name: K Johnson
text: Saw the Struts here in July. One of my top 5 concerts for sure. Loved the venue. Greqt atmosphere and accoustics. After my first show there, I will definitely be back for more.

resp.text: That was a killer show. Thanks for visiting K!

name: Funko Fun87
text: Amazing venues awesome staff great security make America rock agian tour was amazing. Kido to the Wilma for hosting suck an epic night!

name: Earnest Bennett
text: Excellent concert venue. Beautiful old building that has been refurbished. Eat before the show, no food available inside. But plenty of great options in downtown Missoula before a show.

name: Katherine Taylor
text: Classy, intimate, beautiful venue...from Slayer to Melissa Ethridge...heck yea.

name: Jeff Woods
text: I found this a great place to see a show. The Wilma is an awesome combination of historic and modern. Very cool antique type walls and chandeliers but modern bathrooms. It's an "intimate" experience because it is not too big. There is not a bad seat in the house, with a pretty good amount of seating in the balcony. The staff was professional and courteous. I will look forward to seeing another show at The Wilma. Also when I called I was actually talked to patiently when asking questions.

name: William Frank
text: This is probably the best venue in Missoula to watch a live act the acoustics are phenomenal the historic setting is spectacular.  If you get a chance to go watch a concert there do it you will not be disappointed.

name: Corey Wahl
text: Excellent venue for concerts and performances.  The sound system is top notch!

resp.text: Glad you enjoyed, Corey!

name: Kim Hulla
text: The Wilma has been beautifully re-modeled while retaining it's historical feel. It is mostly a concert venue & is attracting great talent. It used to show mostly movies & still dies every now & then. I wish they would show more. There are 2 full bars & food service in a limited amount.

name: Mickelle
text: This is an awesome theater that combines the an old time feel to the ambiance of it's downtown location. I would always come here to watch the wildlife film festival when I was in school, and I go to showings of movies here occasionally too. The theater is beautiful and has a real charm to it.

resp.text: Thanks Mickelle!

name: Denise Zbozny
text: Historical architectural gem that is a landmark for Missoula. Great acoustics make it a lovely venue for shows. If you haven't been there yet, go!

name: Kwyn Ragen
text: Beautiful inside and out. Size is right between accommodating and comfortable. Must see for Missoula traveles.

resp.text: Thanks you Kwyn!

name: Lorrie Brown
text: Beautifully restored historic theater

name: French Faguette
text: Always love coming here for concerts. Staff are always friendly and approachable. Professional. Sound and setup is always great!

name: Mandi Edwards
text: Gorgeous venue! I'll come back over and over again!! Head of security, Goldie, is the nicest guy ever!! He's so accommodating to my disability needs! Thank you!! ✌💙🎶

name: Nathan Pilon
text: This place is so cool it's kind of the center of the Higgins downtown district right next to Caras Park. A lot happening here and definitely worth visiting.

resp.text: Gotta love downtown :) Thanks Nathan!

name: Benjamin Laster
text: Best indoor venue in Montana.  State of the art sound system.

resp.text: Wow, thanks for the kind words, Benjamin!

name: Nevin Graves
text: We had a fantastic time at The Dirty Sexy Chocolate Show. We saw the later performance, and the view from Row C, house right, was perfect. I'm always blown away by how grand the theater looks since the remodel, and the acoustics were right on the money. This is a great space for live theatre and music, the seating is very comfortable and the staff are very professional.

resp.text: Thank you Nevin!

name: Nathan Stone
text: Great place to see a show, easy access, several drink bars and lots of options for moving around the space.

resp.text: Thanks for the great feedback, Nathan!

name: Haley Cohen
text: Saw Glen Hansard show. The venue is beautiful. Seats are comfortable. Would go to another show here.

name: Karen Hutchison
text: This is an excellent event venue. It's a beautiful historic building with an intimate setting yet has been modernized to be comfortable. Do not miss it if you're in Missoula!

name: Danielle Martin
text: The venue is so intimate, you feel like you can touch the artist even if you're in the farthest seat in the house! Beer prices are cheap too!!

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Danielle :)

name: Adams Landscape
text: Great place for a concert. No matter where you were felt like you were right next to the stage

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Adams!

name: Jordan Smith
text: I had so much fun seeing The Melvins in concert here. I'll definitely consider driving 5 hours to see concerts in Missoula again.

resp.text: Stellar show! Thanks Jordan.

name: Beacon Apuzzo
text: Such a cool theater in a cool riverfront location.

resp.text: Thanks, Beacon!

name: Matthew Swanson
text:
Went to see the Moth show. The show was excellent, the venue amazing.
Fully restored to it's original glory, the Wilma is an active hub of Missoula activities that retains the amazing craftsmanship and detail with which it was built.
One of the most beautiful theatres I have been in.

name: Debra Crawford
text: The Wilma is a beautiful venue that has wonderful seating and acoustics. I have seen many different concerts there and have enjoyed every one!

name: Craig Flint
text:
It's been a great place for shows for years, but it's so much better now than it used to be.  They're getting so many great acts now... they're killing.
The staff are friendly, the sound is great, the location is killer.

name: Brent Sullivan
text: Great venue with amazing shows.

resp.text: Thank you very much!

name: Michael Dyon
text: Love the venue, but bad crowd hum, but that could just be too many posers gabbing

resp.text: Thanks for the review Michael.

name: Daddy Wilson
text: Breath taking architecture and a gorgeous venue! Built for sounds and Grand stage performances.

resp.text: Glad you enjoyed, David !

name: Amy McKinley
text: I adore the Wilma! Staff is friendly and bouncers work hard to keep everyone cool! Goldie is awesome!

resp.text: Thanks Amy!

name: Michael Cassens
text: What a treat having a venue like this in town for our musicians.  I am always happy to go here for a concert.  Thanks for adding to the community.

name: Sandy Gates
text: The Wilma is an iconic Missoula landmark. Since the new owners went in and completely revamped the seating and sound, the place is amazing. The interior is a step back in time while the sound quality is superior. I saw The Indigo Girls and felt like I was sitting in the stage! Beer, wine and snacks are served as well. The Wilma is right in downtown Missoula so you can make a day of it before your event.

name: Hadley Youbles
text: The Historic Wilma is always a pleasure to visit whether its for a concert or any other event. Beautiful building and location.

name: B. Navy
text: This gorgeous gilded age theater produces incredible sound in a towering open space complete with period ceiling fixtures and panelling.. during a live event it's easy to imagine the performers and audiences that have passed through going back almost a century now. From the balcony seating, cell phones glow below creating a very anachronistic scene if you're​ inclined to picture it.

name: j w
text: Great concert venue! Handicap seating was awesome.  Melissa Etheridge rocks!

name: jeff osborne
text: A theater I remember from my youth now a fun small venue for live music

name: Donna Budd
text:
Great concerts here. Sound system is great
too. Can order drinks, has bar upstairs & down.

resp.text: Thank you Donna!

name: misty finks
text: The Wilma Rocks! Watch out for the nice new laminated flooring.  It's slippery when wet!

resp.text: Thank you Misty!

name: Katie Engwall
text: Every concert here has been a blast! Love the location downtown close to bars and hotels! So much fun!

name: Kari Kalous
text: Such a great venue, and not a bad seat in the house. We had a blast!!

name: Josh Erickson
text: Went to a concert here. Very nice venu.

resp.text: Thank you Josh!

name: Bob S.
text: Reminiscent of some smaller Seattle venues. Decent sound system, and a fair amount of space. Drink prices aren't terrible for being a theater either.

name: kashya boretsky
text: A beautiful venue with excellent sound quality with both seated and standing events. Lots of great concerts, festivals, and other performances offered. The only reason to not give The Wilma 5 stars is due to the obnoxious audiences; lately every time I've gone to an event here, people have been treating it more like a bar and have been talking loudly and being disruptive the whole time. text:
A beautiful and historic venue for films, concerts, and performances of all kinds right in the center of town.  A nostalgic and glamorous recreation, the Wilma is worn but only in such a way as to give it personality.  As for the events themselves' besides a wide range of concerts of every genre and degree of fame (from locals right on up to world-class touring artists) which are truly excellent, the Wilma also hosts various independent films and renowned festivals including the Big Sky Documentary Film Festival.

For being so high-class and central, it shouldn't be surprising that it's also very expensive, with tickets selling fast and long lines getting in.  As long as you are able to pull it off, though, everything will suddenly seem worth it in one of the countless awesome experiences held inside.

Look for the flashing sign on the building next to the riverfront.

text: Went to Shovels and Rope at the beginning of the month and was very disappointed with this venue. Ever since the remodel the Wilma has been more bar than theater. The wall that used to separate the drink area from the theater was really essential. Now all the chatter from around the bars competes with the music and people forget they're at a concert. If Nick Checota wants to turn the Wilma into a bar fine, it's his business, but stop advertising it as a theater because it's not anymore. There is also always an issue with the sound. At this concert the lows were dropping out and rumbling for quite awhile. With as much money as was put into the sound system it's amazing that they can't find someone who knows how to run it.

resp.text: It is always interesting when reviewers do not use real names for their profile. It makes it hard to decipher the real motivations of a reviewer, particularly when they personalize by calling out the name of the venue owner. Regardless, sound is run by the tour, not the venue.  This is customary in the industry. With respect to the bar comment, the Wilma, as with almost every major concert venue in the united states, has bars inside the venue so the customer does not have to leave the show.  Again, this is very common and is the case for venues such as the 930 Club, the Fox, the Ogden, the Showbox, the Orange Peel, etc.  We do not advertise as a theater, but do consider ourselves a concert venue.

text: I always love stopping by the big dipper when I have a few bucks to spend on some velvety yum yum ice cream 🍦 🍨 they are one of the best in town...They have convenient parking for you while you wait, as well as handicap parking for those handicapable of us out there!!! ALL ARE WELCOME!!! 5 🌟 ⭐ 🌟 ⭐🌟 ACROSS THS BOARD!!

name: Joel S.
text:
Best local ice cream shop around!
Try it, you'll love it.

name: Kevin Goltz
text: Ice cream so good you'll want seconds!  The staff is friendly and quick to serve. This isn't the ordinary I've cream Hotspot. It has a good vibe that served with every cone. Summer, Fall,Winter & Spring.  Go get some!

name: Scott Phares
text:
Really, really good, especially after a fantastic dinner at Ciao Mambo...!
I ordered one scoop of the tangerine sorbet in a cup and I swear that I got a pint! It was fantastic but I couldn't finish it all, unless I wanted permanent brain freeze.
HIGHLY recommended.

name: Summer Sims
text: Our kids loved the huckleberry ice cream cones, the sundae with two scoops is more than enough to share with more than two people. Our son couldn’t finish his root beer float it was two big coming from an 8 yr old. The outdoor seating is perfect they have a mix between shady and sunny spots.

name: Martin Michael
text: Local favorite in Missoula and almost every time we went, we would have to wait in line. Luckily their service is fast and first class. Love it.

name: Angel
text: A Missoula tradition, the line is half the fun and the treats are tops!

name: Caleb Plumlee
text: Espresso shakes. Do it

name: Derek Thrush
text: One of my favorite ice cream places in all of MT! However, I am always open to new places to try. In my opinion this is one not to be missed.

name: Baha
text: Tasty nice. Fast service. Little bit pricely. Nice parking space. So many different options

name: Marne Slife
text: The flavors were amazing, scoop size not like they advertise but enough.

name: Kayla Mae
text: Would be way better if they put chocolate in the bottom of their waffle cones.

name: Joseph Stewart
text: I'll grant the fact that Big Dipper ice cream is fantastic, but that said, you'll definitely pay DEARLY for it! Case-in-point? A week or so ago, the wife dropped by Big Dipper and paid something like $11.50 for a single QUART (not a half gallon)!! Yes, it's tasty stuff, but let's face it - its milk and sugar, not gold bullion! The fact is, the overall cost of living in Missoula is rapidly surpassing almost anywhere else in the late-great-state of Montana, and this tends to be typical for college towns, where students often get their funding from well-to-do parents, or better yet, from bottomless federal student loans (that are all likely to default soon), but unfortunately, the permanent residents among us, who actually still work for a living, have to be a bit more frugal with our finances. Sorbet, anyone?? ;-)

name: Jaclyn Bell
text: Tasty ice cream, lots of flavours, and the option to dip your cone in chocolate! They had huckleberry flavour, which was very good. Quite a few picnic tables outside to eat at. While I was eating, I heard someone saying that there was a secret flavour (chocolate huckleberry) that they were going to serve him.

name: Brian Mccoy
text: Got the best ice cream in town just like Billings

name: Jason Murray
text: Good tasting icecream and the wafflecones are really good as well.

name: Jerry Buck
text: If you love ice cream, you'll love Big Dipper! Their homemade style ice cream is some of the best that you can get in the area. Its a great location just downtown with a small town feel, and great views. You'll love it!

name: Brenda Jones
text: Yummy!!😋 My favorite is the coconut in a fresh made waffle cone dipped in chocolate sprinkled with nuts!

name: Robert Wanberg
text: There are plenty of flavors to choose from, and they're all delicious. The texture of the ice cream is rich and creamy. Absolutely fantastic overall. I would definitely recommend trying samples of  cardamom and/or black licorice.

name: Jon Robichaud
text:
For local homemade ice cream this place is great. The smell of the waffle cone 2 blocks away seals the deal.

The staff is super nice and friendly and the sample sizes are spot on. A must if passing through town.

name: Brandon Wasser
text: A wonderful local handmade ice cream window.  There is no inside seating,  but that won't stop crowds from lining up all year long. Expect a line nearly any time,  but it's worth the wait.  Great ice creams and some wild and unique flavors.

name: Luciano Rosas
text: Always 5 stars

name: Aaron Broxterman
text: If give it 5 stars buy I have a moral obligation to remove 1 star from any place that makes green tea ice cream

name: Nikki Bond
text: We visited on an overcast day when it was not very warm and there was a long line when we arrived and when we left. Definitely a favorite for locals. The picnic tables provided a good place to visit and people watch. The ice cream was wonderful. We all enjoyed it. Plenty of flavors to choose from and some rather interesting combos as well. Well worth a visit.

name: Hannah Moore
text: They have doggie ice cream!

name: Denise Zbozny
text: Update: very nice system setup for social distancing with blue squares to show where to stand. Everyone waiting and serving wore face masks. One line was for ordering with a separate line for picking up your order. Of course, the Big Dipper ice cream is the best! Thank you for making it easy to satisfy my ice cream craving during COVID-19.

name: Jennifer Frazer
text: Not to miss stop in Missoula. Love their cardamom, tried their Mexican chocolate with it. Great combination.

name: Rae Lund
text: Big Dipper is such a treat! The ice cream is wonderfully tasty! I sneak some when I can. Okay I will fess up...I am diabetic and ice cream really messes with my blood sugar. But it's so good. Just once in a while.

name: Deangela Khan
text: Great ice cream and personnel is always so friendly. They are generous with their scoops and there are lines even in the winter. Says a lot about the strong client base and it is well earned.

name: Andrew Butler
text: Best ice cream spot in town, and a great place to find a confusingly long line in January. Friendly service as well.

name: Laura B.
text: Seriously such delicious ice cream! While on the pricier end, it was worth how much you got and how delicious it was. I will definitely be stopping by again! Plus, the workers were very kind in helping us choose flavors.

text: I just paid $5 for a 16 oz shake that I could have gotten at Wendy's. This "sea salted chocolate" shake tastes exactly like a frosty. Pathetic. I only got it because they were, as always, out of the only flavor they came up with that was worth buying this summer at the prices this place charges for the same flavors literally everyone else has. I should have just turned around and left with nothing but i didnt want to leave empty handed after a 30 minute wait in line with zero shade.

text: We love this place. Yummy unique ice cream flavors, very personable staff and love that it's open until 11pm! The long lines are evidence that everything is delicious and they move surprisingly fast. Perfect for a late night treat.

name: Madison Bertin
text: Great place to get ice cream on a hot day or in the middle of winter. The line gets to be quite long, but the staff is always friendly and the specialty flavors are worth it. Pro Tip: you can get your cone chocolate dipped for like 50¢ extra. It's definitely worth it :)

name: Brian Powers
text: They don’t even let a global pandemic stop you from getting ice cream. Highly recommend!

text: 🍨🍦Big Scoops!🍦🍨 Friendly Service and always a good variety of flavors.

name: Marx3012
text: The Mexican chocolate ice cream in shake form is truly to absolutely die for! Love BD.

name: Susan Tash
text: Best ice cream in town! Unique flavors!

name: Michele Crepeau
text: OMG! Big Dipper Ice Cream is out of this world. The coconut ice cream is to die for. Big Dipper makes their own ice cream. It's the real thing. Real milk, real cream, real sugar, real flavors. Like cardamom? They've got it. Yellow cake? Check. El Salvador chocolate? You bet. Bubble gum? Mocha chip? Espresso Heath? Salted caramel? All of them and more! If you're in Helena or Missoula, make sure to stop in and grab a cone, sundae, shake, or float. Pick up a pint or a quart and take it with you. You won't be sorry!

name: Jessica Huggans
text: I had their huckleberry ice cream. It was so delicious and flavorful! Would go back for that again!!

name: Christopher Mendenhall
text: The icecream is fantastic, and homemade cones!  Rain,shine,snow there is always a line, it's that good.

name: Curtis Medina
text: The best, freshest, tastiest flavors of ice cream I've ever had, anywhere. Big Dipper has what it takes to go the distance and be as big and successful as they want to be, easily besting known brands such as Baskin Robbins & Dairy Queen. Their customer service is fast and polite, even when a line is literally going around the block. People wait, socialize & brave cold and wet weather just to get a tasty treat. Once you get to the front, you will be brought a sample flavor if you ask and then you'll have your order in just a minute or two. Every bite of ice cream has an amazing slightly chewy texture, which melts in your mouth. Flavors are anything but boring, changing daily and having some that are always available. My favorite regular flavor is Salted Caramel, but their Huckleberry and Mexican Chocolate are great as well.  They also have vegan sherbet options every day. This is one of Missoula and Montana's most beloved businesses.

name: Bradley Wyss
text: I can't give enough positive comments about this place.  I will happily go to an early diabetus-induced grave one milkshake at a time . Get a milkshake with espresso and malt with the Mexican chocolate flavor and thank me later.

name: Mckay Jolley
text: This place us good if you want some great ice cream. There waffle cones are delicious. I has the root beer float and it tasted great!!!

name: Jonathan Erler
text: When I went to college in Missoula I would clean out my change bowl and spend it all at big dipper.  You always want to try the seasonal flavors, but then you have your go to standards. This means you make multiple trips... And then you want more.  Worth it at any season!

name: Seth Lowe
text: Very good locally made ice cream. Very friendly staff! I love their ice cream and they have different specials all the time, suggested by people in the community. Kinda of priceyer when it comes to ice cream, but it is well worth it as it is truly some quality ice cream.

text: My daughter loves this place.  The tangerine is her favorite.  Last time we were they, my little girl immediately dropped hers on the ground.  I offered to buy another, but they went ahead and gave her another for free.  Very nice.  The place can get busy, but the line moves nicely if the three windows are open.

name: Jena Kaske
text: If you have never been to this ice cream place, it is absolutely wonderful. The customer service has always been great to me, I always leave happy. The ice cream is delicious, White Mint Oreo and Mexican Chocolate are two of my favorites, but it's hard to truly decide! I love that you can also buy containers of different sizes of one flavor, for when you just wanna go to town on one flavor. One of my favorite places here.

name: Noah H
text: Very disappointing, took our out of state relatives to enjoy what was suppose to be great ice cream, only to have a blonde woman take the order, then mess up the order, and then tried to accuse my family for her mistake. She accused them of ordering it wrong, when it was her mistake and then she made a big deal about it..  Not a professional way of handling customers, sad... 🤨

name: Linda Skow
text: Not a fan, they get you with homemade but don’t tell you ifs artificially made. I’ve gotten sick both times having the ice cream so the 2nd time I asked what the ingredients were, I regret not doing that first.

resp.text: Hello Linda. Just seeing this. Our ice cream base mix that goes into every flavor is all natural. Most of our flavors that we have are also all natural, including Vanilla (using pure vanilla), Chocolate and Coffee to name a few. Some of the add ins like Oreos have artificial ingredients and other flavors like Bubblegum also have artificial ingredients. If you would like to give us another shot, I can point you in the right direction for natural flavors and even buy your next cone. Thanks, Bryan  info@bigdippericecream.com

name: Brandon Walker
text: Ice cream was excellent and prices were fair

name: Terry Peterson
text: Home made style ice cream what's not to love?

name: Sarah Vinton
text: A must go in Missoula. Great homeade ice cream flavors- regular flavors and rotating flavors. They are always popular and busy- for good reasons!

name: Joseph Licitra
text: I do not know anywhere else, where there is a line around the block for ice cream, in 25 degree weather. There are a  large variety of flavors, both classic and exotic: Mexican chocolate, green tea, black licorice, huckleberry, etc. The best waffle cone I've ever had. The texture of the cream is like none other. Worth the wait.

name: Sheldon Tosh
text: Best ice cream in Missoula. There are many exotic and normal flavors here, where they make their own ice cream. Can be crowded but the wait is definetely worth it. 5 stars!

name: Jennifer Vogsland
text: Big dipper is the best ice cream in Missoula!

text: Amazing ice cream. But if I have to wait in a long line the wraps around the building. At least have some free wifi that I can use on my phone while I wait. You have so much money. Just get some wifi

name: tunA Kuru
text: If anyone had told me I would find such good ice cream in Montana, there is no way I would believe them.  I love ice cream, the real ice cream, not slushy or soft, creamy sweet whipped cream.. not frozen yogurt. Ice cream. And this is what is made here at Big Dipper. I wish there was one in Bozeman where I live. Salted Caramel is my favorite and I usually get the second scoop from one of the daily specials. It's a must try for anyone visiting Missoula.

name: Andrew Johnson
text: ICE CREAM! It's outstanding. They also have dog cones!  A note to my fellow customers. If the line is long on a hot day please don't get a dozen samples for your bratty kids, it's inconsiderate. It's ice cream, they'll like it no matter what flavor it is.

Loved the fact that they allow you to sample ice cream before purchasing. Not one bad flavor! But for me, Chocolate Whiskey is hands down the best!!!

name: Rachel Gordon
text: Had the special lemon and basil sorbet in a sugar cone and it was wonderful! Such a fun environment with great service. The line was long but only served to show how great the ice cream is!

name: Beth Wood

name: Adam Gray

It's worth the experience for sure. Plus they have some unique flavors.

One of the best places in Missoula.  If I lived closer I'd be broke and weigh 500 pounds.  I judge ice cream on vanilla... if you can get vanilla ice cream right, then you're doing it right.  These guys have killer vanilla/vanilla bean.  I haven't made it through many of the flavors but all the ones I've tried are tops.

The community scene is important and a big part of the experience.  You'll run into someone you know or make a pal as you're waiting to order.  And not trying to be the biggest shop keeps the quality the best.

text:
The best ice cream place in the West!  Great atmosphere, low prices and amazing ice cream.  They cover all the bases with a large selection of homemade flavors and spice things up a bit (both figuratively and literally) with experimental special flavors every week.  Some of my favorites include Tipu's Chai and Cold Smoke (both made with ingredients from other local shops).  Toppings and specials are both standard and all-inclusive; nothing especially exciting here but if you've had it before chances are they'll serve it here.

The community centered around Big Dipper is unique as it has become a staple of Missoula food.  Everybody in town knows and loves it, and on hot summer days it can become crowded -- sometimes too crowded.  Still, the ice cream is well worth the wait and chances are you can strike up a good conversation with someone else in line.

Definitely one of my favorite places to grab a treat.  Try it, you won't regret it.

resp.text: Sorry you had a bad experience. Please let us know if we can do anything to make up for it!

name: Jaclyn Bell
text: I went on this ride with my mom and thoroughly enjoyed it. I think we were the only adults on the ride that had come without children. It was very fast and a very long ride. If you get an outside horse, you have a chance to win a free ride if you're able to grab a ring on the way by. I thought it was very interesting that everyone was required to wear a seatbelt on the horse.

name: Kerri S
text: My daughter has never been on a carousel & she loved it! She was so excited to ride the horses & was so proud of herself that she got to finally be a dragon rider. Her dad grew up coming here & they had lots of fun riding together. We'll definitely be back!

resp.text: So glad to hear you and your family had a good time. It is definitely fun to ride a dragon!

name: Josh Bethke
text: I have been going here almost every time I  drive the 400 plus miles to get here. I love it!!  Got to get the ring for another ride.

resp.text: Thanks for always keeping us in your plans.

name: Rachel Gordon
text: This is such a fun fun fun place to bring kids and adults of all ages. I always have such a good time and it is a staple within the Missoula community. I would say that this is a MUST for anyone visiting the area. This is also a great venue for a birthday party for a littler kid, but it would still be enjoyable even for an older kids party or even a retirement party.

name: Barbara Belize
text:
Fun for the whole family or date night. Anyone.
Historical info & pics...like mini museum.
Great gift shop.
Walking trails along river.
A variety of shops & restaurants in walking distance.
The carousel even has the old fashioned brass rings to grab!

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed your visit to the Carousel. Thank you for the lovely review.

name: Meg Maul
text: Enchanting! And very friendly staff.

name: jesse granger
text: What an awesome place. At over 100 years old and one of the fastest in north America. The kids had a great time!

name: miss buchanan
text: I had to pleasure of learning about the work and craftsmanship of this Missoula carousel. The horses are hand carved and painted. It's a wonderful place for families! Must see when visiting Missoula with young kids! :)

resp.text: So glad you stopped by. Come back anytime.

name: JW E
text: Amazing piece of history. The kids loved it! They could ride all day. They had rings that came out of a dragons mouth that the kids would have to try and grab as they went around. That kept them engaged during the ride. If you get the last ring you win a free ride. The lady working it was awesome. They even offer a room to veiw the history of it all. Lots of seating for adults. For .75 cents you can't beat it!

resp.text: Thanks for all the great comments. We love hearing that people had a great time with us. Hope you will come back soon.

name: Bootsie Louise
text: After checking their website AND Google hours to make sure they were open today, Sunday January 19th, I lugged both kids 30miles into town for a special time at the Carousel. When we got there, loaded my handicap child into his special needs stroller and collected my bag, we were greeted with a closed Carousel. I just wanted to tell them THANKS A LOT.

text: Always a fun experience!

resp.text: Sounds like you are a repeat customer. Thanks for coming back and for all the stars.

resp.text: Aw, thanks. We love making kids happy.

resp.text: Thanks, Jenna, for the kind words and great review. Happy New Year!

text: Heart of our community, and special needs friendly!! The staff is always kind and accommodating for special needs and it's affordable plus a ton of fun!

resp.text: I'm so glad you are a fan. When we reopen on Saturday, we will be fresh, clean and ready for another year!

name: Bob Broughton
text: Had a party for a friends little daughter. Fun place for kids with the beautiful carousel ride. Party room was too small. You need to bring everything ( utensils, plates, etc) but the kids and parents loved the carousel

resp.text: Hi, Daniel. Nice to hear from a former employee. We find as the machine gets older and the population gets larger (the mechanism was built in 1918, when people were significantly smaller) sometimes the rides get unbalanced and throw off the balance of the frame. We can usually fix it by running an empty ride or two, but occasionally a row gets way out of whack and we have to rope it off until the mechanics can rebalance the whole thing. We try to keep rides balanced to avoid the problem, but that's not always possible. I hope you'll come back to give us another chance! Theresa

name: Alex Anderlik
text:
Truly one of the greatest carousels in the country in terms of quality and fun.  The attention to detail put into the carousel, from the moving facade on the pipe organ with a selection of specially-written music, to the decor on the inside and outside of the building, to the dragon-shaped stand holding rings which riders reach for in hopes of getting the brass (and a free ride), to the several dozen unique, intricately hand-carved horses, I'm not being too dramatic to call this a work of art.

While obviously made with children in mind, the atmosphere and fun can really be enjoyed by anyone; this carousel spins much faster than any other I've ever seen, which is exhilarating as a child and is still amusing after growing up.

Plus, the carousel is nicely placed in between the event-filled Caras Park and the similarly medieval-themed Dragon's Hollow playground which is large and intricate enough to entertain on its own.  As such it is perfectly situated next to the river as well as the most active areas of downtown Missoula.

The absolute perfect place to go for taking kids, whether on their own for a bit of fun or in groups as a visit or a nice party venue.   Even adults can come to appreciate the volunteer-made art and architecture, and - hell, who are you kidding, get a token and go for a ride!

name: Forsaken One
text: Wonderfully laid out book store with local authors, Sunday New York Times, fun toys and writing stuff, as well as reviews and recommendations from staff. Host all kinds of events, book groups, and signings. A must Email list to get on. Great place to inspire your own reading or find that perfect gift for a fellow reader!

name: Brian Globerman
text: Friendly people, good selection of books is local interest. Book readings, community oriented.

name: ironman80us
text: What a great bookstore! I thought the "Blind Date With a Book" shelf is a brilliant idea.

name: Erin E. Gunnink Troth
text: I love my local indie bookstore! These guys are great, and they're always willing to order me books that aren't in stock. Books usually only take a couple of days to arrive.

name: William Thorburn
text: Cool local bookstore with jazz playing in the background while you walk the stacks, right in the middle of downtown Bozeman

name: Steve Darnell
text: Just a great local bookshop to visit.

name: Joseph Bernhardt
text: I'm surprised it's taken me so long to review the Country Bookshelf.  It seems like I'm visiting this store at least once a month.  I rely heavily on the employee recommendations for my next reading adventure, and it's rare that one of those recommendations leaves me disappointed.  Reading is a personal experience.  The Country Bookshelf does an extraordinary job in recognizing that and catering to their customers.  This locally owned shop will outlast all the big box stores.

name: Patrick Gescheidle
text: Great bookstore right downtown. Wide selection including staff picks.

name: Brandi Wright
text: Love and enjoy this independent bookstore. Knowledgeable staff and great selection.

name: Calvin Andrews
text: Great book selection and staff

name: Nina Mondré Schweppe
text: Decent selection of books and prices. Dog friendly 🐻

name: Adria Brandvold
text: Great selection of local authors.

name: Tara Fincher

name: Julie Hunter

name: Karen Foust

name: Bill Eickman

name: Jamie Hyem

Bonus points for great Montana author selection and frequent, facinating and free author​ readings. Fantastic kid's section, gifts, notebooks, and they special order. Always worth a visit.
