name: Amanda Magill
text: One of the most beautiful places I've been to! Such a relaxing place to camp and lots of great hiking everywhere around you! Plus the wildlife is amazing.

name: Les Rispens
text: Great campground along willow creek. Lots of shade. It is limited to 22 foot campers. The spots are just big enough to get you camper and your tow vehicle side by side. Gravel road and camp spots. Toilets are not handicapped accessible, but otherwise functional. Lots of ATV riding in the area, but they camp East of the campground.

name: John Hoyt
text: Nice, quiet campground (minus water noise) . Deffinitely not much room if you were pulling a trailer. Lots of moose in the area. Good size spots for tents or small campers.

name: kim lee
text: Lovely campground! Beautiful area with a hotsprings nearby. We did get our camper stuck on a sharp turn, but the next day we had so many people helping us!

name: William Donaldson
text: Rustic,  outhouses (sometimes out of toilet paper), tight quarters.  The suggested length limit is 22', and we would agree. In the trees so mostly shaded, next to or by the creek. Not sure about the fishing, but a natural cooler, and the kids like to play in it (supervised). No loud parties, quiet time is enforced. Good place for family. 5 miles of rough narrow road to get in but we like it.

name: Naomoi Connell
text:
Road is really bad getting back to campsite. Free camping, awesome. Flooded and established camping unavailable when we got there...not so awesome.
Would gladly have paid a fee to camp if it meant road maintenance!

name: Daniel Bryce
text:
Large, rustic camp.  Water available.  Mike hike to hot springs.  I’ve heard local hillbillies sometimes kick people out, but I didn’t run into them.

Camp host was skinny, rugged, seemed like a grouchy dude, but actually nice if you just take time to talk to him.

name: Cindy Evans
text: It's quiet and awesome!  Lots of trail for hiking!

name: Myke
text: Great free campground.

name: M Maz
text: Good food, great beer.

text: Really busy place but I can see why. This place is well worth the wait! We Sat at the bar. Had great service. The wings were delicious!!

resp.text:

-The Bacchus Team

text: Such a comfortable place to have a nice date night! Food is amazing, drinks are just as amazing!

resp.text:

We hope to see you again soon!

-The Bacchus Team

text:
The Philly cheese steak had horrible whiz cheese on it.
The salad was good

resp.text:
Thank you for taking the time to rate us and write a review. We are sorry that you didn't enjoy your Philly Cheesesteak! We will review this with the chef and team. It is very important to have feedback, without it we are unable to continue to improve. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to get you back in our business.

- The Bacchus Team

name: J P
text:
My son and I had lunch (1 ish) here, we had Chili fries with cheese on the side, it was AWESOME!  Amazing crisp fries,then took our Bacon Cheese Burgers to go.  Later we went to eat our Burger's. ... I had left Bozeman, the burgers were not cooked -- they were brown just on outside and then most of it red inside.  Usually, I am asked how do you want it cooked, but no.  I do not eat rare hamburgers.  Well, my son microwaved his, but I could not because I was on my 3hr drive home.  I called was told someone would call me back, but it didn't happen.

It is frustrating spending $ and not being able to eat it.

Thanks for replying here, what happened to my calling and a phone call back? The waiter that answered the phone said would happen?

resp.text:
JP,

Thank you for the taking time to leave us a review. We are terribly sorry and apologize for the under cooked burger. We pride ourselves in using local beef and cooking to the correct temp to order. We will review this issue with the chef. It is very important to us to have feedback, without it we are unable to improve, so thank you for bringing this to our attention. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to help make this situation right and bring you back for another visit.

Sincerely,

The Bacchus Team

name: Tiffany Burnett
text: The food and drinks was overpriced, but the food was good. The drinks had way too much alcohol. Thats all you could taste.

resp.text:
Tiffany,

Thank you for taking the time to rate us and write a review. We apologize that your drinks were not as tasty as they should have been! We will review this with the team. It is very important to have feedback, without it we are unable to continue to improve. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to get you back in our business.

Sincerely,
The Bacchus Team

text: Need more help, but food was great! Always love this place.

resp.text: Thanks for the 5 stars, Jennifer! It can certainly get busy sometimes, but we hope we showed you a good time regardless! Hope to see you again soon!

name: Caylin Lancione
text: Grew up coming here and excited to see that after the remodel it still retains the same Bozeman charm. Great pub atmosphere, friendly staff, and delicious food. resp.text:

All the best and Happy Holidays!

The Bacchus Team

text: Really amazing space and a great menu and selection of beer. If you're not gonna drink definitely at least go in and taking a look at the hotel and space. Has some of the best outdoor seating on Main Street and the staff is really friendly. Troy was awesome. I highly suggest that rubben

text: Reopened under "new owners". So they are riding the coattails of the old owners. The menu is different and disappointing. Looks like I'll have to keep patronizing The Taproom (Bacchus' Old Owners) to get ACTUAL Bacchus Curry Fries. The staff of the NEW Bacchus are overwhelmed and unprepared. Hopefully patrons wont be fooled for long and will see this poor imitation for what it is. A poor imitation. I for one wont be returning.

name: Joyce Swartzendruber
text: Great bar for a quick dinner on a rainy evening.  The spicy roast beef sandwich was tender and a big hit.  The bartender was friendly and helpful; he provided a mini education on the Fruit Fly sour beer and even recommended another downtown establishment where we could try some other sours.   5 stars for the purse hooks under the bar.  Why don't all the bars have them?

name: Lee Brokus
text: Food was mediocre to just plain bad. The brat burger was so dry & overcooked it should have just been labeled as jerky. Drinks were alright, service was not.

name: Renae Mattimoe
text: The Bacchus just reopened under new management with a new menu. Happy to see some old favorites on there,  not too sure about some of the new stuff. Four of us for lunch was $80 before tip, downtown Bozeman prices for sure.

name: William O'Neill
text:
I just had lunch here for the first time since they reopened. I had a cobb salad and it was horrible. The chicken was dry and old, like it had been cooked days ago and left out on the counter. The eggs were chewy and not fresh. I'm actually concerned that I may get food poisoning.
I'm very disappointed and will not be going back. I miss the old Bacchus, which was always very good.

name: Jeff Anon
text: I liked the old bacchus better, this iteration seems a little more palatable to the average bozemanite but hey I get it. Super great staff.

name: Stephanie U
text: I like to go to the Bacchus for lunch! They have a nice, bar food menu, and great service. The atmosphere has a great feel with brick all around, stained glass art, long bar, light music, and specials. The only reason I am giving it a 4 instead of 5 is because it gets really loud when it fills up and it's hard talking to the person across from you. Mostly (obviously) this happens in the evening and weekends.

text: Quality definitely going down if you order during a busy time. It’s still good, but not as good as normal.

The Pad Thai was delicious. The server was friendly and kept my water glass filled. She was really great considering she had the dining room to herself. I will come back.

text: Love this place.  We're regulars at lunch.  Their specials are well priced and the service is quick and friendly.

text: Definitely not fast food which is just fine with me. The food is fresh, and so tasty, well prepared and hot, with choices for very spicy to mild. Clean and pleasant atmosphere, with accommodating and capable staff.

name: Czarina Davis

text: Honestly I've cooked better Thai food and I'm a college student who lives in a basement.

name: Jentry Hartford
text:
I would like to give a shout out to the crew at the Oak street location, they have never failed to provide us with top notch service and epic culinary experiences. I can't remember the name of the guy who runs the front of house, QA, host, waiter.... But dude can manage a restaurant like a boss, if he's not manager he should be!!
I can't even begin to explain how much I love the Pinapple Fried Rice that you guys make but if It is one of the best things I have ever tasted in my life!
Thank you for being on point consistently, Everytime is like the first, we appreciate ya!

name: Winter Blackmore
text: Love the food but waited 40 min. The restaurant was nearly empty but the staff was busy filling to go orders before serving us. It was a bit frustrating. That had never happened before when we ate there.

name: Marta Millard
text: They were so friendly and helpful. The food is wonderful!

name: Lolita Morgan
text:
The food is wonderful. Generous portions, and they will make it to your specific spice level.
The service quality, however, can be inconsistent -- most of the time poor. There is one specific waitress who is amazing, but is she's not working, you'll find dirty tables, not enough silverware, and water glasses frequently on empty.

name: Chris VanBockel
text: Delicious thai food with a diverse menu and great thai iced tea!  Good options of spicy and mild entrees and small plates as well

name: Gail MacMillan
text: Although I've been told their Thai food is not authentic (by people who have been to Thailand), we have always liked the food we got there. One drawback, the to-go orders we've had contain less food than the same meal we ate in the restaurant. I usually take enough home for lunch the next day. There haven't been left-overs when we take it.

name: Andrew Lake
text: Best Thai food in town!! Possibly best food in town! Every dish is amazing.. authentic and delicious. Highly recommend for lunch and dinner of any occasion.

name: Robert Semple
text: Yummy! Decent price, good service!

name: Jared Frasier
text: We brought our kids (3&4) here for a "small plates" lunch. We ordered the crunchy rolls, golden tofu, soft shell crab, chicken satay, mussel pancake, and the rice crackers with pork & shrimp.  IT WAS ALL SO GOOD and our kids loved all the flavors, textures and temperature contrasts. We'll be coming back again.

name: Dodo Cash
text: This past visit was not good.  Food was bland, we ordered spicy.  No flavor in the Thai fried rice.  Service was very poor.  Usually have good food and service.  Guess today was just not their day.

name: Rio Gonzalez McCord
text: It was tasty but had a limited selection for people who are Celiac's and lactose intolerant.

name: Zachary Barr
text: Great food. Semi-fancy sit down style is very nice. I enjoyed the Asian feel.

name: Karl Baer
text: I'm taking 3 stars off my previous review. I'm not sure what's going on, but they're having major quality and accuracy issues of late.  All our orders are takeout so it's really frustrating when we dont discover the issue until were home.  We've tried ordering online to avoid miscommunications,  but they goofed up that order too.  Issues like: dishes requested mild made hot, failure to include ordered extra rice and adding rice noodles to a bean thread noodle dish.  The kicker - the tickets are always correct so it seems like the kitchen is just dropping balls and calling audibles.

name: Eric Sterkel

name: Mandy Lipinski
text: Last quarter of the trail is the steepest. Follows the creek through the forest most of the way up with great views in the occasional meadow. Trail was pretty easy to follow in the snow due to previous traffic. Saw an American dipper and a ruffed grouse as well as TONS of rabbit and hare sign. Loved it and definitely will hike it again!

name: Sebastian Petzing
text: Amazing place to explore, even in the winter. Beware that the trail is quite icy in spots, but still definitely manageable, even in December. It was a sunny day and I made it to the top of Saddle Peak in sweatpants, a hoodie, and normal hiking boots.

name: Kay Lyn Goettlich
text: Beautiful place. Great for hiking biking and just getting outside! Good water access for dogs too.

name: Scott Lundberg
text: Pleasant hike along a stream for the first mile.  Starts climbing towards Truman gulch after that.  Very busy parking lot on the weekends.

name: Michael Parker
text: This is a beautiful summer trail and is easily my dog's favorite. It follows the creek up the valley with several crossings along the way. Around 3 miles up the trail opens up to some amazing vistas. The snow sticks around well into spring so be prepared.

name: Kelli Stanley
text: A favorite hike for our family. Creek crossings and little waterfalls keep the interest of the kids and the dog cool.

name: Joe Cobb

name: MB lovesjesus
text: Lots of shade and water for the pups.  Beautiful hike.

name: Francis Wendt

text: Loved this trail. This would be fun with a younger bunch of children in the summer.

name: Ryan Bartholomew
text: My favorite trail in Bozeman. Mix of woods and sun, beautiful wildflowers, and crosses a creek several times that is great for kids to throw rocks. After 1.35 miles, you reach a nice block with beautiful views that is easy for beginners to hike.

text: Pretty good! Excellent atmosphere and good tasting sushi! The waitress(es) were all very attentive and friendly and service was quick. Had the Habenero roll and it had a good spice. Wish there were more toppings on top of the sushi though. Overall a great experience!!

name: Dylan Weber
text: Great spot with high quality food and service.

name: Marc Lorenz
text: Quiet for the moment. Great sushi, great service. Inherited the Ramen recipe from the fish company. Good stuff all around!

name: Katie Daughenbaugh
text: Hands down best sushi in Bozeman. The Ensenada was amazing. Flavors were unique. Give it a try and support a new local business. You won't regret it.

name: B Michaels
text: A sushi roll topped with torched scallops?!... I love scallops!! And the roll was even better than I expected. Now I will crave it and want it and need to go back, and that’s when you know a 5-Star rating is on queue : )

name: Barbara Hrella
text:
Showed up for a reservation I had made online.
The restaurant was completely closed. Luckily there was an employee inside to tell us they are closed.
If temporarily closed why would the website accept a reservation in the first place. Very frustrating situation.

name: Saundra Strasser
text: Best sushi in town! Great happy hour deals. The Big Kuma is amazing. Very good Ramen for you non sushi people. One of my favorite places to eat in Bozeman.

name: Megan
text:
My first impression at Montana Fish Company was a solid four star. The sushi was good, the ramen was tasty, the drinks were good, but I found the price a bit high (even for the area), and the menu a touch redundant.

By the end of the meal, 1 person in the party had digestive issues. By the next morning the other 2 of us troubles of one kind or another. We had no allergies, and hadn't eaten anywhere else in common.  I was the only one who tried everything we ordered. I'd come back 100% for the taste, but not for the tummy troubles.

name: Courtney Glines
text: Wandered in on a cold October day needing something warm and was surprised by their killer ramen special. My giant bowl of ramen with all the toppings was more than enough food for dinner and lunch the next day. It also tasted awesome. Just salty enough to bring out the best in the bowl. Could have eaten 10 more of the egg they put in.

name: Emily Van Genderen
text: Fantastic service, great sushi, and local beer options. Intimate space great for dinner and drinks.

name: Bill Hanson
text: The real deal when it comes to sushi. We let the knowledgeable staff know what we like and they do not fail, like ever!

name: Mocking Byrd420
text: The sushi was delicious, but the service was very slow

name: Eric Sterkel
text: Great unique selection of sushi.  Newly remodeled and redone.  They don’t sell fish anyone but they now make it for you!

name: Andrew Sanders
text:
Been meaning to try for quite a while.  A birthday celebration gave us a good reason.

It was excellent. Great, fresh products.  Very knowledgeable, helpful waiter. Fish that we haven't previously had an opportunity to try, like Brem and Yellow Jack.

Spent about $50 per person with drinks,  including some mid end asking.

Will be back for special occasions.

name: David Beery
text: By far the best sushi in town. It makes Dave's  and 7 look like grocery store quality. You definitely pay a premium, but it is well worth it if you want good sushi.

name: Paul Manning
text: It's consistently great every time i go and great to take friends or a date.

name: Forrest Bagley
text: Our waitress was very knowledgeable, food was great, fish was fresh, price was fair.

name: Victor Knight
text: Amazing food, super friendly staff, and surprisingly reasonable prices. The perfect combo of fancy and casual that makes an birthday party or small get together a great one!

name: MB lovesjesus
text: Nice sushi but they were literally out of everything.  My son finally got his 4th pick from the menu.  Super nice wait staff.

name: Jessica Katherine
text: This is hands down the best sushi place in Bozeman!! We sat at the bar, even though they had a ton of regular tables, and they took such good care of us! They have 13 different types of fish and all the other sushi places in town apparently have only about 7. A great selection of beer. They probably fed us $40 of free fish on top of what we already bought just to show us what else they offer and the different flavor combinations they have created.....best I ever had!

name: Maddy M
text: My husband and I have been missing good sushi since moving to Montana. We went here over the weekend with some friends and couldn't be happier. Everything we had tasted amazing. The sushi was fresh and delicious. The service was also great. We will be going back whenever we are in Bozeman.

name: Karlene Bailey
text: First time at this restaurant and I was very pleased! Staff was very friendly, food was delicious, and I will definitely be coming back in the future.

name: Sasha B
text: The food was great! All the sushi is very fresh and well made. Our waiter was awesome, gave good recomendations and seemed to really enjoy working there. Nice cozy atmosphere perfect for a date.

name: Jack Scherman
text: Ramen deal on Tuesday is incredible as far as value but the entire menu is delicious and I enjoy the cozy ambiance.  I could see how it might get a little loud for some people.  As an added bonus, beer is half priced next door while you're waiting for your table.

name: Marlena Burton
text: I don't really want to tell others how tasty, artistic and fresh the sushi is here. I don't really want more people to know that this upscale dining experience is available in a casual environment right on Main. You didn't hear it from me.

name: Steffan Anderson
text: The most premium quality sushi in the area. Sushi chefs are classically trained and take great pride in the quality of their ingredients. additionally, great selection of raw steak and seafood to prepare yourself. Don't bring a group, only about 10 seats in the whole restaurant. Highly recommended.

name: Lisa lashing
text: Good, but not my favorite. Would definitely try it again though.

name: John
text: Great food and service.

name: Tori Thayer
text: Best sushi in Bozeman hands down

name: Natasha Shaty
text: Really great service and even better sushi at the right price.

name: Dylan Kantzler
text: Alena = Bozeman's premier sushi chef. We're from FL and tend to be on the picky side when it comes to eating sushi. Alena's flavor profiling when ordering chef's special is absolutely phenomenal. It's also hard to find keto friendly sushi rolls in town, which Alena did excellently for a friend. Thank you so much, we will of course be back... and back... and back!

name: Jeremy Mckaig
text: Great sushi rolls, happy hour, and ramen!

name: Joyce Swartzendruber
text: Great place to share small plates and enjoy Montana beers.  Calamari to die for, excellent service.  Wish they were open for lunch.

name: Cindy
text: The Ramen is wonderful.

text: Was good food service was awesome little pricey but worth the price

name: Devinne Curbow
text: Love this place for a hand roll and a beer. The sushi is good and the portions are appropriate for the price.

name: Terrence Davis
text: My favorite sushi place in bozeman. The best sushi and roman around

name: Kirkwood Donavin
text: Good sushi and recently renovated. I miss the old "deli-style" space of the old Montana Fish Company. But, a sit-down restaurant likely makes more sense in the competitive Bozeman restaurant market. Almost no 'un-filtered' sake on the menu (my favorite)! Despite those drawbacks, the sushi is excellent.

name: Jolene Kristovich
text: Really good sushi at reasonable prices

name: Keaton Roe
text: Very small place so the wait can be large, but the food is terrific.

name: Connor Cox
text: Great service and the best calamari I've ever had!

name: Scotty Krabler
text: Another sushi bar in Bozeman!  We sat at the bar and it turned out to be the best seats in the house.  I usually eat sushi at a sushi bar.  This time the Tonkatsu Ramen was spectacular.  A little dreamy cloud saki and this little spot gets a top ranking.

name: Brian Eilers
text: Real high quality food and service;

name: Connor O'Leary
text: Their food was absolutely delicious and their staff went out of their way to help us.

name: Tiara Bechtold
text: Great tasting food, a little pricey

name: Drew Tyger
text: This is hands-down the best sushi restaurant in Bozeman.  I travel for work and eat at many different sushi place's- MFC has exceptional fish and the chef is great!  If you want good sushi in Bozeman, this is the place to go.  Seven and Dave's are sub-par in my opinion.

name: Hope Christensen
text: Such a nice place and things weren't outrageously priced. The staff was super friendly and very compensative to having made any type of mistake. Really enjoyed the environment too!!

name: John Betancourt
text: Couldn't believe how unprofessional and rude the service was. Almost impossible to get served and sanitation is very questionable! Honestly have no idea how they're even in business.

We came from out of town during busy times of day; it was very frustrating. Call ahead, and even then plan to get burned.

PS The location currently shown on Google (Main Street) is also inaccurate.

resp.text: Thank you for your kindness.  WE are very blessed to have awesome customers such as yourself.  Thank you.

text: Great glutin free!

name: Rewarding You Tube Viewers
text: This has been one of the BEST places as far as customer service goes. I was very impressed with how friendly & quickly they handled business. The only issue I have is their taco pizza they use sauce instead of refried beans & they put tortilla chips on the topping. Taco pizzas use refried beans instead of sauce & I've never had chips as a topping. Other then that the service was ezcellent.

name: zephyer 1999
text: Belgrade staple, small place, pizza is fine.  Hard to judge due to C19 lock down.

name: Ev Frad
text: Have had their pizza 3 times now, typically wait 3 times for consistency check. Each time I was blown away by the fresh ingredients and accuracy of the food. Delivery was quick, in River Rock, and the food was still pippin hot. The staff is always friendly in store. It's worth the little higher price for the nostalgia of the way things used to be, a pizza to your liking, plenty of toppings, and great service. 10/10 will go again.

name: Jonathan Broughman
text: Best pizza I've had in Montana so far

name: Chris Smith
text: I love their Rosa's Combo. I just wish they were open on Sundays and that they would deliver to Manhattan.

name: Yolanda Fuson
text: I love the pizza here. Not to mention the ice cream selections.

name: Bubba Bug
text: Best pizza place in Belgrade!!!

name: Rachel Brown
text: Rosa's in Bozeman is better tasting. It was just pizza, nothing spectacular. Prices are fair. Small dining room/area.

name: Christopher Laramore
text: I have never been inside the store but have had them deliver on 2 separate occasions. On both occasions the food was top of the line driver was friendly and food arrived in a very reasonable amount of time. I had their pizza, big monster sandwiches, (don't remember the name but you might want to share it with someone) and chicken fajitas salad all we're exelexcel.

name: Tyler Goff
text: The pizza is delicious and so was the ranch. The breadsticks I ate the next day with a salad. Super tasty. Is it the best I ever had... no. However,  I highly recommend ordering from here if you haven't before.

name: John Bowles
text: Best pizza and wings in town...you won't regret it...real cheese, fresh toppings...the wings are large pieces, actually cooked!...NOT half cooked, raw, fatty chicken wings you have to recook before there edible like the other pizza joints in town..

name: Logan Turner
text: Crust was undercooked and doughy, not worth the $22 I paid for 1 pizza.

name: Todd Farmer
text:
DISCLAIMER:  TireWorld manager assures me that every lug nut is hind torqued and hit twice, and that my experiences were caused by subsequent tampering or failure to return after 25 miles for subsequent tightening and that Tire World is not responsible.

A month after a tire rotation, one wheel nearly came off on a cross-country trip (first significant driving).   The shop doing the emergency $2000 repairs asked whether any recent work had been done, noting that the locking lug nut was missing, the stud broken, and the four remaining lug nuts were exceptionally loose (several 1-2 turns from coming off).  The only service between the tire rotation and this event was an oil change.  We can't say definitively that TireWorld failed to properly torque one wheel - and they claim that is definitely not the case - but it's hard to accept somebody intentionally loosening one wheel as the alternative cause.

I am not a tire expert, and do not know why it would take a month between the rotation and the loose tire causing the problems it did.  Given the alternative (that somebody loosened the tire), I've concluded the risk of returning to Tire World to be too great, and will go elsewhere for future service.  If you don't believe my story or come to a different conclusion on most probable causes, it doesn't bother me.  They seem like good folks, and I hope their business succeeds, and issues such as mine never happen again.

text: Malibu Tan is a bunch of scam artists. I am so thankful I found a local honest place to go that does not have sneaky ways of charging me extra money. The only problem is I have not had time to go while they're open so I thought I would go for a one-time at Malibu tonight. When I got there the girl that was fairly unfriendly let me know that she could not let me tan until I paid them my $60 I had no clue I had. What happened was last spring I bought a 3 months package but I believe was around $30 a month and she said my card went through for the months of April May and June which are the three months I knew I was paying for. I told her I specifically remember canceling that when I realized it kept going after 3 months. I don't know why they would call it a 3 month plan in the first place! She then told me that I did not call them until July..duh, because if my card was knowingly charged April May and June I would not have known that their three-month plan continues until I was charged in July! Not to mention I'm not sure why I owe $60 for just July when I know that it was not something I paid $60 a month for because I would never do that and I specifically remember it was 30ish. Apparently the manager will be calling me tomorrow and I sure hope they handle it correctly or I'm going to take more action than they probably expect. Companies that do this are far worse than actual pyramid schemes. I now have no clue why anyone goes there and supports them. They purposely bait and switch. If anyone else has the same issue switch to Ambiance Wellness Boutique. They're honest and actually have options for normal people who don't tan 7 times a week year round.

name: Eat Well Travel Often
text:
Current review (2/29/2020): Our dinner at Ted’s last night was the first time (after many visits) that we experienced bad service. We ordered the Delmonico Ribeye with kale salad & brussels sprouts and bison chopped steak with asparagus & chopped salad (beer & iced tea). Our medium well steak was rare (usually no biggie), but upon letting our server know, without a word, he took the plate. It was brought back to our table about 15 minutes later (cooked perfectly), but we didn’t see him again until flagging him down to ask for our check and a to go container. At this point, we had four empty glasses sitting on the edge of our table (2 that originally had water & 2 empty beer glasses). We finished our meal with no drinks & no acknowledgment for obviously needing refills. Definitely not our usual experience here, but it’ll be a while before we go back.
Previous review (2 months ago):Usually we order steak when eating at Ted’s, but we tried other items for lunch this time. The burger was one of the best I’ve had in a while & the steak/blue cheese salad was amazing. The kale salad (a side option) was super light & refreshing. Moscow mule was perfectly made and the beer was ice cold. Service is always top notch. As always, we’ll be back. 100% recommend👍!

name: Chandra Jennings
text:
Was told by several coworkers that I must visit Ted's before I leave Bozeman. I can remember growing up and seeing Ted Turner's name at the end of credits on networks and television shows. So, I was super excited to check out his restaurant and his variety of bison dishes! When I arrived at the restaurant I did not receive the warmest welcome, but was told that I would either have to wait 20 minutes for a table or could get a seat at the bar. I decided to get a seat at the bar. I wasn't acknowledge for a while there as well,  but did eventually receive a menu and was asked if I wanted a drink. The waitress was actually nice and attentive. I decided to get their Hendrick's mule, which was full of flavor and just the right amount of strength.

The food unfortunately was not as impressive as their drinks. I got their Byson meatloaf and instead of the mashed potatoes I got their parmesan broccoli. The meatloaf lacked flavor and any kind of excitement. It was very boring and super small. The broccoli and green beans were not much better either. Many parts of the green beans were the stems, so they could not be eaten. The roll that came with my meal was small and hard--I had to ask the waitress for another one.

For Ted Turners restaurant I really had high expectations and it really fell short.

name: Ev Frad
text: When you first Walk in to the building Ted's is in, you think wow, this might be a fancy dinner place. Very nice, recently renovated, comfortable, welcoming hall. You get to the restaurant, it's still nice and welcoming, but definitely a bit more relaxed. Thank goodness, cause I was in jeans and a hoodie. The waiting list said about 25 minutes, pretty common for downtown Bozeman, we got inside in about 15. Once seated, the chairs felt like they were made for children, small, kind of older, and as a big guy, I wish it wasn't that way. The waitress was prompt and very nice. She had a great attitude with how obviously busy it was. She recommended the bison meatloaf, which caught my eye first anyway. Got it how it normally comes, mashed potatoes and green beans. About 45 minutes later, the table next to ours (a group of 4) a group of 6 people were being served even though we had sat down long before them. Soon after, our food came. The green beans were covered in butter, but practically raw and not even tasty. My mashed potatoes were good, the meatloaf was good, I liked the gravy the best. But just underwhelming overall. My wife he the roasted chicken, and that was the best chicken I've had at a restaurant, jucy, packed with flavor, I think it was the best protein at the table, and my friend ordered a bison steak med-rare. Her side she ordered was broccoli, but they gave her green beans, the worst side... Which they quickly brought her broccoli anyway, thank goodness, cause no one could eat that. She also had mashed potatoes. The strawberry shortcake was more like a biscuit with strawberry and ice cream on it. And I had the brownie, which was super dense and rich. They are not a the dessert place. If it wasn't for the roasted chicken, this place wouldn't be worth mentioning, I'll give it one more time and then make up if I will ever go back. Try anything once, they have great potential.

name: Christina Burdick
text: Love Ulta and the friendly service... however, still forcing patrons to wear masks... ugh.

name: Dave Johnston
text:
It's a fine store, but some of the employees there have taken their mask policy as license to bully people ... and that's a shame.

Hiding your face apparently entitles some folks to berate people they don't know and know nothing about.

resp.text: We are sad to hear that you had a negative experience at our Bozeman store. We appreciate you bringing this to our attention as we are always wanting to create a better shopping experience for you. This feedback will be shared to ensure better visits in the future. Thank you.

name: Karen Davison
text: The clerk was most unfriendly. Maybe just having a bad day but must say I didn't need grumpy

name: Jocelyn Maxwell
text: The girls here are always so sweet and helpful. I never feel stupid asking questions or needing help. Even with the pandemic they are patient and accommodating.

name: Tari Lautenschlager
text:
Erin saved me !!
I was in a lip balm crisis & she not only saved me but she was incredibly kind !!

name: Sara Otero
text: Even though with covid-19 is hard to shop around since there is specific rules such as not trying anything which makes sense for everyone's safety. I got help to decide which colour pop foundation to get! She was nice to help me out!

name: Heidi Potter
text: I had my hair done today by Elizabeth and I am so happy I did. She fixed the bad haircut I had previously gotten and understood what I wanted. She was gentle and took her time learning about the type of hair I have and how I want to wear it. She recommended products and didn't steer me to the most expensive brands. She was great to talk to and I will never have my hair cut by anyone else again.

name: Armando Cly
text: Always a great place to pick up age defying products!

name: Katelyn Maspero
text: Good selection of makeup and beauty products. The people nice and helpful. I wish there was more products from different brands. And a higher stock of the products they do have

name: Emilee Neiminen
text: The customer service at this store is horrendous.

resp.text: We always strive to provide the best service possible to our guests, so we're sorry to hear this. If you have concerns about a specific location or visit, please reach out to our Guest Services team at your earliest convenience either via Facebook Messenger, Twitter Direct Messenger, phone at 1-866-983-8582, or email at gethelp@ulta.com.

name: Michelle L
text: Love getting my eyebrows wax here. The wax they use or is extremely gentle and great for sensitive skin. The brow bar experts are excellent and do exactly what I asked.

name: Cheryl Fitzpatrick
text: Great sale going on

name: Olivia
text: If you like the Kylie Jennet kits, then this is the only place they're available. They have the expensive name brands as well as some cheaper stuff, that actually works very well. They sell a wide variety of skin care items, and the staff is great. I have my eyebrows and hair done at the salon, great service both times!

name: Ryan
text: Had what I went there for and their prices were competitive with Amazon (for that product at least). However, I had to wait in line for at least 4 minutes before it moved once because only one register was open. It was frustrating seeing numerous employees walk by the checkout line having nothing to do but meander through the store. More employees should have been trained to operate the register since if the store were any busier waits would have been ridiculous.

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: Their staff is not always naturally friendly, sometimes they are too busy to offer you help. I love the variety of products that the store has.

name: Lisa
text: I like Ulta, just wish they carried more high-end brands. More of a company-wide thing I have a gripe with so no stars off for this store, their associates are generally wonderful. I especially love Josh at the Lancome counter! Wish everyone was as knowledgable about their products as him!

name: Lisa Giroux
text: Very helpful and nice staff! Love everything in the store I just can't afford some things there.

name: Jen Wakefield
text: LOVE this place! They carry almost everything, staff is super helpful and knowledge!

name: Bayard L
text:
The staff here is really friendly and loves helping customers pick out beauty products. They have skin care treatments available in the store.

The natural hair and skin care product selections are very good and there are options that are not terribly expensive. They carry some of the same brands as Rosaurs for natural products, but they also have some brands that Rosaurs does not stock.

During Black Friday and seasonal sales, some brands are 30% off.

name: Hope Christensen
text: Best place ever! Employees are always so sweet and helpful and you can try anything before you buy it which is great. Staff with give you tips on eye liner or blending or anything else you're wondering about.

name: Bozeman Review
text:
Great selection of products.  Perricone is a fav of the woman as they swear by it.

Nice to have this business in town!

name: Robyn Thompson
text: They have such a good selection!  I always leave with more than I came for!

name: Diane Reese Leach
text: Ulta is ULTA!!!

name: Shirley Morrison
text: I love the service at my Bozeman Ulta beauty, everyone is so nice and professional and I get all the help I need to get my makeup shopping done.

name: Monica Marbut
text: Always nice to just browse the store.

name: Jim Ward
text: Lexi at the brow bar was AMAZING. Very skilled!

name: Janet Marchington
text: Best place for make up, bueaty supplies, bath supplies and nail supplies,, hair cuts,  color

name: Jennifer Emmerich
text: Really great place. The people were very bubbly and knowledgeable

name: Vanessa Gunnell
text: The staff is nice even when you are a makeup less, desperate looking mother. Probably because you look like you need makeup.

name: Layne M
text: So much to choose from.  Employees are great and very helpful.  Love the store

name: Megan Good
text: Huge variety of options and the staff is always friendly and willing to help.

name: Colleen Hybner
text: Helpful staff, just doesn't have the inventory/variety of a bigger Ulta

name: Holley Woosley Vennes
text: Love the staff and selection. Excellent job on eyebrow waxes!

name: Andrea Black
text: The associates here are always ready to help me.  I live the Benefit Brow Bar!

name: Amber Hoadley
text: Great selection of products and I like that they have a customer rewards program

name: Alisha Crane
text: Fun and exciting. Even for people who rarely enjoy makeup.

name: Megan
text: I took the Bozeman Ulta totally for granted until a recent trip out of town. This particular Ulta receives every weird, k-beauty, blogger-fad, holiday-combo-special-release-pack known to the company. I went into an Ulta in Los Angeles looking to buy 4 products from my routine my grandmother had gotten hooked on, and the staff there had never even heard of a single item, let alone had it in stock. #letsguide #kbeauty

name: Jenny Larson
text: Great deals. Found what I needed.

name: Lindsey H
text: I am in love with the store !!  Great selection great prices . The staff is wounderful!! I could spend all day walking around this place!!!

name: Elisabeth Cleveland
text: Staff is generally attentive and seem to know thier stock well!

name: Jamie Herzog
text: The best beauty store in town. A fun upbeat environment with a friendly and super knowledgeable staff make shopping great!

name: Rita Willis
text: Beauty Mecca. Beauty consultants are very polite and knowledgeable.

name: jessica benavides
text: I love the Ladies at the salon

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: Friendly and helpful staff!

name: Serenity McCartney
text: Lane helped me so much and was an absolute sweetheart. Will always shop here because of her!!

name: Amy W
text: Staff is friendly but I'll be returning to my usual makeup place downtown where expertise is standard, price is equivalent and i don't need to hunt around to find help or what i need.

name: Kat Fincher
text: Green Stick!!!!

name: Sierra Buchholz
text: I will only go to Lane for my makeup needs & advice!

name: Alexandra Hardy
text: Staff is helpful and informative.

name: Seth Chase
text: Parking fills quickly. Servers are nice. Chairs are from the 70’s. Decent drink prices. Feels like there are not enough staff during the peak times. Super kitch carpets, it hasn’t changed since I first stepped into this bar 20 years ago so that feels nice. Convenient liquor store attached and the restaurant serves one of my favorite steak subs in town the spicy philly. No worthy complaints. They do have a pool table. this place is convenient for peeps on the west side. Lots of tv’s for sports... you get a nice mix of variously aged white folk consistent with the monochromatic bozone I’ve come to know. Quite a few bearded men no cowboys and women to match the men. I’ll be back.

name: Aurora Reesman
text: Everyone is super nice and very friendly. Probably the best selection of alcohol in Bozeman. Definitely do not attempt to go here with the fake ID it will get taken, they are very good at carding.

name: Bill McNutts
text: We went on a Sunday and they had football and golf playing. It was great! The beer was great! And the best service I've had in awhile... I'll definitely go back!

name: Doug Campbell
text: Great service and the bar tab will never break the bank (might have to break a 20).

name: Mitch Shattuck
text: Always a great place to go! There are lovely people there with amazing service! 10/10 :)

name: Mark Allen
text: Friendly staff, free drinks while gambling, always have the games

name: Chad Mueske
text: Great pork chop sandwich. Very nice service and great tasting food

name: Doug Petersen
text: Liquor store employee started cussing and swearing and threatening me after he told me to wear a mask. I told him I have a medical condition and can't wear a mask. He said he can deny service to anyone for any reason  He then called the police on me. The police explained to him that he cannot deny service to people with medical conditions. They clearly don't understand that the Governors mandate had exceptions for people that can't wear masks

name: Brad Tolson
text: Best pork chop around

name: Tiffany Burnett
text: Absolutely wonderful employees and they treat you like family!!! Definitely a good place to go for a drink in Bozeman

name: Martel Adair
text: Love this place, it also has a little burger joint and casino bar attached to it.

name: kade estill
text: Eat at Brewskers.

name: Cole Heitman
text: Pretty good liquor selection. Hit the lunge if you want some good food at good prices

name: Joe p
text: Always a good selection, and helpful staff.

name: John Kawalski
text: If you want to go to a bar where you can actually watch a game with other people who are also into the game, Hide-a-away is the place for you

name: Desirea Rees
text: kind of a dive bar but the food is awesome and it's nice to go to a bar that's not too crowded

name: Jagd Terrier WillAnderson
text: The bartenders are awesome! Great service every time!

name: John McParland
text: This bar has the best bartenders in bozeman! All of them are extremely friendly and beautiful people all around. Solid group of patrons congregate in this place, and they play the best music out of any bar in bozeman, I've lived here 11 years so I feel well versed on bozeman bars and the awful music that they play. This bar is the best one no doubt!

name: Chris Manifold
text: Great bartenders. Quiet atmosphere. Great hole in the wall bar to get good drinks and shoot pool.

name: Samuel Quick
text: Decent selection of liquor for Bozeman. Staff is very friendly, and helpful when I'm either looking for something new! Big plus for them is their hours. Better hours than Montana Wine and Spirits, slightly smaller selection.

name: Garrett Ness
text: I love the Hideaway.  The bar tenders are fun and easy on the eyes. Drinks are strong and mixed well.

name: Jeff Pickett
text: State of Montana booze store. Good people

name: Jim Ward
text: Top notch liquor store in Bozeman, great service a couple percent higher priced. Worth it.

name: Kevin Hansen
text: Always good!!

name: Tessa Heinemann
text:
This is a weird bar, but not in a bad way necessarily. The beer is cheaper than cheap, and it feels like you're in a cave. Definitely expect to be one of the only women in this joint if you show up.

The liquor store can have some prices that are pretty high.

name: Nicholas Smith
text: Good main street location with good hours and food. And don't forget free ice with purchase at the liquor store.

name: Andy Davison
text: Bill is a super friendly bartender! They have great service and this is the only bar I'll go to in Bozeman.

name: D. Joseph Chyatte
text:
Best cheese steaks in Bozeman, but that's kinda like being the best kickboxer in Belgium . . . Bar tenders are cool though, and it is a premier day-drinking spot.  Nevertheless, I asked for a half pint of Jamo' at the liquor store there, and the clerk looked at me like I just killed a kitten.

Be snooty or be a dive: whatever the case, make up your mind . . .

name: Josh Winterrowd
text: Good dive bar with good liquor store attached. Bar food and great beer selection.

name: Kavin M
text: Helpful staff, went for my 21st birthday, and the cashier was very helpful in giving me suggestions. It was a fantastic night due to his help!

name: Lucretia Berardinelli
text: Great sandwiches, quick service!

name: Megan
text: I can only rate the liquor store. It is dingy and small, but well priced and the hours are fantastic. The staff is always friendly. This is a place to find the classics.

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: Cool dive bar! Pool tables available

name: Devinne Curbow
text: This is one of my favorite holes in the wall. They have excellent food and plenty of space to meet up with friends.

name: 123kaelee123
text: Everything is super marked up. Not worth buying from there.

name: CJ Williams
text: Great dive with mellow patrons. Off the beaten path. Great local crowd.

name: Uriel Utter
text: Good drinks and food, decent bar prices

name: Evelyn Squire

name: Donna Meyer
