name: Daniel Bachler
text: Awesome place to get liquor by campus

name: Courtnie Lemirande
text: Many different options here! Breakfast is the best in my opinion. The Mia eggs Benedict is my favorite. I also LOVE the Elvis crepes. Usually a little bit of a wait here depending on the time because they are so good. So I would recommend calling ahead of time

name: Kamala Gibby
text: Food is delicious 😋.  They make everything homemade right down to the jam and hash browns! Visitors to Bozeman beware,  there is a wait list so call in a little early and get your seats reserved! Well worth the wait!

name: Jennifer Rau
text:
Ok I already loved the food and drinks here but today they topped my day. I was having a ruff start to my day my car died and I just wanted comfort food (eggs bennie) and a mimosa. Nathan was beyond amazing as a server and he definitely helped lift my spirits. He was kind attentive and made sure I felt comfortable.
Go in and ask for Nathan! As a life long bartender people this good in the industry are rare, I will always ask for him from now on! You are sure to leave happy!!

name: Jackie Shinn
text: Loved this place. Great staff and fast service. Fantastic food and nice atmosphere. I had the crab cakes benedict...so yummy. And also the decadent stuffed french toast.

name: Josh Parsons
text: It's an awesome brunch spot! The atmosphere has a great vibe and the staff are always friendly and helpful. It's a regular stop whenever I'm in Bozeman.

name: Brendan Lounsbery
text: Absolutely love this place. You can tell they pay a lot of attention to detail and the food and drinks are truly upscale, several notches above typical diner fare. Classy establishment and very cheerful, welcoming staff.

name: Alex
text: Coming from a city with lots of great breakfast restaurants we weren’t sure what to expect in Bozeman on our trip. The staff at Kimpton hotel recommended Jam and we decided to give it a shot. Spoiler - it was awesome. We got seated immediately and our servers were friendly, knowledgeable, and quick. The menu had many options for all sorts of taste buds and everything we ordered was very delicious. I could eat here every day, that’s how good it was. Prices were not exorbitant and the whole experience was totally worth it.

name: Matthew Bunn
text: This place was great. Even during the covid pandemic we were seated and had a great breakfast. They kept up with all the policies; 6 feet distance, not too crowded. The background music was phenomenal!

name: Fiorella Calderoni
text: Our breakfast was awesome but their covid protocols not so much. They wanted to squeeze groups into indoor waiting areas. Our group and several others felt uncomfortable but the hostess just measured 6 steps with her feet and told us it was safe. We disagreed and stayed further apart. Not much social distancing going on inside either. The place was packed and going to the bathroom felt like an obstacle course.

name: Robert Liebold
text: Stopped in for breakfast.  Great menu and service. Will definitely stop by again.

name: Bryan Espinoza
text: Best jamn jam I've evry had staff is very friendly and very alert awesome food will definitely be back!

name: Jono Odermann
text: Great atmosphere and great food. It's a little pricey for me, with me spending close to 40 dollars on three pancakes in total and two chocolate milks. But overall great experience and good food.

name: Gail MacMillan
text: I had the "Traditional" and the hubby had the breakfast burrito. He said the coffee was good and I loved the fresh squeezed OJ. I ordered my eggs over-medium and they were cooked just right. Other breakfasts that I saw people eating looked fabulous also. We'll definitely be back!

name: Matthew Yetter
text:
Spectacular!  My partner is from southern Kentucky and has spent the last five years in Montana trying in vain to find AUTHENTIC biscuits and gravy.  Today he finally succeeded, and actually said they were better than his mom's. Homemade everything, with big chunks of ham sausage. Now he wants to camp in the alley behind the place just so he can eat here often.

I had the jam crepes and bacon. Also delicious.  Service was incredibly fast as well. I think we had the food around three minutes after it was ordered.

name: Diane Cole
text: This place serves great quisin. It's small portions so don't go if your really hungry.

name: Caylin Lancione
text: Very popular spot but they always do a great job of keeping the wait times down and providing efficient service. Staff is very friendly and the food is delicious and priced very reasonably. I lived in the south for 5 years so it's nice to have a local place here that offers crab cake and pulled pork benedicts 🙏🙏🙏

name: Shane Gill
text: Tasty! The London Fog and Maple Latte are super delicious. Not to mention all the tasty food choices. I love breakfast so I am a big Jam! fan, but don't forget to try their lunch menu during the week!

name: FENGYAN ZHANG
text: Enjoyed a nice Sunday breakfast with my husband!

name: Shanice Luciano
text: Absolutely amazing!!! The entire experience. The staff was great, the food was great and the mimosas were greater. Definitely going back soon. Would recommend the BREAKFAST BURRITO!!!!! DELISH 😋

name: Dylan Brewer
text: Great food for brunch. Had a thirty minute wait but was given free coffee. A little expensive, but on par for Bozeman. Friendly staff. Really enjoyed my experience.

name: D'Vaughn Hayes
text: Breakfast or lunch, this is one of the best restaurants in Bozeman no doubt.

name: Katie Thennis
text: First time in there. I cant believe it used to be universal athletics! Wow. Such tasty food. Tried a Benedict for the first time and I was not disappointed!

name: Stephen G
text: Went here after reading all the amazing reviews and seeing the incredible photos, only to be very disappointed. While the food looks great, it has almost zero flavor. I got a cinnamon chip pancake and the only flavor that stood out at all was the cinnamon.

name: Patty Smith
text: This place keeps calling me back.  Was able to   forgo the wonderful Benedict’s today to try the biscuit sandwich and man oh man.  What a treat! I eat in the south a lot, and am a good baker myself, but this biscuit is on a whole ‘nother level.  Probably it was brushed with butter before being toasted? Slightly savory.  Totally good.  Arrive early.  This place draws crowds.

name: Nathan Knopf
text: I'm not even a "breakfast person" but it was a great breakfast! Definitely will go again someday.

name: Celina Bazinet
text: This place is always packed because everybody loves it. there's a huge variety on the menu and everything I've ever had here has been delicious. Attentive service, awesome downtown location

name: Moquey Marquross
text: Terrific staff, wonderful menu and quality food! Not the typical 'quantity over quality' breakfast.... Quality reigns supreme here.

name: Savannah Donnelly
text: The food was very good... just small portions for the price! Nice to have labeled gluten free options.

name: Krystle Iverson
text: 5 out of 5 for everything. Service, food, atmosphere, drinks. Add this to your must go list.

name: Only Nate
text: Amazing menu. Fun hip atmosphere with plenty of space.  The gluten free pancakes will make you wonder if they are actually gluten free, why, because they are amazing.

name: Jason G
text:
The food was fine, but not incredibly impressive for the price, by quality or quantity.
Some of their staff could use some extra training on customer service. No one was outright rude, just clearly inexperienced and lacking in coaching.

Probably won't be going back.

name: Badfish 406
text: Their Stuffed French Toast plays for keeps! Very impressed with their food, drink selection, and service. Their staff are all really friendly and attentive, too. Thanks you guys!

name: Jonathon Kinser
text: Cappuccino was horrible, asked and employee to not throw it away as I went to the restroom only to find it thrown away. They replaced with a not so good replacement. I ask for caramel I expect to taste it.

name: Burke Padbury
text:
Fantastic eggs Benedict. Sauce was phenomenal.
Crepes were the best I've ever had.

name: nick Friend
text: Great food! Server Areial was very helpful and friendly

name: Lauren Whiddon
text: Always great food, and fast service. The online waitlist option is great because there is always a long wait on weekends.

name: Heidi Potter
text: I've never not had a great dining experience at Jam. The food is delicious and plated so nicely. The staff is warm and friendly. The atmosphere is casual and open. Love this place!

name: Iren Reger
text:
Been here a couple of times and it is a pleasure! Nice and clean, coffee is strong and tasty, food is of great quality and there are healthy options. Vegetarian friendly. I enjoy the lack of plastic single-use containers on the dishes and feel better about leaving less traces from my meal. Portions are well sized, so less food waste, too! The staff is attentive, last time we got great service by Daniel.
I would love to go again soon

name: Amy Deines
text: What a great way to start the way in Bozo.  The latte was made very well.  Had to have the blue berry ricotta pancake with hazelnut, it was Devine. My travel buddy had the roof hash  and really enjoyed it.

name: Court Harris
text: New favorite breakfast spot in BZN. We were there early on a Saturday and had zero wait. I heard it gets busy starting around 0800.  My kid had a hot chocolate with foam and a kids breakfast that was the right amount for a 6 yr old. The menu offerings were a good mix of traditional with twists and some innovative dishes. The eggs benedict menu is very cool. The chicken and biscuit benedict delivered. Looks as good as it tastes.

name: Ashley Watterson
text: We had chai with Bailey's Irish cream in it, which was wonderful! I had stuffed French toast, a biscuit with gravy, and my fiancee had chicken and a biscuit Benedict.

name: Marcella Leaton
text: Yum.  Lake Charles hot sandwich.

name: Bridgette Hyde
text: Moderate masking aggression. Great food and they nail the cortado! Moderate atmosphere

name: Alexandria Last Star
text: Great service and awesome food 👍

name: J Clifton Meek
text: Great, strong coffee. Bright, upbeat atmosphere, pleasant waitstaff. And, the food is good to excellent. Their basic breakfast is the best value around. Really great coffee. Very popular, come outside of standard dining hours to avoid waits.

name: Autumn Underberg
text: Reservations recommended for the weekend. Good food, fun atmosphere.

name: Meg Maul
text: Best brunch food outside of Hash a GoGo in Vegas! Absolutely fresh and amazing!!!

name: Eric Ossorio
text: Breakfast that his the spot! Parking could be easier and less inconvenient, but worth the hassle. Pulled pork omelet is a winner.

name: Trevor Beitman
text: Always love heading to Jam for so good food.

name: Paolette Matute
text: One of Bozeman's best breakfasts spots!! Great location, tasty food, and friendly staff.

name: Jason Fox
text: Recommendation by a friend. Well worth the stop.

name: Sarah Ellis
text: Jam! serves up some good tasting food. Yes, you will pay a premium for it but so worth it. And healthy sized portions. Walking away full but not stuffed. We truly are amazed at how good our breakfasts were. Plus, super friendly and attentive service. Highly recommend!!

name: Richard Salonek
text: They went overboard with the sausage gravy on the loaded browns, otherwise the food was great.  Service was a bit slow, but friendly.

resp.text:
Hey there, Richard!  I am the Operations Manager of Jam.  I would love to hear more about your service experience.  I appreciate all the feedback we can get.  If you would like to tell me more, please call or email me.

Best,
Tori Thomas
406.570.9768
victoria.thomas1976@gmail.com

name: Thena Skinner
text: My fave place in Bozeman

name: Sam Evans
text: Restaurant was super busy Saturday morning as you'd expect. Waited about 20 minutes and we're seated in a nice booth. Menu was nice and had a good variety of gluten free and vegetarian. Prices were just a little higher than I'd like, but the food was really tasty. The basic pancake was fantastic, and biscuits and gravy was good. For some reason the plating was supposed to have basted eggs served on top of the biscuits and gravy? (Seriously, so many basted eggs on the menu. The chef must love them.) Changing the eggs to over hard was no issue, but they were quite difficult to eat with no room on the plate for them. The table was clean enough I didn't mind them accidentally flopping off the hip rectangular plate though. I'd eat here again. Good atmosphere, good food, service was unremarkable in a good way.

name: Jon Ventura
text: GREAT breakfasts esp eggs Benedict Mia and coffee is wonderful

name: Sea Jae Cocalope
text: This place will always be my favorite place to eat here in Bozeman. I have family in Billings and Missoula and one or the other comes through town a couple times per month. This is where we go every time. I’ve eaten here at least 50 times now, and it’s still amazingly delicious every trip. If you haven’t tried this place, you’re really missing out. Get the Stuffed French Toast. It’s DIVINE!

name: Christopher BJ
text: VERY slow and extremely mediocre

name: Elif Bilal
text: Best place for breakfast! You have to call ahead of time to make sure that you won't wait too long before you can devour their delicious food!

name: Lindsey Cozzi
text: The wait to be seated was longer than expected, but once we were seated, everything was so fast. The food was delicious, the service was good, and it's a good atmosphere.

name: James I. Lyon
text: Fast service.   Very friendly staff.   Food was great.  I had pulled pork omelet.   Over the top.

name: Dan Sundgren
text: Incredible bfast burrito, off the hook.

name: Kelli McCain
text: Fast service! Great waiter. He was attentive but not over bearing. Lovely place to take my visiting family. We love the diversity on the menu. I had the stuffed French toast. Excellent if you like sweet treats!

name: U R
text: Amazing place. Great atmosphere. Excellent menu. Delicious fresh food. Friendly happy staff. Must visit while you're in Bozeman

name: Katie Daughenbaugh
text: A hipster joint with delicious food. I enjoyed a delicious blueberry pancake. If you're lucky, Nathan will be your waiter.

name: Bryan Rask
text: Phenomenal eggs Benedict’s and the beer mosas were amazing. Friendly and attentive staff. Fast and efficient!!

name: Les Craig
text: Service is unbelievably fast, especially considering quality of food. Best breakfast in Bozeman.

name: Aaron Blakeslee
text: Amazing place for brunch!

name: Jim Eischeid
text: There's a damn good reason that people are waiting on the sidewalk outside of that place.  The food is just that good!  The service kicks butt too.

name: the710 extractionist
text:
Stuffed French toast is to die for!
Can't wait till we're in Bozeman again!

name: Jenna Livingston
text: If I die tomorrow, I'll die happy knowing that Jam!'s Bananas Foster was my last meal. It's that good.

name: London Clawson
text: The food was amazing! I got some sandwich with jalapenos and if all of there food is that good then this place will be my favorite.

name: Marina Bradley
text: Great food, great service, great atmosphere. Totally to die for pancakes!! I recommend the cinnamon roll pancakes for anybody with a sweet tooth, and the home fries are delicious and pair with almost the whole menu.

name: Tanner Johnson
text: Great food and super quick service!

name: Tony Tornado
text: EXCELLENT service...always great food. Best "philly's" in town...so many choices. Great sandwiches

name: Orion Kubat
text: The place feels like the mural inside. Jam! creates an atmosphere filled with vibrance and vivacity. The servers are incredibly friendly and eager, making the experience quite delightful. Shoutout to Nathan. The various food, drink, and coffee options are versatile and diverse. I think that the higher prices here could be better warranted if breakfast reservations could be made. Still worth the wait.

name: Brenna Sovine
text: Always delicious 😋

name: Kade carter
text: Good food and great service

name: Ashlyn Graham
text: Great atmosphere, friendly service, and scrumptious food!

name: Brian Rauch
text: The food is always delicious. Plus, even during lunch rush it comes fast and quick. Service has always been fantastic. There are some fun and unique items that make it a must go. It is a popular place, so I do recommend going for an early lunch to ensure you don't have to wait. I recommend the Counter Assault! It is a spicy and delicious menu item.

name: Daniel Arenas
text: Good food, but the prices are high and the serving sizes are VERY small. It's more of a hipster novelty breakfast hangout rather than a proper breakfast/brunch restaurant. You'll find better alternatives in Bozeman.

name: FingTim Halbritter
text: Nice atmosphere food was really really good only our 2nd time there but whole family really liked it staff friendly and helpful thanks jam

name: Marina Schreckengost
text: Holy heck! This place is amazing! Gluten free options galore, even amazing pancakes! I've been multiple times and plan to go many more times. I highly recommend the gluten free banana fosters pancake plus a half classic Benedict. Yuuuum! Incredible customer service too!

name: Na Cl
text: Best breakfast in Bozeman. Fresh ingredients, and the special is always well thought out.

name: Mike Giroux
text: Great food. Creative menu and not crowded for an early breakfast on a weekday.

name: Larry Long
text: This place came highly recommended by locals and did not disappoint. We went back a second time. Try the loaded hash browns.

name: Renee Schmidt
text: Really friendly and happy staff. The food was perfectly delicious. I got the beet and root hash with pesto and ate the whole thing because I couldn't stop until it was done.

name: Meredith Beery
text: This is one of my favorite places to take out of town guests! The food and coffee are always great, the service always friendly and the atmosphere always fun and family-friendly. The kitchen is very accommodating for those with special diets and it is easy to get a gluten-free option for pretty much everything.

name: Mina Morley
text: Amazing food and Great coffee!

name: Patrick Webb
text: My wife and i spent our 5th anniversary at Jam for Brunch and were blown away. Even though it was nearing closing time, they we're still very busy. We were given our choice of seating and sat immediately. The food here is the best Breakfast/Brunch food I've eaten. I had a flight of Benedict's where I chose 2 different types of eggs Benedict. I could not believe the flavor in those things. I rounded it off with a peanut butter cup pancake and it was perfect. All the food here was better than I could have imagined it would be. We we're also extremely pleased with the service and our food was brought out to us fast! If you are looking for a new spot to go, go here. You will not be disappointed!

name: Brent Wilting
text: Unique menu and great food for lunch and breakfast. Breakfast only on weekends. Atmosphere is comfortable even when they are packed and they are usually packed. Even with a line outside they usually get you in quick. text message notification so you can shop downtown while waiting.

name: Chris Knudson
text: Always good. Friendly staff. Quick food service.

name: Erin McKenna
text: Really enjoyed this restaurant.  The food was good as well as the service. It is SO busy!  The line was way out the door when we arrived but moved fairly quickly. The wait staff did great keeping up with the huge amount of customers, but you could tell a few were slightly flustered. However...if popularity is an indication of how good the food is, they are right on!

name: Greg Clark
text: Food and staff are always amazing.  It's tough to stray from the benidects but I suggest you do everything we have had on the menu has been amazing.

name: Don Douglas
text: Great menu selection. Only serve breakfast on Sundays. I got the Benedict Crab Cake. Came with potatoes.  Very yummy.  Good atmosphere.  Excellent coffee and friendly service.  Just a bit overpriced @ $18.

name: Mark Cybulski
text: Been here only twice and the food and service was excellent highly recommend

name: Rachel Cotterell
text: My favorite place to get the most amazing eggs benedict with a mimosa!! Atmosphere is always fun and inviting, servers are always kind and upbeat!!!

name: Mike Akerlow
text: Fun place, great food and good service!

name: I Haps
text:
JAM: The food down your throat, the check in your face, now get out the GD door!
Dang y'all, I understand it's tourist season but getting pestered about your order two times within three minutes of being seated on a weekday is crazy. Our checks were even sniped by some other over-zealous server, potentially trying to cash in harder than our own in the food-factory craziness that is this restaurant on a weekday at 9AM.
The food is good, though!

name: Zoie Zundel
text: This place is super good. Great for a little bit more thought out breakfast. However because it is good and also super cute inside its really bisy most of the time. If you arent looking for a 30 minute wait time for a weekend morning breakfast then this isnt for you. The Mia benedict is phenomenal as well as the loaded hasbrowns.

name: Connie Hahn
text: Amazing food and wonderful service. More expensive than Nova and much much noisier. Had to yell across the booth. Recommended going during the off hours.  But a great choice for breakfast!

name: Jane Cumby
text: Excellent service, food and cleanliness. What a great place! The beet salad is wonderful.

name: Babii BiPolarBear
text: Expensive but definitely worth it! Best Benedicts you can find!

name: Truman West
text: I have always strongly disliked beets. Something possessed me to order the root vegetable platter and I did so with the intent to pick all of the beets out. However the dish was so delicious I ate every last bite. Hands down this was the best breakfast I've ever had!

name: Cory Lagor
text: Amazing people, amazing food, amazing atmosphere, just basically amazing all around. Oh and the stuffed French toast, it's also amazing.

name: Shauna Hoffman
text: Our favorite family breakfast.  We love to indulge on the breakfast specials and libations

name: Jon Gfeller
text: Excellent food. Excellent service. Decor is kinda mid-century modern meets rustic. Bonus for Shine On You Crazy Diamond by Pink Floyd playing in the background.

name: Amy W
text: Amazingly happy, helpful, friendly, professional service made for an outstanding lunch. The food was great, with lots of sweet and savory options. Hint: if you get the Counter Assualt Sandwich, order your heat level carefully. The chef brings the heat!

name: Taylor Gerber
text: Great food worth the wait in line

name: Nikki Jackson
text: Food was great fantastic atmosphere buuutttt the pancakes are way to expensive

name: Dieter
text: This place always has awesome service and great food. If you go on the weekdays, you can get lunch food and their sandwiches are amazing.

name: Tom Gibson
text: Great service.  Good energy.

name: Madi Almadi
text: Really amazing place to have a breakfast n brunch !!!

name: Karena Wright
text: Quick, delicious, and friendly

name: Jen Lachowiec
text: I love Jam. Bustling atmosphere and yummy breakfasts. Their biscuits are not to miss.

name: Ashton Ferruzzi
text: Good food. A lot of GF options. Charge a fair bit extra for them, but they are tasty. Very hipster type joint if you're into that.

name: Eric Eichel
text: Good breakfast place right in the middle of downtown. Prices are reasonable and staff is friendly. Can get busy at times to expect a wait during rush hour, but overall worth the wait. Will go back.

name: Shelby Carver
text: This place is wonderful! I was so excited to get great tasting food that was gluten free. It's hard to find food with my allergies, so I wish I could take this restaurant home with me.

name: Jennifer Pearson
text: Great atmosphere, great service, delicious food with lots of gluten free options.

name: Art Hoffart
text: Good food and good service

name: tim roose
text: Loved this place great food and real Montana  Hospitaltiy lots to eat BE hungry

name: David Dean
text: Wild mushroom omelet (special) was crazy good. Cool ambience. Super friendly staff. Perfect place to round out my vacation. Would be a regular if I lived in town!

name: jeffrey grigsby
text: Great food.i had something.. grab meal.nice ..staff was great.😍

name: Taunia Kittler
text: Best Breakfast with atmosphere ever.

name: Jen Wakefield
text: GREAT FOOD!!!! Amazing service. If you like tea, their Earl Grey is devine.

name: Joe Dilschneider
text: Great food and a lovely atmosphere

name: Paul Stanley
text: Enjoyed my biscuits and gravy.  Get there early because they're usually pretty busy.

name: River Burns
text: Love this place!

name: Aaron Brittingham
text: Great modern breakfast food. They have breakfast appetizers/small plates, which I think is a great, unique idea. Every time I've gone I've gotten something different, and it's always been terrific.

name: T.W. Winston
text: Breakfast spot. Service is real. Good food. I had the loaded hash browns. Did not disappoint.

name: Nigel Anselmi
text: Wait times have been much longer than what they estimate, even with reservations. Food has been good, but nothing is stand out, especially for prices. Need to work on sitting people in a timely manner. Gluten free options have a massive surcharge (up to 30% of the cost of the regular meal). In my opinion, there are no real, affordable gluten free options

name: William Gruenes
text: Great presentation but the recipe was one too many ingredients that ruined it.  Shame.

name: Saya Shimada
text: Definitely a "treat yourself" breakfast place. Food is always fresh and the quality, but is on the expensive side for breakfast. Delicious dark brewed coffee. Only go on weekdays because the weekend wait times will put you at lunch time or later.

name: Tim Dolan
text: Had my birthday breakfast here. Had a great visit made more memorable with the biscuits and gravy, attentive service, attractive decor

name: Vicky Shaw
text: Awesome service, food was delicious

name: Shelley Thomas
text: Outstanding everything, except for the long wait.

name: Jessica Detlor
text: Havent always had the nicest service here. The menu/environment reminds us of the chain Snooze! I do love their coffee and gluten free flax coconut banana pancakes though. The other pancakes we've tried were dry and overly sweet

name: Rudi Pafford
text: Truly legendary. Get the biscuits and gravy!

name: Ty Walsh
text: Great setting in a perfect spot in downtown Bozeman. We didn't wait at all on a Tuesday morning and were seated promptly. They're well staffed and attentive to tables. The cold brew coffee was on nitro, the plates were fast and the portions were fair. Lauren was our waitress and she was awesome. The bathrooms were also very clean. The only mistake I made was not refilling my cup on the way out. That nitro was fiya! Keep it up guys!

name: Alexandra Woolley
text: I’ve never loved a breakfast place quite as much as I will ever love Jam!

name: Kelly Rebollo
text: A great breakfast spot in Bozeman!

name: Jonathan Hilgeman
text:
Just got back from eating breakfast at Jam for the first time and I'm a little uncomfortable because I was determined to finish the breakfast burrito, despite my stomach not being big enough. However, the thing was just REALLY good (especially with avocado slices)...

It probably also didn't help that my wife wanted to try their cinnamon roll "appetizers" and I wasn't about to ignore a caramel-glazed cinnamon roll that was sitting in front of me. And yes, it was delicious, and was larger than what I would expect from the word "appetizer."

When I try any new breakfast place, one of the measures of their success is their mocha, and I'd say that theirs was the best I've had in Bozeman so far, barely beating out the mocha from Nova Cafe. Smooth, not TOO sweet, and no leftover sludge sitting at the bottom of the cup when finished. They did the whole leaf design thing on top, too, but I honestly care more about how it tastes than how it looks.

My wife had their basic breakfast with smoked cheddar cheese folded into her eggs. She offered me a bite, which was awesome, but I was all about my breakfast burrito (and so was she after a couple bites).

Fantastic experience, free coffee while waiting, and their wait time was similar to Nova's. Jam is definitely now among my top 5 breakfast restaurants!

name: Michelle Williams
text: Excellent vibe! Loved the atmosphere,  excellent food

name: Doreen Neely
text: Cool place with great food and friendly staff. A must do if you're in the area

name: 123kaelee123
text: Nice service and all, but the food I personally ordered sounded simple and good but ended up being atrocious. The rest of my table enjoyed theirs, though! Very nice host and staff.

name: Jeremy DeVries
text: Love it.  Great breakfasts and always get a bucket of fun!!

name: Kelly McCann
text: Cool little place in downtown Bozeman. Had a great menu, great service, and an overall great experience.

name: Kim Wiley
text: LOVE the food and GREAT Place to work NICE people

name: Erica Burrell
text:
The food is unique and good but recommend management encourage their staff to increase personal hygiene. Staff was eating and drinking over the food preparation area and we saw several instances where hands needed to be washed after touching unsanitary things then food.

We also were there for late brunch, had already ordered $30 of food, there were five open tables with no one waiting, and we were pressed repeatedly about where the rest of our party was, only two people. We also were sitting in a tiny table as it was. We caused no missed tables or lost money but we're not treated very well by other servers. Our server that day was great and got a 30% tip, he didn't pressure is at all. Ended spending $120 for four adults to eat a late breakfast.

name: Lindsey
text: My server Kelsey was attentive and friendly! If you are a coffee lover try the Bee Sting, sooo delish!!

name: B B
text: First visit and took my wife for her birthday breakfast. Extremely fun and new twist on breakfast. Outstanding portions & presentation, ate every bite. Prices were definitely fair. The lack of friendly service caused me to drop a star. Pains me to leave a tip for this constant Bozeman level of bland milk toast low energy millennial service that act like they don’t really care if you come back again. But I will return and hope to switch it up to five stars

name: Shannon Boyle
text: I Love this place so much!

name: Matthew O'Leary
text: Great brunch and wonderful service. We loved the mimosa bucket

name: Mik'haela Digan
text: It has good food that seems like it is from scratch. The environment and the furniture are very different and cool. If you are going in the morning make sure you get there very early because they get very packed so you will be waiting. They also have good service.

name: 3-Gun Jack
text: If you like avocados, love flannel, collect indie records, only drink craft brew, cultivate a glitter beard, plaster your car with PNW stickers, and kinda wish you lived in Portland, then this is the place for you.

name: russell damm
text: The food is always great, and the menu is constantly evolving. We love the atmosphere and the staff is awesome.

name: Ádám Máté
text:
Had a great breakfast here the other day. I went with family and friends, and everyone enjoyed the Jam!
Our service was fine, maybe a bit slow on a Monday morning when the place was super packed (!) -- but our food arrived fast, and their staff was friendly and attentive.
The meals were pretty delicious. I myself got the veggie omlett, which was a good size and tasted awesome.
Jam! is a great spot in downtown Bozeman and I would stop by here without hesitation next time I'm in town.

name: Ann Ledon
text: Great food, amazing mimosas, great atmosphere!

name: Leslie Metcalf Gilbertson
text: Love the food and atmosphere, this is one of my favorite places+

name: Ryan Trefethen
text: Hands down best breakfast in town. Fresh and interesting options, cooked with more skill than breakfast usually has any right to expect. Fast and friendly service, but call ahead for seating, because it's quality isn't a secret, so it's always busy.

name: Alissa Putnam
text: Mmmmm mmmmmm! The food is delish and the service is great! Asher was a delightful server. Be prepared to wait for a table though. Thankfully I sent a friend ahead and she got us a table ;)

name: The Wild Montanan
text: Great breakfast food and great service

name: Logan Shelagowski
text: This is seriously good food. I visited for breakfast a few weeks ago, the coffee is great and all of the food was delicious! I would recommend Jam! to any one!

name: Brandon Meadors
text: Great staff & amazing food. You will pay more here than other breakfast places but you will get your money's worth here as well.

name: Forsaken One
text: Great Sunday morning brunch spot! Lively mix of clientele from Bozeman's outdoors, college, and just-plain cool crowd. I recommend the Huevos Rancheros and a Mimosa!

name: R G Kos
text: What else can be said about Jam? Outstanding food in a comfortable place that will make you say "Holy Mother!" No trip to Boze is complete without. Well worth the wait.

name: Na'Cole Beall
text: A must visit in Bozeman. Not only is the downtown area fun and cute, but this place is amazing. Best Reuben I have ever tried! They braise their beef in house. Fresh squeezed juices with a delicious bottle of prosecco! Meredith was a darling server and gave us great suggestions to enjoy the local area. This will absolutely always be my stop now going to Bozeman. If you like wholesome fresh real food this is your place

name: leslie madsen
text: Great pancakes

name: Susie and Jeremy Wiedemann
text: Great food and friendly service.

name: Bill Seymour
text: Great place for breakfast or lunch.  Interesting menu with good service.  Looking forward to trying more of the items on the menu.

name: Bayard L
text:
One of the gold star breakfast restaurants in Bozeman. They have been around for less than 2 years, but their menu, atmosphere, and seating are top notch. After eating here a half dozen times, I have never been disappointed.

Whether your taste buds are craving a protein rich breakfast or a carb bomb, the flavorful dishes will leave you feeling satisfied and ready to start your day on the right foot.

You may be waiting in line extra time if coming with more than your significant other, but it’s worth the wait.  Now that the breakfast place on north Rouse has closed their doors, Jam should always be one of your go-to breakfast/brunch options.

text:
Well, that lasted about a month.  The last time I used Access, I had to brush dirt off the floor before push-ups, avoid breaking a leg on a broken treadmill, and step around patches of mold in the showers.  I've since switched to a different club, pay a little more, but enjoy much nicer facilities.  Access is still an okay place for the price.

I'll miss all the friends I made there, though...

- Second Edit Follows -
Access obviously listens to their clients.  Since I posted the edit (below), every single point I raised has been dealt with.  Back up to four stars for now.  If they keep this up for a few months, the rating will have to bump back up to five stars.

- First Edit Follows -
Things have started to go downhill since my initial review.  New employees do not take the effort to remember my name, much less recognize me when I come in the door.  In fact, there are occasions when they wander in more than an hour past the posted staffed hours.

Cleaning, which used to be immaculate in the days of Gold's Gym, has gone by the wayside.  It's not bad, but could be much better.

Equipment breaks down, that's a fact of every gym.  But, what used to take a day or two to fix now takes months.

Access is still the best place in town for my training.  It's the only place that allows me to do what I do and provides the equipment to do so.  Therefore, I will continue to pay for their services.  But, if another place comes to town, I might just have to throw in the towel at Access.

- Original Review Follows -
I am one of those "loud grunting men" that the other reviewer complained about.  Access is one of the few places in town that doesn't discriminate toward varying workout cultures.  It's truly judgement free zone.  I'll patiently wait my turn while you do your cross fit pull-ups in the power rack.  Once you're done, I'll chalk up (they don't mind) and do my quarter ton rack pulls.  If you don't like my style, you can go somewhere else.  But, I don't mind if you're here; more power to you.  No matter what you're doing, it's probably better than sitting at home on the couch.

Oh, and about the employees?  Every single one of them knows me by name and greets me as I enter and leave.

name: Only Nate
text: Great coffee. Try the cold smoke. It’s worth it. This is also a great place to meet or get some side hustle done.  The environment has plenty of room and is a fun place to hang out.

name: Bayard L
text:
The coffee prices are very expensive compared to other similar coffee shops in Bozeman. Almond and coconut milk are not available as milk alternatives. Currently $5 for a 12 oz latte.

Ample seating area and places to plug in make the shop great for working remotely. The wifi works well and doesn't require annoying setup that the corporate coffee shops require, which can disrupt the internet connection during longer sessions.

Easy parking has been available every time I've visited the west location.

text: Really nice space with a beautiful coffee bar wrapping around the roasting machine. I may well like this space better than the Oak Street location.

name: Claire Richards
text: Coffee is somehow always the perfect drinking temperature. Excellent coffee, excellent Mochas. Staff is kind and make great coffee! Awesome interior, and makes me want to hang out there and drink coffee. Best spot to sit is by the fireplace. Overall, great.

name: Kathy Frazer
text: The baristas are pretty friendly. Very relaxed atmosphere.

name: Sheldon Young
text: Lots of room great chai tea! The coffee and tea really reflects the atmosphere, really up to date nice modern feel. Right off the main drag, super easy to find.

name: Janna Lauver
text: The London fog tea latte is delicious. Make sure you get a treat too. Cookies or scones or one of each.

name: Evan Lerum
text: Great coffee great place to have small meetings or to work. However, they only serve 2 or 4 shots of espresso (you cant order 1 or 3 shots). Also their 'frappes' are just milkshakes until you ask for and pay extra to get espresso in them. I'd still go back.

name: Jennifer K
text: Cold Smoke and their staff are the best of the best! Great service and tea, coffee and snacks are always available with a smile. They are awesome about giving back to this community too. Love this cozy coffee spot and the new coffee roasting spot inside too!

name: Ann Ledon
text: Beautiful, warm interior. Great etas and super friendly staff!

name: JOHN THOMPSON
text: The coffee is good, I had the medium roasted black no cream no sugar. I also got some water at their tap on the counter but it did taste funny maybe even a little salty? Otherwise nice place. The person taking my order did seem distracted by whomever was talking in her earpiece for the drive through...multitasking I suppose.

name: andrew Breuner
text: This is my go to coffee shop.My dad was in the coffee business while I grew up so I know good coffee and boy do they have it. The staff is incredibly friendly. They remember my name and order and they have that kind of relationship with a lot of people.the live music they have weekly is always a fun experience. It's also a great place to go do homework as a college student. they have fast wifi, and lots of room to get away from distractions

name: Phaedra Nielson
text: Great environment. Clean, good food and drink.

name: Josh Erickson
text: Nice place. Very relaxing and friendly staff.

name: Danielle Elder
text: Their drinks are good, but their drive thru is pretty neglected. Very slow service every time I’ve stopped on my way to work in the morning. The drive thru on Oak is much faster.

name: Mellanie Lerum
text: Great espresso. Friendly service. However, drinks seem to be made differently by different people: there doesn't seem to be a standard.

name: Kim Crawford
text: As a student I've tried every coffee and tea shop in town and I am impressed with this location in particular. They are fast and always kind. Their food is reasonably priced and there is plenty of seating options when it gets full of studying students. Comfy place.

name: Tim Dolan
text: Lots of seating, booths, etc. 2 meeting rooms in back. A new fav out-of-the-way place to go. Has a mission contributing to water needs around the world.

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: Great coffee and super friendly staff. Their conference rooms and facilities are super comfortable for work or friends gatherings. Their snacks are great and I just wish they had more variety and GF and veggie options.

name: Cari Douglass
text: The food is delicious, the coffee is great and the atmosphere is really nice. The staff have always been really friendly as well!

name: Gabriel Howley
text: Massive space with really helpful staff. And quality food and coffee. Good for events in their conference room, or a one on one by the fireplace. One of my favorite places in Bozeman hands down. I will definitely be back.

name: Gillian Zohnert
text: Love the atmosphere. Lots of space for private or business events. Clean spaces and friendly staff

name: Jacob Torgerson
text:
Always love coming here! The coffee is almost always great! I usually get a quad shot mocha because I trust they won't burn the shots. Also, they actually stream the milk properly (dense foam without burning it) and have fun latte art to top it off!

When I want an actual good mocha and a place to study for a couple hours, my first choice is always Coldsmoke.

name: Corrie Lavina Knight
text:
Best coffee shop in Bozeman, despite their severely uncomfortable metal chairs.

The custom-built booths and comfy cushioned chairs are fantastic, and the attached swivel seating in the one area is tolerable for a limited time.

The conference room is great for groups, but be prepared to be blinded by the late afternoon/evening sun due to the positioning of windows with no shades or drapes of any kind. (Plan/schedule your conference room activities accordingly.)

Best coffee in Bozeman!

The food options on their menu are delicious, albeit spendy (but keep in mind that you get what you pay for. Where other restaurants might give you greater quantity and/or selection for your money, the food offered at Cold Smoke is always delicious and made with quality ingredients).

Best chicken salad croissant sandwich in Bozeman!

Baristas are well-trained, professional, and highly personable.

Cold Smoke's business model is admirable.

If I were interested in working at a coffee shop, I would apply first at Cold Smoke before even looking at any other options.

As uncomfortable as the chairs are at this location, they're better than the chairs at the other location. The conference room here is also much larger and better suited to events requiring multiple outlet access for electronic devices.

name: Gregory L.
text: Not much chicken in the chicken pesto panini. The chicken that was in there was mostly cold. Could also use a few more ingredients, even a couple slices of tomato would help.

I Love this place, Its a nice place for coffee with nice staff. .

text: Very pretty place, horrible coffee and tea. The only reason I gave this place two stars is because of the atmosphere and friendly baristas. I have tried multiple drinks here, from black coffee to their London fog, and it all tastes super gross. The coffee has always seemed burnt, and the tea is just nasty. text: Came for Sunday brunch and got seated right away...every game we wanted to see was playing, and the food was phenomenal. Scrambles are great, chicken fried steak is to die for. Good pancakes as well. Drink selection has something for everyone and Sunday was all day happy hour!

text: There are so many good places to eat on Main Street, and this isn’t one of them. The food prices are similar to other nearby places, but the similarity ends there. The garlic fries were just dumped with raw garlic, the salsa on our fish tacos was past its prime and the tortillas were gummy.  Our waitress was nice, but would best be described as awkward. There was also a strange odor coming from the indoor dining area.

text: I came in to El Camino an an event night when it was PACKED. It took a while to be seen at the bar, but when they got to me the drink was good. The layout of the bar is fantastic for mixing, and everyone was super friendly. I'll be back.

text: The waitress there looks like Bad Janet from The Good Place. Good drinks, food and service.

name: JOHN THOMPSON
text:
The concept finally feels to have found its fit in this location after many attempts by other operators. The staff is friendly the place is clean and the atmosphere is fun, relaxed, yet active.  Good for college folks, families and everyone. The menu recently changed and to my displeasure they removed many of my favorites, tacos, jalapeño poppers... now it’s burgers or breakfast and their apps are nachos, fried cauliflower, chicken strips, fries...all of which are good. Very good hamburgers even. BUT no tacos!! I wish they hadn’t limited the menu.

Lots of fun drinks though, slushees, mimosas, and so on. Good beers on tap.

resp.text: Hey Brittani, 2 of our cabinets are actually multi-cades and Pac Man is available along with a bunch of other games. Thank you for your feedback though because we are always trying to better our bar!

text:
Crowded, loud, and unattentive service. It's a new business, so i expect these things will work themselves out. The kiddish menu is really over the top and doesn't appeal to me, but then I don't like sugary, expensive drinks made with cheap liquor. Beer selection is good.
Snack menu has no shortage of deep fried grease bombs. The concept is cute, but the bar was too busy to play any games.
With all the other options out there, not sure I'll be back.

text: Mac and cheese was great but grossly overpriced for the portion size. The service was pretty bad too. The only time I've ever returned a drink in my life was here, it was disgusting. Definitely will not be returning.

name: Taylor Stults
text: I was honestly really disappointed... I was hoping that the Toro replacement was going to be step up, but it got WORSE. The service is priompt, and one of my good friends is even a bartender there. He is incredible, along with the other gentleman behind the bar, and I'm sorry that I have to write this review, but the food was just awful. The menu seemed like something that a group of college boys threw together in their dorm room. I ended up getting the grilled chicken tacos, and 'grilled' is a gross understatement for the amount of CHAR on this chicken. I had to keep asking for different sauces to try and drown out the flavor. That being said, the fry sauce is BOMB.

text: Honestly the best bar in town, the frozen drinks are so good, I hadnt had a good frozen daiquiri since I went to Florida🙏🏻 the arcade games are great and shuffle board is free. NOT TO MENTION THE MUSIC IS LIGHTYEARS BETTER THAN ANY BAR. Respect the snoop, biggie smalls, and Tupac songs!

text:
Awesome bar, I had two alcoholic slushies that were the bomb. The pbj burger with the coleslaw I had was bodacious as well. There are some arcade games,shuffle board,mini bowling and connect four to tickle your fancy.

I highly recomend this bar for a good time

text: Loved all the options for drinks and it has a really fun atmosphere

name: John McParland
text: This place is really fun, NFL blitz 99 on arcade with a couple neo geos, TMNT and street fighter 2 turbo on arcade as well as multiple shuffleboards. I really appreciated how friendly the bar staff was as well as how cheap the happy hour beer was. Love this place!

name: Lisa
text: Oh MAN, my favorite brunch in Bozeman-- a very simple menu but OH SO GOOD.

name: Peyton Rodriguez
text: Super cool new place, you should definitely check it out! The bartenders are amazing, it's super busy but they get to you so quick!

name: Stephanie U
text: Wow! Horrible experience! Three of us went in on St. Patrick's day to a surprisingly mellow atmosphere, maybe 30 people. I was instantly drawn back with how they changed the space from the former pretty/shiny Toro into a distinct dive bar. Don't get me wrong, I'm all about dive bars in Bozeman. I thought the arcade machines were cool and a unique addition to the Bozeman bar scene. Sat down, took the server longer than 10 minutes to get to us. We walked to the bar ourselves to order our drinks at which time the server said, "Um, I'm ready for you now." I said, "you're too late, we're going to order at the bar." She walked away taking it well. At the bar we waited another 5-8 minutes just to get eye contact. While we waited we took in the space and noticed a tray of assorted random items including hot sauce, pizza rolls, pretzels, peppers, etc. My friend took at pizza roll at the same time the rude and prissy bartender was "ready for us." My friend asked what the tray was for and the bartender rudely replied in her valley girl tone, "Actually, that's for the Bloody Mary bar and I really don't appreciate you just taking what you want." We suggested they maybe add a sign but the bartender replied, "That's not my problem and you should maybe just be polite and ask in the future instead of take." She had a point HOWEVER her snarky attitude backed by how pathetic her "I rule all" face looked was enough to let me know that I would never give them my money again. YOU GET ONE SHOT EL CAMINO AND FRANKLY YOU'RE NOT LIVING UP TO THE BOZEMAN STANDARD OF CUSTOMER SERVICE. Educate your staff and watch your customer approach because... for now... I will be spreading my horrible experience, LOUDLY, to anyone who will listen to me!

name: Adam Lebrecht
text: Very slow but good food

name: Steve Olp
text:
Eric Foreman's basement has been moved to downtown Bozeman and it's a blast.
1. Food is awesome! That Fried Chicken Sammie though...
2. Slushies are a great idea. Also dangerously delicious.
3. Patio is awesome, heart of downton Bozeman is yours inside or outside here.
4. Arcade games and shuffleboard. $10 worth of quarters is wish fulfillment for my ten year old self.
5. Entrance to Kitty Warren is now inside El Camino. Bar within a bar.
6. Projector playing games, potential tournaments ahead??
7. Bartenders are fun and enthusiastic. Surprisingly few service errors for the first weekend of being open. But be patient, these things take time.
8. Ultimately a really fun new themed bar. Digging the 70's and 80's music
9. This should probably be higher but the safety measures are impressive. Face shields are worn by the entire staff. Ordering is done by Que, Hand Sanitizer is everywhere!
10. LGTBQIA  friendly, youre safe and welcome here.

text:
***CASH ONLY***

This place rocks. Super chill staff, freshly made 💣 donuts on the daily. Wide variety of flavors; all delicious. I personally really enjoy the maple long john and the Boston cream with chocolate ganache.

The vibe here is spot on, but make sure you show up before 11 if you want a decent selection as they generally run out completely before close (2 pm). Wish they were open more days of the week but appears to be a Fri-Sun business, and I’m thankful every weekend!

name: Timothy Whitney
text: I live in Washington State and wished that I lived in Bozeman Montana simply because of these donuts. The old guy who owns this place is awesome and enjoys bantering, joking and sharing wisdom with his customers.  It's a little tiny place that serves the world's best donuts! I get the coffee cream donut every time I go there and I usually don't walk away without ordering a dozen donuts. I make my annual pilgrimage to Bozeman Montana to have donuts at Granny's. It's the best!

name: Drake Pannell
text: They are great, I promise. Bring cash!

name: Thursday Ackerman
text: Amazing donuts! Super great customer service too! I had to leave to get cash to pay and they gave me an extra donut for my trouble. A little sassy but I appreciated it. Can’t wait to go back in again. With a business like this, it’s gonna be hard not to get donut fat!

name: Margaret Klein
text: Delicious, homemade donuts! I love their cake donuts and my husband loves their maple frosted yeast donuts. Never had a bad experience, this is a must visit for Bozeman!

name: Wyatt Petty
text: Granny’s donuts are iconic. If you want a donut packed with love and stuffing you’ve come to the right place. With all of their varieties, handmade that morning ; you’re never going to get a stale and sad snack.

name: Kashmira Behr
text: Granny's donuts are hands down the best nostalgic, delicious, donuts that Bozeman will ever have. Forget grocery store donuts...this place is where it's at. I have fond morning memories of going out for grannies donuts and getting to put my own sprinkles on. The owner is the nicest man and gave me a free donut when I didn't have enough money for 5. The options are fun and creative...and super delicious. Homemade sugary goodness. Super affordable. Just remember to bring cash!!

name: Belgrade Property
text: This place is an institution in Bozeman... Be prepared to wait to get in, and then have a good laugh when you talk to the staff.

name: Samuel Trammell
text: Best Donuts Period. All of them.

name: Belle Smolczynski
text: Amazing donuts and the owners/workers are just incredible!!

name: Mym B
text: Delicious! Granny's donuts always have a chewy, scrumptious texture that makes my mouth water! Today's special, huckleberry, is sure to make every Montanan swoon! We'll be back soon. We especially appreciate how kind and speedy every worker is, but we love the jokes there the most!

name: David Towery
text: Best little donut shop in Montana. They will make you , on the spot any flavor if they're out or you don't see it . Can't get that from Dunkin Donuts.

name: Bayard L
text:
For a quick, healthy bite, the downtown co-op offers a salad bar, readymade meals to go, and a hot food bar.

If you’re willing to spend about $10-12, you can fill a hot plate with a good amount of organic (or semi-organic) meat and veggie dishes to satisfy an adult appetite.

The selection of baked goodies is also good and there are dairy free and gluten free options.

For refreshment during summer, the coolers are well stocked with sodas, local beers, and juice spritzers.

It can be hard to find parking to get here, but if you’re already downtown, it’s an easy stop to get a healthy meal, snack, or a beverage.

resp.text: WOW - thank you for this review Bayard! We apologize of the delay in our response to you. We are so grateful for your support of our store.

text: This place is a bit pricey, BUT they have the good stuff. I am not a member, so it might have been cheaper if I were. I come here primarily for the ethnic food on certain days. The premium price is expected, because they put extra care on what they serve to the community: the fresh organic and the ethnic food. The place has a warm atmosphere with a really colorful interior design.

resp.text: Thank you Pancasatya! We choose organic and local ingredients whenever possible. These foods do cost more than their conventional counterparts, but we are always looking for ways to keep prices affordable. We appreciate your feedback and look forward to seeing you again soon. Apologies for the delay in our response to your review.

name: Katie Daughenbaugh

We wondered since there's a microwave near the silverware if we are intended to heat it ourselves. ? If not then something is certainly amiss. Even if you account for the time it takes to wait in line and pay for your food, one wouldn't expect it to be quite as not-hot as it was. Apart from the temperature, the taste was good and the Co-op often does a great job, but this might be an area of improvement. Thanks!

resp.text: Hi Katie - Thank you so much for taking the time to let us know about your experience. Your feedback is valuable and gives us the opportunity to do better for all of our customers. name: Eat Well Travel Often
text: Since moving to Bozeman a few months ago, we’ve asked random people while waiting in line at gas stations, employees at the Mall, cashiers, dental office staff, & anyone else we happened to come into contact with, about Mexican restaurants here. You can count on one hand the Mexican food options in the area, and that’s including the Mall Food Court & food truck. We were told over and over that there just isn’t any GOOD Mexican restaurants here. We went ahead & tried Fiesta Méxicana (in both Bozeman & Belgrade), and were super impressed! We’ve eaten at both locations numerous times now & have left happy every single time. The queso is on point, guacamole is fresh, cheese enchiladas are perfect (we always have them add onion into the cheese), fajitas are a fav (especially if stopping by Monday thru Friday for the lunch price), & their Micheladas are perfection (I ask for the Clamato in a separate glass on the side so I can mix it exactly how I like it). If you’re ordering bottled beer, be sure to ask for a cold glass (the glasses are SO cold, your beer will form a thin layer of ice on top when you pour it in... YES, please😍). Dinner entrees are more than enough for 2 people to split, which we’ve done a time or two, but the leftovers are almost as good the next day (so we usually order 2 entrees & have 2 to go boxes full for lunch the next day). Oh, and service has been above and beyond every single time we’ve been to this location. 100% recommend👍🏼 & we’ll continue to return again & again.

text: Awesome place, great variety of games to play. Love it!

name: Megan
text: My son had the time of his life at a birthday party here. The staff is the perfect mix of attentive and hands-off. They make sure your (or your kids) don't spend your precious minutes figuring things out or getting lost in the early details. They check in on you to make sure the VR isn't overhwhelming you. They also do a great job of making sure kids are respectful with the equipment, without being destructive. If you get the chance, talk to the staff - they are very passionate about their mission of using their facility to bring people together in the gaming experience during an era when one-player games are becoming a sad trend.

name: W.B.Malcolm Myers
text: Useslly the cafeteria food is bland and not really good at all, I found this hospital food to be very much up to par.....very good....

name: Felix
text: The games were awesome, the staff helped so much and were really friendly. I had so much fun!

name: Jace Berger
text: Wonderful shop. Staff was very nice and incredibly helpful. Spent almost a hour playing Superhot while my little sister tried Project Cars 2. If you've got a hour or so to burn definetly stop by and give it a try.

name: Tom Halbritter
text: My son loves it plays once a month at least

Hello,

text: Has Games!

name: Tim Halbritter
text: Love the people

name: Thomasita
text: What a wonderful little restaurant with upscale atmosphere and food. A great place for Tapas with friends or a loved one.  I treated myself to a three course meal with dessert wine and espresso. I would definitely go back next time I am in town.

name: Stephanie U
text:
We recently went to Barley and Vine for brunch and loved it. My husband got the chicken and waffle which was amazing, the sweetness was baked right into the waffle and he barely had to use any syrup. It was so flavorful!!! I had the Croque Madame, which is fancy toast with sunny side up egg, arugula, huckleberry jam and Hollandaise sauce. It was so delicious! I’ve never had anything quite like it. I also had a side of the roasted potatoes which had full cloves of roasted garlic and an amazing herb blend.  It was all phenomena , including the service. The girls were really friendly and knowledgeable about their drink selection. They have one of the best selections of cider in town, not that eight selections is a lot but for Bozeman that’s quite a bit. They also had some very unique foreign beers and quite a great selection of wine. Living in Bozeman, you get very accustomed to American style food, however it’s been along time since I’ve been to a
restaurant that vastly exceeded my expectations of food and flavor. As someone who was born in Bozeman I highly recommend Barley and Vine and I hope that you enjoy it just as much as I did. Mind you, I'm a very picky reviewer, and this place earned every bit of my 5 star rating.

name: Brett Loomis
text: Great food. Portions are small so order 1 or 2 extra. It is very pricy but food is good and service is excellent.

name: Sarah B
text: What an inspiring meal! I was seated in a comfortable corner, I had an superb chicken tortellini soup, flavorful chicken drumettes with blue cheese dressing, and a special salad with fresh strawberries and lettuce, brie and almonds. The wine was delicious too. Monday happy hour is really fabulous!

name: Daniel Pollard
text: Fantastic small plates menu. Constantly changing, so it’s easy to go back and see what’s new. Excellent wine list. The staff are fantastic. Shout out to Josh and Thomas for always being great. Perfect later evening/night spot if you want to avoid the mess of the downtown bar scene.

name: Amy Mountain Ference
text: Far and away the best brunch in town (and quite possibly the best brunch I've ever had anywhere). I highly suggest bringing as many friends as you can wrangle and splitting a bunch of dishes as it's too hard to choose just one. Good happy hour specials and dinners are great, but that brunch menu really shines. Service is always good. A little loud when the place is packed.

name: Dieter
text: Awesome atmosphere and great service. Brussel sprouts were the best appetizer I've had in a hot minute

name: Gretchen Sultzer
text: Excellent food. Good service. We will be back!

name: Andy Amidon
text: Cool place, cool atmosphere. Tapas small plate style food to share which is fun and just right portions, a little pricey though when you are buying the multiple plates. The ravioli was great, and veggie pizza was awesome, good prices on beer and wine

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: Best restaurant in Bozeman! The staff is always warm and welcoming. Never had a bad dish

name: Jack Scherman
text: Wine selection was great.  Every dish was delicious and quite diverse.  All the dishes seemed to contain very fresh ingredients from across the world.  Had a wonderful dinner with 7 friends and everyone was very pleased with the experience. Lovely across the board, from seafood, to duck confit, to pizza. The bill can add up pretty quick from the fantastic food and desire to try it all.  I will definitely be returning.

name: Julie Smith
text: Unique atmosphere. The escargot is some of the best I’ve ever had! So far I have not tasted anything I didn’t like and I’ve been 3 times since it opened! It gets very loud since it’s a small space though. I definitely recommend this place if you’re looking to try something new.

name: Audrey Samuelsen
text: Top notch food with great attention to detail, a must have experience!

name: Ben Lemon
text: Typical Bozeman reastraunt.  Good food, decent prices. One of those hip places

name: Dean S
text: Atmosphere is cool.  Food is trendy and portions are small.  Not a huge fan on the chicken and waffles.  The chicken wings were just odd and  flavors did not blend well.  My wife had the Benedict and it was very small but tasty.

name: Andrew Nelson
text: Delicious food at good prices and the staff is very friendly and honest about their reccomendations.

name: Lauren Wittorp
text: The food was incredible. The best Brussels. The shumai was the best of all. Also recommend the sliders and bison Bolognese special. Dessert = don't skip the huckleberry cheesecake. I added the menu as a photo..

text: If you're seeking a cozy, intimate restaurant, with amazing food, a beautiful wine and beer selection and quality ingredients, stop by, you will not be disappointed.

text: Had dinner there last night for the first time.  The food was amazing and wine was great.  I'm glad we've got a good tapas place in Bozeman!

name: Ann Ledon

text: Great food and great service!!! Thomas was awesome!!!!

text: Fantastic

name: Billy Danford
text: Pizza Campania was such an awesome experience for me and my family the staff there were very warm and welcoming and let me get a first-hand view at the way they cook their Pizza and gave me a back story on how their wood fire stove was imported from Italy which was very beautiful and an amazing thing to see I ordered the Gladiator Pizza which was by far an amazing Pizza and my wife ordered was the pig and fig and was absolutely delicious their mozzarella sticks were also on point I would definitely recommend this to anybody looking to get a quick bite and I have a good family outing experience.

name: Eve Chou
text:
The door opens to an open and comfortable atmosphere. The smell of wood fired pizza hits you and you will start salivating. Service is impeccable and so warm. You feel like you are at home and about to devour a pie.

There is a pizza for everyone. You can find a pizza with all the different sauces. There are veggies or meat options. Salads to feel like you are being healthy and leave room for desserts. There are specials throughout the week so keep an eye out for them.

Carne e verde was the choice for the evening. It’s a very friendly size for the pie. Shareable and good for leftovers. Pizza is Neapolitan and has the nice wood fired flavor but not overwhelming. The crust has the crunch but still a tender chew. It’s perfectly thick enough to hold all the toppings. The pesto was fresh and went well with the sausage and prosciutto. The crispy bits of prosciutto added some nice texture along with some of the crunch of the crust. There are pieces of caramelized onions that brought some sweet elements to the pizza party. Sausage was meaty pops of flavor. There was also some spinach which is never a bad thing, some greens to help add some healthiness to the pie. The chili oil drizzle added some subtle kick to the party.

I didn’t plan as well but they have the classic Italian desserts. I would say save room for them.

name: Naomi Peterson
text: Some of the best pizza toppings and GREATEST gluten free crust ever!

name: Gabrielle slade
text: Went inside to pick up food. Host rudely told me it was curbside only. No direction. No signs to tell where curbside I had to find out by watching other cars. No indication online or in order conformation about curbside pick up only. Very confusing and annoying.

name: John Mace
text: What a great little gem. Something for everyone here. Cozy spot that makes you feel welcome. The pie "pizza" is cooked in a real stone oven. Soooooo good!!!! The other food is made to order and amazing. Bring your family and your appetite. I loved it!

name: Leanne Gerling
text: The wood burning o0ven makes the pizza special. I really dig the industrial vibe too.

name: Bridgette Hyde
text:
Great pizza but I will never come again. Very aggressive entry mat is anything but welcoming to strong healthy people. Potentially very sick people, loaded with lots of fear and no backbone are owning, Managing, and operating this joint.

It's important that I know and understand my local business owners business because they are my neighbors. I hear their message loud and clear.
How we run this town matters, who I pay my hard earned dollars to matters to align with my priorities as a consumer.
Smells like California-ruin!

name: Bruce C.
text: Pleasant help.  The tuscan pizza was delicious.

name: Liam O'Keefe
text: The pizza itself was good, but we were charged $4 for substitutions when the menu itself did not specify this extra cost and neither did our server. It would maybe make sense if it was a meat item for a vegetable item but we literally traded salami for sausage. If I wanted to pay extra for the sausage I would have kept the salami as well. The salad was ok although quite basic and they charge you $1 to add red onion. Tomato soup was bland.

text: Consistently great food and service!  Yvonne and her team create a great environment with the level of service they provide and the superior food and drinks they serve.  Great wine options and excellent tiaramasu (sp?). I am a frequent and happy customer!

text: Wood fired Neapolitan style pizza, friendly staff, relaxed atmosphere. They could reinforce the booths however: we had to try not to play backrest tug of war with the table behind us... I weigh 130lbs, it would be interesting to see a real American sit there.

text: Should be a 4.5 stars.  Love the pizzas but sometimes the crusts are as hard as masonite.  Very friendly staff.   Reasonable corkage fee.

name: Obadiah Rouse
text:
What a great place to relax and have some great food. Very relaxed atmosphere and enough room at lunch to eat without a reservation. If you plan on dinner you most likely need a reservation.

The gladiatore pizza is the best.

name: T. Clint Stone
text: I rarely give 5 start reviews, unless it's Subway (they always get my order right 😉), but these guys deserve it! I really felt like I had a fine dining experience at a pizzeria! It's a sophisticated atmosphere, with soft jazz at the perfect volume (their building has great acoustics btw) and a professional wait staff. I never had to raise my glass when it was empty, and I didn't have to ask for a check, everything magically appeared just as I was thinking about needing something! The pizza was fantastic, and they serve beer! It was a perfect place to wrap up a day of skiing!

name: Harley Hunter
text: Good atmosphere, great service, lots of fantastic pies to choose from.

name: Brian Norlin
text: Fantastic pizza! Definitely try the one with clams, amazing!

name: Ryan Bartholomew
text: Super friendly staff, absolutely delicious and creative pizza menu. I love the $5 take out discount on Wednesdays. Would love to see more specials to get the price down on off peak times. The restaurant location is convenient and atmosphere inside is comfortable. Definitely a place to try if you haven't, and a place to return to if you have!

name: Richard Murphy
text: I stopped in here on my way passing through Bozeman. I ordered a lunch pizza Togo and a salad. I can't help but to be critical. The pizza was good but I've had better in Bozeman. The pizza dough was not as well developed as other thus not providing that chewy/ crispy crust that I love. The chef also burnt the pizza too much for my likings as well. The fig goat cheese salad was delicious. Service was friendly. They building looks huge the but the space is quite small.

name: Jacy Morris
text: Good food,  but high prices

name: Carole Matthews
text: Nice variety on pizza, but kids didn't much care for it due to it being very different than what they are used to. I love how it's cooked tho. Went for a family dinner, but turned out more expensive than we had liked. It was busy the night we went, but the staff seemed to kind of forget we were there. Never received refills on drinks.

name: Steve Olp
text: Always good service here and a solid beer list. Rivals my favorite place for pizza in town and a great option if you don't want to head downtown. Caesar salad is great but have yet to find my signature pizza yet. It's a work in progress for me. Good beer selection with several European options to suit my fancy! Outdoor seating is nice in the evening. A little warm in the direct sun.

name: Czarina Davis
text: SO delicious! Their mozzerella sticks and pizza with bison sausage are terrific😃

name: Elizabeth E
text: Delicious food, wood fired pizza is great, good selection of beers on tap, and friendly staff.

name: Christine Armstrong
text: One of the best pizza places in Bozeman. Toppings, cheese, and sauces are great! Crust is really good, but is nothing special. Custom pizzas are all great. Have had several, and haven't been disappointed yet. Staff is friendly, wine selection is not extensive but is enough, beer selection is small but serves foreign brews. Is usually packed at dinner time, so call ahead! They do have a quiet waiting area. Fire pit outside and patio. Would recommend!

name: kade estill
text: Delicous flat bread wood.fired pizzas !! Elegant setting and fancy toppings

text: Great visual atmosphere in an old grain elevator type of building. Can get a bit loud when only even half full. Service and the wood fired pizzas never disappoint.

text: Great! One of the best pizza restaurants in the country. They have "artistic" specialty pies, but they also give the option to build your own, and that's usually not the case at restaurants of such quality. No photos of pizzas, but there's one of a giant hunk of Tira Misu, which she devoured.

It's more like cardboard than crust.  And, I was served the worst lasagna I have ever had.  It was lukewarm on the outside and nearly frozen in the middle.  The noodles had absolutely no bite and literally dissolved in my mouth.  I'll give them an extra star because I've never had an issue with the service, and the ingredients are obviously high quality and fresh.

text: Pizza Campania is a great place to get specialty pizzas.  They use high quality ingredients and the pizzas are cooked in a brick pizza oven. They don't just have pizzas but also have pasta and some other different entities.  There is a nice outdoor seating area with a fireplace.

name: Lisa
text:
I like this place a lot but I can agree to the other reviews of inconsistency.

I usually get the same pizza, sometimes I'll ask to add an extra ingredient to it, and sometimes I'll get it, other times its forgotten. Sometimes even one of the base ingredients are forgotten.. unsure how that happens aside from carelessness. If you're out of something, tell the customer.

The mushroom crostinis are great. Never had an issue with them.
Service is average; young.

Good wine and beer selection, although there have been times the beer is flat. Again, inconsistency.

Overall I enjoy this place but my friends gripe when I suggest it because I seem to be the only one with a vote for it.

name: Kashmira Behr
text: The pizza is very pricey for the size...almost like a personal pizza but slightly bigger. Though the pizza is good, I have found that it is a hit or miss. My first time I got the pizza with clams and the clams were WAY overcooked.  Some pizza combinations are good and others not so much. I wouldn't take kids here because they would be unsatisfied by the "untraditional" pizza choices. The spaghetti and meatballs were subpar and the tiramisu tasted like bread pudding. It's a nice place to go for a different pizza experience, but not my first choice for pizza in Bozeman.

name: Sean Francis
text: I want to love this place, the recipes are delicious and I like what I can eat of the pizzas, but every time I visit I've gotten burnt bubbles in all of my pies, and frankly lackluster service from the staff they employ. I hope they come around cause the place was great

name: Tiffany Gouge
text: Best pizza in Bozeman!! They have great pizza, pasta and salads!  Highly recommended.

name: Lance Steeves
text: Excellent pizza!! Our whole family gave raving reviews

name: Thom Hughes
text: This is wonderful, thin crust pizza.  Hand thrown, cooked in wood fired oven.  It's New Haven style pizza.  Great sauces.  My favorite is a mix of prosciutto, sausage, habanero chilli sauce, and a delicate cheese with carmelized onion.  On a warm day the outside dining is particularly pleasant.

name: Jim Flansburg
text: An amazing pizza dining experience. A great combination of flavors to appease even the most sophisticated palate.

name: Beth Lee
text: Best pizza in a town that had several great places for pizza.

name: Kara Haynes
text: Of of my favorite places to get pizza. Always amazing!
