name: C L
text: This is a local steakhouse and popular with the locals.  A meal includes relish tray with salad, entree and dessert so the price point seems ok. The baked potatoes come loaded if you wish.  Cuts of meat are variable.  The tenderloin was very flavorful and tender.  However the prime rib was bland and could have used seasoning, even salt and pepper would have helped.  Service for a small-town restaurant is good.

name: Tim Malone
text: A lot of food and descent prices. I think their signature meal is the steak fingers. The rest of the meals are a solid amount of food, however, don’t expect the highest quality food.  It’s still wonderful and a great choice to eat, but have realistic expectations that for their prices you aren’t getting the top quality.

name: Isiah Cooper
text: Shrimp cocktail is insane with horseradish!!!! For $12 it should be made for anyone to enjoy.. Rest of the menu is always excellent..

name: B Michaels
text:
This is a favorite we bring all our out-of-town friends and family to experience now. The steaks are a delicious thick slice of Montana and all of them have loved it. It’s the old-fashioned steak supper club experience that anyone passing through Montana should stop and savor! (And be sure to show up hungry. The portions are sized to feed a hardworking cowpoke who hasn’t eaten since breakfast.)

This place is clearly a favorite of locals - it’s not just Manhattan residents eating here, anyone who lives in Gallatin County has likely made a special trip for the amazing plate of food you get here. You can look around the crowd and tell.

Excellent service. Love the cozy wood-walls-cabin-feeling atmosphere. Automatic Veggie/pickle tray to start and Ice Cream for dessert.

name: Matt schaff
text: Mia are erver was amazing she definitely went above and beyond. I would highly recommend this restaurant too anyone.   The T-bone the bone in ribeye steaks were great , so.was the halibut and lobster were awesome. The steaks were as good or even better than the steakhouses in Las Vegas.   A must stop if your in the area.

name: Missy Rudolph
text: Been going here for years.  Food is always good even though staff changes have been made.  Service is same....always good

name: Betty Litschauer
text: The gentleman that was our bartender was awesome, I'd go back just to see him

name: Jeff Pickett
text: Excellent food in Manhattan Montana. Great folks welcoming experience always. Been going here 40 years

name: Nelson Kamerman
text: Delicious steak and great service best steakhouse in  the  valley.

name: Kathy Frazer
text: Great food. They accommodated for my dairy free needs.

name: KELLY GJERDE
text: Worth the drive from Billings.  Great food and service!!!!

name: Julie Seminara
text: The steak was amazing, tender, flavorful and perfectly cooked. The server was sweet, attentive and fabulous.  My only disappointment with the oasis is the sides. There are TONS of them and you leave stuffed but they just seem lesser quality as to the rest. But it remains a Bozeman area tradition of great meat and great service

name: Lane Quandt
text:
I had a cup of beef barley soup and an Au jus burger with Swiss cheese. The burger is the best and my rating would have been 5 stars but for the soup having, I believe,  too much sage which distracts from the rich beef flavor.
The Au just is killer and I asked for a spoon to get every drop.

name: ladonna lambert
text:
Finger steaks little mushy .
Love the baked potatoes and service was awesome

name: Angie Meehan
text: Great lunch. First time to stop in. We had steak fingers that were very tasty. Loved it.

name: Roguegunn Works
text: We headed back from Butte and stopped in. Only room in the bar and that was just fine with us! We ordered up dinner and had a great time. VERY yummy steaks. The whole meal was awesome. A MUST VISIT IN MONTANA!

name: Tory Cooper
text:
The staff was friendly and kind. The food here is good, you get large portions and it's never disappointing. I've had the baked potato twice here and they are grown within 2 miles of the restaurant, fries are good but try the baked potato first.
The last time I took my parents here and they loved it. My mom commented on the staff and my dad commented on how he was unable to finish his stake.
Wait time was about 30 minutes. To be expected. Can't rush your food.
I have brought my kids here but I'd say this is a place you take a date or enjoy with adults. Children can become restless waiting for food and they don't appreciate the atmosphere or service. But if you being them they do have a kids menu and if you want you can order one adult dish and get an additional plate and split it. That's what we do or the kids waist it. It's too good to be wasted.
I had the halibut this time and was given fresh lemon slices to squeeze over it. It was great.

name: Martel Adair
text: Great food and service, make sure you make a reservation. The wait was definitely worth it though. Love this place

name: Taylor Dedman
text: Awesome spot! Well poured drinks and the steak fingers are fantastic.

name: Gregory Alan
text: Be hungry before you go, lots of food, so good, so yummy, and I cannot wait to return to eat one of those giant steaks, love the porterhouse and joe joe fries.

name: Beth
text: The food wasn't bad but it wasn't great either.  Good service and friendly staff. Could use a decor update on the dining side.

name: Douglas Crumpler
text: Great food and excellant staff and service

name: Mic
text: Made a reservation about two days in advance. Arrived about 15 minutes before and were seated almost immediately. Really nice, polite, friendly staff. Served quickly and staff was helpful and polite in that regard. Food came pretty quickly. Smooth so far. My friend had prime rib which she really enjoyed. I had steak fingers which were good but I’d go with a steak next time. I tried her prime rib and it was really good as was the au jus sauce which was real tasty. So the beef was really good. The potato options we had were dry and not great,  just okay. She had the Jo Jos with one mutant looking piece which neither of us wanted to try. I ordered the baked potato, again dry but next time I’d lather it up in butter, sour cream and some coarse sea salt wouldn’t go amiss. The ambiance could use some work. I like the attempt at Montanan style but for a comfy, warm, family dining experience I’d rather it not be like my family at thanksgiving with the folding tables, diner chairs from the attic and “friendly” close seating. But we agreed we might go back again sometime.

name: Erin Kjersem
text: Friendy people good food and entertainment

name: Bandai Kishin
text: Erytime I come to this location I am never displeased.   The service,  the food even the drink is on point and I find myself wanting  more.  The steak stips and seafood are worth coming back for. I have yet to treat myself to some most delicious crab recipes that are offered and I have yet to find something I dont like.  Thank you sir Scott's, I am glad you are here

name: Todd Lafley
text: You definitely get what you pay for and the food is awesome you don't leave hungry

name: BikerCowboy
text: Been going to this place for over a decade and it is excellent! Cozy cabin feel fantastic food and very reasonable prices! The bar section is a great spot for a drink and quick bite too!

name: Chad Sacry Electric
text: Amazing steak fingers burgers steaks and everything else

name: Kea Stathatos
text: Love their prime rib dinner, it is excellent! The service mostly sucks and you could wait a good hour once you order to get you dinner. I have no idea why it's so slow?! I have had many steak or prime rib meals from many different locations and states... I have waited by far the longest here.

name: Dave T
text: Really good food & friendly people

name: DON DAVIS
text: Excellent customer service and great tasting food

name: Lauren Vinson
text: Extra stars for atmosphere. We tried Sir Scott's about 10 years ago and didn't love it, but thought we'd give it another go. The steak fingers were good without the massive coating of fried-ness. It was over priced for the quality ($50 for 4 beers, a plate of steak fingers and fries). Love the small town, but we won't be going again.

name: D Smith
text: Food was good, service was so-so. Didn't get a refill on water,, even asked several times.

name: Daniel Mancuso
text: Very impressed. Surprised at both the quality of the food but also portion. Snow crab, mussels, oysters, halibut, killer steak, big baked potato, and an impressive beer and wine menu. Friendly staff and great advice. Definitely worth the stop. Even the crowd in the restaurant was pleasant.

name: Steve Bolstad
text: I have been going here for many years and it never disappoints.  If you are looking for a trendy steak joint, dont go here.  It is plain and simply a great Montana steak house and bar.

name: Eric Cuneo
text: Great prime rib. My friends loved the porterhouse. Would definitely go back.

name: Tom Eastwood
text: I had not been to Sir Scott's Oasis for about 10 years as I previously thought the food was overpriced for its quality. I recently went back as a friend wanted to go there having recently moved back to the area. I would say that not much has changed. There are far better options in the Gallatin Valley at similar pricing. The service was great, but the food was just okay and the drinks were watered down even before any ice had melted in them. No reason to ever go back again unless there is a big change.

name: Andrea Illig
text: Wonderful steak! Fun environment. Happy staff! Clean. I will return.

name: Eat Well Travel Often
text: We stopped by for dinner last night, & ordered King Crab legs and the bone-in Ribeye. Although service was extremely slow (ate the first half of our meals without drinks, etc), the food was SO delicious that we’re still giving 5 stars👍🏼. The horseradish we asked for with the Ribeye was SO incredibly fresh, the steak itself was cooked to perfection, baked potato was on point, cottage cheese was yummy, side salads were good, beer was cold, & both their ranch and blue cheese dressings were spot on (obviously homemade with big chunks of blue cheese, etc...). DELISH😍!!! 100% recommend👍🏼 (as long as you’re not in a big hurry). We’ll definitely be back!

name: Shelley Thomas
text: While other people were pleased with their meals,  my VERY expensive steak had no flavor whatsoever.  Service was ok.  I had been to this restaurant many years ago,  and wasn't impressed than either. People in the area seem to think it's the place that everyone needs to go and check out. Very very high prices.  I tasted bites of some of the seafood my friends had and they were pretty good.

name: Janna Lauver
text: The steak dinners are amazing as are the seafood steamers. Love the relish tray before dinner. Delicious steakhouse.

name: Ev Frad
text: Went here for my birthday. It reminds me of when I was younger and we'd go out as a family to the famous steakhouse. I will always go here for my birthday from now on. They had a table set for me and my wife, took great care of out needs. As an additional bonus they brought me a "small" extra steak... 16oz is small? Best birthday ever!

name: Josh Winterrowd
text: The food here is outstanding.  You get very very generous portions for the price as well as all the vegetables and crackers you could want. I would highly recommend calling ahead as it is usually busy. The service tends to be very slow and they are always behind on reservations on a busy night. So just plan accordingly.  The wait is worth it.

name: patty d
text: Oh, yeah! This is always great. It's laid back, just fancy enough for dressing up if you want, blue jeans work too. The food is great! We always end up taking home steak that becomes the best left overs ever.

name: Devin Hotalen
text: I love this place. I recommend the prime rib or steak fingers.

name: Randall Smith
text: Very nice meal and superior service

name: Cory
text: If you've never been, go get yourself some supper. No regrets.

name: Sean McCleary
text:
This spot is amazing. Their porterhouse is a cut of heaven! The meal overall is the most Montana meal one can consume.

They have a descent crowd most nights in the dining area. We recommend sitting in the bar area. The service was amazing. All of our courses came out in a timely manner. Our food was prepared perfectly.

There is no doubt that we will return to Sir Scott's Oasis!

name: Leslie Hodges
text: Always a great place to eat! Great host/waitress as well.

name: Mark Snitzel
text: I've had prime rib there twice in the last month; it was excellent as was the service. The prime rib is much better than the competitions’ across the interstate (Sacajawea's). However, once my wife ignored the adage about don't order fish in a steak house. Her halibut was dry and overcooked; most of it was not eaten. The server offered to replace the dinner but my wife declined. Also, the restaurant needs to invest in some real steak knives. Sawing on prime rib with a cheap and dull knife does not enhance the experience.

name: Stephen Boster
text: Great food and atmosphere.   Very friendly staff.   Steaks are fabulous and worth the trip.   Will go again, and again.

name: Heather Petty
text: The food was not good at all. Service was ok, but terrible food for the price - salad was soaking wet, brown and wilted, steak fingers and fries were undercooked. It was one of the worst meals. We will not be back.

name: Jagd Terrier WillAnderson
text: Great service, great food! Still coming here for over twenty five years! Love it!

name: Lora Lanning
text: Had the rib steak. Sweet and tender. Yummy, first time there.

name: Rayzer95
text:
This is one of the best steak houses in the area, usually crowded so definitely call ahead for reservations. The waitstaff are great, chefs are wonderful and know how to grill a steak to perfection every time. Lunch time bar menue is decent and good price. Stop in for a burger, steak or whatever else looks good to you!!
They also do gift certificates so get one for all your friends and family, send me one too I love this place!

name: janelle pruett
text: We had a wonderful evening,  friendly staff fast service and delicious food. The Oasis never disappoints.

name: Matt Merry
text: Classic roadside steakhouse/local watering hole. The menu is basic, but they do it all really well at a fair price.  Great burgers, steaks, and their legendary finger steaks - delicious!  Decent selection of local craft beer on draft as well as bottled imports, wine, and full bar. The place gets packed on the weekend.

name: Sarah Terry
text: Alittle crowded. But the service was amazing. Great food and drinks

name: Scott Arkell
text: Great food and the service was good

name: Nancy Phillips
text: If you want the best food, give them a try. Make a reservation is the best way. Don't pass this please up.

name: Garth Wilkins
text: Really good rib steak in the bar.  Main restaurant wasn't open yet (doesn't open till 4:30).  Not open on Monday.  Typical neighborhood bar, nothing fancy.

name: Priscilla Chamberlin
text: Old town atmosphere,friendly service.Generous portions,great food!Comfortable atmosphere.Prime rib is amazing!

name: Sherry Tucker
text: Wonderful, delicious! Great service.

name: Tim Dolan
text: Classic Montana steakhouse. I enjoyed a deluxe burger as round as a saucer and fries. Got to sit with Scott himself, charismatic restauranteur.

name: Jean Lundberg
text: Most tender steak ever.  Where do they get these?Very courteous, efficient service.    Will go again.

name: alexis thull
text: The service was good, steaks were delicious but other than that medoricer. Place is also cold, bring a sweater. French fries limp and not very hot. Drinks way to stong.

name: Adam Sansaver
text: Steaks are always incredible here. Would give 5 stars but for one thing lacking. No appetizers to speak of? Just seems odd

name: duck man
text: Haven't been there in a while but it was as good as I remember after getting there today.

name: Jeremy Cline
text: Delicious food friendly staff

name: Sonia Kinzy
text: We had an amazing family memory.  Thank you.

name: Larry Lambert
text: I had the broasted chicken. It was fantastic! My bartender, Greg, even let me order a 4 piece dark meat meal. Service and food were excellent.

name: Sarah Lilly
text: Cozy place, good steaks  or laidback bar food and drinks

name: John Jorgenson
text: Excellent food top quality service and best of all ver reasonably priced.

name: sharon wilson
text: My go to place for a great steak.  Their hamburgers and home made fries are awesome too.

name: Henry Tashjian
text: One of my favorite places ever for a great steak dinner, we always bring friends and relatives that visit.

name: Bobbie Jo Warner
text: Used to be a great place ! We would dream about the steak fingers and prime we had eaten here in the past as we were in living out of state at the time.  Since returning home to Montana we couldn't wait to eat at Dir Scott's Oasis again. Wow did they go downhill.  The prices are still good.  The quality of the cooking is awful 😨. Please make it good again ya all. I loved this place 💔 now my heart is broken

name: Floyd Morris
text: Not the best steak in Montana, but close to it.   Excellent staff,  great atmosphere,  and awesome food.  I still think the best steak in Montana is about 200 miles away at Lolo steak house, formerly Guys.

name: Amanda Smith
text: Never had a bad meal in the 25 years I've been going there.

name: Roger Stone
text: MSU Graduation night! Place was very, very busy but plenty of wait staff on hand and food arrived in good time. Sea food was abundant and tasty. Steaks were cooked to order. Prices seemed reasonable.

name: Jeff Jones
text: Great service and great food.

name: Chuck Kohlbeck
text: Great food

name: Deidre Dilbeck
text: If you are looking for a good place for dinner, look no further.  They have a great menu.  This is a stake and potatoes type of place with some seafood and fish mixed in.  Prices can be spending but they are worth it!  Love the Prime Rib and New York Stake with the jojos.  Heads up!  These chefs know what rare meat is, so if you don't like your meat cool in the middle, bloody and red order your meat differently.  Personally, I love my stake cooked rare and that's why I love this place.

name: Gail Blair
text: Our order was taken... The waitress returned after 30 minutes to ask us what we ordered.  Tables that arrived 1 hour later was served before our table.  2 hour wait for dinner.

name: Andrew Sanders
text: Great prime rib! Patient staff coped very well with a party of 45+. Casual atmosphere. Nothing stuffy or high brow here. Just an honest, tasty meal in a clean, local bar atmosphere.

name: Peg Sconyers
text: Best steak in the state!

name: Lili Salazar
text: Our ticket got stuck behind a party of 35. We had to wait over an hour for our entrees. But food was good.

name: Mary Spaulding
text: We love to eat here when we are in the area. My favorite is the Finger steaks but everything is delicious.

name: Debi Brinson
text: Loved the NYsteak and baked potato! Great service!

name: Matt
text:
Best steakhouse in town with finger steaks being absolutely amazing. That said, lately I've had issues of asking for medium rare and getting the steak medium. The lighting is a bit too dim, and while a vintage look it can be a bit tacky and a bit too small, causing cramped table spaces. Needs to update a bit with the times. Noted with them having to push tables into the bar area.

Decent beer and wine selection, and the steaks are fine cuts. The quality of the cooking has gone down a bit, but still fantastic.

name: Wayne Goulet
text: Food was amazing, cooked spot on and service with a grand smile.

name: James Gee
text: Always a great place to eat! Friendly service to!

name: Tyler Goff
text: Can't go wrong with their steak fingers and the relish tray. Don't order drinks there way to expensive for a beer or even well drinks. When we go there we try to only stick with water.

name: Erin Kjersem
text: Grrat food friendly people

name: Tim Halbritter
text: Love this place went this time for lunch to celebrate our 15th anniversary

name: Micah Westra
text: Staff is awesome, portions are generous, drinks are prompt, and quality is definitely there. We go frequently and our out-of-town guests and relatives ask to go back all the time. We highly recommend.

name: Dean S
text:
Update
Owner aknowledged he got a bad run of prime rib and made good on the issue.  I would visit again.
I had not been to the Oasis in a long time....its going to be a long time before i go back.  I ordered my tenderloin med-rare and it came well under rare.  The waitress agreed and took it back.  When it was returned it was med-well.  For a steak house you HAVE to know how to cook steak.  My brother ordered the prime rib and it was like eating a raw boot.
Come on Oasis...you can do better for the old crusty atmosphere and really pricey food!!!

name: Barbara Nutter
text: Great food, good service, but very warm in dining room

name: Erica Droge
text: Always great food, drinks and good service. It's a small town staple and is one of our favorite local stops! Highly recommend for a good Montana stake house!

name: joshua hinson
text: Some of the best steaks I've had in Montana.

name: Collette Miller
text: Some of the best prime rib I've ever had

name: Jared Frasier
text:
Definitely a household name in the Gallatin Valley.  The folks here know how to cook meat like few others.  The finger steaks and pork chops are ridiculously good and fairly priced (LARGE portions).

The clientele can get a little rough after 9PM on weeknights.  One patron randomly walked up and started rubbing my shoulders without an invite.  She was old enough to be my grandma, so it was sweet, but I prefer to eat in peace.

name: Jacqueline Anderson
text: Margaritas were awesome as always,  and the roasted chicken was great.

name: Ryan Bartholomew
text: Wait time was fairly long, but staff was quite friendly and the ambience rather classic and unique. Veggies served to snack on while waiting for main meal is a nice touch. Steak and crab legs were acceptable, but not the quality I'd expect for the price.

name: Sirena Mccullough
text: Went after work today and oredered what I always order steak fingers and a blood mary the drink was watered down with no taste

name: Kathleen Alt
text: Prices kinda high,  pretty good food maybe it could be a bit better for the price. The wait for the food after being seated was eh. But otherwise okay

name: Jentry Hartford
text: A somewhat hidden gem in Manhattan, MT just north of Bozeman, MT that serves Locally sourced Montana beef! Gotta Love the veggie tray and thems Joe Joes are something quite amazing! Love the ambiance of the rustic Montana steak house that Sir Scott's Oasis has!  It's becoming hard to find places honoring the rustic feel of historic Montana, we appreciate ya!

name: andrew stewart
text: Always great food and drinks. Friendly atmosphere with exceptional service. Good times in the bar or restaurant.

name: J.B. Chandler
text: Good food for a return trip home from Manhattan Christian

name: Kyle Blackmore
text: Normally a awesome place. This time I ordered a t-bone medium rare, came out well done. When they brought me my second it came out almost rare with a cold center. Didn't seem to be on their A Game.

name: tunA Kuru
text:
We wanted to try this highly reviewed place on a Saturday afternoon after reading the reviews. The place was almost full for an afternoon to our surprise.
There's a relish plate and a cracker basket waiting for you at your table. Relish plate has raw veggies like zuccini, cauliflower, celery sticks and pickles. We had a kid's burger (for 15$!), finger steaks and a ny strip steak. The dinner comes with a cup of soup or salad and a side choice of fries, baked potato or jo-jos. The burger was good, the steak was ok (definitely not the best one in Montana!) and finger steaks were not good. I liked they cooked the steak just as i wanted, not overcooked which usually is the case i have to deal with when i ask for medium-well. It could taste better with a little bit salt or seasoning.  Maybe that's why they offer steak sauce or horseradish. Finger steaks were fatty and chewy under the breading; the kind you try to eat one but it keeps growing in your mouth as you chew and chew and chew until you either take it out or swallow if you can. French fries were steak-cut. They were soft inside (and some were even undercooked) if you like crispy fries. Jo-jos are not fried potato wedges here, they are breaded and deep fried thick cut potato slices.
The folding tables, metal chairs, plastic placemats, soda served in hard plastic cups etc. It looks more like a diner than a steak house .. But don't worry, it lasts only until you get the check.

At the end we could not feel all that hype it received in the reviews about the food and ambiance. It is a bit overpriced but an ok place if you have to eat in Manhattan.

name: Scuba_Ben
text: Best restaurant ever I've been going here for years it's our little Montana secret.

name: MJ O
text: Always good service and food!  Reasonably priced.

name: Doug Ireland
text: Great food! Not the cheapest place to eat but it's definitely worth it. The staff is always friendly and does their jobs well.

name: glenna dowd
text: Traditional, unpretentious Montana steak house with hand cut, cooked to perfection steaks.

name: Jason Carey
text: Perfect as always

name: Robin Evans
text: This is a great steak house. While the ambiance is a bit lacking, the service and food make up for it.  Make a reservation though, because it's busy here every day of the week.

name: Mary Jane Borlaug
text: We've been stopping by here for about 15 years. We've always had a great meal. I recommend the steak fingers.

name: Karen Kropp
text: Great food and the staff is friendly and helpful.

name: Tim A
text:
Sir Scott's Oasis.  Should be renamed "Best Prime Rib Around!"

This place is know for it's beef, and they do it well.  Don't expect great service and a fancy table.  It's all about the BEEF!

name: Chris Manifold
text: Love their cracker basket and the prime rib is the best in Bozeman

name: Megan
text: Fantastic food. Local atmosphere. Everything is delicious. Great place for kids too. Come VERY hungry - everything from the veggie plate to the ice cream is included in your meal.

name: Steve Olp
text:
Finger steaks I love you!
Just a classic local spot that is diapering in the slow and steady development crawl hell that is the modern Gallatin Valley. "The Oasis", "The O", whatever you call it it still continues on as one of my favorite places to celebrate something or get a bit out of town. Personal highlights are the aforementioned fingersteaks, best prime rib although I usually get the rib steak. PS. The scallops are fantastic! name: Jonathan Hilgeman
text:
I recently finished my second order of the 3-meat platter from Bar 3. Here's what I thought about each item:

Beef Brisket - About 2/3 of the pieces that I got were gristle/fat. The meat was good, but I prefer the majority of what I order to be meat.

Smoked Turkey - Delicious. I am a turkey fan and I ended up ordering this on both orders.

Burnt Ends - This was my first experience with burnt ends, which I ordered after reading someone else's review. They were okay, but not worth ordering again.

Chicken - Someone else wrote a review about this being dry, but I loved the chicken. This was my favorite of all the meats I ordered - the skin was -perfectly- crispy, and the meat was very flavorful. The chicken was the main reason I came back a second time. It wasn't dry (at least not beyond what I would expect from BBQ'd meat).

Sides - These were my biggest disappointment. Only one of the 4 sides I tried was any good. The Hoppin' Johns were great - nicely seasoned and delicious and I'd order them again. Moving onto the bad.... the mac and cheese was just sort of dry/sticky and not very flavorful - it felt like the macaroni was a little overcooked. The garlic mashers were just dry and thick and didn't have much in the way of garlic flavor. The potato salad was blah - the potato slices seemed a little on the hard/undercooked side, so it was sort of like eating some semi-raw potato slices dipped in very thin sour-cream and sprinkled in dill. The slices needed to be cooked just a bit more and it needed some more seasoning.

That said, it's possible I just picked the wrong sides. I'll keep trying some of the other options...

The final verdict is that I would come back here to get the turkey and chicken for sure - both were extremely delicious and had plenty of meat. I knocked off one star for the sides and another star for the amount of gristle on the brisket, but if you prefer milder flavors for the sides, then that might be a good thing for you.

text: Fast and friendly service. Tasty food. They seem to have really streamlined their sanitization process; everything was really clean and well spaced.

text:
I'd been wanting to eat at Dave's for the past few years.  I had never heard anything but good impressions about the place.  Now I am able to confirm that the cudos are in fact true.
The reason I  had to wait so long was it was always full when I had been in Bozeman.   Finally I hit them on a slower afternoon.
The service was prompt,  the offerings were most delicious 😋.  I'll be back as soon as I can.

text: Pretty good sushi, great staff and a good atmosphere. Worth trying if you're in Bozeman. The sushi is less traditionally focused and more focused on different fusions or blends of different non traditional sushi ingredients. Not really my cup of tea honestly but that's just me and the sushi was good and everyone really enjoyed it I talked to. Give it a try.

text: Best sushi in bozeman! Friendly service. Loved it

name: Matt Parry
text: Ok so im not sure how this place has as high of ratings as it does. We tried 4 different rolls and ramen. From the name daves sushi you should already know that this is super american white washed sushi place so i was prepared. We even got experimental and tired a variety. The fried checken rolls was one of the most disgusting rolls ive ever had, it was dry, bland and old. The catipilar was really basic and not fresh. My avocado was brown. The wide spread panic roll was not bad but again nothing special, sounded better then it was. The people who rated this place best sushi in bozeman havent had good sushi. Not to mention they dont even sell sushi. They have sushimi and rolls but no sushi. We got a little more wild and ordered a john wayne and it was actually really good, really unique but good. Now the thing that gave them the 2 stars, their ramen was really really good. Not authentic, but a really tasty western twist on ramen. I am all about trying and supporting local restaurants, but i will not support trash food. When 60% of my food was mediocre or gross, i will not be comming back. Now the location is cool looking but the food not worth the 80 bucks we spent.

We will go back the next time the sushi mood strikes in Bozeman...

text: Le Poison & The Widespread Panic rolls with a small sashimi combo of salmon & tuna.  Mmmmm.  Tasty! Such a locals place. Love this place! It's so good.

name: Mike Dye
text: Always busy, BUT well worth the wait! Been eating here for years and haven't been disappointed yet. Consistently good, cheerful service. You can tell the staff really has fun working here!

name: Sarah Croteau
text: The wait was long, but it was worth it! So many unique rolls, and even several vegetarian options. Would recommend!

name: dcjulian5
text: I liked it. I really wanted to love it but I just wasn’t that impressed with the sushi. The reports and awards really built it up for me. I’ve been three times and tried several different dishes.

name: Confessions And Lessons
text: Always busy. Better than 7 but small and limited dinning accommodations.

name: Michael Garriffa
text: This place is absolutely amazing! Always really fresh, and never a disappointment. About the only thing I would change is opening up a second location or somehow expand the current one!!!

name: Eric Sterkel
text: Eat here all the time and have only had one bad experience with a waiter that threatened to beat me up over a to go order that was wrong.  BUT the current staff is amazing! Always on it and very well trained. Food is the best around.  I would HIGHLY recommend this place to anyone.

name: Eli Ditmore
text: Delicious sushi far from the sea.

name: andrew stewart
text: Good sushi. For montana, great sushi

name: Jamie Lyn
text: Little pricey but totally worth it! All nagiri was tasty and few places can claim that.  They do it well.

name: Kate Nugent
text: Wonderful sushi, fast and friendly service, and a relaxed environment.

name: Ethan Efram
text: Definitely the best sushi spot in town. Great, relaxed atmosphere and the dishes are delicious. Service is always better than most restaurants around town. There's not much to write here. This place is just excellent and if you like sushi you need to be here to see for yourself! Easily 5 stars.

name: Jenny Fleek Airne
text: The sushi was super fresh.  Friendly service. Well worth the wait!

name: Chelsea Navarro
text: Best sushi in town!

name: Reuben Miller
text: If Sushi is your jam, you'll love it!! It's fresh and they have a huge variety. Highly recommend!!

name: Joshua Treadway
text: Order your sushi to go or eat it there. Very fast service and very good food.

name: Grant Kammeyer
text: Dave's Sushi takes great pride into their work. Everytime I've come, I've enjoyed my experience. The presentation of food is phenomenal, and it tastes even better. Friendly and attentive staff. 5 stars

name: Nicholas Thomas
text: Bozemans best sushi by far. Fun and hip environment and quick service. Get reservations if you're bringing a group.

name: Ryan Schwab
text: Tried one of the noodle bowls today and loved it! The sushi is always amazing here as well

name: Colby Hernandez
text: We love sushi at Daves!   Every visit to Bozeman we visit Daves.  The food is always amazing.

name: Rebecca Malisani
text: Sooooo good! Got the Turkey Slayer and John Wayne. Looked super busy, but got our food way fast! Trendy atmosphere with the locals.

name: J Clifton Meek
text: It's fresh sushi. In Montana! Owned by a guy named Dave. But, it's not only our best, but it's really, really good. And fresh. Always busy, because of the quality, and prices are decent. Interior is pretty, though a little close; it's usually an upbeat, fun atmosphere. Wait staff is always pleasant, if a little hurried. An extensive menu is supplemented by really great specials. Good selection of cold and warm sake, beer, and wine. Tiny parking lot and a typically crowded area for parking is the only negative.

name: Rachael Horner
text: Great Service. Fun selection. Just a tad...over priced.

name: Shaunessey Scott
text: Truly delicious sushi. I cannot recommend anything on the menu: go there every night for a week and try it all.

name: Dorian Birdsong
text: So good have to keep coming back to try more off the menu. Great service

name: Emmie Parker
text: The gobbler is worth dieing for.

name: Mark Waugh
text: Fav place in Bozeman!

name: Danielle Hatfield
text: Been here many times times- the restaurant is always very clean. The service is 5 stars, prompt, friendly and attentive. The food is presented beautifully and consistently the best sushi rolls in Bozeman. Highly recommend.

name: John A Graham
text: Excellent sushi, great people.

name: traca russell
text: Great food...just so yummy! Happy server! If I know we are headed to Bozeman, I start thinking about the veggie tempura and Tokyo tacos and cucumber salad days before.

name: Kyle
text: Sushi rolls were excellent.  The hamachi nigiri and unagi nigiri were fair.  They were not as flavorful or fresh as I felt they should be.  The staff at Dave’s was good,  and met all our requests happily.

name: helal al-ganem
text: The outside seating areas were great!! Birds kept coming by and it was adorable feeding them with some rice. The food is delicious!! But, note it can be a little pricey. It was $9 for 4 sushi pieces. They have good food though!! Just remember to ask for ice because they don't give it regularly with the water.

name: Jude
text: Better than 7 Sushi! If you have a craving for sushi do not make plans to go to 7! Go here instead.

name: Chad Kimm
text: Consistently the best sushi in Bozeman. Staff is always super friendly. Comfortable vibe.

name: Providencia Stuart
text: My favorite sushi restaurant hands down. I usually order take out, because the place is always very busy and very noisy. Ingredients are fresh and high quality. The specialty rolls are very imaginative and incredibly tasty. The staff is lovely. It's truly one of Bozeman best restaurants!

name: Chris Dahlhauser
text: Good food, great service,  always crowded.

name: 3-Gun Jack
text: It's expensive, but it's totally worth it. Their rolls are amazing, the sashimi is great, and the sake is dangerously good, especially served hot. Perfect restaurant for dates and celebrations.

name: Mellanie Lerum

name: Chris Knudson

name: Corbae L

name: Tron F

name: Mike Scully

name: Ted Coté
text: Dave's is my personal favorite for sushi in Bozeman. I love their baked mussels, spawning dragon roll and  their sashimi salad. They have a nice butterscotch pudding for dessert.

name: Logan Shelagowski
text: Hell yeah this is good sushi. I was skeptical because BZN isn’t really a sea food epicenter. Let me assure you, both the sashimi and sushi are fantastic! Staff was very polite as well. Parking can be a pain when busy.

name: Dan Warila
text: Surprisingly good sushi. Seriously  I was was super impressed  I wasn't really expecting  much due to hype and the distance  from from the ocean, but this place is making magic happen.

name: Jenine K
text: How do I even provide a less than a 5 star review here???  The wait time that goes on forever?  Yeah, that's because they are **badass** so go earlier, people! Literally everything I put in my mouth here is mind blowing.   Yeah, that good.  No words.  EAT ALL THE FOOD.  Just sayin........

resp.text: Jen, we love you. Just sayin...

name: Kara Haynes

name: Rick Lee
text: First time trying Sushi I think it's very good just not for me

text: One of my favorite places to eat in Bozeman. If sushi isn't your thing, try one of the noodle bowls, they are really tasty. The always have different specials so make sure to ask!

name: Andrew Kaufman

name: Lucia Ortega Toledo
text: Great sushi, great customer service, affordable prices, efficient parking, noisy ambiance, which is not rare in a Restaurant in Bozeman.

name: Kelrune
text:
Well I have a mixed review.
The food was great. It was fresh, great presentation.

Lets talk about the bad. We cam in wanting a patio seat. 20 minute wait. 35 minutes later and 2 people who cam in after us were seated on the patio. We asked why we have not been seated. Some one took our spot . but she never called our name. We got seated 5 minutes after that.

The waitress was not all there. She had 6 tables on the patio who got food in 15 minutes of ordering. Ours took 35 minutes for half the food. Sorry guys good food takes time. I think she forgot our order. We asked to take it to go, for it was 10 minites to close. We wanted to be polite and not hold them up. She cam back with sorry perfection takes time to make it from scratch. Well 15 minutes later our food cam out in to go containers and it took 5 more minutes to get our check.

In short service was less than desirable . next time I am in town I will try again only because of the good food.

resp.text: Abe, thank you for bringing this to my attention. Would you mind emailing me directly at office@daves-sushi.com so I could learn more about what happened yesterday?

name: Amanda Marinovich

name: Heath Hoffman

name: Kayla Kilbride

name: Scuba_Ben

name: Rosana Molina

name: Mike Bacon

name: Laura Rossi

name: Ryan Trefethen

name: Dylan Brewer

text: Great sushi on par with New York eateries. The decor is comfortable and pleasant. The staff is on point and the owner also greets customers in person. I highly recommend this place. name: Michael De Stefano

name: Marla Francis

name: Elif Bilal

name: Sven Wigert

name: Emily Grosswiler

name: Amy Johnson

name: L N

text: Ok, sushi in Bozeman? Do I trust it? Coming from California,  I was a skeptic for sushi in a state that has no ocean front. However, the answer is YES. GO. name: Kathy H

name: Brett Marshall
text: Definitely a key part of the Foundation of the Bozeman restaurant scene; probably, the first real sushi place in town (though some other fine restaurants had sushi bars before Dave's). it is pretty good sushi, most consistently good in town.  i have eaten here maybe 40 times over the last decade and only had one below average piece of sushi. Staff is friendly and american sushi masters make some nice cuts. I have had better sushi here than in some larger land-locked cities. I did mark it down one star for crowds, and noise. If that does not bother you, consider it 5. Also, come for lunch in the summer and sit outside and enjoy the gentle Montana air... yeah downtown... but not terrible traffic near their deck... parking? . ummm yeah... they need to get some signs in their small lot... people park sideways... etc... but you can walk there from anywhere downtown.

Bozeman's best sushi

I give this food establishment only two stars and I most likely will not go back to Dave's Sushi.

In my experience, the service was disappointing. Daves was fairly empty with only three tables of people and yet the service was slow, the waitress showed favoritism to other customers and the waitress mistook me for a male.
My husband and I ordered 3 different rolls of sushi and we didnt enjoy any of them; while usually we discussing which rolls we like best, in this case it was which one we liked the least. The sushi was "americanized," which I feel that if done right could be good but daves varriations in my opinion were bland and the texture felt like mush.

My husband went back to try Daves Sushi in the spirit of a second chance and unfortunately came back with the same disappointed experience.

To sum up our experience,
I dub Daves Sushi, "bozemans worst" sushi establishment.

name: Miriam E. Penado
text: It's a cozy little place. But it is small and everybody ends up complaining about how stuffy and hot it gets; and the food is ok. Bar is expensive and 'some' bar tenders are not very amicable, but they are tolerant to being in the customer service field (nice sometimes, not nice other times like almost hit or miss). One gal said that one of the waitresses kept being rude to her and pretty bossy. I didn't believe it until one of the employees was trying to boss around the kids and keep them from enjoying the place, atmosphere, and the "fun" of the Christmas party. The owner IS very nice though.

resp.text:
Miriam,
Thank you for sharing your recent experience at the Lodge. We are happy to hear that you found us to be cozy, and that you were able to meet the owners, who care very much about each and every guests. We apologize that your experience was not completely enjoyable, as our commitment to offering the highest level of customer experience, quality of food, and atmosphere is the sole purpose of our operation. While we do offer several areas to socialize and enjoy the experience, if large groups congregate in one area, it can temporarily lose its cozy atmosphere. We spend considerable time seeking, training, and retaining the best staff to be able to offer incredible customer service, and will certainly address your concerns with our team. Thank you again for your thoughtful comments, and we hope to serve you again in the future.
Kind regards,
PJ Wirchansky
Lodge Manager

name: Paul Cooke
text: On the upside the staff is friendly, there's a decent wine list, and they make a good Manhattan.  Unfortunately the food was a disappointment. The cheese plate appetizer we had was pricey for how little cheese was on it, the cheeses weren't compelling, plus they were served with very brittle herbed crostini that had enough seasoning on them to overwhelm the taste of the cheeses.  All of our meals arrived dried out, probably from sitting under a warming light for too long; I suspect the entrees were prepared quickly, then sat as we ate our salad course.  The ribs I had ($30) were a small portion (smaller than a standard half rack) and were VERY dry, almost like jerky in spots.  The desserts were good though there was a strange bitterness in the crust of my creme brulee.  We went to Gallatin River Lodge for dinner because there are so many positive reviews on Google, so maybe we caught them on an off day, but there were four of us in our party, and each of us were disappointed by our meals.

resp.text:
Hello Paul - I am so sorry to hear that your dinner with us did not live up to your expectations. We truly try to ensure every guest has an exceptional time while they are here. Please reach out if you would like to connect further on your dinner.

I learned from "Yen" that they CAN do a lot, including telling me what to do between visits to the salon every 2-3 months. The progress has been remarkable, almost all clear now. My feet feel healthier, more comfortable and significantly better looking in thongs when I 'm outside during the summer. Prices are reasonable and well worth it.

I'd still say that going here versus downtown is a good option as you have options in the Cannery building now as well.
Staff was friendly and helpful. They took constructive criticism well and I think with time and a little bit more of a system they will excel and set new standards for Bozeman. Well done!

name: Joyce Swartzendruber
text: We hadn't been back to Nordic Brew Works for a couple years and were pleasantly surprised this week.   The beer flights gave us samples of great lagers and ales.   We took a growler of Mystery Train home.   The seed bread and artichoke dip was excellent!

name: Carrie Arndt
text:
So I ate at Nordic for the again last evening! It was delicious! I had the Cajun chicken sandwich, and fries.

They had my favorite fries, not the everyday kind of fries, but the good ones that taste like they came from potatoes.

The pizza is also so good.  It tasted absolutely amazing. I have been looking for good pizza! I found it!

resp.text:
Hey Carrie,
Thanks so much for all the positive feedback!! Glad to hear you enjoy our food and pizza so much. Until next time! Cheers!

name: Mark Allen
text: Had an issue, was resolved quickly and professionally. One of the best places to get a beer and hang out in a relaxed environment.

resp.text: Hello Mark. This is a very unfortunate circumstance and I am displeased to hear about this. I appreciate the continuous support towards our restaurant, especially during these times. Your loyalty means a lot to our establishment and I would like to correct this situation. Please email me at Kendrick@nordicbrewworks.com with what time you stepped in to our establishment and we can follow up!

name: Brian Hare
text: Wade boggs ipa...ha. good beers. Neat place

resp.text: Thanks Brian!

name: Jason Daughenbaugh
text:
Great food, good beer, good atmosphere, mediocre service.

It is definitely a nice space.  The pizza, salads, appetizers etc were great.  And the beer was surprisingly good too.  But our waitress was MIA.  Never checked on us, refilled drinks, etc.  We could see her goofing off with other waitresses while we were waiting.  Another waitress filled in for her when needed.

But maybe we were just unlucky, or this waitress was still learning to do her job.  We will be back to try again.

resp.text: Jason, I'm glad our food and beer hit the spot, but I apologize if our service left something to be desired. If you ever have any issues while you're here, please reach out so we can take care of the situation for you. I hope you'll return so we can make it up to you. Best. - Jesse Therien, owner

name: Connie Nance
text: Food, service and beer were all AMAZING! My new favorite lunch spot when I'm visiting Bozeman!!

resp.text: Thanks for making us your new lunch spot!

name: Robin Evans
text: Really good beer and pizza. I've tried other things on the menu and they've been mediocre, at best. The service is friendly enough, but so slow. Not many people in because of the pandemic, so it seems to me that the service should be faster.

resp.text: Hi Robin, I am sorry to hear that your service was so slow! Were you in during the lunch or dinner, what day of the week? If you have any additional information I would love to know so as to help our staff work on the service. My name is Erin and I am the general manager here. If you would like to dm me my email address is erin@nordicbrewworks.com. Our service is something we take seriously and want to ensure if there are any issues, that they are addressed and worked on. Thanks for the feedback! Cheers!

name: george bloomgren
text: Staff nice ,drinks cold ,food was good.

name: Kenneth Sheehan
text: The order was wrong when they brought it out but they fixed it right away without me asking. Great Service

resp.text: Thank you for the kind review Kenneth. We are glad we could make your visit enjoyable!

name: Jeff Woods
text: I was impressed by this restaurant and bar. The food was really good and reasonable priced. The service was genuinely friendly and sincere. The building has a nice combination of modern and comfortable. It's a cool touch that you can see the cooks working on your food from where you are sitting, and you can see the brick oven in action too. The pizza is very good. I would recommend trying the chicken sandwich it was huge and great flavor.

resp.text:
Hi Jeff,

So glad to hear you enjoyed your time with us and your service was friendly and sincere! We do what we can to make sure our guests leave happy. Have a good day!
Thanks,
Erin, GM- Nordic Brew Works

name: Mitch Shattuck
text: Amazing food! And great customer service from Rachel! Went out of her way to help me and my friend when I ate there! (:

name: John Doe
text: The food has gotten so good in the short time they’ve been open and I’ve honestly had some of my all time favorite beers here. We go every couple weeks, quickly becoming our favorite spot in town. Service can be a little goofy but it’s improving all the time and the food/beer has become so excellent.

resp.text:
Hey John,
Thanks for the feedback. Glad you have noticed how hard our kitchen has been working with the new menu we debuted back in May. The beer we have to give a big shout out to Polar Brewing, and their brewers Greg and Tracey for the awesome creations they have been sending our way. We strive to provide our guests enjoyable, relaxing interactions with our front of house workers as well, and unfortunately sometimes we do fall short but we will always continue to try our best to ensure you, our guest, will leave happy and satisfied! Thanks for stopping in and we are looking forward to the next time you are able to join us. Have a good one!
Thanks,
Erin- GM

name: B Michaels
text: Princess beer on tap and food was all excellent to everyone of our group of 4. Also loved the design, atmosphere, warm lighting and big windows — beautiful Scandinavian design of this new build restaurant.

name: Chris Kay
text: Unique brewery. Beer was crisp and clean. Good but not great. Pizza was ok. Wife liked it better than I did. Needed more of everything, sauce, meat and cheese.

resp.text:
Hey Chris,
Thanks for the feedback, sorry it wasn't quite to your liking but glad your wife enjoyed it! We have some pizzas that fit into the category of more loaded pizzas like our Quattro Formaggi (4 cheese) which I personally always love adding some sopressata to it. Another one that may be more suited for you with more toppings would be our Meat Me pizza. Great variety of 3 different meats: capicola, sopressata, and prosciutto topped with our house mozzarella, and Parmesan cheese. Hopefully we will see you again sometime to try one of our other pizzas. Have a good one!
Thanks,
Erin-GM

name: Josh Winterrowd
text: Nice decor. I feel like they are trying to appeal to a higher end crowd. Prices are higher than other breweries in town $5 for a pint and a growler is $11 which is high for the equivalent of a six pack. Their beer is good but needs work for the premium prices. The food menu looks good and is reasonably priced. They have a full bar and a nice open floor plan. I would wait till they get their beer sorted before I came back. They are appealing to a certain clientele and I don't think it's me.

resp.text: We appreciate your feedback, Josh. Our selection full of exclusive beers that aren't available at other restaurants you may visit in the area, which we think is reflected in our prices. Still, we want our guests of all demographics and backgrounds to feel right at home at our place, so I hope we can really wow you if you decide to visit us again in the future. -Jesse Therien, owner

name: Courtney Reisig
text: We love Nordic Brew works. They have great pizza and a great atmosphere all for great prices. My husband says the beer is always very good as well. It is a cute little place and you really can't go wrong with any of the food, it is all fresh and phenomenal. It does get very busy so call or something before you go if you don't want to wait for a long time.

resp.text: Courtney, we love reading feedback like this! So happy to hear our cozy atmosphere is just right for you and that your husband is enjoying the brews! We appreciate your patience during our peak hours our look forward to seeing you back soon! -Jesse Therien, owner

name: Stacy
text: Amazing wood fired fare, set in modern cozy excellence!

name: Xavier Harris
text: Beautiful atmosphere and the beer is good the majority of the time. The service is not great. Not sure if its the staff or just the system they use but its always a pain to get anything ordered especially at the bar. Food is pretty good.

resp.text:
Hi Xavier,
Glad to hear you enjoy the atmosphere and the beer! Sorry to hear about your troubles with ordering food at the bar. If you would like to DM me with some more information in regards to when you were in and what the exact issues were that would be beneficial for me to address these problems with staff and try to remedy those problems and stop any future issues from occurring! You can email me at erin@nordicbrewworks.com
-Thanks
Erin- GM Nordic Brew Works

name: Michael and Betsy Caracciolo
text: I have been a big fan of Nordic Brew Works in the past (hence the three stars) love their cocktails and pizzas! But I made a dinner reservation last evening and arrived to find that no one on staff were wearing masks.  Our server was super nice about it and offered to wear a mask at our table which I very much appreciated, but we still felt weary about the rest of the staff.  We spoke with the floor manager who explained that we had arrived in phase 2 of Montana's opening, which I understand, but we mentioned that we had been to several other restaurants who were having their servers wear masks for the safety of not only customers, but the staff themselves.  I did not much appreciate his obvious doubt about what we were telling him about other restaurants in town.  The COVID numbers are quickly rising again in our county,  and we realized that we didn't feel at all well about being there, so we ended up leaving.  I would encourage management to revisit their mask  policies.  I know it may not be so "cool" to have servers wearing masks,  and  that wearing one at work is not that easy, but if we are going to keep our infection numbers down in our valley, while we open up the economy, listen to the CDC!

resp.text:
Hi Michael and Betsy,

I am sorry you felt weary the last time you decided to dine with us a little over a month ago.  Since you were last in, we quickly went back to requiring face masks by employees and prior to the Governors Mandate recently, we began requiring masks of customers coming in to dine with us as well. We are doing everything that we can to continue to keep a safe, sanitary, and comfortable environment for our community and our employees during this unprecedented time! Hopefully we will see you again in the future!
Thank you,
Erin, GM- Nordic Brew Works

name: Tim Moran
text: Fantastic food and drinks!

name: John Ervin
text: It may be my place of employment  but I  an say the atmosphere is amazing both the people and the building and the food in my opinion  is amazing.

resp.text: Thanks for your review John! We couldn't do it without our front of house and back of house team!

name: Naomi Peterson
text: Good gluten free pizza!

resp.text: Thank you for the review Naomi. We have worked hard to find a scrumptious gluten free option!

name: Amber Hoadley
text: Loved it! Beautiful atmosphere and great prices

resp.text: Great to hear Amber.

name: Joseph Pravetz
text: Simple fare done well and good beer.

name: Julie Smith
text: The drinks are delicious! The pizza has been either great or a miss. Very cool atmosphere, we like to bring new people here. It’s always very very busy but it’s in a great area.

name: Korissa Harmon
text: Great drinks and AMAZING pizza. Wonderful service as well - we had Ashlyn and she was fabulous.

resp.text:
Hi Korissa,
Thanks so much for the positive review and I'm so glad you had wonderful service from Ashlyn. We are thankful to have her as part of our team! Until next time, Cheers!

name: Marcos Zelver
text: Great food! Service wasn't bad but definitely not great

resp.text:
Hey Marcos,
Glad to hear you liked your food! I would like to apologize for the service that was not great. Was there anything in particular that we could have done to make your time with us more enjoyable with us? Any additional information would be beneficial for us to be able to address in future training sessions so we don't miss the mark! Thanks for the review. Cheers!

name: Ryan Weaver
text:
I can't actually comment on the food or beer here, only service.

This is the second time I've attempted to go to this place and both times have been met with a lack of service.

Tonight specifically we called ahead for reservations at 6 and they "forgot to tell their staff that customers had made dinner time reservation's...". Apparently folks are sitting here for two hours?  Seriously?  Sitting over at Tanglewood now eating dinner after 45 minutes of waiting on the hostess to " call me when the table is ready".

Further, a few months back I sat directly at the bar and requested a beer menu, took about 5 minutes to get that treasure, was never approached again.

name: Seth Powell
text:
Yum! I always love my food at “Nordic Brew Works.” Pizza “Herba Coppa” 10/10, it has balsamic on it but I think it’s amazing. “Dirty potatoes” so good. I had the special app wings which were great too. Their beer is always yummy had a Pilsner and wit bier which i liked a lot. Overall my favorite restaurant in Bozeman.
On Monday’s I like to come here for two beers and pizza for $15 which is a nice deal for Bzn.

resp.text: Thanks Seth.

name: kade estill
text: Food is great .. beer isnt anything to brag about .. yet !! Beautiful environment.. rustic modern setting

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Kade. What are some of your favorite beers in Bozeman? Which beers did you try at Nordic?

name: Trevor Beitman
text: Go get yourself a 'pricess unicorn',  you won't be disappointed

resp.text: Ooo, you may have had the first of this batch! Glad you enjoyed it!

name: Carole Matthews
text: Went for the first time for a company party. Left with friends! Drinks, desserts, and soup was amazing! Entree was not amazing, but very willing to try something else!! Will definitely be back!!!

resp.text: Great Carole. Glad you tried us out and we look forward to knocking it out of the park for you next time!

name: Erica Nelson
text: Amazing custom drinks. One out of every 5 visits service is not great.

name: E S
text: I absolutely loved this place.  Start off with a flight of 4 dark beers that were all tasty.  Appetizer was the dirty potatoes, which were delicious.  Pizza was amazing and our server was extremely friendly and knowledgable about all the beers, drinks, apps and pizzas.  Ended with a delicious chocolate cheese cake for dessert.  Amazing experience all around!

resp.text: That's great to hear Eric. Thanks for coming in and we look forward to your next visit!

name: evan sapp
text: I love this brewery. They always have new beers and I've never had something I didn't like.  The pizza is great as well. My favorite though is the beet salad

resp.text: Thanks for the review Evan! It's good to hear people loving the continuously new beer styles.

name: Carrie K
text:
Don't go here if you're from Montana. The beer is flavorless and uninteresting. The food was okay, but pizza was more like a salad. Covered in arugula. I don't usually mind weird pizzas, but these had no redeeming qualities. Plenty of better places to go. Anyone that likes this place is paying to be in a swanky environment.
EDIT: I also recieved a snarky response to my critical review further confirming that this place is pretentious and unfriendly. Bridger Brewing in particular is much better.

resp.text: Hello Carrie. Are you suggesting that only Montanans not come visit us, while the remaining 99.7% of US population does? We are sorry you feel the need to exclude our fellow Montanans, since many of our ingredients come from Montana farmers. We do have numerous pizzas with nothing green on them if that's a concern of yours. Although there are many, I will offer you one redeeming quality of our pizza; the dough is made fresh daily from scratch! Thanks for giving us a try Carrie.

name: Chris Woods
text: Very friendly staff who care about the location and good food, but you are often forgotten about by the staff when it is always busy, and they have had a rotating staff in the kitchen making it difficult to find my favorite entree. That being said the pizza crust is fantastic, the beer selection is varied and quality, and those dirty potatoes... Would gladly rate 4 stars if service was better and they find a permanent staff.

resp.text: Thanks for the feedback Chris. We are working on a new menu right now (keeping many of the same items) and have a great team in the kitchen. I hope your concerns will be addressed and look forward to your feedback once things are rolling. Thanks for coming by!

name: Megan
text: I've been into Nordic several times since they opened, and I have been happy every time! The layout is open, but still cozy. The service is always quick and friendly. The drink selection is fantastic, and the pizza is delicious! I've always been pleasantly surprised by the dessert offerings - they are sooooo good - much better than I'd ever have expected to find at a brewery!

resp.text: That's great to hear Megan. We tried to give as much attention to the food as we do the beer, so I'm glad you noticed. Thanks for coming in!

name: Jason Uhlmann
text: Easily the best brewery in Montana. Great beer, food, service, and space.

resp.text: Mighty nice of you to say Jason! We look forward to your return.

name: M Wisman
text: The best Toyota service and quality.

name: Carrie Brekke
text:
Seriously, this is an excellent place! Their craft beer is very good. I recommend the Barnacle Stout! If you like stout, this is the one to have. And yes, the food is very good! Try the Dirty Potatoes!

Claim to fame: I got to try the very first pour of the coconut porter. Amazing! Must love coconut.

My new favorite brewery.

resp.text: Hey Carrie. Apparently, you're a stout/porter lover. Follow us on FB and Instagram to see when the new beers come out. If you provide your email on a comment card, we can add you to our upcoming list where we'll be notifying "members" a little bit sooner about beers that will be coming up. Maybe some more "first pours". Thanks!

name: Emily Lawrence
text: Our bartender was a little too sassy, unhelpful and distracted. The food was great, but again, the bartender couldnt tell me anything about the menu and never offered to ask a server or anyone else. I have food allergies so it was important!

resp.text:
I apologize for this Emily. We will address this with last night's staff. We are happy the food was great!
Can you let us know via info@nordicbrewworks.com what night you were in and if it was the upstairs or downstairs bar?

name: Blake Robertson
text: Delicious beer and funny names, try the Charlie Work.

name: Jamie Herzog
text: Service is absolutely amazing and food is A+!

resp.text:
Hi Jamie,
Thanks so much for the positive review! Glad you enjoyed your time with us and we hope you are able to stop in again. Have a good one and until next time!

name: tunA Kuru
text: Fun and friendly atmosphere, affordable prices. The food was delicious. We ordered Montana Mushroom pizza and Dirty Potatoes which were enough for two people. Their coconut stout (Shakshuka) is also tasty with easy drinking experience.. two sided fireplace creates a warm and cozy ambiance for cold Montana winters..

resp.text: Hey tunA. The Montana Mushroom pizza and Drity Potatoes are two of our best sellers. Thanks for coming in!

name: Tyler Kern
text: They have solid memu options and a great atmosphere. I highly recommend trying one of their many pizzas, my favorite is the Montana Mushroom. This place is great for families or a group of friends!

resp.text: Hey Tyler. We appreciate your feedback and recommendations!

name: Larry Barghultz
text: A great place with great food and service

resp.text: Thank you for your five-star review. We really appreciate your support.

name: shriyansh kothari
text: Love the place and it's ambiance. The staff is super friendly and bartender even explained what drink is what when I asked. The drinks are amazing and the place just looks perfect for the location. I would highly recommend this brewery whether you are passing by or live in town.

resp.text: Thanks Shriyansh! Glad you had a nice visit.

name: Karlene Bailey
text: First time at Nordic and all I can say is they have gained another loyal customer. The service was excellent, my server had some fantastic recommendations that all turned out to be delicious. The cocktails were on point and the pizza was amazing! Had the Montana Mushroom pizza and the mushroom toast, both turned out great 👍Would highly recommend!

resp.text: Thank you for the review and kind words Karlene! We look forward to serving you again.

name: Will B
text: Exceptional service from Mads at the bar!

resp.text: Thanks for the review Will! Glad to hear mads took excellent care of you while you were with us. Cheers!

name: Brett Loomis
text:
Nice interior. Our pizza and Greek salad was very good. Prices were on the higher side, but not too bad. However....

The service was terrible!! We we're seated at 6:40. Our server did not get to our table until 6:51. We ordered everything at that time.  Our pizza did not make it to our table until 7:41. Over 60 minutes from when we sat down!!  The restaurant was not busy, and we sat and watched people who were seated after us get their food before us.

To be fair, we asked for the manager who apologized and seemed to genuinely feel bad for what had happened. She comped the meal (we did not ask, she just did it) and threw in a free dessert to do.

Bottom line: based on service - 0 stars
Food - bumped it up to 1

text:
Beer was great, of the 4 of us 3 ordered pizza, each a different style, all three were very salty to a point that we couldn't get past a few slices. It was as if someone put 4 time more salt in the dough than they should have. I hope there was just a mistake in the prep kitchen when we were in today. One of the people in our group ordered a sandwich which she loved. I hope on our next visit they redeem themselves. Everything else was great, staff was friendly, the atmosphere was great, beautiful facility, just really salty pizza.
Edit: I look forward to eating there again. Thank you for the response.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in! I'm sorry to hear the pizza was less than excellent, but thank you for bringing it to our attention. resp.text: Hi Michelle. We walk a fine line trying to offer local, quality ingredients, from our grass-fed beef to the local tomatoes while keeping prices reasonable. Much of what we offer is hand-made daily and requires more labor. There are ways to offer lower priced food, but quality is of paramount importance to us and we feel the food quality we offer is quite reasonable for the price. We hope you come back. Feel free to ask for a comment card and write down some suggestions that might add some variety.

We stayed for 3 nights and it was a great place to stay. Water and power hookups right at our site, and the campground is well maintained and very clean. It's just a short walk to the resort if you want to spend the day at the pool and waterslide or head to the golf course.

name: April
text:
The first time we went, it was before the big breakfast rush, probably 8:30ish. The food was good and the service wasn't bad.

The second time we went, we weren't so lucky. It was a little after 10:00. We waited for a table for 15 minutes and the whole ordeal with people packed in the lobby while someone was seating or doing whatever else was a disorganized experience.

We got our table, our drinks, and ordered our food. The waitress was awful. I watched her walking around doing little chores all over the place instead of tending to her tables or asking if I wanted a refill. Our food took a good half hour, and I can't be sure if it's because the kitchen was so slow or if it's because our waitress was ignoring her tables. The food wasn't nearly as good as the first visit--I guess when you're so busy you put in a lot less effort making plates.I finally was able to ask for a refill when our food came but she never brought it (surprise!).
After waiting another 10 or 15 minutes after we were done eating she dropped off our check. Over $2.00 for an 8-ounce glass of diet coke packed with ice? Even a second one wouldn't have been worth that, but geez it would've made me less bitter for paying for it. Next time it'll be water. And the waitress will get less than 15% tip, that's for sure (hubby was too nice and gave her that much).
Checking out was a whole another ordeal. ONE cash register, really? ONE cashier who also doubles a hostess while everyone else is running around like chickens? What's wrong with that place?

IF we go back, it certainly won't be during a busy breakfast.

Update: We've been back twice, once at dinner and once at lunch. Dinner was nearly empty and service was STILL terrible. Lunch was busy again and our waitress was incompetent.

We probably won't be back. Maybe Perkins is better?

name: Greg Houston
text: The Squire House is located in the same building as the Elements Hotel which is a block off of Main Street.  It’s a must visit, especially for Brunch.  They have a full bar and outside patio too. The food is incredible, but in full disclosure, I’ve only ever had the Brioche French Toast (pictured below) with bourbon aged maple syrup.  I can’t go there and not order that. They also have scratch made biscuits and croissants.  You could make a meal off of those alone, and are a perfect appetizer to accompany your mimosas.  The service is always great, and they are very attentive.  All food is made when ordered, so be prepared to have a leisurely, relaxing experience.

text:
If you’d like to find a good Elk Burger while in town, this is a great place! It was the hunt for one of those that brought us in the door. And the trout and brussel appetizers were excellent as well. Great service for several detailed requests as well. And a lovely outdoor patio.

Only reason for 4 stars verses 5 was that it just seemed so loud in the space. The design of the room doesn’t keep it a quiet one (no fault of staff or anyone working there, the acoustics of the room with an open kitchen is just loud.) At about 1/3 full it was averaging 72 decibels. Many modern restaurants are like this though, so it’s not abnormal.

text: We had brunch here this morning (Sunday), & our experience was mediocre, at best. We stood up front, waiting to be seated, for a solid 5 minutes before someone approached us, even though only 2 tables were full and a couple of employees had made eye contact with us, but looked away and kept talking with each other. Pros: Creme brûlée French toast was really good, & the mimosa was yummy, as well. Presentation was visually appealing. Cons: The Pork Belly Eggs Benedict were a massive disappointment, with the pork being tough as leather & the hashbrowns being practically burnt (& I’m all for crispy hashbrowns). The Classic French Omelette was “okay”. Service was fine after our issue getting seated. Overall, we were far from impressed.

text:
My wife and I went there for a "Fancy" Date night. We ordered their "special" 8oz fillet to share, with some Brussels sprouts. The sprouts were some of the best that we've ever had, but the fillet was garbage. Our waitress, Juliette came and checked on us in the first few bites, and we explained that the fillet was chewy and difficult to cut. She was very kind, and got us a new fillet without being asked, and it was a world of difference!!! (It must have been the cut)
She provided some of the best service that we have experienced in Bozeman. Thank you Juliette, for saving us from what we though was going to be a disappointment, and redeeming Squire House.  We'll be back for more of those Brussels and great service!
