text: Very fast service for a Saturday evening, excellent staff, from their courteous wait staff to their highly skilled kitchen staff. Portions are reasonable, not gargantuan, but you won't leave overstuffed. I had just enough room for 2 beers, half an appetizer, entree, and dessert. Food was delicious and perfectly prepared!

name: Corrie Lavina Knight
text:
Our experience here was phenomenal!

Our party of 5 booked a reservation for 3:30pm on a weekday and ordered off the dinner menu. Being a naturally slow time of day for any restaurant, we were the only table present and received the absolute most bestest of service. Our orders included a dish with duck confit, a risotto chicken with mushrooms, a blue salad, and a beet chevre salad with salmon added. The food was delectable, presentation was beautiful, and portion sizes were perfect--neither scant nor extraneous.

We had food allergies present in our party. Our server, being vigilant about that, warned us that our appetizer of calamari was typically served on a bed of fancy slaw that included pieces of bell pepper (which was the allergy-offending ingredient). She was happy to bring the calamari pieces in a separate dish from the slaw so that everyone could enjoy the appetizer as it was intended to be served while our allergic person could also enjoy the calamari. At the end of our meal, the owner of the restaurant approached us to ensure that our meal was satisfactory, and that all allergy issues had been resolved successfully.

The house-made rhubarb-strawberry vinaigrette (served on the beet chevre salad) is fabulous, and deserves to be bottled and sold as its own separate entity.

I was disappointed with the overall selections on the menu. While I understand that main dishes featuring duck, seafood, and steak will easily fall in a price range of $25-35 per plate, the only non-appetizer menu options presented for less than $20 per plate were salads and 2 burger options. Even patrons who seek a high-end dining experience can appreciate a menu which includes a few more mid-priced main dishes than that, and I believe hotel guests and the Bozeman community alike would respond favorably to the addition of such.

name: Jeremy Singleton
text: Ate here with a group on a Saturday night. It can be a little loud, the place is really one big room (though I'm not sure what place wouldn't be loud on a Saturday night). It seemed like it too a little longer to get our food but we did take awhile to order and it gave us a chance to enjoy our cocktails. Food was good. Everyone seemed pleased with what they ordered. I had the elk burger and it was cooked perfectly.

name: Sherle Warren
text: Wonderful space, the food was delicious and the service was great.

name: Sean McCleary
text:
My family and I spotted this place and we were curious about what they had to offer. Unfortunately we had arrived just minutes before their kitchen closed.

We debated whether we should leave or stay. As we were contemplating the owner approached us. He gave us a tour of the restaurant. He offered us a seat and we ordered some drinks. To our surprise he brought out a complementary desert just to thank us for stopping by!

The owner consistently visited our table and asked if we enjoyed the dessert and drinks. He made a clear effort to socialize with us and make sure we were comfortable.

Even though we did not have a chance to try the food, we are going to make an effort to return!

name: May Farrand
text: First time visiting Squire House. This seems to be a well-kept secret and my new favorite place to eat/drink/meet on Bozeman! Came in on a Thursday night, sat at the bar, had incredible mussels, a fabulous brussel sprouts appetizer and amazing Sauvignon Blanc. Absolutely perfect dinner.  Walked in with no reservations (I would recommend making reservations, as the restaurant filled up quickly.) I will absolutely be back! The food, drink, service and atmosphere are excellent.  Love Squire House!

name: Kristin Koetz Nunn
text: Delightful brunch on Saturday or Sunday! Sarah made wondetful Irish and Spanish coffees on our frosty weekend morning.

name: randy sailer
text: Our favorite downtown place to get a quiet drink.

name: Piper Marcella
text: If I could give zero stars I would we made a reservation and it took them 40 minutes to seat us and the forgot one of our orders and it took them for ever to get us our food. Definitely not coming back.

name: William O'Neill
text: Nice place. Great food. The people are nice but it takes a long time to get your food.

name: Erin Hunter
text: When I first walked in I immediately expected everything to be on the pricey side. The interior is gorgeous and the food is creative without being overly expensive, would reccomend this spot to anyone looking to enjoy some unique Montana dishes like the Elk Bolognese or the Montana Trout starter

name: Scott Colson
text: Sunday morning (10 AM) great service and food.

name: Chris Ballinger
text: My favorite place in Bozeman! Finally a place where EVERYTHING we ordered was excellent! WOW!!!

name: Jane Foster
text: Great place for brunch! Sarah did an awesome job!!! 👍

name: Alonzo Antonucci
text: We enjoyed our meal and the atmosphere. Careful with the chairs as they all could be replaced as they all seemed to be cheap quality and could possibly break at any moment. Waitresses were excellent. However if they ask if you want bread it costs $6. Entrees do not come with a side. Quite possibly the best ribeye in Bozeman. Other dishes such as a free range chicken and oysters were excellent as well. Expensive eats but great food and desserts as well. Would go back despite some of the things mentioned above now knowing more.

name: Joseph Bernhardt
text: We went to the Squire House for their Easter brunch, so this review may not reflect their typical menu and services.  Most of the savory food was bland, under-seasoned, and definitely sat under the heat lamps all morning.  The home fries were hard and nearly inedible and the eggs were a bit overdone.  The sweet plates, on the other hand, were exceptional.  The french toast was some of the best french toast I've had at a restaurant.  So, overall it was hit or miss, but I'm not sure if it was enough to bring me back a second time.  A special event such as an Easter brunch shouldn't have a miss at all...

name: Diane Reese Leach
text: Great menu, locally sourced food.  Outstanding staff. Nice bar.

name: Kamala Gibby
text: Was excited to try a new restaurant in Bozeman. Made reservations and ordered the trout,only to be met with a mouthful of bones. Told the waitress,and the head chef didn't seem to care. Probably would only go back for drinks, definitely do not order the fish!

name: Stacey Faldetta
text: Great atmosphere! Food is unique and delicious.

name: Bryan Murphy
text: The ribeye is amazing.  We've been here several times and the food has always been great! The Beignets are amazing and the Pot de' Creme is also very,  very good!

name: Brandon Haysom
text: Awesome food! Great portioning! Happy Birthday to me!

name: Les Craig
text: Great spot to try out, menu and experience continue to get better ever time I have visited.

name: Glen Barcus
text: We say at the chef's table and were treated to dinner and a show. Wonderful service and spirit.

name: Diane Reese Leach
text: Excellent food with knowledgable staff...wine selection is fantastic!

name: Diana Loomis
text: Owner is always engaged and makes sure you are cared for.  Good food,  Good presentation, Good ambiance.

name: Caleb Salusso
text: The mac and cheese was dense and delicious,  the chicken was superbly cooked, and the ratatouille was tasted like it was brought straight from France.

resp.text: Caleb, thank you for the wonderful review. We look forward to serving you again. Cheers!

name: Brett Loomis
text: Good food. They are working out some kinks from being new, but worth the visit.

name: Jolene Kristovich
text: I loved our experience, great food, excellent wine selection, and the dessert was amazing!

name: M. Douglas Kypfer
text:
Good food, fast service
Owner is very friendly, stops by table to chat and check on food & service. I will be back.

name: Mike Koziel
text: Great food lineup.  Staff is on point as well

name: Tiffany Cok
text: Food was incredible.   Delicious and unique.

name: Ted Coté
text: Very good scallops, nice wine. Blah dessert.

name: Steve Rast
text: Hidden, underutilized spot in Downtown BZN

name: Nate Harris
text: Delicious!!! Great menu!!! Great Staff!!!

name: Dimitri Vincent
text: Best place eat in Bozeman.

name: Maddi Druckenmiller
text: Best desert

name: Jud Wiers
text: Fabulous

name: Frank Cikan
text: Love it there!!!

name: Tony Smith
text: Great food!

name: Tony Granberg
text: Not too shabby.

name: Sebastian Petzing
text: The M: Always a nice little hike, no matter the season or time of day. Various routes available for different skill levels.

name: Austin Baldwin
text: A great local short hike in the Bridger foothills with an excellent view of Bozeman! 😍

name: Damir Davis
text: Very good trail for a workout that can last all day if you decide to trek the ridge. The views are nice but since you are a distance away from the other mountain ranges it isn't as amazing as it could possibly be. Still a great place to go to take friends, family and significant others.

name: danielle skjelver
text: This is an awesome set of trails and spurs offering variety year round. The only drawback is that the trails are often crowded. Universally friendly but equally universally unleashed dogs leave piles of "fun" behind, and a lot of dog-folks like to leave this fun for other hikers to enjoy. I saw a set of ski tracks today that had gone through two of many piles of dog fun on the steep side. I have been herded by a Border Collie, sending me flying through the air, and occasionally a dog will not get out of the way for you if you are running, but the dog experiences are mostly charming. Overall it's a great set of trails year round, and a great place to encounter inspiring, friendly people.

name: Doreen Neely
text: A great hike to sneak in while out and about in town Bozeman.

name: Paolette Matute
text: Great hike!! Quick, challenging (if you go up the steep side) and with a very fun view!

name: Matthew Roam
text: Fun hiking. Take the easy way unless you are experienced in hiking

name: Chandra Jennings
text: Absolutely amazing! So worth the rocky and sweaty hike up. Such a beautiful place!!

name: Alejandro Escobar
text: Add this to your must visit area list you will not regret it

name: Debi Nagle
text: A great morning hike. Beautiful view of Bozeman.

name: Kennan M
text: There are trails for all skills, ages, and difficulties. It's a great hike, usually takes me right around 40 minutes round trip to the m so with the drive it is something I can squeeze in after work or on a weekend before other activities start. Weekends with nice weather be aware that it is a popular spot. The parking lot could use some upgrades to accommodate the cars but people seem to make do. There's no running water here, just a pit toilet. Nothing wrong with that just another warning.

name: jordan wagner
text: Pick up trash if you see it! The earth thanks you

name: Elif Bilal
text: Currently it is full of flowers and it smells great!

name: Savannah Donnelly
text: An essential Bozeman home!

name: George Hogan
text: Go early or go late, and you'll miss the crowds. It's 5 stars because it allows you into the Bridger's. Go as far as you want. If anyone gives this less than 5 it's because they let crowds ruin it for them. It gets crowded, but the views are the same and you're only a couple miles from town.

name: iTravel
text: Nice view from up here! I recommend it.

name: Craig Dugas
text: It's a great trail with two clearly marked routes for an "easy" or "rigorous" hike. It's a popular local trail, so expect plenty of unleashed dogs and limited parking. The views of the valley from the M are worth the trip!

name: Chelsea Marshall
text: It's a great hike but it is very popular. So, if you're cool with meeting someone on the trail every few minutes it's great!! Major drawback for me personally is the strong dog pee smell on hot days & the amount of dog poop either in bags off to the side or simply uncollected. But a really great hike with kids as they can see where they hiked from anywhere in town due to the huge "M."

name: Garrett Graham
text: A little but busy. Okay, very busy. Okay, you'll probably have a hard time finding a parking spot. But go anyway. It really is bigtime Bozeman destination, and for a good reason. The M gives a great view of the valley for such a short easy hike. If you can't find a parking spot, go across the road to the Drinking Horse Trailhead. Then again, these days its hard to find a spot there, either.

name: jessica carl
text: The family really likes it here and so many different routes to take.

name: A.J. Long
text: It is a great spot to slow down & just take it all in. I hope CK May Excavating doesn't mess it up to bad! Someone should give them a push broom to clean their mess up off of the road  :( Not exactly professional

name: Lisa Ann VanCamp
text: Beautiful!!!! Absolutely gorgeous!!! Didn't make it to the m, I gave up three quarters of the way up lmao 🤦🤦🤦 but it was still gorgeous and I had a great time. It was a beautiful day, sun shining, no rain, wanted to watch sun go down but left before

name: Brent Wilting
text: Nice hike. Straight up is hard around is nice and easier. Good view at top.

name: Alex Emerson
text: GREAT trail- a few different routes to vary length, traffic and difficulty, terrific views. There does tend to be a dog poop problem, which is the only reason this doesn't get the full five stars.

name: Brian Negaard
text: A great trail that isn't to far out of the way, but can get a little crouded for parking.

name: Amir Darabi
text: A nice hiking trail with a great view of the gorgeous city of Bozeman

name: Heather Williamson
text: Love this hike, have been going up there as long as i can remember. Now my kidd get to enjoy it! Parking sucks and is the only downside.

name: Mr. Green LoLyPoP Boy
text: Well maintained trail with a great view at the top

name: Kim Gilbert
text: Great hike!  Heavily trafficked

name: Chrystina Katz
text: Love the trails. Can take dogs too.  Awesome 2hr hike with steep walking  and beautiful views.

name: Michael Kelly
text: Nice 45 minute aerobic walk ( for us old folks) with nice view at the M

name: Pinky Floydy
text: Great place to walk the dog.... 👍

name: COLBY QUINN
text: With screws in my shoes and trekking poles the M is a great steep hike.

name: Thom Hughes
text: This is not a picnic area, it's a very popular, too popular, trail head.  On the weekend its hard to park, and there's only one picnic bench.  There are many better places for a picnic!

name: Richard Flint
text: Nice beginners hike beautiful scenery with some harder trails for those with more experience

name: Jason Kay
text: Seriously busy trailhead but for good reason. You can take the easy way up to the M and enjoy the view or keep going to stretch your legs on some of the serious terrain the Ridge serves up. Overflow parking is available at the Drinking Horse Mountain trailhead across the street.

name: Jason Daughenbaugh
text: Busy Trailhead - for good reason, the trail is great.  But as a picnic area?  I might consider somewhere else to avoid the crowds.

name: Matthew Stewart
text: Amazing views and great hiking trails minutes away from downtown Bozeman. Trails for beginners and for serious hikers and runners.

name: Drones in Pursuit
text: Beautiful view, great hike. Definitely worth the visit.

name: Ryan Johnson
text: It's convenient to town and it makes for a good workout because it's steep.

name: Charles Lehmann
text: Fantastic trail.  Great place for a family afternoon hiking.

name: Will B
text: Great place for a hike, multiple trail options for different ability levels.

name: Zachary Barr
text: Nice trail, but way too much dog poop.

name: Debra Johnson
text: Great family time place.

name: Adam Gregg
text: take the trail straight up to the Bridger ridge trail.

name: Chris Schmandt
text: Nice but busy TH to get up on the main Bridger ridge

name: Garrett
text: Great place for a quick hike, great view, or an entrance into the Bridgers

name: Ryan Bartholomew
text: Beautiful views without having to go far, and nice to have a couple trail options. Can get crowded and difficult to park, however.

name: Andrew Nakas
text: Amazing hiking spot. Great local vibe.

name: Kirkwood Donavin
text: Short hike, good cardiovascular training for running or hiking and spectacular view of the valley. A Bozeman classic.

name: Merrilee Thomas
text: Great quick hike for families, alone, or your dog.

name: Gregg Fuller
text: Crowded all the time

name: Peyton Rodriguez
text: Great, and pretty strenuous hike

name: Joshua Francis
text: Great hike early in the morning.

name: Charles Bischoff
text: Perfect afternoon hike

name: Dave Skattum
text: Fun and challenging

name: Peter Sandstrom
text: Not the complete alphabet

name: Nicholas English
text: Great running/hiking!

name: Alex Morren
text: Not only does Townshend's Teahouse offer a worldly tea selection with outstanding service, the staff's attention and dedication to infection control are superb. Despite concerns one may have surrounding COVID-19, their frequent surface bleaching, hang washing, and encouragement to wear masks whenever possible begets an atmosphere that is as comforting and relaxing as the teas they serve.

resp.text: Thank you for your review, Alex! We're so glad you enjoyed your visit and your tea, and that you felt safe and comfortable. We'll pass on your encouraging words on to our staff. Wishing you Happy New Year and we hope you'll be able to visit the Teahouse again soon!

name: pelican antics
text: Legitimately the best hot chocolate I've ever had.

resp.text: Thanks for your review, so happy to hear you loved our hot chocolate!  We hope you'll visit again soon. Cheers!

name: Ana Miriam RodriguezCruz
text: Clean, cozy, roomy with a delicious variety of teas to choose from.  My favorite tea "Irons Of Mercies" was delicious, soothing and their scones are fresh and warm up the ❤.

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed your visit with us!

name: Janelle Garza
text: Was better when it was Townshend's.

resp.text: Thanks for your feedback, Janelle, and thanks for visiting the new Steep Mountain Tea House! We've kept the same tea selection, staff and management, added more food selections, and implemented an ownership change, brand update, and a new paint job as you saw!  We're trying to maintain the same welcoming atmosphere, and in the future when COVID safety is not a concern, we'll add more tables and resume our dances, game nights, open mic nights and other community events. I'd love to hear from you if you have any more specific feedback regarding what you miss from Townshend's that you'd like us to consider re-creating with Steep Mountain Tea! Feel welcome to email me if you'd like at manager@steepmtntea.org.

name: G. Eric Gustafson
text: Always friendly service. Tapioca pearls (boba) drinks are excellent with a wide range of delicious flavors.

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed your visit, and your tea!  We'll pass on your encouraging words to our staff. Hope you'll be able to visit the Teahouse again soon!

name: purry bb
text: I think I may have found the love of my life...at Townshend's! He was tall and cool in a 24oz glass, this watermelon kombucha is the perfect thing to sip on a hot Summer day 🙌

name: Jono Odermann
text: The service isn't too bad, they're friendly and quick with ordering, and the tea takes a really long time. But it's worth the wait because the bubble tea is really good. It's got a cozy environment.

name: Dylan Weber
text: Lovely downtown teahouse with tasty bubble teas.

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed you tea! Thanks for visiting us!

name: Drake Pannell
text: Thinking of going here... can't wait!

resp.text: We're excited to hear that you're thinking of visiting us!

name: Thursday Ackerman
text: Amazing as always. I never regret a visit here (despite ordering the same thing every time). I actually asked out my girlfriend here! The staff was super helpful! Special shout out to Becca for being so accommodating and helping me with my plan. Couldn’t have done it without her. Again, amazing service, always anticipating my next visit.

name: Katherine Stout
text: good place for tea with a warm and cozy atmosphere. the bubble tea is really great with lots of flavors and they have a good variety of types of tea and milks. it's usually fairly busy but worth a short wait in line.

name: Zeph Casias
text: Visited for the 1st time on game night. It's a nice location with a large selection of teas. I randomly chose one since I don't know much about the different types and their benefits.

name: Gail Hatch
text: Bubble tea is fun to drink! 🤠

name: justin garcia
text: Nice atmosphere, good chai, great staff. Upgraded to five stars the next day!

name: Emily Natale
text: Seriously the best place to come if you need to get a little work done.  Good drinks, solid internet,  friendly staff, and it's usually a bit quieter than a lot of the local coffee shops.  I love the black milk bubble tea on a hot day or the roasted coconut mate on a chilly day.  There are so many teas that it's easy to get overwhelmed,  so my advice would be to stick to the speciality drinks menu,  everything I've tried from it has been good!  Oh, and their Clear Mind or Ginger Turmeric kombuchas are my absolute favorites!!

name: Nina Mondré Schweppe
text: One of my former students works here and we had the best kombucha on tap after a run that I've had so far in Bozeman

name: Jack Fry
text:
Townshend's Tea Shack is a staple business is Bozeman. The atmosphere inside is comforting and welcoming. There is a wide variety of different teas to try, and I have happily enjoyed everything I have tried.
Often I will walk in to see a group of people there for some form of event. I've walked in and seen 13 people playing board games, and another time I walked in to the tables having been moved aside and a large group of people practicing their dancing.
People come here to do homework, meet with friends, or even just relax and read a book for a while.
The staff is always friendly and helpful, and truly seem to enjoy interacting with their customers.
Just go :)

name: Elif Bilal
text: Always a great place to hang out with friends and family, and by myself. One of my favorite places in town. I always get a bubble tea to celebrate something, and I love loose green teas that they have.

name: Alexa Adamson
text: Great atmosphere and the dark forest Chai was amazing! When they served it it was perfect temp, not too hot, great to sip on. They have a huge menu with incredible options. Definitely reccomend

name: Ryan Schwab
text: Dragon Pearl Jasmine tea is all you need in life!  It gets fairly crowded in the evenings as it's one of the only places to hang out that's not a bar.     Overall It's a great place to study or meet with people while staying mildly caffeinated.

resp.text: Thanks Ryan, so glad you enjoyed your visit, and your Jasmine tea!

name: JP Pendleton
text: Always a great cup of tea here at Townshend's, with a friendly and knowledgeable staff and a great atmosphere. Buy some bulk loose leaf tea while you're at it.

name: Brandon Vanderkolk
text: Best tea in the state! Clear mind kombucha and milk oolong are my two favorites!

name: Jordan Dood
text: Hands down the best tea in Bozeman!

name: Jenna Stoffers
text: Great tea, friendly people!

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed your visit with us!

name: Wyatt Petty
text: Great place to sit down and relax. They play very calm and relaxing music that has a very Bozeman’esk feel to it. They have a multitude of options of teas and some pastry options. The workers seem to genuinely enjoy their job and bring a very welcoming aroma to your experience. A very well maintained area and I would highly recommend coming here to have a cup of tea if you’re ever in the mood!

name: Audrey Moss
text: One of my favorite Bozeman spots. Can occasionally be busy or slow, but always cozy and delicious. Over 100 kinds of tea, bubble tea, kombucha, and milk options. Staff is always friendly and kind. Can't recommend highly enough.

resp.text: Thanks, Audrey! We love hearing that!

name: Eben Howard
text: Great tea selection plus they have the rare wonder of bubble tea (rare around Bozeman anyway)

name: Bayard L
text:
This little tea house fills what was a much needed void in Bozeman, a place to get finely crafted tea, find a table, and get cozy for awhile.

The Mack drink is a delicious blend of steamed milk, chamomile and mint that is both relaxing and spirit warming. A continuing favorite, as I have tried a modest eight or half dozen drinks here and I keep craving The Mack. The Golden latte is a more medicinal drink, but also incredible for the right palate.

My girlfriend and I love sitting down during a colder evening and enjoying a hot blended drink, especially when the sofa or lounging chairs are available.

If you’re a patron older than 25, you’ll notice on the weekends that many of the people filling the tables are high school students.

name: Amber Flanagan
text: I have come to this tea house for the better part of the last two or three years at this point, and tonight's experience was just another reason for me to keep coming back. I came in tonight actually having questions on tea as my boyfriend is looking for other alternatives to energy drinks. I had a faint idea of what I was looking for, and after perusing the book for a bit, I was down to two different teas. The gentleman at the front counter was able to pin down exactly what he thought would work as well as recommending a couple for the evening for my boyfriend as well. All of their teas are truly fantastic and I can't ever say no to going to Townshend's!

name: Sigrid O
text: Awesome tea and atmosphere. Also lots of community events

name: Hans Dierenfeldt
text: Dont go anywhere else for my loose-leaf tea. Highly recommend the milk oolong!!

name: Breana Dyk
text: Love this place! The staff are all very friendly and helpful. They know their product well and can help point you to a tea that will suit whatever you are craving. Great atmosphere for studying or meeting with friends.

name: Ben Suslavich
text: Chill vibes! Great tea selection!

name: GM Faux
text: Great bobba tea! A fun hangout with free to play boardgames!

resp.text: So happy you enjoyed your visit— hope to see you again soon!

name: Katelyn Maspero
text: This was my first time here and I was very happy with my Thai tea. It's very relaxed in the teahouse and the staff are very friendly

resp.text: Thank you for visiting, glad you enjoyed your tea and the atmosphere!  I will pass your compliments on to our staff.  Hope to see you again soon!

name: Emily Grosswiler
text: Great place for bubble tea! I love that they have eco friendly straws!

resp.text: Thanks, Emily! We're always trying to do our best for this planet!

name: Tel Poof
text: strong tea

resp.text: So glad you enjoyed your tea!  Happy New Year, hope you'll be able to visit the Teahouse again soon!

name: Amy Schulte
text: This might be my favorite place in the whole wide world.  I moved out of town but any time I get anywhere near Bozeman I ALWAYS stop at the teahouse and get a bubble tea!

resp.text: Thank you, Amy, so glad you continue to visit us and that you love our tea!  We appreciate your feedback and I'll be sure to pass your compliment on to our full staff.  All the best to you!

name: Joshua-Luke O'Connor
text: Scott and Melissa are the greatest and a sweeter couple you will not find. They run an excellent establishment. Their employees are friendly and professional and constantly accommodating. Love the variety and quality of the teas. The overall atmosphere is great! I love playing board/card games here and studying for hours on end or even just coming in for a quick tea. My favorites are any of the chai/maté combinations made as a latte with coconut milk. Excellent.

resp.text: Thanks Josh, we appreciate you!

name: Ryan Connelly
text: Huge tea selection!  Eclectic crowd, but not a ton of seating. Good things come to those who wait.

name: Nick Esposito
text: Very popular destination in downtown Bozeman, MT.   The tea selection is spectacular and you can buy loose leaf to take home with you. It's a great place to go on a date, read a book, or catch up with friends!

name: Rebekah Mohr
text: One of my favorite places in Bozeman to meet friends. You will have a hard time selecting a tea as they have so many options to choose from. However, their knowledgeable and friendly staff will help you every step of the way. This is the BEST place to find a cup of tea in Bozeman. They frequently have interesting and diverse events - keep an eye on their calendar!

resp.text: Thank you for the review, Rebekah!  See you again soon.

name: Chris VanBockel
text: Had a great experience, lots of tea variety and the staff have great knowledge, helped me choose the right green tea for my needs, they also have my favorite tea in stock the silver needles white tea.  Ambience is relaxing and quiet for studying, work, or in this case time with a good friend.will return again and again and recommend highly

name: Julia Elaine
text: Their selection of tea is the best in Bozeman! And they always brew it perfectly! I would definitely recommend this place to anyone looking for a nice cup of tea!

name: Tenaya Pedersen
text: I have have never been let down here! This is my go to study spot! I have lived in Bozeman 2 years and still have. It tried every tea here! It is the ideal environment for studying or visiting with friends. I love it here!

name: Edward Johnson
text: Excellent place for community. The owners are the nicest people and they host dancing and other events at the Teahouse. The art and decor is very nice, seating is great and atmosphere is perfect. Enjoy tea with friends or work here. Love the selection of well over 100 teas. You can buy kombucha and bulk tea as well.

name: Michelle Breen
text: I've only been here a couple times but will keep going back. Nice atmosphere great service and a fantastic selection of tea. If you're a tea drinker, this is the place for you.

name: Monkey Belle
text: Its adorable and they have a huge variety of tea. Usually fairly quiet so its good to study

name: Osiris
text: Best tea house in town! I can't think of another one, but none the less amazing! Fantastic selection and positively wonderful staff. AAA can't recommend enough,  great place to catch up with friends or homework.  Love you Townsend Teahouse and everyone who goes there.

name: Mohammad Alkhaled
text: I love this place. They have lots of different kinds of teas. White, green, matcha,yerba. Great place .

name: Karl Molina
text: This place is great the staff are super friendly and the drinks are always tasty, keep it up.

name: Everett Johns
text: Such a cute place. They have little containers of whole tea that you can smell to help you decide. This is more of a social and event atmosphere than a quiet study place. I have seen some amazing people doing poetry slams there. It gets packed pretty fast though! They have Wifi and cozy seating. The employees are more than willing to help you if you aren't really a tea person.

name: Matthew Campbell
text: This is one of my favorite places to do homework, and their tea selection is fantastic. The only reason I rate this place four stars is because their location is a little small and very echoey. So if the place is crowded it can get pretty hard to hear people. Hopefully someday they can open a new location or move to a larger spot. Until then, I will continue coming here to enjoy their tea, and I simply use headphones!

name: Jason Kay
text: Great tea shop with a wonderful variety. The tea and employees are great but there is another element that makes Townshend's special. That is the owners and the events they host in their space. Open mic night, tango, west coast swing, and tea tastings are just a few of the events that will be going on here. Well worth a stop in. They will have a tea for you.

name: Marcus Twichel
text: One of the shining gems in Bozeman. Great selection of tea, and I have never had a bad drink here. The staff is very friendly as well! Highly recommended!

name: Pricsilla Cervantes
text: such a unique place. very cozy

name: B. Tegner Jacobson
text: Townshend's has a wide variety of different teas to try at affordable prices. They often invite local musicians and entertainers to their storefront in order to have small events and support local talent. It's a fun place to hang out and enjoy some unique tea.

name: A Gordon
text: There are so many options and the menu is great for learning about the options. They also have amazing kombucha on tap and I recommend getting the flights if you can't decide on one flavor. You can also get a growler of kombucha if you really enjoyed a specific flavor. Their tea lattes are really good, I recently tried the matcha and I can't say I'll ever get it again, it tasted like alfalfa (I know this because I've eaten it before). Matcha is one of those you like it or you don't, I found that I'm in the latter group. I've tried all the other lattes and enjoyed them though, especially the pumpkin one. I went here a lot to study when needing to get out of my apartment. The atmosphere is good but can be crowded and depending on the crowd and time it can be noisy. But that's why they made headphones right? The WiFi is good here although maybe not good enough to stream a movie or anything, music is good to stream though. They often have different events held there, usually Friday, which are fun such as tango. The workers are very pleasant and bring the drinks to your table, they will also bus your table I'd not busy but I try to do that myself as they have a station for it. Parking isn't impossible because it's towards the end of downtown so there may be a spot or two always open nearby.

name: Joey Knappenberger
text:
Tl,dr; While a bit crowded, this place is amazing and definitely worth a visit.

This is easily one of my favorite places in Bozeman. There are plenty of places that deserve 5 stars, but if there was an option to give a 5+, this would be one of the few places that deserves it. The tea is amazing. They have a huge selection, and I've never been disappointed just picking a random one. Their bubble tea is top notch as well, (I personally have to recommend a black tea base with green apple and fruit gells). I'm not into kombucha, but my friends who are tell me that it's really good here. Finally, the food, while not exactly healthy, is amazing.

There are a few things to note. The first is that it is sometimes a bit crowded, especially on weekends, so finding a table can be a bit tricky. It's not too bad, and it's only been a real problem for me once, but it's something to keep in mind. The second thing is that while they do have decent free internet, it's a bit spotty from time to time, so uploading files for school projects can be a bit difficult. Neither of these are real issues though, and this place is truly something special.

text:
Santa Fe's has always been dependable for tasty food for me. My friend and I went for lunch. Service was very prompt and our order came out quickly.
I didn't have one this time, but their house margaritas are large and tasty. I also enjoy the atmosphere, it's not your regular restaurant. It has character. Prices are reasonable as well.
Enjoy

resp.text: Thank you Tiffani for taking the time to write this. I'm so glad you enjoy yourself when you come in! We also offer buy one get one for ladies drinks on Thursday nights, stop in for some margaritas!!

name: Larry Boles
text:
My first experience was looking for some Mexican options while stuck at home due to quarantine. Ended up ordering some nachos and they did not disappoint.

Second time we ordered some queso with our meal which unfortunately our uber eats person didn't get, but after reporting the problem we were issued a refund with no hassle

A few weeks after quarantine was over we decided to check them out in person and the atmosphere of the place was great! Was not expecting it to be as nice inside considering the street side exterior of the building.
Amazing food! Had very high quality carne asada, and while there get the Elote. Aside from the cheese being shredded instead of crumbled It's pretty legit!

text: The best Mexican food in Bozeman, bar none. Exceptional quality, ginormous portions, outstanding service, Maria was a most gracious hostess. Cali, Tenille and Jay are all superb bartenders. Try the Cadillac Margarita, you'll want to have two. The atmosphere is inviting and eclectic. There is always a fun special going on and we have had traditional live music on a Friday night. For a full service experience with cocktails, food and fun I highly recommend Santa Fe Red's!!

text: Lovely restaurant and bar. The atmosphere is chill and the food.. Oh man. Tried the chicken mole and it was great. Just the right amount of bittersweet at first and then hello heat. Rice and beans were pretty standard if a little bland, but that chicken was bitchin. 💜💜

text: I think they started my family of young kids in the bar... So loud with the love music.  Food was kinda plain.  Chips and salsa was good though.  Service could improve as well.  If you have the time look for a different Mexican restaurant.

resp.text:
Hi Erin,

My name is Carlos Gonzalez and I am the General Manager here at Santa Fe Red's.  I am the one that offered you and your family the booth in the Cantina.  I was trying to get you sat a little faster since we had you on a wait.  I had a lot of large groups already in the restaurant occupying tables for 7 people.  I would have gladly waited for one of those tables to come free had I known you didn't care for the one in the area  we offered you.  I noticed you had small children and thought I would offer seating faster.  As for the food, it's very traditional Mexican that comes from my family recipes.  I would have been more than happy to discuss all of this with you when I thanked you for coming in and wished you a good evening.  I'm sorry that we didn't have the opportunity to solve any problems that you had with your experience here tonight.

An extremely satisfied customer.

name: Jason Daughenbaugh
text:
Poor service, slow kitchen, expensive, decent food, great patio.

Arrived to eat at 2:30 on a Sunday with a group of seven.  The restaurant was empty - just one family leaving and another family out on the patio.  Yet it took 15 minutes and some staff arguing among themselves to get the table ready for us.  Then another 15 minutes before the waitress took our drink order (3:00) and warned us that the kitchen was out of a lot of menu items.  We told her that some of our group needed to leave for the airport around 4 and she said that wouldn't be a problem.  Another 15 minutes (3:15) and she came with our drinks and took our food order.

Shortly after this the other family out on the patio made a scene and left - they had been waiting so long for their food that they gave up and left (without their meals!).  Not a good sign.

About 3:35 our food showed up (so actually pretty quick after ordering.)  But some of it wasn't right (wrong meat, wrong side, etc) but we didn't have time to get that fixed.  The food was fine, not great but not bad either.  But $13 for a mediocre burrito is crazy.

The final problem was that the kid's tacos were so spicy that the kids couldn't eat them.  Their mom said that they were even too spicy for her (and she was visiting from Texas and loves spicy mexican).  Who makes kids meals super spicy?

But the patio was great with great weather, so 2 stars.  But it will be a long time before we return.  Too bad because years ago this was one of our favorite places to eat.

text: Awesome place for authentic mexican food! My wife and I are from Phoenix and the enchiladas were surprisingly authentic, great portions, cool layout and overall great experience!

name: Erica Murphy-Burrell
text: Unfortunately we were shorted our sides and salad with a takeout order last night. Cost nearly $40 for one burrito and six taquitos. The food was okay, but I had to wait at the empty hostess stand for 5 minutes before anyone came up. Both bars were also empty and three staff walked by me and others in line behind me many times. This was at 7pm so really have to wonder why the entire staff was not at their stations at rush hour (there were over a dozen empty tables). They weren't even that full and there were several waitresses who were busting their bums but no one else was around. Really unsatisfying food and service, so likely won't be back. Manager should be made aware also that I tried to call both last night and today and was brushed off because they "were in a rush". We were in a rush last night too and did not get all of our food. No wonder all of their other locations keep closing.

name: Mikaela DiBerardinis
text: While the food is okay, our last 2 visits the service was incredibly slow. By the time qe got our food from ordering it had been an hour. It was not overly busy where I would expect a wait in the kitchen. We ended up taking our food to go. There was another patron who was seated near us who clearly had a problem with children, she made it so obvious and eventually asked for another seat. Our kids are well behaved and normal kids, not getting up from their seats and not being too loud. The other pateon was served before us after being seated a good 15 minutes after and we ordered only nachos and quesadillas, nothing crazy or elaborate. This was a favorite since childhood and it just is not the same - or maybe my standards have changed.

resp.text:
Hi Mikaela,

My name is Carlos Gonzalez and I am the General Manager here at Santa Fe Red's.  I want to apologize for your negative experience in my restaurant.  I would like to get some more information from you about your visit.  If you wouldn't mind contacting me at (406) 587-5838 or by email, carlos@santafereds.com, and let me know who your server was and what time of day you visited us.  I would love to see what we can do to make it your favorite place again.  I have been here for just under a year and we have been working on improving everything about our restaurant from our food, service, cleanliness, to our overall guest experience at Santa Fe Red's.

I have found that this has been a memory for many folks in Bozeman.  It seems that Santa Fe Red's from the past drew a much younger crowd (18 - 25), to whereas now days those same guest have kids of their own and are a bit older and mature (35-40).  I am sure some things about Santa Fe Red's will never be the same just because of the demographics of the restaurant.  However, we are building a new flavor and a more mature status here offering a more authentic cuisine (my families recipes) and a relaxed family atmosphere.  I apologize for how the other patron acted.  We really love and appreciate children here at Santa Fe Red's.  We foster a family environment and are actually adding a Kids Eat Free day every Wednesday for kids 10 and under.

I am looking forward to hearing from you.  Let me make this right.

Sincerely,
Carlos

name: Mark Fredenberg
text: Pick your own meats (pork, beef, chicken, shrimp...), veggies, noodles, sauces, then watch them grill it all up! Great environment. Clean. Friendly.

name: Kamala Gibby
text: Food is always great at Mongolian and you can make it as healthy as you want. I like to stick to the veggies and white meats. They also have the rice noodles as a great alternative.

name: Sam Viall
text: Nothing fancy, but I've never been disappointed here. Stir fry style, food ~$10 er person.

name: Jason Hill
text: I love this place. Sure u get one trip, but that just means you got a think!...build yourself a tower...put the small things on bottom, etc. Make a game of seeing how much you can get in one bowl. I can eat for 2 days off one and it tastes amazing!...if your on a budget and want good food try out this budget man/woman's gem.

name: Lora Lanning

name: Charles Jiang
text:
Part of the joy for places like this is stacking. If you get a medium bowl and are able to stack as high as possible you shouldn't be penalized by having them automatically upgrade to the pricing for a large.

Overall food quality isn't bad, pretty generic of Mongolian BBQ places, frozen meat and seafood etc seem fresh. Nice choice of vegetables. A lot of other places like this offer complimentary rice and soup, however this place does not.

When we went, there were 2 grill masters, however they do this thing where they only cook 2 bowls at a time, and they rotate and swirl your food around the cooking surface. This means not only are you getting less of your own sauces, you are also getting a good portion of the sauce of your neighbor. At the end they all pretty much taste the same.

Apart from Mongolian BBQ we also ordered the broken rice dish with the pork chop. The rice wasn't actually broken, just long grain Jasmine which is fine, it tastes pretty much the same. The porkchop was very small for the price, but the taste was okay.

The service leaves much to be desired. It took us quite a long time for us to track down our waitress to be able to place our side orders. The environment is kind of hectic, since the food line is in the middle of the restaurant there's just constant foot traffic all around you as you eat.

text: The food was good,  but other than that nothing exceptional.   We were sat on Wednesday evening,  got our drink orders,  and we went to get our food.  The menu was not explained to us,  so I was expecting like any other Mongolian bbq place that there would be an all you can eat option. There IS NOT one!   You pay by bowl,  and to make things worse,  they accept credit cards but they charge you for that too.  As for the drinks the menu states free refills,  but they serve you in cans and we were never asked if we wanted a refill.   Needless to say it was a bad experience.   I honestly don't know if I will go back.

Their sauce list is extensive, and they have a very well kept, cleaned often, grease removed often grill plate. Their service is excellent as well,  constantly making sure that you have a filled water glass. A wonderful joint with dedicated helpful staff with delicious food that keeps me coming back constantly every time I find myself in Bozeman.

name: Paul Cooke
text:
Let me start by saying that I have had mostly positive experiences with Scrubbys - in general the employees are friendly and courteous, the owner's son - Chad - is great, and they usually do a good job of washing a car.  I have had a couple of bigger problems there which Chad quickly and professionally resolved.  The first was that they blew the paint off the bumper of my wife's new SUV, and the second was them putting someone else's floor mat in my new truck while putting my new floor mat into another person's vehicle.  For the paint Chad had me get a few estimates, then took care of the cost to repair the paint on my wife's Grand Cherokee; when the mats got switched Chad had Big Sky Toppers (where I bought the mats) order another set (they only come as a pair), and only asked me to drop off the one that wasn't needed.
The small problems I have had have been with the car wash not getting my Jeep Rubicon clean, particularly the black plastic fenders and rear bumper.  Today I took my Jeep through the car wash and asked that they make sure to focus on the rear bumper.  The guy taking my payment said "No problem" and made a note on my windshield pointing it out.  I could tell that the guys in the wash didn't hit the bumper well so I opened my window and asked that they do so, to which I got a nod.  When I got home I saw that it was actually very dirty still, but didn't have the time to go back and point it out (which I have done before).  Attached are photos to show what I mean (the water drop on it is from the car wash).  When this happens at Scrubbys I usually just go to the do-it-yourself car wash at 19th and Springhill Road and re-clean the bumper and fenders.
This time I decided to call and let Scrubbys know that it had happened again, but no one picked up the phone.  Then I decided to email them to let them know what had happened, and this is where it gets weird.  About an hour after I sent an email explaining that my vehicle came out dirty even though I had pointed out in advance to pay attention to the rear bumper, I got a call on my cell from a woman that identified herself as the owner of Scrubbys.  She told me that she was going to reimburse me the cost of my wash and the tip I'd left, emphasizing she would have to ask the employees to give the tip money back to her.  Then she told me to never come to her car wash again.  From there she proceeded to say that they have bent over backwards to make me happy and I have been nothing but trouble to them, and have in particular treated her son terribly, and something to the effect of 'how dare I do that to a young man that has lost his father'.  I was shocked by the accusations, particularly in regards to Chad, as I have never been anything but polite to him, and he the same to me.  But this woman was awful.   She just doesn't listen.  She told me that she has a dozen cameras in the car wash and had reviewed the washing of my Jeep, and that my bumper was perfectly clean when it left, and that if they had pressure washed it any harder the paint would have come off it like it had before (the paint was pressure washed off of our Grand Cherokee, not this vehicle).  The problem with her comment is that my Jeep's rear bumper and fenders are black plastic - there is no paint to damage the on them.  I tried to tell her that there are stripes of dirt still on them but she wouldn't listen, talking over me and again accusing me of treating her son terribly, then reiterated that I was to never visit her car wash again, and then hung up on me while I was still talking.
So, the reasons for the one star rating are: my vehicle didn't get cleaned after making multiple requests to pay attention to where it was dirty; that this has happened multiple times; and epecially the rude and unprofessional way the business owner conducted herself on the phone.  A good business owner would ask to see evidence of what is occurring, and then take steps to fix the problem instead of attacking a customer for pointing out where they had let the customer down.

text: Boyne Corp has no leadership skills in creating awesome culture, they lost it this year (again). Ski culture WAS an amazing chance to let loose, have a lot of fun, celebrate the fresh outdoor healthy living lifestyle. Now you just pay the highest rate for recreation and lifestyle to quietly stand in line, receive orders and directions, see no smiling faces, a chance to focus on being cold and angry, and read a ton of serious tone of voice marketing signs everywhere! It's absolutely a buzz kill for $180/day. You can get a better feel good ROI giving that money to charity or, support small business. Best advice for the soul is to skip these lines and this mood killer and find something else to do. They have a lot of work to do to turn around the culture and attitude.

name: Bryan Hughes
text:
This review is heavily weighted towards how bad they are at keeping their customers safe during Covid-19. And it is not good.

We have skied Mammoth, Bachelor, and Bridger during Covid, putting a lot of miles on our car. I thought Bachelor was bad, but Big Sky takes the cake.

First, they break the queue into two parts, those for people to ride together, and those for your party only. This wrong and dangerous. It promotes and rewards strangers sitting side by side on a 6 person chair because it goes faster. They should be held liable if anyone gets sick because of this. Next, they rarely enforce or police the queue, so so many people just ignore the signs. Finally, it is clear that the so called reservations is a joke, the place is packed. Will not be coming back here. It is clear the corporation running this place cares little about their customers or stemming the spread of Covid.

resp.text: Thank you for your feedback. Lift queue organization is set up to provide different options for guests who have varying levels of comfort when loading chairs. If you have any other feedback, please feel free to reach out to us at info@bigskyresort.com.

name: Paul Cooke
text: This is a world class resort in terms of terrain, number and quality of lifts, and high caliber ski instructors, all in uncrowded southwest Montana, plus it's one of the largest ski resorts in North America.  There are green runs that are 3+ miles long, lots of groomed blue runs, and fantastic off piste blue and black tree and glade skiing.  The tram features one black diamond run and many, many double black runs.  There are also double black runs that you can access without riding the tram, worth noting because the tram requires a more expensive lift ticket, and it can have an hour or more wait to ride it.

You're a short day trip to lots of places...Virginia City/Nevada City ghost towns, Bozeman for bigger shopping and Museum of the Rockies, West entrance to Yellowstone, the small mountain town of Big Sky with a fantastic church, and Big Sky resort  (great food!!) just up the hill. We hope to return annually. Had an entire week of PERFECT (weather et al) days.  When's the last time you could say that? Say "Hi" to the ducks on the lake. name: Matthew Campbell
text: I fell in love with this place four years ago, and every person I bring here does the same. It's certainly rocky, so expect to see your skis trashed in a year or two. But the amazing terrain, small lift lines, and friendly people MORE than make up for it. They have two great beginner areas for kids to learn to ski, and a great progression of terrain from there. Intermediate skiers will love the abundance of rolling, scenic groomer runs. Advanced skiers will love the incredible tree skiing, wide open bowls from the peak, and the headwaters chutes. The ski resort itself is fairly priced with a great selection of amenities for every type of skier, but expect to shell out for crazy priced food, lodging, and other amenities if you stay at the mountain village or elsewhere in Big Sky.

name: Bella
text: Always have great food the belt wraps are amazing. And the huckleberry grilled cheese sandwich is amazing when cooked crispy   👍

name: Lindsay Raymond
text: Love this place so much ❤ the chocolate croissants are to die for.

name: moonwitch01
text: Second time through and the staff team is good what they do!

name: Kate Brady
text: I've gone here twice in the last month and both times they messed up my very simple, straight from the menu, one item order. I didn't ask them to fix it either time because I didn't feel like waiting longer, but I'm sure they would have.  A few of the workers did not have masks on. The ones who did kept repeatedly touching them and pulling them down around their chins when they spoke, completely defeating the purpose. One girl with her mask around her chin was coughing a bunch, which was more than a bit disconcerting. The food is super bland, but I get it's supposed to be standard fare americana so probably can't fault them for that. Two stars because they're always super friendly and the food is so cheap for giant portions.  Regardless, definitely not going back anymore.

name: Charles Major
text: They were able to make the breakfast sandwich I wanted so that was awesome and I love the cinnamon rolls

name: Cole. Brown
text: Guy working at counter was decently rude and didn’t get our order right along with the hair in our food it was just a bad experience. Definitely used to be a good place to go, but by the messiness of the inside and the general vibes I’d say find somewhere else to do lunch.

resp.text: Hello Cole.  I am so sorry you had a bad experience.  We strive to make our customers happy and would love for you to try us again.  We are currently struggling with being sooo short staffed which puts extra pressure on those that are working but still there is no excuse for rudeness. Thanks for taking the time to leave us a note.

name: Natalia Utter
text: Delicious food! Get a cinnamon roll, they are gigantic.

resp.text: We love the size of our cinnamon rolls!  Breakfast, lunch and diner all in one!  We hope we can serve you again someday, thanks for leaving us a review.

name: Elizabeth Iverson
text: They have the best food and coffee, not sure why anyone would even go to Starbucks when this place is a couple blocks away!

name: Madeline Willis
text: Very clean and helpful staff

name: bambi rhodes
text: Always courtesy service and great products for great price

name: Ayda Tello
text: Food was delicious and I devoured their cinnamon roll! Their coffee was alright.

name: Buck Arnold
text: Great bakery! Unbelievable cinnamon rolls!! Their sandwiches are fantastic too! Nice people as well!

name: Tom Langston
text: The best bakery in Montana. Awesome selection of baked goods. My favorite is the giant croissants with ham and swiss baked in! Huckleberry cinnamon rolls are a close second.

resp.text: If you get the opportunity to try one of our "bearclaws" you wont be disappointed!  Thanks for eating with us and taking the time to write us such a nice review.  I hope we can serve you again!

name: Ben Horton
text: Truly amazing GIANT Huckleberry Cinnamon Rolls!

name: K Banks
text: Excellent baked goods. Their sandwiches seem to lack consistency but are very good. I love e using their flour for at home baking.

name: Dick D
text: Food is good but over priced and the selection sucks. Great friendly service.

name: Rodney Gottula
text: Good food. Decent prices.

name: Lucky Man
text: Awesome little eatery. I wanted to get a cinnamon roll, but I foolishly ate breakfast at my hotel. I ate the Mighty Missouri sandwich hours later at Glacier and it was so freaking good, it was a highlight of an already wonderful day. Nice local food products to take home. Eat here if you're visiting Kalispell.

resp.text: Not too steal our own thunder........but, just about anything tastes good when your in the park looking at all those awesome views!!!!  Thanks for the nice review and welcome back!

name: Mike Barham
text: Great spot!!

name: John Casey
text: You wouldn't think you'd get days old croissant and days old cinnamon roll at a bakery, but that is what I think I got today.  Not interested in coming back.

resp.text: Hello John. I am so sorry to hear that you were not satisfied with our bakery. Every morning we start our baking at 4 am to assure our customers they get FRESH daily. If day old bakery is sold, it is at a discounted price and marked as such. Please try us again as we hope to gain your business back but also thanks for the review. We are always working to improve.

name: Melissa Myers
text:
Delightful, Delicious, speedy food.
Wonderful, friendly staff. 😊

name: Erin
text: Love, love, love this place! Nicest staff and owners!! Delicious food and I get the BIG bag of 7 grain oatmeal from them. Delicious:) customer service is a big thing to me and they definitely got it! Great job!

resp.text: Customer service is our #1 goal!  Thanks for letting us know we are headed in the right direction! (I also think the 7 Grain cereal is the best.)

name: jasiu raczynski
text: Awesome little spot! Delicious food and great atmosphere

resp.text: Thanks for taking time out of your day to write us such a nice review!  I hope our awesome staff has the pleasure of serving you again in the future!

name: Mr Anonymous
text: Stoped in to grab a sandwich with my girlfriend one day and ended up getting in a long conversation with a man sitting in the corner who happened to be the owner. Seemed like a super awesome guy that was interested in pushing forward with conversation and wanted to learn about our views. Staff was great and the food was phenomenal. Highly recommend checking this place out.

resp.text: Thanks for taking the time to write us a review!  It's fun when we can get reviews like this one.

name: Henry m
text: Had sandwich to go turkey and ham with ranch.  Was a wonderful and tasty sandwich.  Also got a cream cheese cinnamon roll.  Yum

resp.text: That would have been our Mighty Missouri sandwich!!!  Thanks for writing us a review and we hope to serve you again!

name: Brooke Tselishchev

resp.text: Brooke, please stop in and visit one of our managers. We want to correct this for you!

text: Amazing hot sandwich, even with the gluten free bread, delicious warm soup, yum!!! Perfect lunch for a chilly day... and very friendly staff also ;) can't forget about this gem downtown!!

resp.text: Your review brought some sunshine to us on this cloudy day!!!!!!!  Thank you for eating with us and we hope to serve you again.

name: Amber Nestell
text: This place is amazing! I was sad when Cafe max went out of business because I loved their soup and went here on a whim- BEST tomato bisque soup I have ever had anywhere. I have gone back several times since and would recommend this place to anyone.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in Amber.  It's nice to hear we met your expectations!  Welcome back.

resp.text: Thanks for stopping in and we hope to see you soon!

text: Its ok. The older lady is kind of a witch. You can get better croissants at Costco, dont waste your dough!

resp.text: Thanks for the review!  We wish we could get a 5 star every-time somebody rates us, but we know we are humane and that would not be possible to do!  I'll visit with the older employee and let her know her communication with you was not exceptionable.

text: Gals and guy working were super helpful and friendly! Great food,  I got the homestead sandwich and a frappe. Everything was great!!

resp.text: You made our Saturday crews day, with this solid 5!  Welcome back, we'd be happy to serve you again.

resp.text: Wow! we feel honored to serve customers like you!  Thanks for the review and welcome back.

text: Awesome, still waiting for their london fog to come back but as always their the best!

name: Dane

name: Helena Brown
text: We go to Sweet Peaks often. Their ice cream is super yummy.  The Yeti is my favorite. :-)

name: Teresa Thoms
text: Delicious ice cream. Clean and pleasant.

name: Stephanie Burcusa
text: Awesome ice cream options! The Mountain Chai was delicious, and my daughter loved the Cupcake flavor. Cute gift shop attached as well. Highly recommend!

name: Kevin Duncan
text: Are you kidding?!! The ice cream is not only the best and richest but also the most creative in their flavor creations.

name: yvonne boll
text: I bought a gift card faster than anywhere else that I ever had any place else.

name: Hazel Flack-Barley
text: DELICIOUS!! Not over priced either. Loved it and will return.

name: Martin Michael
text: Perfect place for a "little" treat. They have a variety of choices and servings are big. Don't forget to get one of their dog popsicles for your four legged friend.

name: Brenna Harm
text: Great summer stop. The only reason I can't give it 5 stars is for the high price, but the ice cream was delicious. The upstairs outdoor seating was also a neat touch.

name: Zach Purdy
text: Salty caramel... All you need to know.

name: Monique Hawkins
text: Oh ice cream, the sad thing I'm always finding a seasonal favor I love, but it won't be there when I return, which give me a reason to fall in love with another flavor. I love their oatmeal cookie with banana base ice cream. Sounds like breakfast doesn't it?

name: Jamie Crowell
text: The ice cream is awesome.

name: N C
text: Good ice cream, however someone with a medical exemption was denied entry and service. Contacted owner, employee may need to be informed of this exemption. Response from owner: was concerned and this should not have happened.

name: John ThePiper
text: Great ice cream! Can't wait to go back.

name: Bush
text: Good ice cream and nice staff. They have plenty of chairs outside and upstairs to chill out and relax.

name: Ken Casto
text: Awesome ice cream! You have to stop and try some.

name: Starr Turner
text: If you are a quality-over-quanity person, this is the place for you. The flavors featured on the chalkboard are few, but earn their place. And the roof- top tables feature a fun view of Kalispell.

name: Reya OnTheRoad
text: Don’t miss. Savor a double on the upper deck.

name: Samantha Platkowski
text: best ice cream you will ever have.   This had to be the best vanilla ice cream ever made.  It's fresh and natural tasting, not artificial like so many others.   They also offer half scoops,  so if you want to mix 2 flavors but are watching your girlish figure,  get the half scoops.   Double flavor no guilt!

name: Mo Leigh
text: Amazing gourmet homemade ice cream. The coffee traders and banana oatmeal cookie and my favorites!!!! The clothing is adorable. I've never had a bad experience.

name: Amy Nelson
text:
Sooo. ..this place is "sweet"..cute, and cozy...small to be exact, prices are high, options are few..but that being said the service was top notch and the ice cream was good..
Not handicap friendly persay...
Darling gift shop

name: Sarah Ellis
text: Yum! Good service and wonderfully tasting ice cream.

name: Melody Amundson
text: Delicious homemade ice cream.  Fun distinct flavors.

name: Janya K Comer
text: Fun little place. I would only recommend that the gal behind the counter keep her shirt over her pieced belly button. It completely took away from the "family atmosphere". There's a place and time to show off your anatomy... Your place of employment should not be that place.

name: Lucas Hill
text: Excellent Ice cream. If you are driving through Kalispell and are craving something sweet and cold Sweet Peaks will certainly satisfy your needs.

name: Kevin Nelson
text: Yummy  :)

name: Terri AKA JUNIOR
text: Girls friendly and the ice cream was amazing!

name: Clint E.
text: Eat way too much ice cream

name: Brad
text:
Delicious Ice Cream! The flavors are very unique and delicious! The staff were great with the kids and we're very friendly! The place was a little small but the staff made sure the lines moved quickly so it wasn't too uncomfortable.

I ordered the mint smore flavor which turned out to be a fantastic pick me up for the evening I was having. They have a great seating area above the building and good spaces right outside on a hot day.

I will definitely be back here, the ice cream was fantastic!

name: Mike Jeffers
text: Great ice cream. I had the espresso ice cream. It was fresh and awesome.

name: Kerry Ledford
text: Great service, excellent ice cream!

name: Katie
text: Very cute shop with fun flavors. I also saw they got an A+ health rating in 2019.

name: Laurie Jenkins
text: Honey Cinnamon is the best flavor!! But I have yet to have a bad one here or at any of the Sweet Peaks Locations. The staff is so friendly and will give you plenty of samples, ensuring that you have the best possible ice cream experience. The clothing shop is so cute as well!

resp.text: Thanks for this great review Laurie!

name: James Bamfield
text:
Great little ice cream shop! The local for city visitors (and I'm sure those who live there) is great. The environment is charming, and the staff is friendly.

The only issue I had (which was enough for me not to love it) was sticker shock. I understand that the ice cream is hand made, but it still took me back when a milkshake was $6. Worth it, mind you! Definitely will visit again next time I'm in Kalispell!

name: Ms Jenny
text: If you like ice cream you should like it here. Prices are average and so is portion size.

name: Ian Argall
text:
Sweet Peaks is hands down my favorite ice cream place ever! I've been to some fancy well reviewed places in San Francisco, Oakland, Berkeley, Seattle and Portland but I'd pick Sweet Peaks over any of 'em.

From the locally sourced ingredients to the wide variety of flavors and the awesome employees Sweet Peaks is a must stop if you're in the area.

Try the cinnamon honey or the orange ginger marmalade or honestly anything in their daily made fresh waffle cone and you'll be on the right track to ice cream bliss!

resp.text: Thanks for your kind works Ian!

name: Brian Friess
text: Sweet Peaks is one of the great local attractions in Kalispell.  they make very unique and tasty creative flavors of ice cream. we really enjoy going in there with our kids and tasting some of the new flavors that they've whipped up. one of our favorites that we would like to see again was Earl Grey London Fog ice cream but they don't often keep their eclectic flavors from week to week.  they often use Coffee Traders or other locally-sourced ingredients. some of the more favored flavors are Huckleberry and chocolate love. Their mint chocolate also uses real mint in their ice cream.  There is also a small shop to buy Montana tourist type items adjacent inside.

name: Shelley Emslie
text: Love their coffee ice cream and of course the huckleberry, too! Such an awesome place for quality ice cream😍

name: Jim C
text: Unique flavors, limited as they were out of two of them, could use less retail space and more seats.

name: Dan Rowlan
text: Ice cream was real good. More flavors would be nice.  Great staff.

name: John Kessler
text: Great flavors and staff. Reasonable prices and serving sizes. I don't want to eat icecream often, but when I do, I'll be at sweet peaks.

name: Erin A
text: I love this place. Always really nice people. My kids love it. Every flavor I've ever tried is absolutely delicious and perfectly balanced.

name: Joshuah Rogers
text: Love the montana Christmas can't get.good stuff like that any where else

name: Jeremy Ashby
text: Hand crafted small batch hard ice cream.  They have dairy free options and a rotating selection of regular favorites along with local favorites like coconut and salty caramel.  Also try a hit coco float or Sunday

resp.text: Thanks Jeremy!

name: ironman80us
text: Incredible ice cream. Try the S'mores flavor. Out of control good.

name: Aundrea Eaton
text: This place makes everyone happy! I love the atmosphere and the ice cream is the best.

name: J

The staff at what is now dubbed "The Dog Club" really do care about your furry companions. This isn't the most glamorous calling but you can see the passion for animal care in their eyes and hear it in their voices!

The facilities are continually on the update. Expanding and offering more for the animals during their stay. They have a groomer on site and a well known professional dog psychologist and trainer in often to work with the pooches and employees as well.

If you want the comfort of mind knowing your furry family members will be taken care of, this is the place to have them watched over! You can also tune in to their live cams online.

name: Andrew Hamilton
text: If you are doing anything outdoors in the Flathead, then the Sportsman Ski Haus should be your only stop. Whether you're fishing, hunting, golfing, folfing, camping, biking, hiking, cross country skiing, or blood pumping downhill skiing, or if maybe this is your year to take up snowboarding, this is the only  place to get all of the things that you're going to need to enjoy our beautiful valley. Hats, sunglasses, clothing, golf clubs, walking sticks, bear spray, binoculars, guns, licenses, skis (snow and water) and any other accessory that you might need for your favorite activities can be found here at the right price. Not sure what you need, then one of their highly trained associates will be more than happy to assist you to make sure that you have the right accessories to make your sport a success, even if its bird watching at the beach. And golfers, even on a rainy day, you can stop by and check out the state of the art Trackman 4 virtual reality golf simulator which is truly amazing. I’ve snowshoed once in my life and was excited to show my wife how fun the sport is. I was treated so poorly that we ended up forgoing the rental and the trip altogether.

Retail employees: Realize that not everyone is a ski bum that is familiar with technical terms like “televators” and such (honestly had to look it up). You are literally hired to educate and HELP people. Customer service is your job. If you don’t like it, there are plenty of other jobs where it’s not as important and plenty of other people willing to work hard and treat people with respect that will happily replace you. It’s not that difficult. It’s specially important when there is so much new competition.

There are other companies that I’m sure offer the same products and that appreciate their customers. I’ll try them next time. Sadly, you lost our business, Sportsman. You can thank Haley (if I recall correctly) at rentals for that.

resp.text: Hi Bruce. Thanks for your 4 stars and comments. Don't know if you know our history . . . which goes back to 1968 when we started out as a TINY military-type surplus store down near the intersection of Hwy. 2 & 93 in Kalispell. Over the years we added on several times and now that location is currently the Flathead Industries store. When there wasn't any more room to grow without swallowing up all the parking spaces, the decision was made to build and move to our present Kalispell location in Hutton Ranch Plaza. We love hearing you support local stores and we're very proud to be one of them. Not only are we local, we're employee-owned! We take our local roots seriously and have a commitment to 'giving back' to our community with over one million dollars in support and contributions to a myriad of causes and organizations over just the past 15 years alone. We carry some upscale brands which may cost more than some brands though we do carry a range of items in different prices in many cases. By the way, if you do find an identical item being sold by another retailer at a better price, whether in a store or online, we will match the price. name: Venus Corriher
text: Oh my goodness!!! This place. We have an exotic, a sugar glider to be exact. We woke up around 0100 in the morning, went in to check on him (we had only had him about 4 days), he had not eaten his fruit (this boy LOVES some watermelon) and had not been out. We took him put of his and his right eye was swollen. We got him to eat a bit, put him back up and went back to bed. I got up at 0800 that same morning, called the clinic and they set me an appointment on an already full schedule! We knew we wpuld have to wait, which was fine, we were worried sick. We got there at 1530 (appt time was 1545), parked and called to tell them that we were there (no one is allowed in clinic except pets because of COVID). We only waited for about 20 minutes. Someone came out, asked a few questions, and whisked our boy away. About 15-20 minutes later, they brought him back out in his little pouch with some antibiotics and again, the gentleman asked questions about our boy, as if he were genuinely interested. The staff was amazing, the prices are great and we will be making this our glider's vet. They are wonderful!!!

Yet, having to wait for a regular scheduled appt seems worth it when you know the doctor cares about everyone’s animals. If the role was reversed I would gladly wait for my pets wellness exams to ensure another persons animal was getting the life saving services they needed. text: I got "LUCKY" today. Arrived in plenty of time. Checked in with my usual "Pre-Check" supplied by the Global Entry Program and waited at the little "Pre-Check" gate while several regular customers, 6, were put through to the Screening tables. It was finally my turn. I followed a United Airline First Officer and Pilot who smoothly proceeded. I got diverted to another line, was put thru the imaging machine where I had to empty my shirt pockets completely, I had my daily pills there. Got thru that OK and had to wait yet again while my personal item was dug thru, pulling out too much looking for who knows what they thought they saw. Then I had the pleasure of re-packing it. Nice job Staff. Didn't understand how my Global Entry Pre-Check Program could help me thru Security so WELL. Oh well, maybe next time, ...

If you ever have to fly in or out of state, try flying in or out of Bozeman’s airport. You won’t regret it!

name: Ryan Schwab
text: Literally the BEST international airport in the bozeman area!!

name: Jed Winstanley
text: In 40 years of air travel we have never before been the only two passengers in an airport, and to go through security on our own was an absolute delight. The breakfast was also the best meal I have ever had in an airport. After the stress of Manchester, Heathrow, and all the major hubs around the world, Bozeman was a truly pleasant experience. And, our flight set off on time and arrived early.

name: Thom Laveaux
text: Airport staff have always treated my family and I with great courtesy and customer assistance whenever we flew anywhere. Great airport, great personnel, great service! The Big Sky MONTANA FAMILY/ NEIGHBOR WAY!!!! LOVE IT!

name: Ryan Bartholomew
text: Driving to/from and parking at BZN is extremely easy. No traffic, reasonable fees. Once inside, it has an extremely cozy, welcoming, down to earth feel, similar to being at a vacation lodge, and while there can be significant lines for  baggage check-in, the security lines are typically minimal. The staff is friendly, the town and the people are cool, and the flight options are plentiful considering the size of the area. Excellent, well-run airport!

name: Tita

name: Ryan Swimley
text: Very welcoming environment. I had to write a paper that was worth 15 percent of my grade and I felt a growth of inspiration swell in me and I got almost an entire page done.

name: Autumn Norman
text: Nice people. Small enough so you won’t get lost. Cozy feel. Only negative, but quite an annoying one, TSA here is in slow motion. Ive been to a few airports and I’ve never seen anything like it, kinda crazy and stressful when you need to make a flight on time.

name: Jasna Pantic
text: Very efficient very busy very clean and very beautifully done it looks like a big log cabin with a lot of statues and windows gorgeous

name: Megan
text:
TSA here is much better than in years past. The workers who inspected my bag were able to have a good laugh with me when they had to inspect my bag for DICE MASTERS of all things.

The layout is efficient. Everything is quite clean. Bathrooms aren't as spacious as larger airports, but they are so pretty it is hard to fault them.

There are large water bottle filling stations, which is very appreciated. I hate jamming my water bottle under a dirty drinking fountain.

They have multiple outlets & USB outlets at each gate. At least 8 of each. Best of all, charging is free! (And usually available, thanks to no crowding!)

Edit: De-icing planes has us with 45 minute+ takeoff delays. Not good for tight connections!

name: Randa Hulett
text: Was worried with the below zero if planes were able to fly. Emailed the airport and they got right back to me with YES. Easy airport to find where you need to go. Very nice helpful people.
