text: Wow, Preston is the rudest person I have ever dealt with in a hotel. It is called the Hospitality industry not the bitchy I'm out to make everyone have a bad day industry. And coming out of the back office with your friend, and buttoning up your shirt is a bit unprofessional. You may want to consider getting fully dressed before you come into the lobby when guests are around.

name: Barry Yaeger
text: Nice spacious room with a pretty decent kitchen. Great breakfast

resp.text:
Dear Mr. Yaeger,
Thank you for your review of the Residence Inn Helena.

We are so happy you enjoyed the room and breakfast and hope you will have a chance to visit us again.

Happy New Year,
Emmet

name: Cheryl Myers
text: This place was amazing! The rooms were spacious, clean and very comfortable. Our room had a full size refrigerator​, freezer and dishwasher. It also had an ice maker which was very convenient. The bed was comfortable. The Wi-Fi was fast. The best part was the free breakfast and dinner. It also has a great pool area. The pool area was clean, stocked with towels and heated to a perfect temperature. The hot tub was the hottest one I have ever been in. I will stay here every time I visit Helena.

name: Toshi Samano
text: Great service. Clean and spacious room. Very polite stuff.

name: Richard Evans
text: clean, large rooms!

name: Coley King
text: Very nice suites, with friendly staff. Swim area and hot tub are great. Look forward to staying when in town.

name: Jeff Carter
text: There's two Marriott hotels in town, and this is the one you want to stay at. Excellent and hospitable housekeeping staff. Good breakfast options.

name: josh eads
text: Room 315. Splendid view. Splendid service. Splendid room. Nice pool and hot tub too

name: Cathy Carroll
text: The staff is so awesome, treat you like family, the rooms are awesome, a great daily breakfast ,  very comfortable! Can't go wrong!

resp.text:
Dear Carhy,

Thank you for taking time to review the Residence Inn Helena and the wonderful comments about the staff. I am so happy you enjoyed your stay.

Regards,
Emmet M.

name: Travis “Mr.T” Hubbard
text: The rooms were great full kitchenettes #quaint

resp.text:
Dear Travis,
Thank you for your review of the Residence Inn Helena. We are very happy you enjoyed your stay and appreciate the kind words and 5 star rating. Hope you are able to visit us again in the future.

Emmet

name: BitO Wit
text: Lovely room, staff is friendly and accommodating.  We will be back.

resp.text:
Dear Guest,
Thank you for posting your review of the residence Inn Helena. We appreciate your comments about the staff and our rooms, we work hard everyday to ensure all of our guests feel the way you did.
Look forward to your return,
Emmet

name: Erik Rose
text: Was there for breakfast with a coworker from out of town. Very clean and well kept. Gentleman from the Middle East working the front desk was extremely polite and professional. Food was pretty mediocre - not great but no complaints.

name: Charlotte Roy
text: Love the indoor waterpark and pool

resp.text:
Good afternoon Charlotte,
Thank you for the 5 out of 5 review. We appreciate your review and we are glad to hear you loved the water park and pool.  We hope you are able to visit us again.
Thank you
Velvet

name: Donna Carkeek
text: The rooms are typically okay but the smell from the nearby sewer treatment plant can permeate inside the rooms making for an uncomfortable stay. Hotter months seem worse.

resp.text:
Dear Donna,

Thank you for your feedback. Hope your stay in Helena was enjoyable.

Regards,
Emmet

name: Sean Gilman
text: Always friendly folks at the front desk. Rooms are super nice. Great value.

name: Dara Deines
text: The room is amazing, clean and comfortable. It has everything I could possibly need in it. My only complaint is I was missing dishes when I got to the room and I wasn't informed of the pre authorization charge, since I am here for work.

name: Don Powell
text: Great hotel. The Front Desk Manager (Jordan) checked me in, he was friendly, accommodating and informative.

resp.text:
Dear Don,

Thank you for the feedback regarding your stay at the Residence Inn Helena. Jared will be happy to hear he was mentioned in the review. Thank you for staying with us and hope you will be able to visit again.

Regards,
Emmet M.

name: Chan Jong
text: Really nice and clean. Gym is small, but pool is nice. Morning breakfast food is good too.

resp.text: Thank you for your review, Chang Jong! We are glad that you enjoyed the property! We are also pleased that you were able to enjoy the hotel amenities, such as the pool and fitness center and breakfast buffet.  We hope that you will come back again soon!

name: Kyle Dubbs
text: Clean rooms, good food and comfortable space.

resp.text:
Dear Kyle,

Thank you for posting your review of the Residence Inn Helena. We are very pleased you enjoyed your stay and want you to know that we appreciate your business. Hope you will have a chance to visit us again.

Regards,
Emmet

name: Sc Anderson
text: Best extended stay hotel we have stayed in.

resp.text:
Dear Guest,

Thank you for the review, we appreciate the feedback and are extremely happy you feel the way you do about our property here. We hope you will have another chance to visit us,
Emmet

name: Janeen Caffrey
text: Very nice place in a good location with a great pool. Close to lots of places to eat and not far from downtown or the ski hill.

name: Mitch Babcock
text: 2 meals a day, great rooms, and a nice hot soak.  Great for the long stay.

name: Becky H
text: Horrible. I ordered off the menu, a hamburger stuffed with cheese, topped with jalapeno,  bacon bits and pepper jack cheese . What I got was a burger with pepper jack cheese. So when I said something, the lady took it back, I got the same thing. You don't get what you order. Pretty much you'll get a plain cheeseburger,  when you order.

name: Gregory Hawkins
text: This place used to be great.  My wife and I would eat here every time we visited Yellowstone, which is about once a month.  Then a year or so ago,  the service dropped off a cliff.  There may be new ownership or something, but we went in a couple times in a row and the new servers were incredibly rude.  I would much rather eat a peanut butter sandwich in my car than pay people to be rude to me.

name: Walter White
text:
We ordered two pizzas. They forgot to cook one of them. Had to wait an extra 30 minutes before getting the second one. And there was only one other family in the restaurant.

The place was a little run down and dirty. The bathrooms were absolute filthy. Carpets looked like they haven’t been replaced since the 1940’s. The pizza was average.

name: Light For Darkness Ministries & Publishing
text: Bad food and overpriced. McDonald's would have been a better choice.

name: Paul Ramsingh
text: Good food and OK value. Restaurant did not have enough waitresses at the time so service was relatively slow. Otherwise nice place for the family.

name: Darla Collins
text: Food was ok. No one came back to check or refill drinks. Had to ask for ticket. Wouldn't go back

name: Sandra Lee
text: A place for the locals and not much else. Limited menu, average food, weird and slow service, not many choices in this town.

name: John Montana
text: Sign says Wait to be seated. So I waited and waited. I left after about five or six minutes when no one had even acknowledged my existence. Obviously at this rate breakfast would really be a slow process.

name: Charlie Schmidt
text: Service was not that great,food was marginal at best. When I was there it was Cash only there card machine was not working, wish I was told that when I walked in, would have left.

name: Gabe Varns
text: Great food.

name: B B
text: Stayed for 2 nights and it was a great stay. Really enjoyed choosing my room from the app and using the digital key. Helpful staff. Clean and comfortable. Slept a very well but brought my own pillow and very glad I did. The only reason for 4 stars is the lack of complimentary breakfast. Not sure where I thought that was included. But it wasn’t a big deal.

name: KIMMY TRUSSELL
text:
The Hilton Garden Inn in Missoula is fantastic! The property is well maintained and the staff is amazing! William, the guest services representative that checked me in, is incredible!  What a gem he is - personable, professional,  and accommodating. I'd had a tough week and wasn't in the best mood upon arrival. After conversing with William for a few minutes, I was in much  better spirits. His outstanding customer service/hospitality skills are a huge asset to this property. Thank you William, Jenny, and Biore (spelling?), the maintenance/pool person, for making my stay absolutely perfect. I will definitely be back😍
Note: **I travel with my service dog. All (most) businesses must accept them. Not all businesses are happy about that though and make it quite obvious. The Hilton Garden Inn
made both me AND Lil O.G.🐹
feel welcome.** Thanks again.♥

name: Jonas Byrd
text: This place is kind of a dump compared to other Hilton properties I’ve started at. Desperately in need of renovation. It’s cheap but I won’t be staying here again.

name: Ahmed Gaber
text: Nice hotel.. with so warm hot tub

name: sabrina bayha
text:
We went to a rock and gem show here at the Hilton. It was a great experience with the kids. They had a lot of Hands-On booths. Some of the boos for $0.50 you could sift through sand and pebbles to find gyms.it was set up on a glass plate with a light under it to make it easy to find the really tiny things with tweezers. All the kids sitting there plus us you could tell thought it was great. We found tiger eyes, garnet and all kinds of other rocks and minerals. Very fun and hey 50 cents. 😉 Where can you say you have that much fun for 50 cent's these days?

They also had a kid's auction where they would put rocks minerals and gems on plates and they could go and bid whatever they want on each plate and every 20 minutes or less I think they would close the bidding and the kids would win whatever they auctioned on if they were the highest bidder. My kids kept winning auction that were as little as $0.75 it was very exciting for them.

There were lots of exhibits with arrowheads from around the world old and new. Dinosaur fossils, bones and teeth, fossil plants in rocks Etc. So many beautiful things to see. It's so amazing to see how much color is hidden in the earth below our feet. Hot pink, purple, deep navy blue. Just amazing to see are the original artist came up with for us to dig up and find. 👍👍👍 They say they do it every year so if you haven't checked it out. Look it up for the next show. I think you'll enjoy it.

resp.text:
Sabrina,

Thank you for stopping in for the Gem and Mineral show! It's always a great turnout and we're extremely fortunate to host such an amazing event.

Thank you for your comments and we will see you next time!

Kindly,
William Macy

name: Michelle McClain
text:
The hotel is the cleanest , and I so appreciate that!  The hot tub area was stocked and clean.
Dinner at the Blue Canyon was amazing!  The food...... 《♡》 !!
I like that they feature local artists' work in the lobby of the gorgeous hotel lobby.... that's cool !

resp.text:
Michelle,

We are pleased to hear you enjoyed your stay with us and your dining experience at our restaurant! We value your patronage and hope you come back soon.

Regards,
Front Desk Staff

name: Bob Cleverly
text: Nice staff , good location , normal hotel room.

name: Hannah Anderson
text: Nothing that was really great.or good really. The beds were fine but the pillows were terrible!  I could not sleep at all because of them, so lumpy and just a pillowcase over a pillow which had been used by hundreds of other guests?! My head itched all night, having an extra layer like a pillow protector to make sure the guest is comfortable with what they are laying their head on doesn't seem like a difficult request(I should not be obligated to have my own pillow).  The room was clean enough, no visible dirt noticible sign as of the previous tenant.

name: Tamara Neal
text:
We have used Priceline twice on our trip in Missoula. The first night was at the Holiday Inn Express and on our way back we stayed here.
To be honest, we were a little disappointed with the Hilton.
Comparing them the Holiday Inn Express served us a full breakfast. (You placed an order and they filled it.) The Hilton offered us a snack bag.
I talked to the girl at the desk and she said the Hilton was working toward opening the breakfast area within a week.  It looked like it would be wonderful.
The room at the Holiday Inn Express was nicer. Especially the size of the bathroom.  There was no blow dryer in the bathroom here.  It was very small and I had to open the door to ventilate it after showering.
The Holiday Inn Express had coffee available at all times, the Hilton had a Keurig in their marketplace. (There was also one in our room, but the one in the marketplace had Peet's coffee.)
The Hilton does have a restaurant, but it is closed right now.
The lobby here is breathtaking.  You are expecting the same in your room. But our room was what I would call average.
Keep in mind that some amenities that are missing might be due to Covid, however we would choose the Holiday Inn Express over the Hilton Garden Inn.

name: Vicki Dale
text: Very clean. Nice pool area

name: Steve Ball
text: Very nice and a very good price

name: Bubba Phett
text: They didn't have a clean room at check in time. Room could be better

name: John Briggum
text: Excellent stay.  Great staff.

name: Bob Broughton
text: Great staff.  Sit down breakfast. Hilton  Garden a step up from Hamilton Inn. Very similar  price

name: Karri Clark
text: Friendly and helpful as to where to dine during these times

name: Barbara Belize
text:
Great cozy lobby and seating areas. Friendly and very caring staff. Words with me to change my room and make me.

Mountain views and easy access,  on and off to major streets and freeway.

Rooms are very clean and consistent with Hilton standards.

Thanks Missoula Hilton Garden Inn for a great stay.
I appreciate your hospitality! I'll be back.

name: Bob Beall
text: The room was not ready even at 5:00 then the room I had reserved was givin to someone else, went across the street to the got exactly what I wanted...(Holiday Inn Express)

name: Chad Schauers
text: I travel all over the Northwest and this is one of my favorite properties. William at the front desk has developed a great service culture and Deb in the restaurant is one of the best around. We have hosted events at this property for years and always appreciate the opportunity to do business with them.

name: Tom McCracken
text: Absolutely no problem with the room the staff or the service. However, for the price you are paying there's some small perks that you expect, such as breakfast. While there is a breakfast available you have to spend/pay $9.95. Keep in mind there are other available options; within walking distance McDonald's and a mile or two away Cracker Barrel restaurant. Lack of an included breakfast was very disappointing.

name: Robert Kunz
text: This place is amazing! Great service and delisious food! Happy hour is 4 to 6 pm half price on appetizer!

name: Jeanne Mays
text: Very clean and pleasant employees.

name: makedesigns
text: I've never seen a more poorly designed King Suite. Barely enough lighting to see with a few lamps you had to turn on by hand. Faucet of spa tub has seen better days. Bathroom door swings out into Entry door and refrigerator door and closet door.... WOW. I sure hope the standard rooms are better. Oh, and if you want breakfast it is $9.95 per person more. Didn't try it, just pointing that out. There was ZERO hospitality,... front desk looked very understaffed.

name: Jessi Beeman
text: Friendly service. Great beds.

name: Tracia Schenberg
text: Wedding fair no place to put your coats , Hard to hear the announcement of who won drawings if you were not out front... when I arrived and find out they told me that I had to be there for the big drawing at the end and from what I was under the impression you didn't have to be there for all the other little drawings but apparently you had to be

name: Martin KaLdahl
text: We had a couple Christmas parties here. In the convention center, The food was excellent and the service was as well. Lots of parking and close to lots of stores and other places.  Afterwards we went to the casino in front and had a blast.  The Silver Creek casino I believe.  The restaurant is called the Blue Canyon.

name: Justin Brewer
text: Room was good.  Usually when you stay in places the breakfast is.  Service was good. Pool was cold and a little small.

name: Broc Tefertiller
text: Vendor for Gun Show there, and the place was great. A/C was fantastic for vendor's as well as customers. Breakfast there was awesome, rooms a little expensive, but it's summer ya know, and tourist are out hittin the sights as well as the gun show. Supporting the Second Amendment as well as being Law abiding citizens, and looking to protect themselves from the evil the is out there trying to take it all away from us in this magnificent country we live in the United States of America. Home of the Brave, and Land of the Free. GOD BLESS all, and live long and prosper.

name: Preston James
text: Excellent property! William at check in was amazing and our driver to the airport was friendly and punctual! Thank you Hilton Missoula!

resp.text:
Thank you for your kind words and we hope you have a great honeymoon!

-William Macy

name: Corby B.
text: Had a great stay. Asked the front desk have ideas where to eat and sites to see. They gave great suggestions on restaurants and places to visit. The carousel was wonderful to see, restaurants to eat at absolutely wonderful. Had a quiet room also.

resp.text:
Corby,

We're glad you enjoyed your stay and our desk staff was so helpful with guiding you to our hidden secrents of Missoula!

Kindly,
William Macy

name: Jessica Tabor
text: We have stayed here before and enjoyed the property. We are local and needed a room for the night but the service this time made me regret staying here. We were not able to check in until way past check in. We checked with the front desk early and were told an hour, 3 hours later and past check in time we still are not checked in. Service is not worth the money.

name: Brent Gyuricza
text:
Fantastic meeting place. I had no idea the had a great breakfast place as well.
I'm pretty picky about my biscuits and gravy and these folks rocked it.

name: BARBARA H H
text: Clean. Cozy lobby/living room area. Rooms are consistent with Hilton standards.  Very friendly staff.

name: Kara Lekse
text: Fantastic service! Checked in late in the evening, staff was pleasant and helpful, took less than 2 min. Incredibly accommodating. Breakfast was worth every penny for myself and children. Room, pool and overall condition was clean and neat.  I would highly recommend and would stay again.

name: Terri Cobb
text: Their restaurant is nice we eat before the concert at the kettlehouse was a nice place.

name: Squiddlez
text: This is one of the more "high-end" hotels that I have stayed at in Missoula. I come to Missoula often and appreciate the discount they give for jehovah's witnesses! Thank you so much!

name: Cindy Davis
text: There for the MOR dinner and auction.  Dinner was great, staff was personable and friendly.  Great ran event.

name: Rick Rox
text: Good value

name: Steve Ingalsbe
text: The staff was friendly and efficient. We got there about 7 pm on a Sunday night. Being Diamond members we enjoy the perks of Hilton stays but all we got here was free water (small bottles). We had a 6 am flight the next morning so the breakfast was out of the question but the shuttle driver was ready for us at 4:30 am. They had juice, water, and coffee in the lobby for people leaving before the 6am breakfast. I would stay here again.

name: RONALD BARKER
text:
Very disappointed.  Informed us we were staying in a "newly renovated room." The beds had stains on them, mattresses we're definitely not new like the gentleman told us.  When we opened up the Kurig there was YELLOW water in it.  The restaurant next door was over priced and not good.  Plus $10 for breakfast.

For $140 you can stay downtown at the Holiday Inn and get an executive suite with a park view with much better opportunities for food, drinks, and entertainment.

name: Kassidy Martin
text: The staff was excellent! Very helpful, lots of recommendations, great customer service. Breakfast was stellar and the restaurant/bar was incredible. Would highly recommend. The room was large, homey, clean and comfortable. The whirlpool tub was a huge bonus

name: Bob Edwards
text: William is awesome!

name: Tia Celentano
text: The front desk staff during our stay and the breakfast staff were all very friendly and accommodating.  The fitness room was just perfect and was happy to see they had good options.  The room was spacious, clean and bed was very comfy!  Also the location was perfect for the kids as it was a short drive to the hub and right next door to Panda Express.

name: craig scott
text: Loved it except for covid 19

name: Jenny Thompson
text: I enjoy this place.

name: Clifford Lee
text: Went to a gun show that had plenty of vendors with a variety of products in clean and spacious rooms.

resp.text: Clifford, glad we did a great job hosting a the gun show. It was a great event and we were very excited to be the new venue for you folks!

name: Rick Paris
text: Had a buffet breakfast there. Clean, nice service. I would definitely stay here

name: Peggy Miller
text: The hotel is very attractive and clean. Parking is convenient. The room provided for the meeting I attended was easy to find, comfortable to be in, and close to bathrooms. Beverage service was also included.

name: Suzanne Moody
text: Friendly ,helpful staff and beds were wonderful.

name: Travis Robbins
text: Very nice!

name: Jeff Reynolds
text: Fantastic as always from Hilton. My main reason for 5 stars is the consistency of Hilton's.

name: Gail Archambeau
text: Great happy hour,  nice rooms

name: Magpi Fly
text: Hilton accommodated a very large conference. The conference started between 7 and 8 lasting till 5pm. They provided morning foods and drinks, a great Mexican build your own taco lunch, and afternoon gave us fresh from the oven cookies and brownies. They did a really great job, even removing dirty ware in a quite manner. Hilton is a very nice building and the bathroom were kept cleaned and stocked. Location is right off the highway and easy to get to. Parking for so may people was along a low traffic road, which was fine. There are a few restaurants close by within walking distance but Montana has Uber which can take you wherever you need to go. They are close to the airport and offer a free shuttle. (I did not stay the night.) I do recommend this Hilton. People are friendly and helpful, and it's a beautiful building.

name: Shannon Willhite
text: The food is amazing and they have a good beer selection. Unfortunately, sometimes the service is marginal. Overall, I would definitely recommend.

name: Amber Thomas
text: Friendly staff, beautiful room. Our stay was comfortable and pleasant.

resp.text: Amber, glad we took care of you during your stay. We hope to see you in Missoula again soon!

name: R Middleton
text: Friendly staff and clean, comfortable rooms

name: Rishona Corson
text: Very nice hotel. Conveniently located off interstate but quiet. Very friendly staff. Big rooms. Well equipped fitness center. Really nice pool and spa. Great breakfast.

name: Nick
text: The riverside Hilton is my favorite hotel in Missoula. It's located in a great spot right next to downtown and the university. The staff is always very helpful. If you can get a riverside room, the view of the Clark Fork river is great. The in house restaurant (Finn and Porter) has great food and a full bar. The rooms are a little dated but aside from that are very nice. I'd recommend the hotel to anyone.

name: MOOSEDROOL Moos
text: Friendly employees, easy access off the highway. Room was great but the AC fan made noise at night. Nice restaurant attached to the hotel

name: Justin Clark
text: Nice Hotel.  We rented a Jacuzzi King room for our date night.  Jacuzzi did not work, when we reported it to the front desk in the morning she said she would have maintenance look at it. $150.00 for a room without a working Jacuzzi is a little steep. Unfortunate.

resp.text:
Justin,

I apologize that the Jacuzzi in your guest room wasn't functioning correctly. If you have a moment could you send me an email with the issues you had so I can have my Engineering manager look into the issue? Also to see what else we can do to make it up to you! Let me know what we can do for you sir.

Kindly,
William Macy
William.Macy@Hilton.com
406-532-5302

name: Colleen Chapple
text: We always stay there.

name: Alan Cutler
text: Clean my friends stay offten

name: Raelynn Rae
text: Nice place. Sometimes friendly staff

name: Gary White
text: Excellent location, great breakfast, fabulous employees

name: Johnny Lingle
text: Well everyone is very nice. The room and bath spotless. The A/C is trying to keep up. It's middle July. But overall it s pretty nice. Idaho falls Idaho was perfect!

name: Taylor Stewart
text: At almost $300 a night, I was extremely disappointed by what was provided for our two night business stay...the hot tub was down for matinence, the breakfast is $9.95 not included unless you buy a "breakfast and bed" plan, which we were not told about at any point up until we went to get breakfast ... No one told us where our room was or how to get there, there was a broken ice machine on our floor and  no staff even acknowledged our existence or helped us in anyway during our stay.. I was EXTREMELY disappointed and I won't be staying here or recommending it to anyone.

name: Kellie McBride
text: Great staff, clean rooms, and ample parking.

name: Marion Eve Shepley
text: Used to love this line of hotels. But something happened. The linens seem cheap, using just flat sheets to mimic a duvet cover, and the king beds are horrible! This one had a ditch in the middle. An employee even admitted to me that the king beds were to be avoided. They went cheap. Queen beds are better.

name: Jesse Larson
text: I attended a social event at the Hilton Garden Inn. The event was held in a ballroom type area with a large lobby, which provided enough room for many booths plus walking room for those in attendance, plus a stage. The event room was very clean and nicely decorated.

name: Michelle McClain
text: It's our family's favorite!  Sit by the fireplace,  if you can :)

name: Clayton Anderson
text: Visited for a large charity auction. The room it was held in was massive, and could easily accommodate what I believe was 500+ individuals. The food was excellent, and overall, the event was very enjoyable to attend.

name: Kathleen McHenry
text: Awesome staff, so helpful they do a wonderful job, and always a great place to gamble or play cards!!!

name: Janet Morgan
text: Terrible experience.  Dirty, dusty, falling apart. They say all the right things but do very little to fix things. Too bad. Seems they are taking advantage of Phoenix' lure of tourists. Too bad.

name: Rachel Riggs
text: The staff is really great :) especially Nichole in the bar, Will the front desk manager, and Tori at the front desk they have helped me a lot.

name: Ben Stuart
text: Nice hotel, house keeping is not so good, I found an empty bag of chips, a candy andy wrapper under the bed. Not to mention I'm pretty sure the house keeper took a huge dump in the our bathroom, the room smelled absolutely horrid when we checked in. And to top it all off breakfast was 10 dollars a plate.

name: Nevin Graves
text: We were warmly and promptly welcomed at the front desk, and the room was exceptionally comfortable. I would highly recommend this hotel to visitors looking for a quiet, restful evening after a day enjoying the city.

name: Heather Phillips
text: I’ve only attended events at this location. The food is always great, and the servers friendly. I would recommend for small and larger events.

name: Janice Washingto
text: I was traveling for work with my Fiancee. We stayed at the Hotel and she loved the oversized jetted bath tub. The hotel had easy parking and was easy to find from the I 90. Its is a short drive into downtown Missoula for restaurants.

name: Nic Huggins
text: Room felt lacking. Small tvs and having to turn off and on each lamp not on a light switch really is annoying. House keeping should make sure alarms are off when cleaning rooms.

name: Sara Rae
text: Attended a great event here, nice atmosphere. Also the restrooms were spotless all night and this was a huge event.

name: James Raymond
text: Good place for a trade show

name: Rhonda Hasselfeldt
text: LOVED IT! Centrally located, easy to get to the airport, highways, greta restaurant, bar, pool, hot tub. The front desk employees were wonderful and one of them spoke Spanish and that helped with my friends that came from Guatemala. It was a perfect stay and the breakfast they serve was spot on!!!

name: Brandon Follett
text: It's Okay,  don't expect a Hilton stay just because it's a Hilton. More like a holiday Inn express minus the friendliness and  free breakfast. Very convenient that the staff is downstairs anytime at night - - just give them a few to pause the movie they are watching so they can help you. Dramatic lighting in the bathroom is unique as you never know if you'll have both on,  one on,  or if one will shut off halfway through a shower. Plenty of towels provided, though only 2 are needed to lay down on the floor to catch the water leaking out of the toilet or tub - - still trying to figure out that one! Oh and you seriously cannot hear the train over the AC and drunks from the casino... So they do have that going for them!!

name: K B
text: This is the 3rd time I have attended an event at the Hilton Garden Inn. Its a beautiful place and has first class service!

name: Jocelyn Stewart
text: John Edward Group always the best venue. Front desk was helpful thank you

name: Kinder Boyd
text: Clean, comfortable rooms.  Cozy reception area.  Nice bar in the casino.

name: Marsha Kirchner
text: Room was too cold and no coffee.

name: Beth Storey
text:
This is definitely an old Hilton property. While our room was clean, you could tell that maintenance was an issue. The ceiling in the small closet was coming down, and the in-room fridge was falling apart. Also, the handle in the hot tub was being held together with duct tape.
My biggest issue was that the sheets were awful. They were thin, stiff, and very scratchy.

name: John Baldwin
text: Great service and great food

name: Tana Mount
text: We paid for breakfast and then we're told the next day it was free because we booked with Expedia.  It would have been nice to know that when we checked in instead of when we checked out.

name: Ryan Cape
text: Half of the parking lot was consumed by an event tent and had to park far away on the street. The towel rack is in the shower... Interesting design choice.

name: Jeff Harris
text: -Firm bed, but comfortable. -Beer and wine available if someone happens to be working the "bar". No liquor. -Decent restaurant with terrible bar tenders in the parking lot -great casino in the parking lot

name: Jason Simonetti

name: Run-A-Way Bill
text:
Ovando, Montana ---

"Trixi's Antler Saloon" is bar 343 of "666 Bars of 2017" ...

"Trixi's Antler Saloon" has been on Montana Route 200 since 1960.  Owner "Trixi" McCormick was a Montana cowgirl and legendary rodeo/vaudeville/USO entertainer, who was even in 2 movies.

The atmosphere is comfortable, with plenty of "antlers", "Trixi" trivia & other eye-catching bar flair.

Bartender Christine was efficient & interactive ... and gave me "More Smiles Than I Came In With!"

"Trixi's" is a hand-off bar from "Boxcars" bartender Rawnie (Havre, Montana) ... tanx very pARTy Much Rawnie 👍🤠
